shades.explanation: The badhl (substitution) in the Quran is one of the divine acts. The verse 2:61 establishes the complaint of the Children of Israel - they wanted to substitute the better (manna and quails) for the lower (cucumbers and garlic). The badhl in the Quran has multiple meanings - the substitution of one thing for another (tabdil), the exchange of the better for the lower (istibdal), and the transformation of the form (taghyir). The hadith establishes that whoever cheats us is not of us. Al-Ghazali treats the badhl as the divine law - the one who substitutes the divine command for his own desire has gone astray.
shades.hadith_ar: مَنْ غَشَّنَا فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا
shades.hadith_en: Whoever cheats us is not of us

meaning.en: To be short, fall short. The root denotes the state of being short or falling short - and the act of shortening.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْقَصَرُ: ضِدُّ الطُّولِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْقَصَرُ: ضِدُّ الطُّولِ. وَالْقَصِيرُ: ضِدُّ الطَّوِيلِ

quran_examples.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُتَوَفَّوۡنَ مِنكُمۡ وَيَذَرُونَ أَزۡوَٰجًا وَصِيَّةًۭ لِّأَزۡوَٰجِهِم مَّتَـٰعًا إِلَى ٱلۡحَوۡلِ غَيۡرَ إِخۡرَاجٍۢ ۚ فَإِنۡ خَرَجۡنَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فِى مَا فَعَلۡنَ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِنَّ مِن مَّعۡرُوفٍۢ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
quran_examples.en: And those who are taken in death among you and leave wives behind - they, [the wives, shall] wait four months and ten [days]. And when they have fulfilled their term, then there is no blame upon you for what they do with themselves in an acceptable manner. And Allah is Knowing of what you do

hadith.ar: إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْجَمَاعَةَ فَلْيَأْخُذْ نَصِيبَهُ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ
hadith.en: When one of you goes to the gathering, let him take his share from the earth

shades.explanation: The qasr (shortening) in the Quran is one of the legal concepts. The verse 2:240 establishes the waiting period for widows. The qasr in the Quran has multiple meanings - the shortening of the prayer during travel (al-safar), the shortness of the limbs (al-a'rada), and the deficiency in the deeds (al-naqs). The hadith establishes the importance of the gathering. Al-Ghazali treats the qasr as the divine mercy - Allah has made the prayer shorter during travel to ease the burden of the traveler.

meaning.en: To consult, take counsel. The root denotes the act of consulting or taking counsel - and the state of deliberation.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْمُشَاوَرَةُ: اسْتِخْرَاجُ الرَّأْيِ. وَشَاوَرَ: اسْتَخْرَجَ رَأْيَهُ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْمُشَاوَرَةُ: اسْتِبَانَةُ الرَّأْيِ وَطَلَبُ الْوَجْهِ الْأَصْوَبِ فِي الْأَمْرِ

quran_examples.ar: ۞ وَٱلۡوَٰلِدَٰتُ يُرۡضِعۡنَ أَوۡلَـٰدَهُنَّ حَوۡلَيۡنِ كَامِلَيۡنِ ۖ لِمَنۡ أَرَادَ أَن يُتِمَّ ٱلرَّضَاعَةَ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱلۡمَوۡلُودِ لَهُۥ رِزۡقُهُنَّ وَكِسۡوَتُهُنَّ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِ ۚ لَا تُكَلَّفُ نَفۡسٌ إِلَّا وُسۡعَهَا ۚ لَا تُضَآرَّ وَٰلِدَةٌۢ بِوَلَدِهَا وَلَا مَوۡلُودٌۭ لَّهُۥ بِوَلَدِهِۦ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱلۡوَارِثِ مِثۡلُ ذَٰلِكَ ۗ فَإِنۡ أَرَادَا فِصَالًا عَن تَرَاضٍۢ مِّنۡهُمَا وَتَشَاوُرٍۢ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡهِمَا ۚ وَإِنۡ أَرَدتُّمۡ أَن تَسۡتَرۡضِعُوٓاْ أَوۡلَـٰدَكُمۡ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ إِذَا سَلَّمۡتُم مَّآ ءَاتَيۡتُم بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
quran_examples.en: Mothers may breastfeed their children two complete years for whoever wishes to complete the nursing [period]. Upon the father is their provision and clothing according to what is acceptable. No soul shall be burdened beyond its capacity. No mother shall be harmed through her child, nor father through his child. And upon the [father's] heir is a duty similar to that [of the father]. But if they both desire weaning through mutual consent from both of them and consultation, there is no blame upon either of them

hadith.ar: مَا شَقِيَ عَبْدٌ قَطُّ بِمَشُورَةٍ
hadith.en: A servant is never wretched if he takes counsel

shades.explanation: The shura (consultation) in the Quran is one of the divine attributes - Allah commands consultation in His decisions. The verse 2:233 establishes the mutual consultation in weaning. The shura in the Quran has multiple meanings - the divine consultation (al-shura al-ilahiyyah - which is from the perfection of Allah's knowledge), the human consultation (al-shura al-bashariyyah), and the consultation of the heart with itself (al-tafakkur). The hadith establishes that a servant is never wretched if he takes counsel. Al-Ghazali treats the shura as one of the divine attributes - the consultation of Allah with His angels reflects the perfection of His knowledge and the wisdom of His creation.
shades.hadith_ar: مَا شَقِيَ عَبْدٌ قَطُّ بِمَشُورَةٍ
shades.hadith_en: A servant is never wretched if he takes counsel

meaning.en: To deceive, betray. The root denotes the act of deception or betrayal - and the state of being false.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْخَوْنُ: نَقْضُ الْأَمَانَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْخَوْنُ: الْغِشُّ. وَخَانَ: نَقَضَ الْأَمَانَةَ

quran_examples.ar: أُحِلَّ لَكُمۡ لَيۡلَةَ ٱلصِّيَامِ ٱلرَّفَثُ إِلَىٰ نِسَآئِكُمۡ ۚ هُنَّ لِبَاسٌۭ لَّكُمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ لِبَاسٌۭ لَّهُنَّ ۗ عَلِمَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ تَخۡتَانُونَ أَنفُسَكُمۡ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَعَفَا عَنكُمۡ ۖ فَٱلۡـَٔـٰنَ بَـٰشِرُوهُنَّ وَٱبۡتَغُوا۟ مَا كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡ
quran_examples.en: It has been made permissible for you the night preceding fasting to go to your wives. They are clothing for you, and you are clothing for them. Allah knows that you used to betray yourselves, so He accepted your repentance and forgave you. So now, approach them and seek what Allah has prescribed for you
quran_examples.context: The command to not betray during fasting

hadith.ar: إِيَّاكَ وَالْخَيَانَةَ فَإِنَّ الْخَيَانَةَ مَجْلَبَةٌ لِلْفَضِيحَةِ
hadith.en: Beware of betrayal, for betrayal leads to disgrace

shades.explanation: The khiyana (betrayal) in the Quran is one of the major sins. The verse 2:187 establishes the command to not betray during fasting. The khiyana in the Quran is closely related to al-ghish (deception) and al-nifaq (hypocrisy). The hadith establishes that betrayal leads to disgrace. Al-Ghazali treats the khiyana as the opposite of al-amanah (trust) - the one who betrays the trust has no din and no dunya.
shades.hadith_ar: إِيَّاكَ وَالْخَيَانَةَ فَإِنَّ الْخَيَانَةَ مَجْلَبَةٌ لِلْفَضِيحَةِ
shades.hadith_en: Beware of betrayal, for betrayal leads to disgrace

meaning.en: To guide, lead. The root denotes the act of guiding or leading - and the state of being on the right path.
meaning.ar: الْهُدَى: ضِدُّ الضَّلَالِ، الدَّلَالَةُ إِلَى الطَّرِيقِ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْهُدَى: ضِدُّ الضَّلَالِ. وَهَدَاهُ: دَلَّهُ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْهُدَى: الدَّلَالَةُ إِلَى مَا يَقْصِدُهُ الْدَّالُّ. وَالتَّوْفِيقُ مِنَ اللَّهِ: خَلْقُ الْإِرَادَةِ

quran_examples.ar: سَيَقُولُ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَا وَلَّىٰهُمۡ عَن قِبۡلَتِهِمُ ٱلَّتِى كَانُوا۟ عَلَيۡهَا ۚ قُل لِّلَّهِ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقُ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبُ ۚ يَهۡدِىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسۡتَقِيمٍۢ
quran_examples.en: The foolish among the people will say, What has turned them away from their qiblah which they used to face? Say, To Allah belongs the east and the west. He guides whom He wills to a straight path

hadith.ar: مَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْرًا يُصِبْ مِنْهُ
hadith.en: Whomever Allah wishes good for, He afflicts him

shades.explanation: The huda (guidance) in the Quran is one of the most fundamental divine attributes. The verse 2:142 establishes the change of qiblah. The huda in the Quran has multiple levels - the huda of guidance (al-huda al-tablighi - showing the way), the huda of inspiration (al-huda al-ilham - giving the ability to follow), and the huda of salvation (al-huda al-naja - leading to Paradise). The hadith establishes that whomever Allah wishes good for, He afflicts him. Al-Ghazali treats the huda as the ultimate divine gift - the one who has been guided has been given the ultimate blessing.
shades.hadith_ar: مَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْرًا يُصِبْ مِنْهُ
shades.hadith_en: Whomever Allah wishes good for, He afflicts him

meaning.en: To forget, neglect. The root denotes the act of forgetting or neglecting - and the state of being unmindful.
meaning.ar: النِّسْيَانُ: ضِدُّ الْحِفْظِ، تَرْكُ الشَّيْءِ مَعَ كَوْنِهِ فِي الذِّهْنِ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: النِّسْيَانُ: ضِدُّ الْحِفْظِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: النِّسْيَانُ: غَيْبَةُ الشَّيْءِ عَنِ الذِّهْنِ. وَالنَّسْيُ: التَّرْكُ

quran_examples.ar: أَتَأۡمُرُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ بِٱلۡبِرِّ وَتَنسَوۡنَ أَنفُسَكُمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ تَتۡلُونَ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبَ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
quran_examples.en: Do you order righteousness to the people and forget yourselves while you recite the Scripture? Then will you not reason?

hadith.ar: إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ أَنْسَى كَمَا تَنْسَوْنَ
hadith.en: I am only a human, I forget as you forget

shades.explanation: The nisyan (forgetfulness) in the Quran is one of the human traits. The verse 2:44 condemns those who order righteousness to the people but forget themselves. The nisyan in the Quran has multiple meanings - the human forgetfulness (al-nisyan al-bashari), the divine forgetfulness (which is impossible for Allah), and the forgetting of the self (al-nisyan al-nafsi). The hadith establishes that the Prophet forgets as humans forget. Al-Ghazali treats the nisyan as the source of all sin - the one who forgets Allah has fallen into sin, the one who remembers Allah has found the truth.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ أَنْسَى كَمَا تَنْسَوْنَ
shades.hadith_en: I am only a human, I forget as you forget

meaning.en: To encounter, meet face-to-face. The root denotes the act of meeting face-to-face - and the state of being frontal.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْجَبْهَةُ: مَا اسْتَقْبَلَكَ مِنَ الْوَجْهِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْجَبْهَةُ: الْجِهَةُ الَّتِي تُقَابِلُ الْمُقَابِلَ. وَاسْتَجْبَهَهُ: اسْتَقْبَلَهُ

quran_examples.ar: فَوَلِّ وَجۡهَكَ شَطۡرَ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡحَرَامِ ۚ وَحَيۡثُ مَا كُنتُمۡ فَوَلُّوا۟ وُجُوهَكُمۡ شَطۡرَهُۥ
quran_examples.en: So turn your face toward al-Masjid al-Haram. And wherever you [believers] are, turn your faces toward it
quran_examples.context: The command to face the Sacred Mosque

hadith.ar: مَا أَقْبَلَ عَبْدٌ إِلَى اللَّهِ بِوَجْهٍ كُلِّهِ إِلَّا أَقْبَلَ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ بِوَجْهِهِ
hadith.en: No servant turns to Allah with all his face except that Allah turns to him with His face

shades.name_en: al-Jabh - The Forehead and the Encounter
shades.name_ar: الْجَبْهَةُ - الْجِهَةُ مِنَ الْوَجْهِ، مُقَابَلَةُ الشَّيْءِ
shades.explanation: The jabh (forehead, encounter) in the Quran is one of the images of facing. The verse 2:144 establishes the command to face the Sacred Mosque. The jabh in the Quran is closely related to al-muqabala (facing) and al-wajh (face). The hadith establishes that no servant turns to Allah with all his face except that Allah turns to him. Al-Ghazali treats the jabh as the place of prostration - the one who prostrates with his jabh has humbled himself to Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: مَا أَقْبَلَ عَبْدٌ إِلَى اللَّهِ بِوَجْهٍ كُلِّهِ إِلَّا أَقْبَلَ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ بِوَجْهِهِ
shades.hadith_en: No servant turns to Allah with all his face except that Allah turns to him with His face

meaning.en: To crowd, gather, stir. The root denotes the act of crowding or stirring - and the state of being in a crowd.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْحَشْرُ: الْجَمْعُ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْحَشْرُ: جَمْعُ الشَّيْءِ مِنْ مَتَفَرِّقِهِ. وَتَحْشِيشُ الْقَلْبِ: تَحْرِيكُهُ

quran_examples.ar: فَإِذَا قَضَيۡتُم مَّنَاسِكَكُمۡ فَٱذۡكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَذِكۡرِكُمۡ ءَابَآءَكُمۡ أَوۡ أَشَدُّ ذِكۡرًۭا ۚ فَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِى ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَمَا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلۡءَاخِرَةِ مِنۡ خَلَـٰقٍۢ
quran_examples.en: And when you have completed your rites, remember Allah like your [previous] remembrance of your fathers or with [much] greater remembrance. And among the people is he who says, Our Lord, give us in this world, but he will have in the Hereafter no share
quran_examples.context: The remembrance of Allah after Hajj

hadith.ar: حُشُورًا تُحْشَرُونَ
hadith.en: You will be gathered in crowds

shades.name_ar: الْحَشْرُ - جَمْعُ الشَّيْءِ مِنْ مَتَفَرِّقِهِ، يَوْمُ الْحَشْرِ
shades.explanation: The hashr (gathering) in the Quran is one of the great divine acts. The verse 2:200 establishes the remembrance of Allah after Hajj. The hashr in the Quran has multiple meanings - the gathering of the people on the Day of Resurrection (al-hashr al-kubra), the gathering of the believers in the Hereafter (al-hashr al-mu'minin), and the gathering of the disbelievers in the Fire (al-hashr al-mujrimin). The hadith establishes that the people will be gathered in crowds. Al-Ghazali treats the hashr as the ultimate gathering - all of humanity will be gathered before Allah on the Last Day.
shades.hadith_ar: حُشُورًا تُحْشَرُونَ
shades.hadith_en: You will be gathered in crowds

meaning.en: To seek, desire, transgress. The root denotes the act of seeking or desiring - and the state of transgression.
meaning.ar: الْبَغْيُ: طَلَبُ الشَّيْءِ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ. وَالِاسْتِبَاءُ: الِاسْتِكْبَارُ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْبَغْيُ: التَّجَاوُزُ. وَبَغَى: طَلَبَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْبَغْيُ: مُجَاوَزَةُ الْحَدِّ فِي الِاسْتِئْصَالِ وَالِاسْتِطَالَةِ

quran_examples.ar: وَإِذۡ قُلۡتُمۡ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ لَن نَّصۡبِرَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامٍۢ وَٰحِدٍۢ
quran_examples.en: And when you said, O Moses, we will never be patient over one kind of food
quran_examples.context: The complaint of the Children of Israel

hadith.ar: إِيَّاكُمْ وَالْبَغْيَ فَإِنَّ الْبَغْيَ مُحَقِّقٌ لِأَصْحَابِهِ
hadith.en: Beware of transgression, for transgression leads to its followers' doom

shades.name_ar: الْبَغْيُ - مُجَاوَزَةُ الْحَدِّ، طَلَبُ الشَّيْءِ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ
shades.explanation: The baghy (transgression) in the Quran is one of the major sins. The verse 2:61 establishes the complaint of the Children of Israel. The baghy in the Quran has multiple meanings - the transgression of the limit (tajawuz al-hadd), the seeking of something without right (talab bighayr haqq), and the injustice (al-zulm). The hadith establishes that transgression leads to its followers' doom. Al-Ghazali treats the baghy as the source of corruption - the one who transgresses the divine limit has corrupted his own soul.
shades.hadith_ar: إِيَّاكُمْ وَالْبَغْيَ فَإِنَّ الْبَغْيَ مُحَقِّقٌ لِأَصْحَابِهِ
shades.hadith_en: Beware of transgression, for transgression leads to its followers' doom

meaning.en: To slip away, escape. The root denotes the act of slipping away or escaping - and the state of slipping.
meaning.ar: السَّلَالَةُ: مَا يُسْتَخْرَجُ مِنَ الشَّيْءِ. وَسَلَّ: خَرَجَ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: السَّلُّ: الِاسْتِخْرَاجُ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: السَّلُّ: الِاسْتِخْرَاجُ. وَالسَّلَالَةُ: النُّطْفَةُ. وَتَسَلَّلَ: خَرَجَ خُفْيَةً

quran_examples.ar: أَمۡ تُرِيدُونَ أَن تَسۡـَٔلُوا۟ رَسُولَكُمۡ كَمَا سُئِلَ مُوسَىٰ مِن قَبۡلُ ۗ وَمَن يَتَبَدَّلِ ٱلۡكُفۡرَ بِٱلۡإِيمَـٰنِ فَقَدۡ ضَلَّ سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
quran_examples.en: Or do you intend to ask your Messenger as Moses was asked before? And whoever exchanges faith for disbelief has certainly strayed from the right way
quran_examples.context: The warning against asking the Prophet excessive questions

hadith.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ
hadith.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, and I seek refuge in You from incapacity and laziness

shades.name_en: as-Sull - The Slip and the Escape
shades.explanation: The sll (slip, escape) in the Quran is one of the human errors. The verse 2:108 establishes the warning against asking the Prophet excessive questions. The sll in the Quran has multiple meanings - the slip of the tongue (zill al-lisan), the slip of the foot (zill al-qadam), and the slip of the mind (zill al-fikr). The hadith establishes the prayer of refuge from incapacity and laziness. Al-Ghazali treats the sll as the human condition - the one who is aware of his slips has begun the journey of self-purification.
shades.hadith_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ
shades.hadith_en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, and I seek refuge in You from incapacity and laziness

meaning.en: To fabricate, invent, split. The root denotes the act of fabricating or inventing - particularly lies against Allah.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْفِرْيَةُ: الْكَذِبُ. وَفَرَى: اخْتَلَقَ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْفِرْيَةُ: الْبُهْتَانُ وَالْكَذِبُ الْمُتَعَمَّدُ. وَفَرَى الشَّيْءَ: شَقَّهُ

quran_examples.ar: فَوَيۡلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ يَكۡتُبُونَ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبَ بِأَيۡدِيهِمۡ ثُمَّ يَقُولُونَ هَـٰذَا مِنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ لِيَشۡتَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ثَمَنًۭا قَلِيلًۭا ۖ فَوَيۡلٌۭ لَّهُم مِّمَّا كَتَبَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَوَيۡلٌۭ لَّهُم مِّمَّا يَكۡسِبُونَ
quran_examples.en: So woe to those who write the book with their own hands, then say, This is from Allah, to exchange it for a small price. Woe to them for what their hands have written and woe to them for what they earn
quran_examples.context: The condemnation of writing false books

hadith.ar: مَنْ كَذَبَ عَلَيَّ فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنَ النَّارِ
hadith.en: Whoever lies upon me, let him take his seat in the Fire

shades.explanation: The faraya (fabrication) in the Quran is one of the major sins. The verse 2:79 establishes the condemnation of those who write books with their own hands and say this is from Allah. The faraya in the Quran has multiple meanings - the fabrication of lies against Allah (al-faraya al-ilahiyyah), the fabrication of stories (al-faraya al-qisasiyyah), and the splitting of the truth (al-faraya al-haqq). The hadith establishes that whoever lies upon the Prophet should take his seat in the Fire. Al-Ghazali treats the faraya as the worst form of deception - the one who fabricates against Allah has committed the unforgivable sin.
shades.hadith_ar: مَنْ كَذَبَ عَلَيَّ فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنَ النَّارِ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever lies upon me, let him take his seat in the Fire

meaning.en: To resolve, determine, be necessary. The root denotes the act of resolving or determining - and the state of being necessary.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْحَوْمُ: الْإِقْبَالُ عَلَى الشَّيْءِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْحَوْمُ: الْإِقْبَالُ بِحَرْصٍ. وَحَامَ حَوْلَ الشَّيْءِ: أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْهِ

quran_examples.ar: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبُ لَا رَيۡبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًۭى لِّلۡمُتَّقِينَ
quran_examples.en: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah

hadith.ar: حُرِّمَتِ الْحَمْرَةُ وَهِيَ مِنْ عَصِيرِ الْعِنَبِ
hadith.en: Intoxicants are forbidden, they are from the juice of grapes

shades.name_en: al-Humum - The Cares and the Worries
shades.name_ar: الْهُمُومُ - مَا يَشْغَلُ الْقَلْبَ مِنَ الْأَحْزَانِ
shades.explanation: The humum (cares, worries) in the Quran is one of the states of the soul. The verse 2:2 establishes the Quran as the guidance for the muttaqin. The humum in the Quran is closely related to al-ahzan (sorrows) and al-ghumm (concerns). The hadith establishes the prayer of refuge from the humum. Al-Ghazali treats the humum as the burden of the believer - the one who is free from humum has found the true peace of the soul.

meaning.en: To come, arrive. The root denotes the act of coming or arriving - and the state of being present.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: أَتَى: جَاءَ. وَأَصْلُهُ: الْإِقْبَالُ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: أَتَى: قَصَدَ. وَالْإِتْيَانُ: الْمَجِيءُ

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكۡتُمُونَ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبِ وَيَشۡتَرُونَ بِهِۦ ثَمَنًۭا قَلِيلًا
quran_examples.en: Indeed those who conceal what Allah has revealed of the Book and exchange it for a small price

hadith.ar: مَنْ عَامَلَ فَلْيَتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَلْيَجْعَلْ مُدَّةَ أَرْبَعِ سِنِينَ
hadith.en: Whoever works, let him fear Allah and set a period of four years

shades.explanation: The ityan (coming) in the Quran is one of the most fundamental concepts. The verse 2:174 establishes the condemnation of those who conceal revelation. The ityan in the Quran has multiple meanings - the physical coming (al-maji' al-maddi), the temporal coming (al-maji' al-zamani), and the figurative coming (al-maji' al-majazi). The hadith establishes the divine command to fear Allah in transactions. Al-Ghazali treats the ityan as the divine decree - all things come to pass at their appointed time, and the one who knows this is patient.

meaning.en: To refuse, reject. The root denotes the act of refusing or rejecting - and the state of being unwilling.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْإِبَاءُ: الرَّفْضُ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْإِبَاءُ: تَرْكُ الْقَبُولِ. وَأَبَى: رَفَضَ

quran_examples.ar: وَإِذۡ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسۡجُدُوا۟ لِأَدَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓاْ إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ أَبَىٰ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَـٰفِرِينَ
quran_examples.en: And [recall] when We said to the angels, Prostrate before Adam; so they prostrated, except for Iblees. He refused and was arrogant and became of the disbelievers
quran_examples.context: The refusal of Iblees to prostrate

hadith.ar: أَبَى أَنْ يَسْأَلَ رَبَّهُ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ
hadith.en: He refused to ask his Lord three times

shades.name_ar: الْإِبَاءُ - الرَّفْضُ، عَدَمُ الْقَبُولِ، تَرْكُ الطَّاعَةِ
shades.explanation: The iba' (refusal) in the Quran is one of the major sins. The verse 2:34 establishes the refusal of Iblees to prostrate - he refused and was arrogant and became of the disbelievers. The iba' in the Quran has multiple meanings - the refusal of the truth (al-iba' al-haqq), the refusal of obedience (al-iba' al-ta'ah), and the rejection of the divine command (al-iba' al-amr). The hadith establishes that the Prophet Yusuf refused to ask Allah three times - the ultimate refusal was the refusal of sin. Al-Ghazali treats the iba' as the opposite of al-taslim (submission) - the one who refuses the divine command has gone astray.

meaning.en: To flee, run away. The root denotes the act of fleeing or running away - particularly from one's master.
meaning.ar: الْإِبَاقُ: الْهَرَبُ، فِرَارُ الْعَبْدِ مِنْ سَيِّدِهِ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْإِبَاقُ: الْهَرَبُ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْإِبَاقُ: هَرَبُ الْعَبْدِ مِنْ مَوْلَاهُ. وَأَبَقَ: هَرَبَ

quran_examples.ar: وَإِذۡ فَرَقۡنَا بِكُمُ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ فَأَنجَيۡنَـٰكُمۡ وَأَغۡرَقۡنَآ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَأَنتُمۡ تَنظُرُونَ
quran_examples.en: And when We parted the sea for you and saved you and drowned the people of Pharaoh while you were looking on

hadith.ar: إِذَا أَبَقَ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ سَيِّدِهِ فَقَدْ بَرِئَتْ مِنْهُ الذِّمَّةُ
hadith.en: When the slave flees from his master, the covenant is absolved from him

shades.name_ar: الْإِبَاقُ - هَرَبُ الْعَبْدِ مِنْ مَوْلَاهُ، الْفِرَارُ
shades.explanation: The ibaq (flight) in the Quran is one of the images of escape. The verse 2:50 establishes the drowning of Pharaoh's people. The ibaq in the Quran has multiple meanings - the flight from the master (al-ibaq min al-sayyid), the flight from the truth (al-ibaq min al-haqq), and the flight from Allah (al-ibaq min Allah). The hadith establishes that the slave who flees from his master has absolved the covenant. Al-Ghazali treats the ibaq as the ultimate separation - the one who flees from Allah has been separated from His mercy.
shades.hadith_ar: إِذَا أَبَقَ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ سَيِّدِهِ فَقَدْ بَرِئَتْ مِنْهُ الذِّمَّةُ
shades.hadith_en: When the slave flees from his master, the covenant is absolved from him

meaning.en: To be heavy, weighty. The root denotes the state of being heavy or weighty - and the act of burdening.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الثِّقَلُ: ضِدُّ الْخِفَّةِ. وَثَقُلَ الشَّيْءُ: رَجَحَ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الثِّقَلُ: ضِدُّ الْخِفَّةِ. وَالثَّقِيلُ: ضِدُّ الْخَفِيفِ

quran_examples.ar: وَٱسۡتَعِينُوا۟ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ۚ وَإِنَّهَا لَكَبِيرَةٌ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلۡخَـٰشِعِينَ
quran_examples.en: And seek help through patience and prayer, and indeed it is difficult except for the humbly submissive [to Allah]
quran_examples.context: The command to seek help through patience and prayer

hadith.ar: كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ
hadith.en: Two words are light on the tongue, heavy in the balance

shades.name_ar: الثِّقَلُ - ضِدُّ الْخِفَّةِ، الْوَزْنُ الْكَثِيرُ، ثَقَلُ الْآثَامِ
shades.explanation: The thaqal (heaviness) in the Quran is one of the most important concepts. The verse 2:45 establishes the command to seek help through patience and prayer. The thaqal in the Quran has multiple meanings - the heaviness of the body (al-thaqal al-badani), the heaviness of the burden (al-thaqal al-majhul), and the heaviness of the sins (al-thaqal al-dhanb). The hadith establishes the two words that are light on the tongue but heavy in the balance. Al-Ghazali treats the thaqal as the burden of the deeds - the one whose deeds are heavy in the balance has found the ultimate success.
shades.hadith_ar: كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ
shades.hadith_en: Two words are light on the tongue, heavy in the balance

meaning.en: To be pure, clean. The root denotes the state of being pure or clean - and the act of purifying.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الطَّهَارَةُ: ضِدُّ النَّجَاسَةِ. وَطَهُرَ: نَظُفَ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الطَّهَارَةُ: النَّظَافَةُ مِنَ الْأَقْذَارِ. وَالطُّهْرُ: ضِدُّ الْحَيْضِ

quran_examples.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلۡبَيۡتَ مَثَابَةًۭ لِّلنَّاسِ وَأَمۡنًۭا وَٱتَّخِذُوا۟ مِن مَّقَامِ إِبۡرَٰهِـۦمَ مُصَلًّۭى ۖ وَعَهِدۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ إِبۡرَٰهِـۦمَ وَإِسۡمَـٰعِيلَ أَن طَهِّرَا بَيۡتِىَ لِلطَّآئِفِينَ وَٱلۡعَـٰكِفِينَ وَٱلرُّكَّعِ ٱلسُّجُودِ
quran_examples.en: And We made the House a place of return for the people and [a place of] security. And take, [believers], from the standing place of Abraham a place of prayer. And We charged Abraham and Ishmael, [saying], Purify My House for those who perform Tawaf and those who are staying [there] for worship and those who bow and prostrate [in prayer]

hadith.ar: الطُّهُورُ شَطْرُ الْإِيمَانِ
hadith.en: Purification is half of faith

shades.name_ar: الطَّهَارَةُ - النَّظَافَةُ، ضِدُّ النَّجَاسَةِ، طَهَارَةُ الْقَلْبِ
shades.explanation: The tahara (purification) in the Quran is one of the keys to prayer. The verse 2:125 establishes the command to purify the House for the worshippers. The tahara in the Quran has multiple meanings - the physical purification (al-tahara al-maddiyyah), the ritual purification (al-tahara al-shar'iyyah), and the spiritual purification (al-tahara al-ma'nawiyyah). The hadith establishes that purification is half of faith. Al-Ghazali treats the tahara as the foundation of the prayer - the one who does not purify himself cannot stand before Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: الطُّهُورُ شَطْرُ الْإِيمَانِ
shades.hadith_en: Purification is half of faith

meaning.en: To remember, mention. The root denotes the act of remembering or mentioning - and the state of being mindful.
meaning.ar: الذِّكْرُ: ضِدُّ النِّسْيَانِ، حِفْظُ الشَّيْءِ فِي الذِّهْنِ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الذِّكْرُ: ضِدُّ النِّسْيَانِ. وَذَكَرَ: حَفِظَ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الذِّكْرُ: اسْتِحْضَارُ الشَّيْءِ بِالْقَلْبِ أَوِ اللِّسَانِ. وَالذَّكَرُ: ضِدُّ الْأُنْثَى

quran_examples.ar: فَٱذۡكُرُونِىٓ أَذۡكُرۡكُمۡ وَٱشۡكُرُوا۟ لِى وَلَا تَكۡفُرُونِ
quran_examples.en: And remember Me; I will remember you. And thank Me and do not be ungrateful to Me
quran_examples.context: The divine command to remember Allah

hadith.ar: كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَـٰنِ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
hadith.en: Two words are light on the tongue, heavy in the balance, beloved to the Most Merciful: Glory to Allah and praise be to Him, glory to Allah the Magnificent

shades.name_ar: الذِّكْرُ - اسْتِحْضَارُ الشَّيْءِ بِالْقَلْبِ أَوِ اللِّسَانِ، ذِكْرُ اللَّهِ أَعْلَى الْعِبَادَاتِ
shades.explanation: The dhikr (remembrance) in the Quran is the highest form of worship. The verse 2:152 establishes the divine command: 'Remember Me; I will remember you.' The dhikr in the Quran has multiple meanings - the remembrance of the tongue (dhikr al-lisan), the remembrance of the heart (dhikr al-qalb), and the remembrance of the self (dhikr al-nafs). The hadith establishes the two words that are light on the tongue but heavy in the balance. Al-Ghazali (Ihya, Book of Remembrance) treats the dhikr as the highest form of worship - the one who remembers Allah has found the ultimate treasure.
shades.hadith_ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
shades.hadith_en: Glory to Allah and praise be to Him, glory to Allah the Magnificent

meaning.en: To ride, mount. The root denotes the act of riding or mounting - and the act of composing or building.
meaning.ar: الرُّكُوبُ: الِاسْتِوَاءُ عَلَى الظَّهْرِ. وَالرَّكْبُ: الْمَرْكُوبُ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الرُّكُوبُ: الِاسْتِوَاءُ عَلَى الْمَرْكُوبِ. وَرَكِبَ: عَلَا
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الرُّكُوبُ: الِاسْتِوَاءُ عَلَى الظَّهْرِ. وَتَرْكِيبُ الشَّيْءِ: بِنَاؤُهُ مِنْ أَجْزَاءٍ

quran_examples.ar: لَآ إِكۡرَاهَ فِى ٱلدِّينِ ۖ قَد تَّبَيَّنَ ٱلرُّشۡدُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَىۦ ۚ فَمَن يَكۡفُرۡ بِٱلطَّـٰغُوتِ وَيُؤۡمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدِ ٱسۡتَمۡسَكَ بِٱلۡعُرۡوَةِ ٱلۡوُثۡقَىٰ لَا ٱنفِصَامَ لَهَا ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
quran_examples.en: There is no compulsion in religion. The right path has become distinct from the wrong. So whoever disbelieves in Taghut and believes in Allah has grasped the most trustworthy handhold with no break in it. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing

hadith.ar: الرَّاكِبُ شَيْطَانٌ وَالرَّاجِلُ شَيْطَانٌ وَالْمَاشِي شَيْطَانٌ
hadith.en: The rider is a devil, the walker is a devil, and the one who goes by foot is a devil - except for one who has a need

shades.name_ar: الرُّكُوبُ - الِاسْتِوَاءُ عَلَى الظَّهْرِ، تَرْكِيبُ الشَّيْءِ
shades.explanation: The rukub (riding) in the Quran is one of the divine favors. The verse 2:256 establishes that there is no compulsion in religion. The rukub in the Quran has multiple meanings - the riding of animals (al-rukub al-hayawani), the riding of ships (al-rukub al-bahri), and the composition of things (al-tarkib). The hadith establishes that the rider is a devil - meaning that the one who moves without purpose has been distracted from Allah. Al-Ghazali treats the rukub as the divine favor - the one who rides on the land and the sea has been blessed by Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: الرَّاكِبُ شَيْطَانٌ وَالرَّاجِلُ شَيْطَانٌ
shades.hadith_en: The rider is a devil, the walker is a devil

meaning.en: To be righteous, good. The root denotes the state of being righteous or good - and the act of reconciling.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الصَّلَاحُ: ضِدُّ الْفَسَادِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الصَّلَاحُ: ضِدُّ الْفَسَادِ. وَالصَّالِحُ: ضِدُّ الطَّالِحِ. وَأَصْلُهُ: الْجَرْحُ الَّذِي يَبْرَأُ

quran_examples.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ ءَامِنُوا۟ كَمَآ ءَامَنَ ٱلنَّاسُ قَالُوٓاْ أَنُؤۡمِنُ كَمَآ ءَامَنَ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّهُمۡ هُمُ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا يَعۡلَمُونَ
quran_examples.en: And when it is said to them, Believe as the people have believed, they say, Should we believe as the fools have believed? Unquestionably, it is they who are the fools, but they know not

hadith.ar: مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ إِلَّا وَلَهُ عَمَلٌ يَتَقَرَّبُ بِهِ إِلَى اللَّهِ
hadith.en: There is no servant except that he has a deed by which he draws near to Allah

shades.name_ar: الصَّلَاحُ - ضِدُّ الْفَسَادِ، حُسْنُ الْحَالِ، الْإِصْلَاحُ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ
shades.explanation: The salah (righteousness) in the Quran is one of the highest attributes. The verse 2:13 establishes the condemnation of the hypocrites. The salah in the Quran has multiple meanings - the personal righteousness (al-salah al-fardi), the social righteousness (al-salah al-ijtima'i), and the cosmic righteousness (al-salah al-kawmi). The hadith establishes that there is no servant except that he has a deed by which he draws near to Allah. Al-Ghazali treats the salah as the foundation of the afterlife - the one whose deeds are salih has found the ultimate success.
shades.hadith_ar: مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ إِلَّا وَلَهُ عَمَلٌ يَتَقَرَّبُ بِهِ إِلَى اللَّهِ
shades.hadith_en: There is no servant except that he has a deed by which he draws near to Allah

meaning.en: To make, do, manufacture. The root denotes the act of making or manufacturing - and the careful production.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الصَّنْعَةُ: الْعَمَلُ بِحِرْفَةٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الصَّنْعَةُ: الْعَمَلُ فِي شَيْءٍ بِحِرْفَةٍ

quran_examples.ar: وَإِذۡ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوۡمِهِۦ يَـٰقَوۡمِ إِنَّكُمۡ ظَلَمۡتُمۡ أَنفُسَكُم بِٱتِّخَاذِكُمُ ٱلۡعِجۡلَ فَتُوبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ بَارِئِكُمۡ فَٱقۡتُلُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡ
quran_examples.en: And when Moses said to his people, O my people, you have certainly wronged yourselves by your taking of the calf [for worship]. So repent to your Creator and kill yourselves
quran_examples.context: Moses' call to repent after worshipping the calf

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ إِذَا عَمِلَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَمَلًا أَنْ يُتْقِنَهُ
hadith.en: Indeed Allah loves that when one of you does a deed, he does it with itqan (excellence)

shades.name_ar: الصَّنْعَةُ - الْعَمَلُ بِحِرْفَةٍ، الِاتِّقَانُ فِي الْعَمَلِ
shades.explanation: The sun' (manufacturing) in the Quran is the act of careful production. The verse 2:54 establishes Moses' call to repent. The sun' in the Quran is closely related to al-amal (action) and al-hirfa (craft). The hadith establishes that Allah loves that when one of you does a deed, he does it with excellence (itqan). Al-Ghazali treats the sun' as the divine attribute - Allah is the Creator (as-Sani') of all things, and the one who does a deed with excellence has been blessed.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ إِذَا عَمِلَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَمَلًا أَنْ يُتْقِنَهُ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed Allah loves that when one of you does a deed, he does it with excellence

meaning.en: To flow, run. The root denotes the act of flowing or running - particularly of water.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْجَرْيُ: سَيَلَانُ الْمَاءِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْجَرْيُ: الْمَضِيُّ سَرِيعًا. وَجَرَى الْمَاءُ: سَالَ

quran_examples.ar: ثُمَّ قَسَتۡ قُلُوبُكُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَ فَهِىَ كَٱلۡحِجَارَةِ أَوۡ أَشَدُّ قَسۡوَةًۭ ۚ وَإِنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡحِجَارَةِ لَمَا يَتَفَجَّرُ مِنۡهُ ٱلۡأَنۡهَـٰرُ ۚ وَإِنَّ مِنۡهَا لَمَا يَشَّقَّقُ فَيَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهُ ٱلۡمَآءُ ۚ وَإِنَّ مِنۡهَا لَمَا يَهۡبِطُ مِنۡ خَشۡيَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَـٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
quran_examples.en: Then your hearts became hardened after that, being like stones or even harder. For indeed, there are stones from which rivers burst forth, and there are some of them that split open and water comes out, and there are some of them that fall down for fear of Allah. And Allah is not unaware of what you do

hadith.ar: كُنَّا إِذَا أَصَابَتْنَا مُصِيبَةٌ قُلْنَا: لِلَّهِ أَنَا بَالُهُ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ
hadith.en: When a calamity befell us, we would say: To Allah we belong and to Him we shall return

shades.explanation: The jary (flowing) in the Quran is one of the natural phenomena. The verse 2:74 establishes the hardness of the hearts - the stones from which rivers burst forth. The jary in the Quran has multiple meanings - the flowing of water (jary al-ma'), the running of horses (jary al-khayl), and the passage of time (jary al-zaman). The hadith establishes the saying at the time of calamity. Al-Ghazali treats the jary as the divine decree - the one who flows with the divine will has found peace.

meaning.en: To pass away, expire. The root denotes the act of passing away or expiring - and the state of being lost.
meaning.ar: الْفَوْتُ: ضِيَاعُ الشَّيْءِ بَعْدَ إِمْكَانِ الْإِدْرَاكِ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْفَوْتُ: ضِيَاعُ الشَّيْءِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْفَوْتُ: سُوقُ الشَّيْءِ مَرًّا وَاحِدًا. وَفَاتَ: مَضَى

quran_examples.ar: سَيَقُولُ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَا وَلَّىٰهُمۡ عَن قِبۡلَتِهِمُ ٱلَّتِى كَانُوا۟ عَلَيۡهَا ۚ قُل لِّلَّهِ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقُ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبُ ۚ يَهۡدِىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسۡتَقِيمٍۢ
quran_examples.en: The foolish among the people will say, What has turned them away from their qiblah which they used to face? Say, To Allah belongs the east and the west. He guides whom He wills to a straight path

hadith.ar: إِذَا مَاتَ ابْنُ آدَمَ انْقَطَعَ عَمَلُهُ إِلَّا مِنْ ثَلَاثٍ
hadith.en: When the son of Adam dies, his deeds cease except for three

shades.explanation: The fawt (passing away) in the Quran is one of the images of loss. The verse 2:141 establishes the change of qiblah. The fawt in the Quran has multiple meanings - the passing away of time (fawt al-zaman), the loss of opportunity (fawt al-fursah), and the death of a person (fawt al-shakh). The hadith establishes that when the son of Adam dies, his deeds cease except for three. Al-Ghazali treats the fawt as the urgency of action - the one who realizes that time passes has begun the journey of self-purification.
shades.hadith_ar: إِذَا مَاتَ ابْنُ آدَمَ انْقَطَعَ عَمَلُهُ إِلَّا مِنْ ثَلَاثٍ
shades.hadith_en: When the son of Adam dies, his deeds cease except for three

meaning.en: To be hidden, concealed. The root denotes the state of being hidden or concealed - and the act of concealing.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْخَفَاءُ: ضِدُّ الْجَهْرِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْخَفَاءُ: ضِدُّ الْجَهْرِ. وَأَخْفَيْتُ الشَّيْءَ: سَتَرْتُهُ

quran_examples.ar: أَوَلَا يَعۡلَمُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَ
quran_examples.en: Do they not know that Allah knows what they conceal and what they declare?
quran_examples.context: Allah knows the hidden and the declared

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَفِيقٌ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ فِي الْأَمْرِ كُلِّهِ
hadith.en: Indeed Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all affairs

shades.name_ar: الْخَفَاءُ - ضِدُّ الْجَهْرِ، الِاسْتِتَارُ، سِرُّ الْقَلْبِ
shades.explanation: The khafa' (concealment) in the Quran is one of the divine attributes - Allah is al-Khabir (the All-Aware of the hidden). The verse 2:77 establishes that Allah knows what they conceal and what they declare. The khafa' in the Quran has multiple meanings - the physical concealment (al-khafa' al-maddi), the spiritual concealment (al-khafa' al-ma'nawi), and the divine knowledge of the hidden (al-ilm al-khafiy). The hadith establishes that Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all affairs. Al-Ghazali treats the khafa' as the divine knowledge of the unseen - the one who knows that Allah knows the hidden has attained ihsan.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَفِيقٌ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ فِي الْأَمْرِ كُلِّهِ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all affairs

meaning.en: To judge, be wise. The root denotes the act of judging or being wise - and the divine judgment.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْحُكْمُ: الْمَنْعُ. وَالْحَاكِمُ: الْمَانِعُ مِنَ الظُّلْمِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْحُكْمُ: الْقَضَاءُ بِالْعِلْمِ. وَالْحِكْمَةُ: الْعِلْمُ مَعَ الْعَمَلِ

quran_examples.ar: وَقَالَتِ ٱلۡيَهُودُ لَيۡسَتِ ٱلنَّصَـٰرَىٰ عَلَىٰ شَىۡءٍۢ وَقَالَتِ ٱلنَّصَـٰرَىٰ لَيۡسَتِ ٱلۡيَهُودُ عَلَىٰ شَىۡءٍۢ وَهُمۡ يَتۡلُونَ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبَ ۗ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ مِثۡلَ قَوۡلِهِمۡ ۚ فَٱللَّهُ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَـٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ
quran_examples.en: The Jews say the Christians have nothing [true] to stand on, and the Christians say the Jews have nothing [true] to stand on, though they [both] recite the Scripture. Thus the ignorant say the same of them. But Allah will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ
quran_examples.context: The divine judgment between the sects

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمْ يَجْعَلْ لِعَبْدِهِ الصَّالِحِ خُلُوفًا إِلَّا عَلَى قَدْرِ حَالِهِ
hadith.en: Indeed Allah does not give the righteous servant contradictions except in proportion to his state

shades.name_ar: الْحُكْمُ - الْقَضَاءُ بِالْحَقِّ، الْإِحْكَامُ، حُكْمُ اللَّهِ الْعَدْلُ
shades.explanation: The hukm (judgment) in the Quran is one of the divine attributes - al-Hakam (the Judge). The verse 2:113 establishes that Allah will judge between the Jews and the Christians on the Day of Resurrection. The hukm in the Quran has multiple meanings - the divine judgment (al-hukm al-ilahi), the human judgment (al-hukm al-bashari), and the wisdom (al-hikmah). Al-Ghazali (Maqsad al-Asna) treats al-Hakam as one of the divine attributes - Allah judges with perfect justice, and the one who submits to His judgment has found the ultimate peace.

meaning.en: To form, image, picture. The root denotes the act of forming or imaging - and the divine shaping of creation.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الصُّورَةُ: الْهَيْئَةُ الْمُجَوَّفَةُ. وَصَوَّرَ: جَعَلَ لَهُ صُورَةً
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الصُّورَةُ: هَيْئَةُ الشَّيْءِ مِنْ حَيْثُ هُوَ مَتَصَوِّرٌ. وَالتَّصْوِيرُ: إِعْطَاءُ الصُّورَةِ

quran_examples.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَسَوَّىٰهُنَّ سَبۡعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍۢ ۚ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىۡءٍ عَلِيمٌ
quran_examples.en: It is He who created for you all of that which is on the earth. Then He directed Himself to the heaven, and made them seven heavens, and He is Knowing of all things
quran_examples.context: The creation of the heavens and earth

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَ آدَمَ عَلَى صُورَتِهِ
hadith.en: Indeed Allah created Adam in His image

shades.explanation: The sura (image, form) in the Quran is one of the divine acts - Allah is al-Musawwir (the Shaper). The verse 2:29 establishes the creation of all that is on the earth. The sura in the Quran has multiple meanings - the physical form (al-sura al-maddiyyah), the spiritual form (al-sura al-ma'nawiyyah), and the divine form (al-sura al-ilahiyyah - 'created Adam in His image'). The hadith establishes that Allah created Adam in His image. Al-Ghazali (Maqsad al-Asna) treats al-Musawwir as one of the divine attributes - Allah shaped His creation in the most beautiful form.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَ آدَمَ عَلَى صُورَتِهِ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed Allah created Adam in His image

meaning.en: To understand, comprehend deeply. The root denotes the act of deep understanding or comprehension - particularly of religion.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْفِقْهُ: الْإِدْرَاكُ. وَفَقِهَ: فَهِمَ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْفِقْهُ: إِدْرَاكُ الْمَعْنَى الْبَعِيدِ مِنَ الْكَلَامِ. وَالْفَقِيهُ: مَنْ أَدْرَكَ الْمَعَانِيَ الْبَعِيدَةَ

quran_examples.ar: أَفَتَطۡمَعُونَ أَن يُؤۡمِنُوا۟ لَكُمۡ وَقَدۡ كَانَ فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنۡهُمۡ يَسۡمَعُونَ كَلَـٰمَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُحَرِّفُونَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا عَقَلُوهُ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُونَ
quran_examples.en: Do you covet [the hope] that they would believe for you while a party of them used to hear the words of Allah and then distort it after they had understood it, while they were knowing?
quran_examples.context: The Jews distorting the words of Allah

hadith.ar: مَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيۡرًا يُفَقِّهۡهُ فِي الدِّينِ
hadith.en: Whomever Allah wishes good for, He grants him understanding of the religion

shades.name_ar: الْفِقْهُ - إِدْرَاكُ الْمَعْنَى الْبَعِيدِ، فِقْهُ الدِّينِ
shades.explanation: The fiqh (deep understanding) in the Quran is one of the highest stations of knowledge. The verse 2:75 establishes the condemnation of those who distort the words of Allah after they have understood them. The fiqh in the Quran has multiple meanings - the understanding of the religion (fiqh al-din), the understanding of the Quran (fiqh al-Quran), and the understanding of the hadith (fiqh al-hadith). The hadith establishes that whomever Allah wishes good for, He grants him understanding of the religion. Al-Ghazali (Ihya) treats the fiqh as the highest station of knowledge - the one who has fiqh of the religion has been given the ultimate treasure.
shades.hadith_ar: مَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيۡرًا يُفَقِّهۡهُ فِي الدِّينِ
shades.hadith_en: Whomever Allah wishes good for, He grants him understanding of the religion

meaning.en: To fabricate, lie. The root denotes the act of fabricating or lying - particularly against Allah.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْإِفْكُ: الْكَذِبُ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْإِفْكُ: الْكَذِبُ الْمُتَعَمَّدُ. وَأَفَكَ: صَرَفَ

quran_examples.ar: وَإِذۡ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأۡمُرُكُمۡ أَن تَذۡبَحُوا۟ بَقَرَةًۭ ۖ قَالُوا۟ أَتَتَّخِذُنَا هُزُوًۭا ۖ قَالَ أَعُوذُ بِٱللَّهِ أَنۡ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡجَـٰهِلِينَ
quran_examples.en: And [recall] when Moses said to his people, Indeed Allah commands you to slaughter a cow. They said, Do you take us in ridicule? He said, I seek refuge in Allah from being among the ignorant
quran_examples.context: The command to slaughter a cow

hadith.ar: مَنْ أَفْتَرَى عَلَيَّ حَدِيثًا فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنَ النَّارِ
hadith.en: Whoever fabricates a hadith upon me, let him take his seat in the Fire

shades.explanation: The ifk (fabrication, lie) in the Quran is one of the major sins. The verse 2:67 establishes Moses' command to slaughter a cow and the people's ridicule. The ifk in the Quran is closely related to al-faraya (fabrication) and al-kidhb (lie). The hadith establishes that whoever fabricates a hadith upon the Prophet should take his seat in the Fire. Al-Ghazali treats the ifk as the worst form of corruption - the one who fabricates against Allah has corrupted his religion.
shades.hadith_ar: مَنْ أَفْتَرَى عَلَيَّ حَدِيثًا فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنَ النَّارِ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever fabricates a hadith upon me, let him take his seat in the Fire

meaning.en: To worship, serve. The root denotes the act of worshipping or serving - particularly Allah alone.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْعِبَادَةُ: الْخُضُوعُ. وَعَبَدَ اللَّهَ: أَطَاعَهُ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْعِبَادَةُ: أَفْضَلُ أَنْوَاعِ الْخُضُوعِ، وَهِيَ انْقِيَادٌ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى بِطَاعَتِهِ وَامْتِثَالِ أَوَامِرِهِ

quran_examples.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱعۡبُدُوا۟ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمۡ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَتَّقُونَ
quran_examples.en: O mankind, worship your Lord who created you and those before you that you may become righteous
quran_examples.context: The command to worship the Lord

hadith.ar: أَفْضَلُ الْإِسْلَامِ أَنْ تَشْهَدَ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
hadith.en: The best of Islam is to testify that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah

shades.name_ar: الْعِبَادَةُ - أَفْضَلُ أَنْوَاعِ الْخُضُوعِ، انْقِيَادٌ لِلَّهِ بِطَاعَتِهِ
shades.explanation: The ibada (worship) in the Quran is the highest purpose of creation. The verse 2:21 establishes the divine command to worship your Lord who created you. The ibada in the Quran has multiple meanings - the ritual worship (al-ibada al-tashri'iyyah), the spiritual worship (al-ibada al-ruhaniyyah), and the universal worship (al-ibada al-kawniyyah - all creation worships Allah in its own way). The hadith establishes that the best of Islam is the testimony of faith. Al-Ghazali (Ihya, Book of Worship) treats the ibada as the ultimate purpose of life - the one who worships Allah has found the ultimate meaning of existence.
shades.hadith_ar: أَفْضَلُ الْإِسْلَامِ أَنْ تَشْهَدَ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
shades.hadith_en: The best of Islam is to testify that there is no god but Allah

meaning.en: To be soft, fine, delicate. The root denotes the state of being soft or delicate - particularly of the heart.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الرِّقَّةُ: ضِدُّ الْغِلَظَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الرِّقَّةُ: ضِدُّ الْغِلَظَةِ. وَالرَّقِيقُ: ضِدُّ الْغَلِيظِ

quran_examples.ar: ثُمَّ قَسَتۡ قُلُوبُكُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَ فَهِىَ كَٱلۡحِجَارَةِ أَوۡ أَشَدُّ قَسۡوَةًۭ
quran_examples.en: Then your hearts became hardened after that, being like stones or even harder

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَفِيقٌ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ فِي الْأَمْرِ كُلِّهِ
hadith.en: Indeed Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all affairs

shades.explanation: The riqa (softness) in the Quran is one of the qualities of the heart. The verse 2:74 establishes the hardness of the hearts as the opposite of riqa. The riqa in the Quran has multiple meanings - the softness of the heart (riqa al-qalb), the softness of the sky (riqa al-sama'), and the softness of the clouds (riqa al-sahab). The hadith establishes that Allah is gentle and loves gentleness. Al-Ghazali treats the riqa as the quality of the believer's heart - the one whose heart is soft has found the way to Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَفِيقٌ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ فِي الْأَمْرِ كُلِّهِ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all affairs

meaning.en: To be ignorant, act foolishly. The root denotes the state of being ignorant or foolish - and the act of striving against someone.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْجَهْلُ: ضِدُّ الْعِلْمِ. وَأَصْلُهُ: الْخِفَّةُ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْجَهْلُ: عَدَمُ الْعِلْمِ بِالشَّيْءِ. وَالْجَاهِلِيَّةُ: الْحَالَةُ الَّتِي كَانَتْ قَبْلَ الْإِسْلَامِ

quran_examples.ar: قَالَ أَعُوذُ بِٱللَّهِ أَنۡ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡجَـٰهِلِينَ
quran_examples.en: He said, I seek refuge in Allah from being among the ignorant

hadith.ar: لَا تَسُبُّوا أَصْحَابِي فَلَوْ أَنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ أَنْفَقَ مِثْلَ أُحُدٍ مَا بَلَغَ مُدَّ أَحَدِهِمْ وَلَا نَصِيفَهُ
hadith.en: Do not curse my Companions, for if one of you were to spend the equivalent of Mount Uhud in gold, it would not equal a mudd (handful) of one of them, nor even half of it

shades.explanation: The jahl (ignorance) in the Quran is one of the human conditions. The verse 2:67 establishes Moses' refuge from ignorance. The jahl in the Quran has multiple meanings - the simple ignorance (al-jahl al-basit), the compound ignorance (al-jahl al-murakkab - thinking one knows when one does not), and the willful ignorance (al-jahl al-'inad). The hadith establishes the honor of the Companions over the later generations. Al-Ghazali (Ihya) treats the jahl as the opposite of al-'ilm (knowledge) - the one who is ignorant of Allah has fallen into the lowest station.

meaning.en: To be few, light. The root denotes the state of being few or light - and the decrease of time.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْقَهْلُ: قِلَّةُ الشَّيْءِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْقَهْلُ: قِلَّةُ الشَّيْءِ. وَقَهِلَ: قَلَّ

quran_examples.ar: مَثَلُهُمۡ كَمَثَلِ ٱلَّذِى ٱسۡتَوۡقَدَ نَارًۭا فَلَمَّآ أَضَآءَتۡ مَا حَوۡلَهُۥ ذَهَبَ ٱللَّهُ بِنُورِهِمۡ وَتَرَكَهُمۡ فِى ظُلُمَـٰتٍۢ لَّا يُبۡصِرُونَ
quran_examples.en: Their example is that of one who kindled a fire, but when it illuminated what was around him, Allah took away their light and left them in darkness [so] they could not see

hadith.ar: إِيَّاكُمْ وَالْجَهْلَ فَإِنَّ الْجَهْلَ مِنَ الْمَعَاصِي
hadith.en: Beware of ignorance, for ignorance is from the sins

shades.explanation: The qahl (fewness, lightness) in the Quran is one of the natural states. The verse 2:17 establishes the parable of the hypocrites - their light was taken away. The qahl in the Quran is closely related to al-qillah (fewness) and al-khiffa (lightness). Al-Razi treats the qahl as the decrease of time - the one who knows that time is decreasing has begun the journey of wisdom.

meaning.en: To wink, hint. The root denotes the act of winking or hinting - and the act of gesturing.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الرَّمْزُ: الْإِشَارَةُ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الرَّمْزُ: إِشَارَةٌ بِالْعَيْنِ أَوِ الْحَاجِبِ

quran_examples.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَقُولُوا۟ رَٰعِنَا وَقُولُوا۟ ٱنظُرۡنَا وَٱسۡمَعُوا۟ ۚ وَلِلۡكَـٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
quran_examples.en: O you who have believed, say not [to Allah's Messenger], Ra'ina but say, Unzurna and listen. And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment
quran_examples.context: The command not to say ra'ina

hadith.ar: إِذَا أَوْتَمِنَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَأْدِ الَّذِي ائْتُمِنَ عَلَيْهِ
hadith.en: When one of you is entrusted, let him fulfill the trust

shades.explanation: The ramz (winking, hinting) in the Quran is one of the methods of communication. The verse 2:104 establishes the command not to say 'ra'ina' (which the Jews distorted). The ramz in the Quran is closely related to al-ishara (signaling) and al-kinaya (metaphor). Al-Razi treats the ramz as the subtle communication - the one who understands the ramz of the Quran has entered the inner circle of knowledge.

meaning.en: To be safe, submit, greet. The root denotes the state of being safe or submitted - and the act of greeting.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: السَّلَامُ: ضِدُّ الْحَرْبِ. وَسَلِمَ: خَلَصَ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: السَّلَامُ: ضِدُّ الْحَرْبِ. وَالْإِسْلَامُ: الِانْقِيَادُ لِلَّهِ

quran_examples.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱدۡخُلُوا۟ فِى ٱلسِّلۡمِ كَآفَّةًۭ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيۡطَـٰنِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌ
quran_examples.en: O you who have believed, enter into Islam completely and do not follow the footsteps of Satan. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy
quran_examples.context: The command to enter Islam completely

hadith.ar: لَا تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّى تُؤْمِنُوا وَلَا تُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّى تَحَابُّوا
hadith.en: You will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another

shades.name_ar: السَّلَامُ - ضِدُّ الْحَرْبِ، الْأَمَانُ، الِانْقِيَادُ لِلَّهِ
shades.explanation: The salam (peace, submission) in the Quran is one of the names of Allah - as-Salam. The verse 2:208 establishes the command to enter Islam completely. The salam in the Quran has multiple meanings - the peace of the world (al-salam al-dunya), the peace of the heart (al-salam al-qalb), and the ultimate peace of Paradise (al-salam al-janna). The hadith establishes that you will not enter Paradise until you believe and love one another. Al-Ghazali (Maqsad al-Asna) treats as-Salam as one of the divine names - Allah is the source of all peace, and the one who establishes peace among people has been blessed.
shades.hadith_ar: لَا تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّى تُؤْمِنُوا وَلَا تُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّى تَحَابُّوا
shades.hadith_en: You will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another

meaning.en: To be bad, evil. The root denotes the state of being bad or evil - and the act of doing evil.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: السُّوءُ: ضِدُّ الْحُسْنِ. وَسَاءَ: صَارَ سَيِّئًا
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: السُّوءُ: ضِدُّ الْحُسْنِ. وَالسَّيِّئُ: ضِدُّ الْحَسَنِ

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّمَا يَأۡمُرُكُم بِٱلسُّوٓءِ وَٱلۡفَحۡشَآءِ وَأَن تَقُولُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
quran_examples.en: He only orders you to evil and immorality and to say about Allah what you do not know

hadith.ar: سُوءُ الْخُلُقِ يُفْسِدُ الْعَمَلَ كَمَا يُفْسِدُ الْخَلُّ الْعَسَلَ
hadith.en: Bad character corrupts deeds, as vinegar corrupts honey

shades.explanation: The su' (evil) in the Quran is one of the most important concepts. The verse 2:169 establishes that the devil only orders you to evil and immorality. The su' in the Quran has multiple meanings - the moral evil (al-su' al-akhlaqi), the physical evil (al-su' al-maddi), and the spiritual evil (al-su' al-ruhani). The hadith establishes that bad character corrupts deeds as vinegar corrupts honey. Al-Ghazali (Ihya, Book of Discipline of the Soul) treats the su' as the opposite of al-husn (good) - the one who purifies himself from the su' has found the ultimate success.
shades.hadith_ar: سُوءُ الْخُلُقِ يُفْسِدُ الْعَمَلَ كَمَا يُفْسِدُ الْخَلُّ الْعَسَلَ
shades.hadith_en: Bad character corrupts deeds, as vinegar corrupts honey

meaning.en: To incline, deviate. The root denotes the act of inclining or deviating - particularly from the truth.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الصَّغْوُ: الْمَيْلُ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الصَّغْوُ: مَيْلُ الْأُذُنِ عَنِ السَّمَاعِ. وَصَغَا: مَالَ

quran_examples.ar: وَإِذۡ أَخَذۡنَا مِيثَـٰقَكُمۡ وَرَفَعۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمُ ٱلطُّورَ خُذُوا۟ مَآ ءَاتَيۡنَـٰكُم بِقُوَّةٍۢ وَٱسۡمَعُوا۟ ۖ قَالُوا۟ سَمِعۡنَا وَعَصَيۡنَا
quran_examples.en: And when We took your covenant and raised over you the mount, Take what We have given you with determination and listen. They said, We hear and disobey
quran_examples.context: The covenant of the Children of Israel

hadith.ar: سَيَكُونُ فِي أُمَّتِي قَوْمٌ يَعْدِلُونَ عَنِ الْحَقِّ
hadith.en: There will be in my Ummah a people who will deviate from the truth

shades.explanation: The saghu (inclination, deviation) in the Quran is one of the deviations of the heart. The verse 2:93 establishes that the Children of Israel said 'we hear and disobey' - they inclined away from the truth. The saghu in the Quran is closely related to al-mayl (inclination) and al-inhiraf (deviation). The hadith establishes that there will be in this Ummah a people who will deviate from the truth. Al-Ghazali treats the saghu as the deviation of the heart - the one who inclines away from the truth has fallen into misguidance.
shades.hadith_ar: سَيَكُونُ فِي أُمَّتِي قَوْمٌ يَعْدِلُونَ عَنِ الْحَقِّ
shades.hadith_en: There will be in my Ummah a people who will deviate from the truth

meaning.en: To be small, young. The root denotes the state of being small or young - and the act of despising.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الصِّغَرُ: ضِدُّ الْكِبَرِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الصِّغَرُ: ضِدُّ الْكِبَرِ. وَصَغُرَ الشَّيْءُ: حَقُرَ

quran_examples.ar: وَٱسۡتَشۡهِدُوا۟ شَهِيدَيۡنِ مِن رِّجَالِكُمۡ فَإِن لَّمۡ يَكُونَا رَجُلَيۡنِ فَرَجُلٌۭ وَٱمۡرَأَتَانِ مِمَّن تَرۡضَوۡنَ مِنَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءِ
quran_examples.en: And get two men to testify, or one man and two women from those whom you accept as witnesses

hadith.ar: لَا تَحْقِرَنَّ مِنَ الْمَعْرُوفِ شَيْئًا وَلَوْ أَنْ تَلْقَى أَخَاكَ بِوَجۡهٍ طَلۡقٍ
hadith.en: Do not despise any act of kindness, even if it is just meeting your brother with a smiling face

shades.explanation: The sighar (smallness) in the Quran is one of the natural states. The verse 2:282 establishes the command for witnesses. The sighar in the Quran has multiple meanings - the smallness of age (sighar al-sinn), the smallness of value (sighar al-qadr), and the smallness of the act (sighar al-amal). The hadith establishes that one should not despise any act of kindness, even if it is just meeting your brother with a smiling face. Al-Ghazali treats the sighar as the smallness of the soul - the one who despises the small deeds has lost the way to Paradise.
shades.hadith_ar: لَا تَحْقِرَنَّ مِنَ الْمَعْرُوفِ شَيْئًا
shades.hadith_en: Do not despise any act of kindness

meaning.en: To write, prescribe, decree. The root denotes the act of writing or prescribing - and the divine decree.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْكِتَابَةُ: ضِبْطُ الْحُرُوفِ. وَكَتَبَ: صَوَّرَ الْحُرُوفَ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْكِتَابُ: ضِبْطُ الشَّيْءِ بِحُرُوفِ الْهِجَاءِ. وَالْكِتَابُ: الْقَضَاءُ الْمُقَدَّرُ

quran_examples.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُتِبَ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلصِّيَامُ كَمَا كُتِبَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَتَّقُونَ
quran_examples.en: O you who have believed, decreed upon you is fasting as it was decreed upon those before you that you may become righteous

hadith.ar: كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْقِتَالُ وَهُوَ كُرْهٌ لَّكُمْ
hadith.en: Fighting has been prescribed for you, but you may dislike it

shades.name_ar: الْكِتَابَةُ - ضِبْطُ الْحُرُوفِ، الْقَضَاءُ الْمُقَدَّرُ، كِتَابُ اللَّهِ الْقَدَرَ
shades.explanation: The kitaba (writing, prescribing) in the Quran is one of the most fundamental concepts. The verse 2:183 establishes the divine prescription of fasting. The kitaba in the Quran has multiple meanings - the physical writing (al-kitaba al-maddiyyah), the divine prescribing (al-kitaba al-takwiniyyah), and the divine decree (al-kitaba al-qadariyyah). The hadith establishes that fighting has been prescribed for you. Al-Ghazali treats the kitaba as the divine decree - everything that happens is written in the preserved tablet (al-lawh al-mahfuz).
shades.hadith_ar: كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْقِتَالُ وَهُوَ كُرْهٌ لَّكُمْ
shades.hadith_en: Fighting has been prescribed for you, but you may dislike it

meaning.en: To think, reflect. The root denotes the act of thinking or reflecting - particularly on the signs of Allah.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْفِكْرُ: إِعْمَالُ الْخَاطِرِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْفِكْرُ: إِثَارَةُ الْخَوَاطِرِ لِلِاسْتِدْلَالِ بِالْمَعْلُومِ عَلَى الْمَجْهُولِ

quran_examples.ar: أَيَوَدُّ أَحَدُكُمۡ أَن تَكُونَ لَهُۥ جَنَّةٌۭ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعۡنَـٰبٍۢ تَجۡرِى مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَـٰرُ لَهُۥ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ وَأَصَابَهُ ٱلۡكِبَرُ وَلَهُۥ ذُرِّيَّةٌۭ ضُعَفَآءُ فَأَصَابَهَآ إِعۡصَارٌۭ فِيهِ نَارٌۭ فَٱحۡتَرَقَتۡ ۗ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلۡءَايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَتَفَكَّرُونَ
quran_examples.en: Would one of you like to have a garden of palm trees and grapevines underneath which rivers flow, in which he has all kinds of fruits, but then he is struck with old age, while his children are still young, and then a whirlwind with fire comes and burns it? Thus does Allah make clear to you the signs that you might reflect
quran_examples.context: The parable of the burning garden

hadith.ar: تَفَكُّرُ سَاعَةٍ خَيْرٌ مِنْ عِبَادَةِ سِتِّينَ سَنَةً
hadith.en: An hour of reflection is better than sixty years of worship

shades.explanation: The fikr (reflection) in the Quran is one of the keys to knowledge. The verse 2:266 establishes the parable of the burning garden - Allah makes clear the signs so that you might reflect. The fikr in the Quran has multiple meanings - the reflection on the signs (al-fikr fi al-ayat), the reflection on the creation (al-fikr fi al-khalq), and the reflection on the self (al-fikr fi al-nafs). The hadith establishes that an hour of reflection is better than sixty years of worship. Al-Ghazali (Ihya, Book of Reflection) treats the fikr as the foundation of ihsan - the one who reflects on the signs of Allah has attained the ultimate station.
shades.hadith_ar: تَفَكُّرُ سَاعَةٍ خَيْرٌ مِنْ عِبَادَةِ سِتِّينَ سَنَةً
shades.hadith_en: An hour of reflection is better than sixty years of worship

meaning.en: To split, tear. The root denotes the act of splitting or tearing - particularly of the sky, the earth, and the heart.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الشَّقُّ: انْفِرَاجُ الشَّيْءِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الشَّقُّ: ضِدُّ الْإِلْتِئَامِ. وَشَقَّ الشَّيْءَ: فَتَقَهُ

quran_examples.ar: ثُمَّ قَسَتۡ قُلُوبُكُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَ فَهِىَ كَٱلۡحِجَارَةِ أَوۡ أَشَدُّ قَسۡوَةًۭ ۚ وَإِنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡحِجَارَةِ لَمَا يَتَفَجَّرُ مِنۡهُ ٱلۡأَنۡهَـٰرُ ۚ وَإِنَّ مِنۡهَا لَمَا يَشَّقَّقُ فَيَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهُ ٱلۡمَآءُ
quran_examples.en: Then your hearts became hardened after that, being like stones or even harder. For indeed, there are stones from which rivers burst forth, and there are some of them that split open and water comes out

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَحِيمٌ يُحِبُّ الرَّحْمَةَ وَيَجْزِي بِهَا
hadith.en: Indeed Allah is Merciful and loves mercy

shades.explanation: The shaq (splitting) in the Quran is one of the divine acts. The verse 2:74 establishes that the stones split open and water comes out. The shaq in the Quran has multiple meanings - the splitting of the sky (shaqq al-sama'), the splitting of the earth (shaqq al-ard), and the splitting of the moon (shaqq al-qamar). The hadith establishes that Allah is Merciful and loves mercy. Al-Ghazali treats the shaq as the divine opening - the one whose heart is split open by the divine light has found the ultimate opening.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَحِيمٌ يُحِبُّ الرَّحْمَةَ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed Allah is Merciful and loves mercy

meaning.en: To appear, be manifest. The root denotes the state of being apparent or manifest - and the act of conquering.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الظُّهُورُ: ضِدُّ الْخَفَاءِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الظُّهُورُ: الْبُرُوزُ بَعْدَ الْخَفَاءِ. وَالظَّهِيرُ: الْمُعِينُ

quran_examples.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُعۡجِبُكَ قَوۡلُهُۥ فِى ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَيُشۡهِدُ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا فِى قَلۡبِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَلَدُّ ٱلۡخِصَامِ
quran_examples.en: And of the people is he whose speech pleases you in worldly life, and he calls Allah to witness as to what is in his heart, yet he is the fiercest of opponents

hadith.ar: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
hadith.en: The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe

shades.name_ar: الظُّهُورُ - ضِدُّ الْخَفَاءِ، الْبُرُوزُ، الظُّهُورُ عَلَى الْعَدُوِّ
shades.explanation: The zuhur (manifestation) in the Quran is one of the divine acts. The verse 2:204 establishes the description of the hypocrites whose speech pleases you but whose hearts are fierce. The zuhur in the Quran has multiple meanings - the physical manifestation (al-zuhur al-maddi), the spiritual manifestation (al-zuhur al-ruhani), and the triumph over the enemy (al-zuhur 'ala al-'adu). The hadith establishes that the Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe. Al-Ghazali treats the zuhur as the divine victory - Allah supports His servants and makes them victorious over their enemies.
shades.hadith_ar: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
shades.hadith_en: The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe

meaning.en: To set up, erect, toil. The root denotes the act of setting up or erecting - and the state of being exhausted.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: النَّصْبُ: التَّعَبُ. وَأَصْلُهُ: إِقَامَةُ الشَّيْءِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: النَّصْبُ: الْإِقَامَةُ. وَنَصَبَ: تَعِبَ

quran_examples.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَدًۭا ۙ سُبۡحَـٰنَهُۥ ۖ بَل لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ لَّهُۥ قَـٰنِتُونَ
quran_examples.en: And they say, Allah has taken a son. Exalted is He! Rather, to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. All are devoutly obedient to Him
quran_examples.context: The condemnation of saying Allah has a son

hadith.ar: الْعِبَادَةُ فِي الْهَرْجِ كَهِجْرَةٍ إِلَيَّ
hadith.en: Worship during the time of tribulation is like emigrating to me

shades.name_en: an-Nasab - The Toil and the Erecting
shades.explanation: The nasab (toil, erecting) in the Quran is one of the human conditions. The verse 2:167 establishes the condemnation of those who say Allah has taken a son. The nasab in the Quran has multiple meanings - the physical toil (al-nasab al-maddi), the setting up of idols (al-nasab al-sanami), and the establishment of religion (al-nasab al-dini). The hadith establishes that worship during the time of tribulation is like emigrating to me. Al-Ghazali treats the nasab as the toil of the believer - the one who toils in the way of Allah has found the ultimate success.
shades.hadith_ar: الْعِبَادَةُ فِي الْهَرْجِ كَهِجْرَةٍ إِلَيَّ
shades.hadith_en: Worship during the time of tribulation is like emigrating to me

meaning.en: To be old, gray-haired. The root denotes the state of being old or gray-haired - and the act of mixing.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الشَّيْبُ: بَيَاضُ الشَّعَرِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الشَّيْبُ: بَيَاضُ الشَّعَرِ مِنَ الْكِبَرِ. وَشَابَ الشَّيْءُ: خَالَطَهُ غَيْرُهُ

quran_examples.ar: أَيَوَدُّ أَحَدُكُمۡ أَن تَكُونَ لَهُۥ جَنَّةٌۭ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعۡنَـٰبٍۢ تَجۡرِى مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَـٰرُ لَهُۥ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ وَأَصَابَهُ ٱلۡكِبَرُ وَلَهُۥ ذُرِّيَّةٌۭ ضُعۡفَآءُ
quran_examples.en: Would one of you like to have a garden of palm trees and grapevines underneath which rivers flow, in which he has all kinds of fruits, but then he is struck with old age
quran_examples.context: The parable of the burning garden

hadith.ar: كُونُوا شَبَابًا أَوْ عَجَائِزَ فَإِنَّ أَهْلَ النَّارِ يَكُونُونَ شَبَابًا
hadith.en: Be young or old, for the people of the Fire will be young

shades.explanation: The shaib (gray hair) in the Quran is one of the signs of age. The verse 2:266 establishes the parable of the burning garden - the person is struck with old age. The shaib in the Quran is closely related to al-kibar (old age) and al-shaikhuukhah (extreme age). The hadith establishes that the people of the Fire will be young. Al-Ghazali treats the shaib as the sign of approaching the end - the one whose hair has turned gray should increase in repentance.
shades.hadith_ar: كُونُوا شَبَابًا أَوْ عَجَائِزَ فَإِنَّ أَهْلَ النَّارِ يَكُونُونَ شَبَابًا
shades.hadith_en: Be young or old, for the people of the Fire will be young

meaning.en: To be wicked, commit immorality. The root denotes the state of being wicked or immoral - and the act of disobeying.
meaning.ar: الْفُسُوقُ: ضِدُّ الطَّاعَةِ، الْخُرُوجُ عَنِ الطَّاعَةِ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْفُسُوقُ: الْخُرُوجُ عَنِ الطَّاعَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْفُسُوقُ: الْخُرُوجُ عَنِ طَاعَةِ اللَّهِ. وَالْفَاسِقُ: الْخَارِجُ عَنِ الطَّاعَةِ

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَسۡتَحۡىِۦٓ أَن يَضۡرِبَ مَثَلًۭا مَّا بَعُوضَةًۭ فَمَا فَوۡقَهَا ۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فَيَعۡلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمۡ ۖ وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَيَقُولُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًۭا ۘ يُضِلُّ بِهِۦ كَثِيرًۭا وَيَهۡدِى بِهِۦ كَثِيرًۭا ۚ وَمَا يُضِلُّ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلۡفَـٰسِقِينَ
quran_examples.en: Indeed, Allah is not ashamed to present a comparison - even of a mosquito or what is even smaller. As for the believers, they know that it is the truth from their Lord. But as for the disbelievers, they say, What did Allah intend by this comparison? He leads astray many by it and guides many by it. And He does not lead astray by it except the wicked

hadith.ar: مَنْ قَالَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ فَقَدْ بَرِئَتْ مِنَ الشِّرْكِ
hadith.en: Whoever says 'there is no god but Allah' has been absolved from shirk

shades.explanation: The fisq (wickedness) in the Quran is one of the major sins. The verse 2:26 establishes that Allah does not lead astray by the parable except the fasiqun (the wicked). The fisq in the Quran has multiple levels - the fisq of the limbs (fasiq al-jawarih), the fisq of the tongue (fasiq al-lisan), and the fisq of the heart (fasiq al-qalb). The hadith establishes that whoever says 'there is no god but Allah' has been absolved from shirk. Al-Ghazali treats the fisq as the ultimate departure from the divine path - the one who returns to Allah from fisq has found the ultimate salvation.
shades.hadith_ar: مَنْ قَالَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ فَقَدْ بَرِئَتْ مِنَ الشِّرْكِ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever says 'there is no god but Allah' has been absolved from shirk

meaning.en: To be pure, select. The root denotes the state of being pure - and the act of selecting or purifying.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الصَّفَاءُ: ضِدُّ الْكَدَرِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الصَّفَاءُ: ضِدُّ الْكَدَرِ. وَصَفَا الشَّيْءُ: خَلَصَ

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكۡتُمُونَ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبِ وَيَشۡتَرُونَ بِهِۦ ثَمَنًۭا قَلِيلًا
quran_examples.en: Indeed those who conceal what Allah has revealed of the Book and exchange it for a small price

hadith.ar: طُوبَى لِلْمُهَاجِرِينَ
hadith.en: Blessed are the emigrants

shades.explanation: The safa' (purity) in the Quran is one of the qualities of the heart. The verse 2:174 establishes the condemnation of those who conceal revelation. The safa' in the Quran has multiple meanings - the purity of the heart (safa' al-qalb), the clarity of the sky (safa' al-sama'), and the selected remnant (al-safi - the chosen). The hadith establishes that blessed are the emigrants. Al-Ghazali treats the safa' as the purity of the heart - the one whose heart is pure has found the ultimate treasure.
shades.hadith_ar: طُوبَى لِلْمُهَاجِرِينَ
shades.hadith_en: Blessed are the emigrants

meaning.en: To be lost, perish. The root denotes the state of being lost or perishing.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْفَهْدُ: الْهَلَاكُ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْفَهْدُ: الضَّيَاعُ. وَفَهِدَ: هَلَكَ

quran_examples.ar: وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَا تَتۡلُوا۟ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ عَلَىٰ مُلۡكِ سُلَيۡمَـٰنَ ۖ وَمَا كَفَرَ سُلَيۡمَـٰنُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُعَلِّمُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ ٱلسِّحۡرَ
quran_examples.en: And they followed what the devils used to recite in the reign of Solomon. Solomon did not disbelieve, but the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic

hadith.ar: إِذَا ضَيَّعْتُمُ الْأَمَانَةَ فَانْتَظِرُوا السَّاعَةَ
hadith.en: When you betray the trust, wait for the Hour

shades.explanation: The fahd (loss) in the Quran is one of the divine warnings. The verse 2:102 establishes the condemnation of the devils who taught magic. The fahd in the Quran is closely related to al-halak (destruction) and al-day' (loss). The hadith establishes that when you betray the trust, wait for the Hour. Al-Ghazali treats the fahd as the ultimate loss - the one who loses the trust has lost everything.
shades.hadith_ar: إِذَا ضَيَّعْتُمُ الْأَمَانَةَ فَانْتَظِرُوا السَّاعَةَ
shades.hadith_en: When you betray the trust, wait for the Hour

meaning.en: To turn, return, heart. The root denotes the act of turning or returning - and the heart (qalb).
meaning.ar: الْقَلْبُ: تَقْلِيبُ الشَّيْءِ وَتَصْرِيفُهُ، أَوِ اللُّبُّ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْقَلْبُ: تَقْلِيبُ الشَّيْءِ عَنْ وَجْهٍ إِلَى وَجْهٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْقَلْبُ: لُبُّ الشَّيْءِ وَخَالِصُهُ. وَتَقْلِيبُ الْقَلْبِ: تَصْرِيفُهُ فِي الْأَحْوَالِ

quran_examples.ar: لَّا يُؤَاخِذُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِٱللَّغۡوِ فِىٓ أَيۡمَـٰنِكُمۡ وَلَـٰكِن يُؤَاخِذُكُم بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ قُلُوبُكُمۡ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٌ
quran_examples.en: Allah does not impose blame upon you for what is unintentional in your oaths, but He imposes blame upon you for what your hearts have earned. And Allah is Forgiving and Forbearing
quran_examples.context: The divine treatment of unintentional oaths

hadith.ar: أَلَا وَإِنَّ فِي الْجَسَدِ مُضْغَةً إِذَا صَلَحَتْ صَلَحَ الْجَسَدُ كُلُّهُ
hadith.en: Beware, there is a piece of flesh in the body, if it is sound the whole body is sound

shades.name_ar: الْقَلْبُ - لُبُّ الشَّيْءِ، مَوْضِعُ الْإِيمَانِ وَالْعِلْمِ
shades.explanation: The qalb (heart) in the Quran is one of the most important concepts. The verse 2:225 establishes that Allah does not blame you for what is unintentional in your oaths, but He blames you for what your hearts have earned. The qalb in the Quran has multiple meanings - the physical heart (al-qalb al-jismani), the spiritual heart (al-qalb al-ruhani), and the heart of understanding (qalb al-'aql). The hadith establishes that there is a piece of flesh in the body - if it is sound the whole body is sound. Al-Ghazali (Ihya, Book of the Heart) treats the qalb as the king of the body - the one whose heart is alive with iman has found the ultimate success.
shades.hadith_ar: أَلَا وَإِنَّ فِي الْجَسَدِ مُضْغَةً إِذَا صَلَحَتْ صَلَحَ الْجَسَدُ كُلُّهُ
shades.hadith_en: Beware, there is a piece of flesh in the body, if it is sound the whole body is sound

meaning.en: To enter, go in. The root denotes the act of entering or going in - and the state of being inside.
meaning.ar: الدُّخُولُ: ضِدُّ الْخُرُوجِ، الدُّخُولُ فِي الشَّيْءِ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الدُّخُولُ: ضِدُّ الْخُرُوجِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الدُّخُولُ: ضِدُّ الْخُرُوجِ. وَدَخَلَ الْمَكَانَ: حَلَّ فِيهِ

quran_examples.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱدۡخُلُوا۟ فِى ٱلسِّلۡمِ كَآفَّةًۭ
quran_examples.en: O you who have believed, enter into Islam completely
quran_examples.context: The command to enter Islam completely

hadith.ar: إِذَا دَخَلَ أَحَدُكُمُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَلْيَرْكَعْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَجْلِسَ
hadith.en: When one of you enters the mosque, let him pray two rak'ahs before sitting

shades.explanation: The dukhul (entering) in the Quran is one of the most common actions. The verse 2:208 establishes the command to enter Islam completely. The dukhul in the Quran has multiple meanings - the physical entering (al-dukhul al-maddi), the spiritual entering (al-dukhul al-ruhani), and the metaphorical entering (al-dukhul al-majazi). The hadith establishes that when one of you enters the mosque, let him pray two rak'ahs before sitting. Al-Ghazali treats the dukhul as the entry into the divine presence - the one who enters the mosque has entered the presence of Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: إِذَا دَخَلَ أَحَدُكُمُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَلْيَرْكَعْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَجْلِسَ
shades.hadith_en: When one of you enters the mosque, let him pray two rak'ahs before sitting

meaning.en: To neglect, delay. The root denotes the act of neglecting or delaying - and the act of shaking.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: النَّوْسُ: التَّأَخُّرُ. وَتَنَاوَسَ: تَقَلَّبَ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: النَّوْسُ: تَقَلُّبُ الشَّيْءِ. وَنَاسَ: تَأَخَّرَ

quran_examples.ar: وَإِذۡ قَتَلۡتُمۡ نَفۡسًۭا فَٱدَّٰرَأۡتُمۡ فِيهَا ۖ وَٱللَّهُ مُخۡرِجٌۭ مَّا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡتُمُونَ
quran_examples.en: And you killed a soul and then quarreled over it. And Allah was to bring forth what you were concealing
quran_examples.context: The story of the murdered soul

hadith.ar: مَا نَسَخْنَاهُ أَوْ نَنسَهْ نَأۡتِ بِخَيۡرٍۢ مِّنۡهَآ أَوۡ مِثۡلِهَآ
hadith.en: Whatever verse We abrogate or cause to be forgotten, We bring better than it or the like of it

shades.explanation: The nawsu (delaying) in the Quran is one of the conditions of the human soul. The verse 2:72 establishes the story of the murdered soul. The nawsu in the Quran is closely related to al-takhmis (delay) and al-ta'akhur (being late). Al-Ghazali treats the nawsu as the state of the negligent soul - the one who delays in good deeds has fallen into the trap of negligence.

meaning.en: To be few, dry, empty. The root denotes the state of being few or empty - and the act of drying up.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْجَفَافُ: ضِدُّ الرُّطُوبَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْجَفَافُ: ضِدُّ الرُّطُوبَةِ. وَجَفَّ الشَّيْءُ: يَبِسَ

quran_examples.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱعۡبُدُوا۟ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمۡ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَتَّقُونَ
quran_examples.en: O mankind, worship your Lord who created you and those before you that you may become righteous
quran_examples.context: The command to worship the Lord

hadith.ar: لَوْ أَنَّ ابْنَ آدَمَ أُعْطِيَ وَادِيَ مَالٍ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ غَيْرِهِ
hadith.en: If the son of Adam were given a valley of gold, he would love to have a second one

shades.explanation: The jafaf (dryness) in the Quran is one of the natural states. The verse 2:21 establishes the command to worship the Lord. The jafaf in the Quran is closely related to al-yubs (dryness) and al-jafu' (empty). Al-Ghazali treats the jafaf of the heart as the opposite of its riqqah - the one whose heart has dried up has lost the way to Allah.

meaning.en: To be near, almost. The root denotes the state of being near or almost - particularly of something about to happen.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الشَّيْفُ: الْحَدُّ. وَشَافَ: قَرُبَ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الشَّيْفُ: حَدُّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ. وَتَشَوَّفَ: تَطَلَّعَ

quran_examples.ar: يَكَادُ ٱلۡبَرۡقُ يَخۡطَفُ أَبۡصَـٰرَهُمۡ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أَضَآءَ لَهُمۡ مَشَوۡا۟ فِيهِ وَإِذَآ أَظۡلَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ قَامُوا۟
quran_examples.en: The lightning almost snatches away their sight. Every time it lights [the way] for them, they walk therein; but when darkness comes over them, they stand [still]

hadith.ar: كَادَ الْفَقْرُ أَنْ يَكُونَ كُفْرًا
hadith.en: Poverty is almost disbelief

shades.explanation: The shayf (nearness) in the Quran is one of the states of approach. The verse 2:20 establishes the parable of the disbelievers - the lightning almost snatches away their sight. The shayf in the Quran is closely related to al-qurb (nearness) and al-hadd (limit). The hadith establishes that poverty is almost disbelief. Al-Ghazali treats the shayf as the state of being near to Allah - the one who is near to Allah has found the ultimate treasure.
shades.hadith_ar: كَادَ الْفَقْرُ أَنْ يَكُونَ كُفْرًا
shades.hadith_en: Poverty is almost disbelief
