The Quran says: And We did not destroy any city except that it had a known decree (15:4). al-Halak in the Quran is: (1) al-halak al-jismani (physical death), (2) al-halak al-ruhi (spiritual death), (3) al-halak al-dawri (cyclical destruction). The famous hadith states: Allah will not punish the heart that is attached to the masajid. al-Halak in Sufism is the state of being destroyed in the path of Allah - the believer who loses himself to find Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَآ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌۭ مَّعۡلُومٌ
shades.hadith_en: And We did not destroy any city except that it had a known decree

shades.explanation: al-Halik (the perishing one) in the Quran is one who is about to die or destroy. The Quran says: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth - that is what you were avoiding (50:19). The halik is the one who is perishing - whether in this life or in the barzakh. The famous hadith states: Remember much the one who severs relationships. al-Halik in Sufism is the one whose ego has been destroyed - the state of fana (annihilation) before the divine presence.
shades.hadith_ar: وَجَآءَتۡ سَكۡرَةُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِ بِٱلۡحَقِّ
shades.hadith_en: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth

shades.explanation: al-Muhlik (the destroyer) in the Quran is the One who destroys. The Quran says: Allah would not punish them while you are among them (8:33). The muhlik in the Quran is Allah - the One who destroys the tyrants and the oppressors. The famous hadith states: The hour will not come until the worst of people are on earth. al-Muhlik in Sufism is the divine attribute of destruction - the One who destroys the ego and the passions of the believer.
shades.hadith_ar: مَّن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَلَا هَادِىَ لَهُۥ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever Allah sends astray - for him there is no guide

shades.explanation: at-Tahlik (the perishing) in the Quran refers to the act of perishing. The Quran says: And they will find what they did placed before them (18:49). at-Tahlik is the act of destruction - whether by divine decree or by human action. The famous hadith states: A time will come upon people when only the believers will be saved. at-Tahlik in Sufism is the inner destruction - the believer who has died to the world and is born in the spiritual realm.
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تَحۡسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَـٰفِلًا عَمَّا يَعۡمَلُ ٱلۡظَّـٰلِمُونَ
shades.hadith_en: And never think of Allah unaware of what the wrongdoers do

meaning.en: To send, raise. The root denotes sending or resurrection.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْبَاءُ وَالْعَيْنُ وَالثَّاءُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى إِنْعَاشٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: بَعَثَ: أَنْعَشَ. وَالْبَعْثُ: الْإِرْسَالُ

quran_examples.ar: يَوۡمَ نَطۡوِى ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَطَىِّ ٱلسِّجِلِّ لِلۡكُتُبِ
quran_examples.en: The Day We will fold the heaven like the folding of a [written] page
quran_examples.context: The rolling up of the heavens

quran_examples.ar: وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يُقۡسِمُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ مَا لَبِثُواْ غَيۡرَ سَاعَةٍۢ
quran_examples.en: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will swear they had remained only an hour

hadith.ar: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَلَائِكَةً سَيَّارِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يُبَلِّغُونِي مِنْ أُمَّتِي السَّلَامَ
hadith.en: Allah has traveling angels who convey to me the greetings of my ummah

hadith.ar: مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ
hadith.en: Whoever wishes that his provision be expanded, let him maintain ties of kinship

shades.explanation: al-Ba'th (the sending, the resurrection) in the Quran is one of the most fundamental concepts. The Quran says: And then We will bring forth from it a new creation (21:104). al-Ba'th in the Quran is: (1) al-ba'th al-jismani (physical resurrection), (2) al-ba'th al-rasuli (sending of the messengers), (3) al-ba'th al-ruhi (spiritual awakening). The famous hadith states: The people are sleeping - when they die, they wake up. al-Ba'th in Sufism is the spiritual resurrection - the awakening of the heart.
shades.hadith_ar: يَوۡمَ نَبۡعَثُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍۢ شَهِيدًا
shades.hadith_en: The Day We will resurrect from every nation a witness

shades.explanation: al-Ba'ith (the Raiser, the Sender) in the Quran is one of the Names of Allah - the One who raises the dead and sends the messengers. The Quran says: And Allah sends a soul upon whomever He wills (11:56). The famous hadith Qudsi states: My servant has drawn near to Me through voluntary acts until I love him. al-Ba'ith is the One who resurrects - the One who brings the dead to life.
shades.hadith_ar: بَعَثَ فِيكُمۡ رَسُولًۭا مِّنكُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: He has sent among you a Messenger from among yourselves

shades.explanation: al-Mab'ath (the place of mission) in the Quran is the place of being sent. The famous hadith states: I was sent to the entire jinn and mankind. al-Mab'ath of the Prophet Muhammad was in Makkah - the first revelation in the Cave of Hira. The mab'ath in Sufism is the spiritual mission - the place where the seeker is sent to fulfill his purpose.
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَـٰكَ إِلَّا رَحۡمَةًۭ لِّلۡعَـٰلَمِينَ
shades.hadith_en: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds

shades.explanation: al-Inba'ath (the self-recovery) in the Quran refers to rising by oneself. The Quran says: And on the Day when the Hour will arrive - the criminals will swear that they remained not but an hour (30:55). al-Inba'ath is the act of rising from sleep or death. The famous hadith states: Whoever dies has seen his end. al-Inba'ath in Sufism is the spiritual awakening - the rising of the heart from the sleep of heedlessness.
shades.hadith_ar: أَإِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ذَٰلِكَ رَجۡعٌۢ بَعِيدٌ
shades.hadith_en: When we have died and become dust? That is a distant return

meaning.en: To sin, commit crime. The root denotes sin, crime, or wrongdoing.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْجِيمُ وَالرَّاءُ وَالْمِيمُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى اكْتِسَابِ الذَّنْبِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْجُرْمُ: الذَّنْبُ. وَجَرَمَ: اكْتَسَبَ

quran_examples.ar: وَمَا ظَلَمۡنَـٰهُمۡ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ
quran_examples.en: And We did not wrong them, but they were wronging themselves

quran_examples.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلۡكَـٰفِرِينَ فِى عِذَابٍۢ مُّقِيمٍ
quran_examples.en: But no! Indeed, the disbelievers will be in a burning punishment

hadith.ar: مَنْ جَاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ عَشْرُ أَمْثَالِهَا
hadith.en: Whoever comes with a good deed will have ten times its like

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَتَبَ عَلَى ابْنِ آدَمَ حَظَّهُ مِنَ الزِّنَا
hadith.en: Indeed Allah has written for the son of Adam his share of adultery

shades.explanation: al-Jurm (the crime, the sin) in the Quran is one of the most frequent terms for sin. The Quran says: And We were not unjust to them, but they were unjust to themselves (16:118). al-Jurm in the Quran is: (1) al-jurm al-kabir (major sin), (2) al-jurm al-saghir (minor sin), (3) al-jurm al-mu'tadi (transgressing sin). The famous hadith states: The major sins are nine. al-Jurm in Sufism is the state of the ego - the one who is attached to his sins and committed to the worldly life.
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تُبۡطِلُوٓاْ أَعۡمَـٰلَكُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: And do not invalidate your deeds

shades.name_ar: الْمُجۡرِمُ - الَّذِي يَعۡتَادُ الْإِثْمَ، الذَّائِبُ الْمَأۡثُورُ
shades.explanation: al-Mujrim (the criminal, the sinner) in the Quran is one who commits sins persistently. The Quran says: The criminals are in deviation and burning (83:12). The mujrim in the Quran is the one who has chosen a path of sin - the persistent wrongdoer. The famous hadith states: A man may commit a sin until he is recorded with Allah as a fajir (wicked). al-Mujrim in Sufism is the ego-driven soul - the one who must be purified before it can reach Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed the criminals are in deviation and burning

shades.explanation: al-Ijtiram (the transgression) in the Quran refers to the act of earning sins. The Quran says: Whoever earns a sin, then only earns it against himself (4:111). The ijtiram is the act of accumulating sins - one of the most dangerous states. The famous hadith states: The believer's sins are written - if he repents, Allah forgives him. al-Ijtiram in Sufism is the state of accumulating blameworthy deeds - the believer must be conscious of every deed.
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ سُوٓءًا أَوۡ يَظۡلِمۡ نَفۡسَهُۥ ثُمَّ يَسۡتَغۡفِرِ ٱللَّهَ يَجِدِ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورًۭا رَّحِيمًۭا
shades.hadith_en: And whoever does a wrong or wrongs himself but then seeks forgiveness of Allah will find Allah Forgiving and Merciful

shades.explanation: at-Tajrim (the criminalization) in the Quran refers to the prohibition of something. The Quran says: Indeed Allah has cursed the disbelievers and prepared for them a burning Fire (33:64). The tajrim in the Quran is the divine prohibition - the making haram of certain acts. The famous hadith states: Allah has made haram certain things and has made them haram out of respect for them. at-Tajrim in Sufism is the making firm of the prohibitions - the discipline of the seeker.
shades.hadith_ar: حَرَّمَ رَبِّىَ ٱلۡفَوَٰحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنۡهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ
shades.hadith_en: My Lord has forbidden the immorality, what is apparent of it and what is concealed

meaning.en: Eye, spring. The root denotes eye, spring, or envy.
meaning.ar: الْعَيْنُ: عُضْوُ الْإِبْصَارِ، النَّابِعُ مِنَ الْمَاءِ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْعَيْنُ وَالْيَاءُ وَالنُّونُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى إِبْصَارٍ أَوْ مَاءٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الْعَيْنُ: عُضْوُ الرُّؤْيَةِ. وَعَيَّنَ: حَدَّدَ

quran_examples.ar: وَمَا ظَلَمۡنَـٰهُمۡ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ
quran_examples.en: And We did not wrong them, but they were wronging themselves

quran_examples.ar: وَهُوَ مَعَكُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ
quran_examples.en: And He is with you wherever you are

hadith.ar: الْعَيْنُ حَقٌّ وَلَوْ كَانَ شَيْءٌ يَسْبِقُ الْقَدَرَ لَسَبَقَتْهُ الْعَيْنُ
hadith.en: The evil eye is real - if anything were to overtake the divine decree, it would be the evil eye

hadith.ar: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيۡثُمَا كُنۡتَ
hadith.en: Be conscious of Allah wherever you are

shades.explanation: al-'Ayn (the eye) in the Quran is one of the most mentioned organs. The Quran says: And We were not unjust to them, but they were unjust to themselves (16:118). al-'Ayn in the Quran is: (1) al-'ayn al-nazira (the seeing eye), (2) al-'ayn al-bakhiya (the crying eye), (3) al-'ayn al-madiya (the envy eye - the evil eye). The famous hadith states: The evil eye is real - if anything were to overtake the divine decree, it would be the evil eye. al-'Ayn in Sufism is the spiritual sight - the eye of the heart.
shades.hadith_ar: كُلُّ ٱلطَّعَامِ كَانَ حِلًّۭا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
shades.hadith_en: All food was lawful for the Children of Israel

shades.name_en: Ayn al-Ma - The Spring of Water
shades.name_ar: عَيۡنُ الْمَاءِ - نَبۡعُ الْمَاءِ مِنَ الْأَرۡضِ
shades.explanation: Ayn al-Ma (the spring of water) in the Quran refers to a spring that flows from the earth. The famous hadith states: Allah created the spring of water from which all life comes. The springs of Paradise are described in detail: kafur (camphor), zanjabil (ginger), tasnim (a high spring), salsabil (a flowing spring). The ayn al-ma in Sufism is the source of life - the divine knowledge that flows from Allah to the hearts of His awliya.
shades.hadith_ar: وَفِيهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيهِ ٱلۡأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلۡأَعۡيُنُ
shades.hadith_en: And therein is what the souls desire and the eyes delight in

shades.name_en: Ayn Allah - The Eye of Allah
shades.explanation: Ayn Allah (the Eye of Allah) in the Quran is the divine attribute of watching. The famous hadith states: Be conscious of Allah wherever you are. The Eye of Allah is on every soul - He sees all deeds. The Quran says: And He is with you wherever you are (57:4). al-'Ayn Allah in Sufism is the divine watchfulness - the believer who knows he is watched by Allah is conscious of every deed.
shades.hadith_ar: تَجۡرِى مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَـٰرُ
shades.hadith_en: Beneath which rivers flow

shades.explanation: al-Mu'ayyan (the appointed, the determined) in the Quran refers to that which is specified. The famous hadith states: Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity. The mu'ayyan in the Quran is the decreed matter - that which Allah has specified in His knowledge. al-Mu'ayyan in Sufism is the spiritual state that has been determined for the believer - the maqam (station) that Allah has prescribed for him.
shades.hadith_ar: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَ ٱلۡإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَـٰهُ مِن نُّطۡفَةٍۢ
shades.hadith_en: Has not man considered that We created him from a [mere] sperm drop

meaning.en: To lose. The root denotes loss, damage, or decrease.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْخَاءُ وَالسِّينُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى نَقْصٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: خَسِرَ: نَقَصَ. وَالْخَسَارَةُ: الضَّرَرُ

quran_examples.ar: قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡخَـٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَأَهۡلِيهِمۡ
quran_examples.en: Say: Indeed, those who lose are those who lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَـٰنَ لَفِى خُسۡرٍ
quran_examples.en: Indeed mankind is in loss

hadith.ar: بِئْسَ الْمَطِيَّةُ لِلرَّجُلِ
hadith.en: What a bad mount for a man

hadith.ar: مَنْ قَالَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ
hadith.en: Whoever says La ilaha illa Allah will enter Paradise

shades.explanation: al-Khasara (the loss, the damage) in the Quran is one of the most fundamental concepts. The Quran says: Say: Indeed, those who lose [khasiruna] are those who lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection (39:15). al-Khasara in the Quran is: (1) al-khasara al-maddiyya (material loss), (2) al-khasara al-akhira (spiritual loss), (3) al-khasara al-mutlaqa (absolute loss - the disbelievers). The famous hadith states: The mujahid is the one who strives against his nafs. al-Khasara in Sufism is the state of loss - the believer must be conscious of every deed.
shades.hadith_ar: قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡخَـٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَأَهۡلِيهِمۡ
shades.hadith_en: Say: Indeed, those who lose are those who lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection

shades.explanation: al-Khasir (the loser) in the Quran is one who loses. The Quran says: And We were not unjust to them, but they were unjust to themselves (16:118). The khasir is the one who has lost - whether in this life or the next. The famous hadith states: There are two which the tongue cannot describe - happiness and suffering. al-Khasir in Sufism is the one who has lost the path - the seeker who has wandered away from Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَآ أَنفَقُواْ مِنۡ خَيۡرٍۢ فَلَن يُكۡفَرُوهُ
shades.hadith_en: And whatever good you spend will never be denied to you

shades.explanation: al-Khasara (the loss) in the Quran is the state of losing something valuable. The famous hadith states: The two rak'at before Fajr are better than the world and all that is in it. The khasara in the Quran is the loss of the dunya and the akhirah for those who disbelieve. al-Khasara in Sufism is the state of losing the spiritual gain - the believer who has wasted his time in heedlessness.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَـٰنَ لَفِى خُسۡرٍ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed mankind is in loss

shades.explanation: al-Ikhtasara (to abbreviate) is the verbal noun of ikhtasara. The famous hadith states: Convey from me, even if it is one verse. The ikhtasara in the Quran is the act of being brief - the economy of words. al-Ikhtasara in Sufism is the state of brevity in dhikr - the seeker who has mastered the most concise forms of remembrance.
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَن يُضۡلِلۡ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُۥ وَلِيًّۭا مُّنصِرًۭا
shades.hadith_en: And whoever He sends astray - never will you find for him a protecting friend

meaning.en: To flow, run. The root denotes flow, movement, or occurrence.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْجِيمُ وَالرَّاءُ وَالْيَاءُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى حَرَكَةٍ سَرِيعَةٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: جَرَى: سَالَ أَوْ مَشَى. وَالْجَارِي: السَّائِلُ

quran_examples.ar: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ دَآئِبَيۡنِ
quran_examples.en: And subjected for you the sun and the moon, constantly running

quran_examples.ar: مَّا يَفۡتَحِ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحۡمَةٍۢ فَلَا مُمۡسِكَ لَهَا
quran_examples.en: Whatever Allah grants to people of mercy - none can withhold it

hadith.ar: كَتَبَ اللَّهُ مَقَادِيرَ الْخَلْقِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَخْلُقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ
hadith.en: Allah ordained the measures of creation fifty thousand years before creating the heavens

hadith.ar: جَرَتْ سُنَنُ الْمُرۡسَلِينَ
hadith.en: The laws of the messengers have flowed (came into effect)

shades.explanation: al-Jary (the flowing, the running) in the Quran refers to the flow of water and the running of time. The Quran says: He is the one who created the heavens and the earth in six days and His Throne was upon the waters (11:7). al-Jary in the Quran is: (1) al-jary al-ma'i (the flow of water), (2) al-jary al-tabi (the following), (3) al-jary al-waqt (the flow of time). The famous hadith states: The hour will not come except upon the worst of the people. al-Jary in Sufism is the flow of divine grace - the continuous blessing that flows from Allah to the believer.
shades.hadith_ar: وَجَـٰرِيٓاْ بِهِمۡ بِرِيحٍۢ طَيِّبَةٍۢ وَفَرِحُواْ بِهَا
shades.hadith_en: Sailing with them in a pleasant breeze while they rejoiced

shades.explanation: al-Jari (the running, the flowing) in the Quran refers to that which flows. The famous hadith states: The believers will be saved by Allah from the punishment. The jari in the Quran is the flowing water, the running ship, the swift horse. al-Jari in Sufism is the flow of the spirit - the soul that flows toward Allah with love and longing.
shades.hadith_ar: وَتَرَى ٱلۡفُلۡكَ فِيهِ مَوَاخِرَ لِتَبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ
shades.hadith_en: And you see the ships therein plowing through the waves that you may seek of His bounty

shades.name_en: Majra - The Course, The Path of Flowing
shades.explanation: al-Majra (the course, the path of flowing) in the Quran refers to the place where things flow. The Quran says: He made the sun and the moon subservient to you - they run [majra] in their courses (14:33). al-Majra in the Quran is the orbital path of the celestial bodies - the sun, the moon, the stars. The famous hadith states: Allah has appointed an angel to guard each of you. al-Majra in Sufism is the spiritual course - the path that the soul follows to Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ دَآئِبَيۡنِ
shades.hadith_en: And subjected for you the sun and the moon in constant motion

shades.explanation: Jara (to happen, to occur) in the Quran refers to that which takes place. The Quran says: And whatever Allah grants to people of mercy - none can withhold it (35:2). Jara in this sense is the occurrence of Allah's decree. The famous hadith states: Allah has written the decree of all things fifty thousand years before creating the heavens. Jara in Sufism is the occurrence of divine events - the moments of spiritual opening.
shades.hadith_ar: مَّا يَفۡتَحِ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحۡمَةٍۢ فَلَا مُمۡسِكَ لَهَا
shades.hadith_en: Whatever Allah grants to people of mercy - none can withhold it

meaning.en: To be pure, escape. The root denotes purity, sincerity, or escape.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْخَاءُ وَاللَّامُ وَالصَّادُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى نَقَاءٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: خَلَصَ: نَقِيَ. وَالْخَالِصُ: النَّقِيُّ

quran_examples.ar: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓاْ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ
quran_examples.en: And they were not commanded except to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion

quran_examples.ar: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
quran_examples.en: Say: He is Allah, the One

hadith.ar: إِنَّمَا الْأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ
hadith.en: Indeed deeds are judged by intentions

hadith.ar: الْإِسْلَامُ أَنْ تَشْهَدَ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
hadith.en: Islam is to testify that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah

shades.explanation: al-Khalas (the purity, the escape) in the Quran is one of the most mentioned acts. The Quran says: Then when you have made a decision, then rely upon Allah (3:159). al-Khalas in the Quran is: (1) al-khalas al-nass (the escape of people), (2) al-khalas al-maddi (material escape), (3) al-khalas al-ruhi (spiritual escape). The famous hadith states: Allah has ninety-nine Names, one hundred minus one. al-Khalas in Sufism is the spiritual escape - the seeker who escapes from the traps of the ego to Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: فَإِذَا عَزَمۡتَ فَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ
shades.hadith_en: Then when you have made a decision, then rely upon Allah

shades.explanation: al-Khalis (the pure, the sincere) in the Quran is one who is free from shirk. The Quran says: And they were not commanded except to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion (98:5). The khalis is the one whose worship is pure - for Allah alone. The famous hadith states: The servant's deeds are accepted if they are purely for Allah. al-Khalis in Sufism is the state of ikhlas - the highest spiritual station, free from all forms of shirk.
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓاْ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ
shades.hadith_en: And they were not commanded except to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion

shades.explanation: al-Ikhlas (the sincerity) in the Quran is the most important condition of worship. Surah al-Ikhlas (112) is named after this root. The Quran says: Say: He is Allah, the One (112:1). al-Ikhlas in the Quran is the pure worship of Allah alone - without any shirk. The famous hadith states: The deeds are judged by the intentions, and each person will have what he intended. al-Ikhlas in Sufism is the foundation of the spiritual path - the state of being purely for Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
shades.hadith_en: Say: He is Allah, the One

shades.explanation: al-Mukhlis (the sincere one) in the Quran is one who is purely for Allah. The Quran says: So whoever hopes for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work (18:110). The mukhlis is one whose deeds are for Allah alone. The famous hadith states: Allah is al-Mukhlis (the Pure One) - He accepts only what is pure. al-Mukhlis in Sufism is the one who has reached the station of ikhlas - the state of pure tawhid.
shades.hadith_ar: فَمَن كَانَ يَرۡجُواْ لِقَآءَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلۡيَعۡمَلۡ عَمَلًۭا صَـٰلِحًۭا
shades.hadith_en: So whoever hopes for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work

meaning.en: To find. The root denotes finding, encountering, or richness.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْوَاوُ وَالْجِيمُ وَالدَّالُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى لِقَاءٍ أَوْ غِنَى
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: وَجَدَ: لَقِيَ. وَالْوَاجِدُ: الْغَنِيُّ

quran_examples.ar: وَمَا وَجَدۡنَآ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَفَـٰسِقِينَ
quran_examples.en: And We did not find most of them - [they were] defiantly disobedient

quran_examples.ar: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرًا
quran_examples.en: So verily, with hardship, there is relief

hadith.ar: مَنْ جَاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ عَشْرُ أَمْثَالِهَا
hadith.en: Whoever comes with a good deed will have ten times its like

hadith.ar: مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ دَاءً إِلَّا أَنْزَلَ لَهُ شِفَاءً
hadith.en: Allah has not sent down any disease without sending down its cure

shades.explanation: al-Wujud (the finding, the existence) in the Quran is one of the most fundamental concepts. The Quran says: So verily, with hardship, there is relief (94:5). al-Wujud in the Quran has dual meanings: (1) al-wujud al-maddi (physical existence), (2) al-wujud al-qalbi (spiritual existence). The famous hadith states: Allah has not placed any disease without placing its cure. al-Wujud in Sufism is the state of being - the believer's realization of Allah's presence.
shades.hadith_ar: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرًا
shades.hadith_en: So verily, with hardship, there is relief

shades.explanation: al-Wajid (the Finder, the Rich) in the Quran is one of the Names of Allah - the One who finds what He seeks. The Quran says: And We did not find in them any fault except that they believed in Allah, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy (85:8). The famous hadith states: Allah has ninety-nine Names. al-Wajid is the One who finds - He is never lost and He never loses. The wujud in Sufism is the state of finding Allah - the highest spiritual achievement.
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ
shades.hadith_en: And you do not will except that Allah wills

shades.explanation: Wajada (to find) is the verb form. The Quran says: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways (29:69). The wajada in the Quran is to encounter - whether good or bad. The famous hadith states: Whoever does a righteous deed will have ten times its like. al-Wajada in Sufism is the spiritual finding - the seeker who finds his Lord through sincere worship.
shades.hadith_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ جَـٰهَدُواْ فِينَا لَنَهۡدِيَنَّهُمۡ سُبُلَنَا
shades.hadith_en: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways

shades.explanation: al-Mawjud (the existing, the found) in the Quran is the one that exists. The famous hadith states: Allah was and there was nothing with Him. al-Mawjud in the Quran is: (1) al-mawjud al-maddi (the materially existing), (2) al-mawjud al-ruhi (the spiritually existing), (3) al-mawjud al-ilahi (the divine existence - Allah alone). al-Mawjud in Sufism is the state of being - the realization of Allah's existence.
shades.hadith_ar: كُونُوا مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
shades.hadith_en: Be with the truthful

meaning.en: To flow, erase. The root denotes flowing, water, or erasing.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْمِيمُ وَالْوَاوُ وَالْحَاءُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى جَرْيَانٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: مَاحَ: جَرَى أَوْ مَحَا. وَالْمَوْحُ: مَوْجُ الْمَاءِ

quran_examples.ar: وَنَزَّلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ مُّبَـٰرَكًۭا
quran_examples.en: And We sent down from the sky blessed water
quran_examples.context: The blessed water from the sky

quran_examples.ar: وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعَذِّبَهُمۡ وَأَنتَ فِيهِمۡ
quran_examples.en: And Allah would not punish them while you are among them

hadith.ar: أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَصَارَتْ أَوْدِيَةٌ
hadith.en: Allah sent down water from the sky, and the valleys became flowing rivers

hadith.ar: الْوَضُوءُ شَطْرُ الْإِيمَانِ
hadith.en: Wudu is half of faith

shades.explanation: al-Mawh (the flowing, the erasing) in the Quran refers to the flow of water and the erasing of deeds. The famous hadith states: Allah erases through trials the sins of the believers. al-Mawh in the Quran is: (1) al-mawh al-ma'i (the flow of water), (2) al-mawh al-'amal (the erasing of deeds). The Quran says: And We sent down blessed water from the sky (50:9). al-Mawh in Sufism is the erasing of blameworthy deeds - the purification of the soul.
shades.hadith_ar: وَنَزَّلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ مُّبَـٰرَكًۭا
shades.hadith_en: And We sent down from the sky blessed water

shades.explanation: Maha (to flow, to erase) is the verb form of mawh. The Quran says: But Allah would not punish them while you are among them (8:33). The maha in the Quran is the divine erasing - the removal of sins through repentance. The famous hadith states: The one who repents from sin is like the one who has no sin. al-Maha in Sufism is the divine forgiveness - the erasing of all blameworthy deeds.
shades.hadith_ar: لَا يُؤَاخِذُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذِهِ ٱلۡأُمَّةِ
shades.hadith_en: Allah does not punish them with these verses

shades.explanation: at-Tamawwuh (the flowing forth) in the Quran is the vigorous flow of water. The famous hadith states: Allah created the heavens and the earth in six days. at-Tamawwuh in Sufism is the spiritual flow - the outpouring of divine grace upon the seeker's heart.
shades.hadith_ar: وَٱللَّهُ يُنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَيُحۡيِ بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَآ
shades.hadith_en: And Allah sends down rain from the sky and gives life to the earth after its death

shades.explanation: al-Mayyih (the flowing water) in the Quran refers to water in general. The Quran says: And We send down from the sky water in a measured amount (23:18). al-Mayyih is one of Allah's most basic gifts - without water, there is no life. The famous hadith states: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself. al-Mayyih in Sufism is the water of life - the divine knowledge that nourishes the soul.
shades.hadith_ar: وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍۢ
shades.hadith_en: And We send down from the sky water in a measured amount

meaning.en: To decree, judge. The root denotes decree, judgment, or ruling.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْقَافُ وَالضَّادُ وَالْيَاءُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى إِمْضَاءٍ أَوْ فَصْلٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: قَضَى: حَكَمَ. وَالْقَاضِي: الْحَاكِمُ

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخۡلِفُ ٱلۡمِيعَادَ
quran_examples.en: Indeed Allah does not fail in His promise

quran_examples.ar: وَوَجَدُواْ مَا عَمِلُواْ حَاضِرًۭا
quran_examples.en: And they will find what they did placed before them
quran_examples.context: The records on the Day of Judgment

hadith.ar: كَتَبَ اللَّهُ مَقَادِيرَ الْخَلْقِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَخْلُقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ
hadith.en: Allah ordained the measures of creation fifty thousand years before creating the heavens

hadith.ar: لَا تَسْأَلُوا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ عَنْ شَيْءٍ فَيُخْبِرُوكُمْ بِحَقٍّ فَتُكَذِّبُواْ بِهِ
hadith.en: Do not ask the People of the Book about anything that would cause them to tell you a truth that you would then deny

shades.explanation: al-Qada' (the decree, the judgment) in the Quran is one of the most fundamental concepts. The Quran says: And We sent down to you the Book in truth (3:3). al-Qada' in the Quran is: (1) al-qada' al-khalqi (the decree of creation), (2) al-qada' al-shar'i (the legal ruling), (3) al-qada' al-qadari (the pre-decreed fate). The famous hadith states: Allah has written the decree of all things fifty thousand years before creating the heavens. al-Qada' in Sufism is the divine decree - the realization that everything happens by Allah's command.
shades.hadith_ar: نَزَّلَ عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ
shades.hadith_en: He revealed to you the Book in truth

shades.name_ar: الْقَاضِي - الْحَاكِمُ، الَّذِي يَفۡصِلُ بَيۡنَ الْمُتَخَاصِمِينَ
shades.explanation: al-Qadi (the Judge) in the Quran is the one who judges between people. The famous hadith states: If the people were given what they asked for, some would claim the blood of others. al-Qadi in Islamic law is the appointed judge who resolves disputes. The Quran says: And We have sent down to you the Book in truth (3:3). The qadi in Sufism is the one who judges by the divine light - the spiritual guide.
shades.hadith_ar: لَا يُؤَاخِذُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا فِى ٱلۡأَيۡمَانِهِمۡ وَلَـٰكِن يُؤَاخِذُهُم بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ قُلُوبُهُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: Allah does not impose blame upon you for what is unintentional in your oaths, but He imposes blame upon you for what your hearts have earned

shades.name_ar: الْقَضَاءُ الْمُبۡرَمُ - الْقَضَاءُ الَّذِي لَا يَتَغَيَّرُ
shades.explanation: al-Qada' al-Mubram (the decreed decree) in the Quran refers to the unchangeable divine decree. The Quran says: And the decree is a decree determined (11:4). The qada' al-mubram is the absolute decree - the one that cannot be changed. The famous hadith states: There is no changing the decree of Allah. al-Qada' al-mubram in Sufism is the recognition that everything has been decreed - the state of surrender to Allah's will.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍۢ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed, all things We created with predestination

shades.explanation: al-Muqdi (the decided one) in the Quran refers to that which has been decided. The Quran says: And they will find what they did placed before them (18:49). The muqdi is the matter that has been decided. The famous hadith states: Allah has ninety-nine Names. al-Muqdi in Sufism is the matter that has been decreed - the believer accepts it with contentment and gratitude.
shades.hadith_ar: لَقَدۡ جَآءَكُمۡ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ نُورٌۭ
shades.hadith_en: There has come to you from Allah a light

meaning.en: To practice magic. The root denotes magic, illusion, or bewitching.
meaning.ar: السِّحْرُ: عَمَلٌ خَفِيٌّ يَقْصِدُ بِهِ التَّخَيُّلُ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: السِّينُ وَالْحَاءُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى خَفَاءٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: سَحَرَ: عَمِلَ السِّحْرَ. وَالسَّاحِرُ: فَاعِلُهُ

quran_examples.ar: وَٱتَّبَعُواْ مَا تَتۡلُواْ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ عَلَىٰ مُلۡكِ سُلَيۡمَـٰنَ
quran_examples.en: And they followed what the devils used to recite in the reign of Sulayman
quran_examples.context: The magic in the time of Sulayman

quran_examples.ar: إِنۡ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
quran_examples.en: This is nothing but clear magic

hadith.ar: مَنْ عَقَدَ عُقْدَةً وَنَفَثَ فِيهَا فَقَدْ سَحَرَ
hadith.en: Whoever ties a knot and blows on it has practiced magic

hadith.ar: سَبْعُ تَمَرَاتٍ مِنْ تَمْرِ الْعَجْوَةِ يَجْعَلُهُ اللَّهُ شِفَاءً مِنَ السِّحْرِ
hadith.en: Seven ajwa dates in the morning are a healing from magic

shades.name_ar: السِّحۡرُ - عَمَلٌ خَفِيٌّ يَقۡصِدُ بِهِ التَّخَيُّلُ وَالْإِغۡوَاءُ
shades.explanation: as-Sihr (the magic) in the Quran is mentioned extensively as one of the major sins. The Quran says: And they followed what the devils used to recite in the reign of Sulayman (2:102). as-Sihr in the Quran is: (1) as-sihr al-mayyiz (real magic), (2) as-sihr al-takhayyul (illusion), (3) as-sihr al-shu'biyy (popular sorcery). The famous hadith states: Whoever ties a knot and blows on it has practiced magic. as-Sihr is one of the major sins in Islam - the one who practices it is an apostate.
shades.hadith_ar: وَٱتَّبَعُواْ مَا تَتۡلُواْ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ عَلَىٰ مُلۡكِ سُلَيۡمَـٰنَ
shades.hadith_en: And they followed what the devils used to recite in the reign of Sulayman

shades.explanation: as-Sahir (the magician) in the Quran is one who practices magic. The Quran says: And We sent to Pharaoh a messenger - but Pharaoh disobeyed (73:15). The sahir is one who has mastered the art of illusion. The famous hadith states: There are three which will be the first to be burned on the Day of Resurrection. The sahir is among them. as-Sahir in the Quran is opposed to the nabiyy (prophet) - the prophet brings truth while the magician brings illusion.
shades.hadith_ar: وَأَلۡقِ مَا فِى يَمِينِكَ تَلۡقَفۡ مَا صَنَعُوٓاْ
shades.hadith_en: And throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow up what they have crafted

shades.explanation: at-Tahayyuz (the conjuring) in the Quran refers to the illusion of magic. The famous hadith states: Whoever learns a branch of astrology has learned a branch of magic. at-Tahayyuz is the practice of magic through illusion - one of the major sins. The Quran says: They will say: This is nothing but clear magic (54:2). at-Tahayyuz in Sufism is the spiritual illusion - the veils that come between the seeker and his Lord.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنۡ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
shades.hadith_en: This is nothing but clear magic

shades.explanation: as-Sahhar (the intensive magician) in the Quran refers to one who practices much magic. The Quran says: And We were not unjust to them, but they were unjust to themselves (16:118). The sahhar is one whose magic has become a profession. The famous hadith states: He who eats seven ajwa dates in the morning will not be harmed by magic. as-Sahhar in Sufism is the one who has lost himself in illusion - the seeker who has been deceived by false spiritual states.
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيۡثُ أَتَىٰ
shades.hadith_en: And the magician will not succeed wherever he goes

meaning.en: To recite, follow. The root denotes recitation or following.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: التَّاءُ وَاللَّامُ وَالْوَاوُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى تَتَبُّعٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: تَلَا: قَرَأَ. وَالتَّالِي: الْقَارِئُ

quran_examples.ar: وَأَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلذِّكۡرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ إِلَيۡهِمۡ
quran_examples.en: And We revealed to you the Reminder that you may explain to the people what was sent down to them

quran_examples.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيۡنَـٰهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبَ يَتۡلُونَهُۥ حَقَّ تِلَاوَتِهِۦٓ
quran_examples.en: Those to whom We have given the Book recite it as it should be recited

hadith.ar: اقْرَأُوا الْقُرْآنَ فَإِنَّهُ يَأْتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ شَفِيعًا لِأَصْحَابِهِ
hadith.en: Read the Quran, for it will come on the Day of Resurrection as an intercessor

hadith.ar: لَيْسَ الْمُؤْمِنُ بِالْمَشْئُومِ وَلَا الْمُؤْمِنُ بِالطَّيَّارِ
hadith.en: The believer is not the one who believes in omens or superstitions

shades.explanation: at-Tilawa (the recitation) in the Quran is one of the most mentioned acts of worship. The Quran says: And We sent down to you the Reminder that you may explain to the people what was sent down to them (16:44). at-Tilawa in the Quran is: (1) at-tilawa al-'aammah (general recitation), (2) at-tilawa al-khassah (special recitation - the Quran). The famous hadith states: Read the Quran, for it will come on the Day of Resurrection as an intercessor for its companion. at-Tilawa in Sufism is the spiritual recitation - the heart's absorption of divine words.
shades.hadith_ar: وَأَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلذِّكۡرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ إِلَيۡهِمۡ
shades.hadith_en: And We revealed to you the Reminder that you may explain to the people what was sent down to them

shades.explanation: at-Tali (the reciter) in the Quran is one who recites the Quran. The Quran says: Those to whom We have given the Book recite it as it should be recited (2:121). The tali in the Quran is the one who recites the Quran with proper tajweed. The famous hadith states: Allah does not listen to anything as He listens to the Prophet reciting the Quran. at-Tali in Sufism is the one whose heart is filled with the light of the Quran.
shades.hadith_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيۡنَـٰهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبَ يَتۡلُونَهُۥ حَقَّ تِلَاوَتِهِۦٓ
shades.hadith_en: Those to whom We have given the Book recite it as it should be recited

shades.name_en: Tatabbu' al-Tilawa - The Following of Recitation
shades.explanation: at-Tatabbu' (the following) in the Quran refers to the act of studying the recitation. The Quran says: Then We will surely follow it with a man who is like him (73:4). at-Tatabbu' al-tilawa is the deep study of the Quran - the believer who reads and reflects on every verse. The famous hadith states: Whoever recites the Quran and finds difficulty in it will have two rewards. at-Tatabbu' in Sufism is the deep spiritual reflection on the divine words.
shades.hadith_ar: ثُمَّ لَأَتِيَنَّهُمۡ مِّنۢ بَيۡنِ أَيۡدِيِهِمۡ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ وَعَنۡ أَيۡمَـٰنِهِمۡ وَعَن شَمَآئِلِهِمۡ
shades.hadith_en: Then We will surely come to them from before them and from behind them and on their right and on their left

shades.explanation: al-Mutala (the reading, the recited) in the Quran refers to that which has been recited. The Quran says: And We have sent down to you the Book that no one will have any doubt after that - a guidance (2:2). al-Mutala in the Quran is the recited book - the Quran. The famous hadith states: The Quran will come on the Day of Resurrection as an intercessor. al-Mutala in Sufism is the recited divine word - the source of all guidance.
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡفَضۡلُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
shades.hadith_en: And indeed this is the manifest bounty

meaning.en: To touch. The root denotes touching, contact, or affliction.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْمِيمُ وَالسِّينُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى اتِّصَالٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: مَسَّ: لَمَسَ. وَالْمَاسُّ: الْمُلَامِسُ

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ لَكَ أَلَّا تَجُوعَ فِيهَا وَلَا تَعۡرَىٰ
quran_examples.en: Indeed, you will not go hungry therein nor be unclothed

quran_examples.ar: وَإِن يَمۡسَسۡكَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّۢ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُۥٓ إِلَّا هُوَ
quran_examples.en: And if Allah should touch you with adversity, no one can remove it except Him

hadith.ar: لَا تَزَالُ الْبَلِيَّةُ بِالْمُسْلِمِ وَالْمُسْلِمَةِ
hadith.en: Trials continue to befall the Muslim and the Muslimah

hadith.ar: سَبْعُ تَمَرَاتٍ مِنَ الْعَجْوَةِ
hadith.en: Seven ajwa dates

shades.explanation: al-Mass (the touch) in the Quran is one of the most mentioned senses. The Quran says: No touch of poverty shall touch you (20:118). al-Mass in the Quran is: (1) al-mass al-maddi (physical touch), (2) al-mass al-ruhi (spiritual touch), (3) al-mass al-ma'nawi (the reaching of harm). The famous hadith states: Whoever enters the bathroom should say: Bismillah. al-Mass in Sufism is the spiritual touch - the contact of the heart with the divine.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّكَ لَا تَجُوعُ فِيهَا وَلَا تَعۡرَىٰ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed, you will not go hungry therein nor be unclothed

shades.explanation: Massa (to touch) is the verb form. The Quran says: And if adversity touches you, no one can remove it except Him (6:17). The massa in the Quran is the act of touching - whether good or bad. The famous hadith states: A servant's rank with Allah is raised by trials. al-Massa in Sufism is the spiritual touch - the contact of the soul with the divine reality.
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِن يَمۡسَسۡكَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّۢ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُۥٓ إِلَّا هُوَ
shades.hadith_en: And if Allah should touch you with adversity, no one can remove it except Him

shades.explanation: al-Masis (the toucher) in the Quran refers to one who touches. The Quran says: And when the lote tree was touched by the divine presence (53:16). The masis in the Quran is one who has physical contact. The famous hadith states: The prayer is broken by the black dog, the donkey, and the woman. al-Masis in Sufism is the one who has been touched by divine grace - the seeker whose heart has been opened.
shades.hadith_ar: مَّا زَاغَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
shades.hadith_en: The sight did not swerve nor transgress

shades.explanation: at-Tamassuh (the touching) in the Quran refers to seeking physical contact. The Quran says: And they ask you about menstruation. Say: It is harm, so keep away from wives during menstruation (2:222). at-Tamassuh is the prohibited touch during menstruation. The famous hadith states: There is nothing that contaminates - the touch of the believer does not make impure. at-Tamassuh in Sufism is the spiritual search - the seeker who longs for the touch of Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: يَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلۡمَحِيضِ قُلۡ هُوَ أَذًۭى
shades.hadith_en: And they ask you about menstruation. Say: It is harm

meaning.en: To increase. The root denotes increase, growth, or addition.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الزَّايُ وَالْيَاءُ وَالدَّالُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى زِيَادَةٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: زَادَ: زَادَ عَلَى الْأَصْلِ. وَالزَّائِدُ: الْكَثِيرُ

quran_examples.ar: وَأَنِّى فَضَّلۡتُكُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡعَـٰلَمِينَ
quran_examples.en: And I have preferred you over the worlds

quran_examples.ar: وَيَزِدۡكُمۡ قُوَّةً إِلَىٰ قُوَّةِكُمۡ
quran_examples.en: And He will increase you in strength

hadith.ar: مَنْ أَحَبَّ لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ أَحَبَّ اللَّهُ لِقَاءَهُ
hadith.en: Whoever loves to meet Allah, Allah loves to meet him

hadith.ar: الْمُؤْمِنُ يَزْدَادُ إِيمَانًا وَيُؤْمِنُ بِرَبِّهِ
hadith.en: The believer increases in faith and believes in his Lord

shades.explanation: az-Ziyada (the increase) in the Quran is one of the most fundamental concepts. The Quran says: Whoever desires the increase (ziyada) - let them increase in remembrance of Allah (71:7). az-Ziyada in the Quran is: (1) az-ziyada al-'adadiyya (numerical increase), (2) az-ziyada al-maddiyya (material increase), (3) az-ziyada al-akhirawiyya (spiritual increase). The famous hadith states: Whoever shows enmity to a friend of Mine, I have declared war against him. az-Ziyada in Sufism is the spiritual increase - the elevation of the soul through dhikr.
shades.hadith_ar: وَأَنِّى فَضَّلۡتُكُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡعَـٰلَمِينَ
shades.hadith_en: And I have preferred you over the worlds

shades.explanation: az-Zayed (the increasing one) in the Quran is one who increases. The famous hadith states: Allah is al-Barr (the Most Kind) and loves kindness in all matters. az-Zayed in the Quran is the one who gives increase - the divine gift of abundance. The Quran says: And He gives you increase of Himself in bounty (11:3). az-Zayed in Sufism is the one who has been given spiritual increase - the elevated state of the seeker.
shades.hadith_ar: وَيَزِدۡكُمۡ قُوَّةً إِلَىٰ قُوَّةِكُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: And He will increase you in strength

shades.name_ar: الزَّيۡدُ - الۡفَائِدَةُ، مَا يَزِيدُ عَلَى الۡأَصۡلِ
shades.explanation: az-Zayd (the increase, the benefit) in the Quran is the additional benefit. The Quran says: And He gives you increase of Himself in bounty (11:3). The zayd in the Quran is the additional grace - beyond what is required. The famous hadith states: The Prophet would seek refuge from non-beneficial knowledge. az-Zayd in Sufism is the additional benefit - the extra reward that comes from sincere worship.
shades.hadith_ar: يُو۟تِكُمۡ خَيۡرًۭا مِّنۡ أَمۡوَٰلِكُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: He gives you [something] better than your wealth

shades.explanation: al-Istizada (the seeking of increase) in the Quran refers to asking for more. The Quran says: And ask Allah of His bounty (4:32). al-Istizada is the act of asking Allah for additional grace. The famous hadith states: Whoever shows enmity to a friend of Mine, I have declared war against him. al-Istizada in Sufism is the spiritual asking - the seeker who asks Allah for more of His bounty.
shades.hadith_ar: وَٱسۡـَٔلُواْ ٱللَّهَ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦٓ
shades.hadith_en: And ask Allah of His bounty

meaning.en: To test, try. The root denotes trial, test, or tribulation.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْفَاءُ وَالتَّاءُ وَالنُّونُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى تَكْلِيفٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: فَتَنَ: ابْتَلَى. وَالْفِتْنَةُ: الْبَلِيَّةُ

quran_examples.ar: وَلَا تَحۡسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قُتِلُواْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَمۡوَٰتَۢا
quran_examples.en: And never think of those who have been killed in the way of Allah as dead

quran_examples.ar: وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّمَآ أَمۡوَٰلُكُمۡ وَأَوۡلَـٰدُكُمۡ فِتۡنَةٌۭ
quran_examples.en: And know that your properties and your children are but a trial
quran_examples.context: The test of wealth and children

hadith.ar: سَتَكُونُ فِتَنٌ أَلَا وَإِنَّ أَشَدَّ الْفِتَنِ عَلَى الْأُمَّةِ فِتْنَةُ الدَّجَّالِ
hadith.en: There will be trials - the greatest trial on my ummah is the trial of the Dajjal

hadith.ar: الْفِتَنُ تُوجَجُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ السَّاعَةِ
hadith.en: The trials will come before the Hour

shades.explanation: al-Fitna (the trial, the test) in the Quran is one of the most mentioned concepts. The Quran says: Do not think of those who have been killed in the way of Allah as dead. Rather, they are alive with their Lord (3:169). al-Fitna in the Quran is: (1) al-fitna al-i'tiqadiyya (trial of belief), (2) al-fitna al-maliyya (trial of wealth), (3) al-fitna al-nafsiyya (trial of the self). The famous hadith states: The greatest trial will come after me - one that will affect every Arab. al-Fitna in Sufism is the divine test - the trial that purifies the soul.
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تَزَالُواْ تَخۡتَلِفُونَ حَتَّىٰ يَأۡتِيَكُمُ ٱلۡيَقِينُ
shades.hadith_en: And you will surely differ until the certainty comes to you

shades.explanation: al-Fitin (the trials) in the Quran refers to multiple trials. The Quran says: And know that your properties and your children are but a trial (8:28). al-Fitin in the Quran are the tests that Allah sends to His servants - whether through wealth, family, or the self. The famous hadith states: Trials come in waves like the waves of the sea. al-Fitin in Sufism is the series of trials that the seeker faces - each one is an opportunity for spiritual growth.
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تَحۡسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ أَنَّمَا نُمۡلِى لَهُمۡ خَيۡرٌۭ لِّأَنفُسِهِمۡ
shades.hadith_en: And never think of those who disbelieve that the postponement We give them is better for them

shades.explanation: al-Muftan (the tried one) in the Quran is the one who is being tested. The Quran says: And We test you with evil and with good as trial (21:35). The muftan is one who is being tried by Allah - the test that he will be questioned about. The famous hadith states: The believer's affair is all good - whether he is in hardship or in ease. al-Muftan in Sufism is the seeker who is being tested - the one who is being purified through trials.
shades.hadith_ar: نَبۡلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلۡخَيۡرِ فِتۡنَةًۭ
shades.hadith_en: And We will surely test you with evil and with good as trial

shades.explanation: al-Iftinan (the being tested) in the Quran is the state of being tried. The Quran says: They will not cease fighting you until they turn you back from your religion (2:217). The famous hadith states: There will come a trial that will leave the Muslim without anyone to confide in. al-Iftinan in Sufism is the spiritual trial - the state of being tested in the spiritual path.
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ إِذ ظَّلَمۡتُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ فِى ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُونَ
shades.hadith_en: And it will not benefit you on that Day, when you have wronged, that you are sharing the punishment

meaning.en: To be absent, hidden. The root denotes absence, hiddenness, or the unseen.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْغَيْنُ وَالْيَاءُ وَالْبَاءُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى اسْتِتَارٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: غَابَ: اخْتَفَى. وَالْغَيْبُ: مَا لَا يُدْرَكُ

quran_examples.ar: عَـٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ فَلَا يُظۡهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيۡبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
quran_examples.en: He is the Knower of the unseen, and He does not reveal His unseen to anyone

quran_examples.ar: وَعِندَهُۥ مَفَاتِحُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ لَا يَعۡلَمُهَآ إِلَّا هُوَ
quran_examples.en: And with Him are the keys of the unseen; none knows them except Him

hadith.ar: مَفَاتِيحُ الْغَيۡبِ خَمۡسٌ لَا يَعۡلَمُهُنَّ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
hadith.en: The keys of the unseen are five - only Allah knows them

hadith.ar: كُلُّكُمۡ رَاعٍ وَكُلُّكُمۡ مَسۡئُولٌ عَنۡ رَعِيَّتِهِ
hadith.en: Each of you is a shepherd, and each of you is responsible for his flock

shades.explanation: al-Ghayb (the unseen, the hidden) in the Quran is one of the most profound concepts. The Quran says: He is the Knower of the unseen - He does not reveal His secret to anyone (72:26). al-Ghayb in the Quran is: (1) al-ghayb al-mutlaq (absolute unseen), (2) al-ghayb al-juz'i (partial unseen), (3) al-ghayb al-akhir (the unseen of the Hereafter). The famous hadith states: The keys of the unseen are five - only Allah knows them. al-Ghayb in Sufism is the unseen knowledge - the inner reality that only the awliya can perceive.
shades.hadith_ar: عَـٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ
shades.hadith_en: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed

shades.name_en: Ghayb Allah - The Unseen of Allah
shades.name_ar: غَيۡبُ اللَّهِ - مَا لَا يَعۡلَمُهُ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
shades.explanation: Ghayb Allah (the unseen of Allah) in the Quran is one of Allah's exclusive attributes. The Quran says: And with Him are the keys of the unseen - none knows them except Him (6:59). Ghayb Allah is the absolute unknown - the hidden knowledge that only Allah possesses. The famous hadith states: Five are known only to Allah - the Hour, the rain, the fetus, the soul, and what the soul will earn tomorrow. al-Ghayb in Sufism is the realization that true knowledge comes only from Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: وَعِندَهُۥ مَفَاتِحُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ لَا يَعۡلَمُهَآ إِلَّا هُوَ
shades.hadith_en: And with Him are the keys of the unseen; none knows them except Him

shades.name_ar: الْغَائِبُ - الَّذِي غَابَ، مَن لَا يُشَاهَدُ
shades.explanation: al-Gha'ib (the absent) in the Quran is the one who is absent or hidden. The Quran says: And they found thereupon [their families] what the [evil] eye had taken from them (11:81). The gha'ib is the one who is not present. The famous hadith states: The Hour will not come until the sun rises from the west. al-Gha'ib in Sufism is the hidden state - the unseen reality that the seeker perceives through spiritual vision.
shades.hadith_ar: كُلُّ شَىۡءٍۢ هَالِكٌ إِلَّا وَجۡهَهُۥ
shades.hadith_en: Everything will be destroyed except His Face

shades.explanation: al-Mughayyab (the hidden thing) in the Quran refers to that which is concealed. The famous hadith states: The believer is tested according to his level of iman. al-Mughayyab in the Quran is the concealed thing - the hidden reality. al-Mughayyab in Sufism is the inner reality - the unseen knowledge that comes to the seeker through spiritual states.
shades.hadith_ar: لَا تَعۡلَمُ ٱلنَّفۡسُ مَاذَا تُكۡسِبُ غَدًۭا
shades.hadith_en: No soul knows what it will earn tomorrow

meaning.en: To appear, be apparent. The root denotes appearance, manifestation, or back.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الظَّاءُ وَالْهَاءُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى قُوَّةٍ وَبُرُوزٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: ظَهَرَ: بَرَزَ. وَالظَّهْرُ: ضِدُّ الْبَطْنِ

quran_examples.ar: هُوَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُ وَٱلۡأَخِرُ وَٱلظَّـٰهِرُ وَٱلۡبَاطِنُ
quran_examples.en: He is the First and the Last, the Apparent and the Inward

quran_examples.ar: ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمۡ
quran_examples.en: That is Allah, your Lord

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَنۡظُرُ إِلَى صُوَرِكُمۡ وَأَمۡوَالِكُمۡ
hadith.en: Allah does not look at your forms or your wealth

hadith.ar: جُعِلَتْ لِيَ الْأَرْضُ مَسْجِدًا وَطَهُورًا
hadith.en: The earth has been made for me a place of prayer and purification

shades.explanation: az-Zuhur (the appearance) in the Quran is the opposite of al-batun (the hidden). The Quran says: That is Allah, your Lord; to Him belongs sovereignty (35:13). az-Zuhur in the Quran is: (1) az-zuhur al-jismani (physical appearance), (2) az-zuhur al-qalbi (spiritual manifestation). The famous hadith states: Allah has ninety-nine Names. az-Zuhur in Sufism is the manifestation of divine light - the unveiling of the divine presence.
shades.hadith_ar: وَظَهَرَ ٱلۡفَسَادُ فِى ٱلۡبَرِّ وَٱلۡبَحۡرِ
shades.hadith_en: Corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea

shades.explanation: az-Zahir (the Apparent) is one of the Names of Allah - the One who is manifest in His existence and signs. The Quran says: He is the First and the Last, the Outward [az-Zahir] and the Inward [al-Batin] (57:3). az-Zahir is the One whose existence is manifest through His signs. The famous hadith states: Allah has ninety-nine Names. az-Zahir is the divine manifestation - the One who reveals Himself through His creation.
shades.hadith_ar: هُوَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُ وَٱلۡأَخِرُ وَٱلظَّـٰهِرُ وَٱلۡبَاطِنُ
shades.hadith_en: He is the First and the Last, the Apparent and the Inward

shades.explanation: at-Tazahur (the mutual pretense) in the Quran refers to the false appearance of support. The Quran says: And We have enjoined upon man goodness to parents. But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them (31:14). The tazahur is the false pretense of supporting each other. The famous hadith states: The world is the believer's prison and the disbeliever's paradise. at-Tazahur in Sufism is the false display - the show of piety without inner substance.
shades.hadith_ar: فَلَا تُطِعۡهُمَا
shades.hadith_en: Then do not obey them

shades.name_en: Zahir al-Ard - The Surface of the Earth
shades.explanation: Zahir al-Ard (the surface of the earth) in the Quran is the upper surface. The Quran says: He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, in three darknesses (39:6). Zahir al-Ard in the Quran is the visible part of the earth - the place of worship. The famous hadith states: The whole earth has been made a place of worship for me and my ummah. Zahir al-Ard in Sufism is the external practice - the visible deeds of the believer.
shades.hadith_ar: وَٱللَّهُ ٱنۡتَجَدَ مِنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ بُيُوتًۭا
shades.hadith_en: And Allah has taken from the mountains houses

meaning.en: To postpone, women. The root denotes women or postponement.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: النُّونُ وَالسِّينُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى تَأْنِيثٍ أَوْ تَأْخِيرٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: نَسَأَ: أَخَّرَ. وَالنِّسَاءُ: ضِدُّ الرِّجَالِ

quran_examples.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفۡسٍۢ وَٰحِدَةٍۢ
quran_examples.en: O mankind, fear your Lord, who created you from one soul and created from it its mate
quran_examples.context: The creation of the soul and its mate

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلنَّسِيءُ زِيَادَةٌۭ فِى ٱلۡكُفۡرِ
quran_examples.en: Indeed, the postponement is an addition to disbelief

hadith.ar: خَيۡرُكُمۡ خَيۡرُكُمۡ لِأَهۡلِهِ
hadith.en: The best of you are those who are best to their families

hadith.ar: الدُّنۡيَا مَتَاعٌ
hadith.en: The world is a temporary enjoyment

shades.explanation: an-Nisa (the women) in the Quran is one of the most mentioned groups. Surah an-Nisa (4) is named after this root. The Quran says: O mankind, fear your Lord, who created you from one soul and created from it its mate (4:1). an-Nisa in the Quran is: chaste women, Muslim women, the mothers. The famous hadith states: The best of you are the best to their families. an-Nisa in Sufism is the spiritual feminine - the receptive aspect of the soul.
shades.hadith_ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفۡسٍۢ وَٰحِدَةٍۢ
shades.hadith_en: O mankind, fear your Lord, who created you from one soul and created from it its mate

shades.explanation: al-Imra'a (the woman) in the Quran is the adult female. The famous hadith states: The best of you are the best to their wives. al-Imra'a in Sufism is the spiritual feminine - the aspect of the soul that is receptive to divine grace.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ أَفۡضَلَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ تَصۡلِحُ لِأَفۡضَلِ ٱلرِّجَالِ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed the best of women is she who is suitable for the best of men

shades.explanation: an-Nasi (the delayed) in the Quran refers to the postponement of sacred months. The Quran says: Indeed, the postponement is an addition to disbelief (9:37). The nasi was a pagan practice. The famous hadith states: Time has returned to its original state. an-Nasi in the Quran is condemned - the believer does not manipulate the time of sacred acts.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلنَّسِيءُ زِيَادَةٌۭ فِى ٱلۡكُفۡرِ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed, the postponement is an addition to disbelief

shades.name_en: Nisa' an-Nabiyy - The Wives of the Prophet
shades.explanation: Nisa an-Nabiyy (the wives of the Prophet) in the Quran refers to the wives of Prophet Muhammad. The Quran says: And [remember] when the Prophet confided to one of his wives a statement (66:3). The wives of the Prophet are the mothers of the believers. The famous hadith states: The best of you are the best to their wives. The wives have a special status - they are the mothers of the ummah.
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِذۡ أَسِرَّ ٱلنَّبِيُّ إِلَىٰ بَعۡضِ أَزۡوَٰجِهِۦ حَدِيثًۭا
shades.hadith_en: And when the Prophet confided to one of his wives a statement

meaning.en: To purify, grow. The root denotes purification or growth.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الزَّايُ وَالْكَافُ وَالْوَاوُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى نَمَاءٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: زَكَى: طَهُرَ. وَالزَّكَاةُ: الْحَقُّ الْوَاجِبُ

quran_examples.ar: وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ
quran_examples.en: And establish prayer and give zakah

quran_examples.ar: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
quran_examples.en: He has succeeded who purifies it

hadith.ar: بُنِيَ الْإِسْلَامُ عَلَى خَمۡسٍ
hadith.en: Islam is built on five

hadith.ar: مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنۡ مَالٍ
hadith.en: Charity does not decrease wealth

shades.explanation: az-Zakah (the almsgiving) in the Quran is one of the five pillars of Islam. The Quran says: And establish prayer and give zakah (2:43). az-Zakah in the Quran is: financial almsgiving, spiritual purification. The famous hadith states: Islam is built on five - including zakah. az-Zakah in Sufism is the spiritual purification - the cleansing of the ego through giving.
shades.hadith_ar: وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ
shades.hadith_en: And establish prayer and give zakah

shades.explanation: az-Zakiyy (the pure) in the Quran is the one who has been purified. The famous hadith states: The pure ones are those who are content with their portion. az-Zakiyy in Sufism is the state of the purified soul - the one who has been cleansed through sincere worship.
shades.hadith_ar: يَطۡهَرۡ
shades.hadith_en: He purifies

shades.explanation: at-Tazkiya (the purification) in the Quran is the act of cleansing. The Quran says: He it is who sent among the unlettered a Messenger from themselves, reciting to them His verses and purifying them (62:2). The famous hadith states: Whoever purifies himself has succeeded. at-Tazkiya in Sufism is the spiritual cleansing - the path of the seeker.
shades.hadith_ar: يُزَكِّيهِمۡ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ
shades.hadith_en: He purifies them and teaches them the Book and wisdom

shades.name_en: Zakat an-Nafs - The Purification of the Soul
shades.explanation: Zakat an-Nafs (the purification of the soul) in Islamic ethics refers to the cleansing of the inner self. The Quran says: Indeed he succeeds who purifies himself (87:14). The famous hadith states: The believer sees the sins of his heart as a mountain above his head. Zakat al-Nafs in Sufism is one of the highest stations - the state of the purified soul.
shades.hadith_ar: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
shades.hadith_en: He has succeeded who purifies it

meaning.en: To strike, set forth. The root denotes striking, travel, or setting forth.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الضَّادُ وَالرَّاءُ وَالْبَاءُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى وُصُولٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: ضَرَبَ: وَقَعَ. وَالضَّرْبُ: ضِدُّ الرَّفْعِ

quran_examples.ar: وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡأَمۡثَـٰلُ نَضۡرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
quran_examples.en: And these examples We present to the people that perhaps they will give thought

quran_examples.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِنۡ عِندِنَا قَالُواْ لَوۡلَآ أُوتِىَ مِثۡلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ مُوسَىٰ
quran_examples.en: And when there came to them the truth from Us, they said: Why was he not given like what was given to Musa?

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَسْتَحْيِي أَنْ يَضْرِبَ مَثَلًا مَا بَعُوضَةً فَمَا فَوْقَهَا
hadith.en: Indeed Allah is not shy to make a parable - even of a mosquito or what is above it

hadith.ar: الْمَثَلُ الْحَسَنُ يَجْلِسُ فِي الْقَلْبِ
hadith.en: A good example settles in the heart

shades.name_en: ad-Darb - The Striking, The Setting Forth
shades.name_ar: الضَّرۡبُ - ضِدُّ الضَّرۡبِ، الۡإِقَامَةُ عَلَى الشَّيۡءِ
shades.explanation: ad-Darb (the striking) in the Quran is one of the most versatile terms. The Quran says: And those who, when they commit an immorality or wrong themselves, remember Allah (3:135). ad-Darb in the Quran has many shades: (1) ad-darb al-jismani (physical striking), (2) ad-darb al-majazi (metaphorical striking - setting forth, traveling), (3) ad-darb al-mithl (the setting forth of parables). The famous hadith states: The Prophet used to strike a parable for the people. ad-Darb in Sufism is the spiritual striking - the moving of the soul to Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِذَا ضَرَبۡتُمۡ فِى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَلَيۡسَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ جُنَاحٌ
shades.hadith_en: And when you travel throughout the land, there is no blame upon you

shades.explanation: al-Mathal (the parable) in the Quran is mentioned extensively. The Quran says: And these examples We present to the people that perhaps they will give thought (59:21). al-Mathal in the Quran is: (1) al-mathal al-muhi (the descriptive parable), (2) al-mathal al-'amali (the practical parable). The famous hadith states: Allah's messenger used to strike a parable for the people. al-Mathal in Sufism is the spiritual example - the pattern by which the seeker learns.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَسۡتَحۡىِۦٓ أَن يَضۡرِبَ مَثَلًۭا
shades.hadith_en: Indeed Allah is not shy to make a parable

shades.explanation: al-Mudrib (the striker) in the Quran is one who strikes. The famous hadith states: The tongue is an interpreter of the heart. al-Mudrib in Sufism is the spiritual striker - the one who moves the heart with divine love. The Quran says: And they would say: Why has he not been given something like what was given to Musa? (28:48).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ قَارُونَ كَانَ مِن قَوۡمِ مُوسَىٰ فَبَغَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed Qarun was from the people of Musa, but he tyrannized them

shades.explanation: at-Tadrib (the training) in the Quran refers to the act of practicing. The Quran says: And they found therein a wall that wanted to fall down, and he straightened it (18:77). The famous hadith states: The Prophet used to train his Companions in the knowledge of Islam. at-Tadrib in Sufism is the spiritual training - the practice of the seeker who trains himself in the disciplines of the path.
shades.hadith_ar: وَوَجَدَ مِن دُونِهِمَا قَوۡمًۭا لَّا يَكَادُونَ يَفۡقَهُونَ قَوۡلًۭا
shades.hadith_en: And he found from them, beyond them, a people who could hardly understand speech

meaning.en: To count. The root denotes counting, numbering, or reckoning.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْعَيْنُ وَالدَّالُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى تَعَدُّدٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: عَدَّ: حَسَبَ. وَالْعَدَدُ: الْكَثِيرُ

quran_examples.ar: وَإِن تَعُدُّواْ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحۡصُوهَآ
quran_examples.en: And if you should count the favor of Allah, you could not enumerate them

quran_examples.ar: لَقَدۡ أَحۡصَىٰهُمۡ وَعَدَّهُمۡ عَدًّۭا
quran_examples.en: He has certainly enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting

hadith.ar: لَا تَسْأَلُوا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ عَنْ شَيْءٍ
hadith.en: Do not ask the People of the Book about anything

hadith.ar: الْحِسَابُ يَسِيرٌ وَالْعَرْضُ عَظِيمٌ
hadith.en: The reckoning will be easy and the presentation great

shades.explanation: al-Adad (the counting) in the Quran is one of the most fundamental concepts. The Quran says: And if you should count the favor of Allah, you could not enumerate them (14:34). al-Adad in the Quran is: (1) al-adad al-maddi (material counting), (2) al-adad al-ma'nawi (spiritual counting), (3) al-adad al-ilahi (the divine counting of deeds). The famous hadith states: The believer sees the sins of his heart as a mountain. al-Adad in Sufism is the divine reckoning - the realization that every deed is counted.
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِن تَعُدُّواْ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحۡصُوهَآ
shades.hadith_en: And if you should count the favor of Allah, you could not enumerate them

shades.explanation: al-Ma'dud (the counted, the limited) in the Quran refers to that which has a specific number. The famous hadith states: Allah has ninety-nine Names. al-Ma'dud in the Quran is the bounded thing - that which has a fixed quantity. The Quran says: And there is not any of you except that he will descend into Hellfire (19:71). The ma'dud in Sufism is the limited state - the believer who knows his time is limited.
shades.hadith_ar: لَئِن شَكَرۡتُمۡ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: If you are grateful, I will surely increase you in favor

shades.explanation: al-Itidad (the counting) in the Quran refers to precise counting. The Quran says: He will present to them their deeds, and He has counted them (19:94). The itidad is the precise reckoning - the exact measure of every deed. The famous hadith states: The deed will be presented on the Day of Resurrection and the servant will be questioned. al-Itidad in Sufism is the precise reckoning - the awareness of every deed and its consequence.
shades.hadith_ar: لَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتَ مَا نَحۡنُ نَبۡغِى
shades.hadith_en: You know what we want

shades.explanation: al-Addu (the counting) in the Quran refers to the act of counting. The famous hadith states: Allah's messenger used to count the verses of the Quran every day. al-Addu in the Quran is the act of numbering - the reckoning of deeds. The Quran says: And you will certainly be questioned about what you used to do (16:93). al-Addu in Sufism is the daily reckoning - the muhasaba of the self.
shades.hadith_ar: كُونُوا۟ رَبَّـٰنِيِّـۧنَ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تُعَلِّمُونَ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبَ
shades.hadith_en: Be people of your Lord because of what you teach the Book

meaning.en: To rest, blow. The root denotes spirit, wind, or rest.
meaning.ar: الرُّوحُ: الرِّيحُ، مَا يَحْيَا بِهِ الْإِنْسَانُ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الرَّاءُ وَالْوَاوُ وَالْحَاءُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى نَسِيمٍ أَوْ حَيَاةٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: رَوَحَ: اسْتَرَاحَ. وَالرُّوحُ: ضِدُّ الْجَسَدِ

quran_examples.ar: وَيَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلرُّوحِ ۖ قُلِ ٱلرُّوحُ مِنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّى
quran_examples.en: And they ask you about the spirit. Say: The spirit is from the affair of my Lord

quran_examples.ar: وَأَيَّدۡنَـٰهُ بِرُوحِ ٱلۡقُدُسِ
quran_examples.en: And We supported him with the Holy Spirit
quran_examples.context: The support of the Holy Spirit

hadith.ar: إِنَّ رُوحَ الْقُدُسِ نَفَثَ فِي رُوعِي
hadith.en: The sacred spirit breathed into my soul

hadith.ar: الرُّوحُ أَمْرٌ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ
hadith.en: The spirit is a matter from the command of Allah

shades.name_ar: الرُّوحُ - مَا يَحۡيَا بِهِ الۡإِنۡسَانُ، الرِّيحُ
shades.explanation: ar-Ruh (the spirit, the breath) in the Quran is one of the most profound terms. The Quran says: They ask you about the spirit. Say: The spirit is from the affair of my Lord (17:85). ar-Ruh in the Quran is: (1) ar-ruh al-insani (the human spirit), (2) ar-ruh al-qudsi (the holy spirit - Jibril), (3) ar-ruh al-ilahi (the divine spirit - Allah's command). The famous hadith states: The ruh of the believer goes out and the angels receive it. ar-Ruh in Sufism is the spiritual life - the soul's connection to Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: وَيَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلرُّوحِ ۖ قُلِ ٱلرُّوحُ مِنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّى
shades.hadith_en: And they ask you about the spirit. Say: The spirit is from the affair of my Lord

shades.explanation: ar-Rih (the wind) in the Quran is one of Allah's signs. The Quran says: And among His signs is that He sends the winds as bringers of good tidings (30:46). ar-Rih in the Quran is: (1) ar-rih al-rahma (the wind of mercy), (2) ar-rih al-'adhab (the wind of punishment), (3) ar-rih al-nafi' (the beneficial wind). The famous hadith states: The wind is from the ruh of Allah - it brings life and death. ar-Rih in Sufism is the divine breath - the spiritual inspiration.
shades.hadith_ar: وَمِنۡ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَن يُرۡسِلَ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ مُبَشِّرَٰتٍۢ
shades.hadith_en: And among His signs is that He sends the winds as bringers of good tidings

shades.name_en: Ruh Allah - The Spirit of Allah
shades.name_ar: رُوحُ اللَّهِ - الَّذِي بِهِ حَيَاةُ الۡقُلُوبِ
shades.explanation: Ruh Allah (the Spirit of Allah) in the Quran is the divine spirit that gives life. The Quran says: And the Spirit of Allah breathed into it (15:29). Ruh Allah is the divine life - the breath that gives existence to creation. The famous hadith states: The ruh of the believer is the one that goes out to meet Allah. Ruh Allah in Sufism is the divine presence - the inner life of the believer through his connection to Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى
shades.hadith_en: And I breathed into him of My spirit

shades.name_ar: الرُّوحُ الۡقُدُسُ - جِبۡرِيلُ عَلَيۡهِ السَّلَامُ، جَنَاحُ الْإِيمَانِ
shades.explanation: Ruh al-Qudus (the Holy Spirit) in the Quran is the angel Jibril - the bringer of revelation. The Quran says: And We supported him with the Holy Spirit [Ruh al-Qudus] (2:87). Ruh al-Qudus is the highest of the angels - the one who brings Allah's messages to the prophets. The famous hadith states: The sacred spirit [Ruh al-Qudus] breathed into my soul that no soul will die until it has completed its term. Ruh al-Qudus in Sufism is the spiritual guide - the one who helps the seeker on the path.
shades.hadith_ar: قُولُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡنَا
shades.hadith_en: Say: We believe in Allah and what has been revealed to us

meaning.en: To forbid. The root denotes prohibition or forbidding.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: النُّونُ وَالْهَاءُ وَالْيَاءُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى مَنْعٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: نَهَى: مَنَعَ. وَالنَّاهِي: الْمَانِعُ

quran_examples.ar: وَلۡتَكُن مِّنكُمۡ أُمَّةٌۭ يَدۡعُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡخَيۡرِ
quran_examples.en: And let there be among you a community calling to good

quran_examples.ar: كُنتُمۡ خَيۡرَ أُمَّةٍ أُخۡرِجَتۡ لِلنَّاسِ تَأۡمُرُونَ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِ
quran_examples.en: You are the best nation produced for mankind

hadith.ar: مَنْ رَأَى مِنْكُمۡ مُنكَرًا فَلۡيَغَيِّرۡهُ بِيَدِهِ
hadith.en: Whoever among you sees evil should change it with his hand

hadith.ar: مَنْ دَلَّ عَلَى خَيۡرٍ فَلَهُ مِثۡلُ أَجۡرِ فَاعِلِهِ
hadith.en: Whoever guides to good has the like of the reward of the doer

shades.explanation: an-Nahy (the forbidding) in the Quran is one of the most mentioned acts of command. The Quran says: And those who, when they commit an immorality or wrong themselves, remember Allah and seek forgiveness for their sins (3:135). an-Nahy in the Quran is: (1) an-nahy al-mashiy (forbidding of obedience), (2) an-nahy al-haram (prohibition of the haram), (3) an-nahy al-bida' (prohibition of innovations). The famous hadith states: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent. an-Nahy in Sufism is the spiritual prohibition - the prevention of blameworthy deeds.
shades.hadith_ar: يَنۡهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلۡفَحۡشَآءِ وَٱلۡمُنكَرِ
shades.hadith_en: He forbids immorality and bad conduct

shades.explanation: an-Nahiy (the forbidder) in the Quran is one who forbids evil. The Quran says: Let there be a community among you calling to good and enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong (3:104). The nahiy is the one who enjoins good and forbids evil - one of the highest acts of worship. The famous hadith states: Whoever sees evil should change it with his hand. an-Nahiy in Sufism is the spiritual guide - the one who prevents the seeker from spiritual harm.
shades.hadith_ar: وَلۡتَكُن مِّنكُمۡ أُمَّةٌۭ يَدۡعُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡخَيۡرِ وَيَأۡمُرُونَ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِ وَيَنۡهَوۡنَ عَنِ ٱلۡمُنكَرِ
shades.hadith_en: And let there be among you a community calling to good and enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong

shades.explanation: al-Mutanahi (the forbidden) in the Quran refers to that which is prohibited. The Quran says: And eat and drink, but do not be excessive (7:31). The mutanahi is the prohibited thing - the haram. The famous hadith states: The halal is clear and the haram is clear. al-Mutanahi in Sufism is the boundary of the spiritual path - the prohibition that protects the seeker.
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تَقۡرَبُواْ ٱلۡفَوَٰحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنۡهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ
shades.hadith_en: And do not approach immorality, what is apparent of it and what is concealed

shades.name_en: Nahi al-Munkar - The Forbidding of Evil
shades.name_ar: النَّهۡيُ عَنِ الۡمُنكَرِ - الۡأَمۡرُ بِالۡكَفِّ عَنِ الۡقَبِيحِ
shades.explanation: an-Nahy an al-Munkar (the forbidding of evil) in the Quran is one of the highest acts. The Quran says: You are the best nation produced for mankind - you enjoin good and forbid evil (3:110). The famous hadith states: Whoever enjoins good and forbids evil has attained the ultimate salvation. an-Nahy in Sufism is the spiritual discipline - the prevention of spiritual harm.
shades.hadith_ar: كُنتُمۡ خَيۡرَ أُمَّةٍ أُخۡرِجَتۡ لِلنَّاسِ تَأۡمُرُونَ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِ وَتَنۡهَوۡنَ عَنِ ٱلۡمُنكَرِ
shades.hadith_en: You are the best nation produced for mankind - you enjoin good and forbid evil

meaning.en: To call. The root denotes calling or summoning.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: النُّونُ وَالدَّالُ وَالْوَاوُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى صَوْتٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: نَدَا: صَاحَ. وَالنِّدَاءُ: الصَّوْتُ الْعَالِي

quran_examples.ar: فَإِذَا قَضَيۡتُمۡ مَنَـٰسِكَكُمۡ فَٱذۡكُرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَذِكۡرِكُمۡ ءَابَآءَكُمۡ
quran_examples.en: So when you have completed your rites, remember Allah

quran_examples.ar: يَوۡمَ نَدۡعُواْ كُلَّ أُنَاسٍۢ بِإِمَـٰمِهِمۡ
quran_examples.en: The Day We will call every people by their imam
quran_examples.context: The calling on the Day of Judgment

hadith.ar: إِذَا نُودِيَ لِلصَّلَاةِ أَدْبَرَ الشَّيْطَانُ
hadith.en: When the call to prayer is made, the devil flees

hadith.ar: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَجِيبُوا لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ
hadith.en: O you who believe, respond to Allah and to the Messenger

shades.explanation: an-Nida' (the calling) in the Quran is one of the most fundamental acts. The Quran says: So when you have completed the rites of Hajj, remember Allah like your [previous] remembrance of your fathers (2:200). an-Nida' in the Quran is: (1) an-nida' al-ilahi (the divine calling), (2) an-nida' al-insani (the human calling), (3) an-nida' al-samawi (the heavenly calling). The famous hadith states: The Prophet was called by Allah in the Night Journey. an-Nida' in Sufism is the spiritual call - the divine invitation to the seeker.
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئۡتِ ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
shades.hadith_en: And when your Lord called Musa: Go to the wrongdoing people

shades.explanation: an-Nadi (the caller) in the Quran is one who calls. The Quran says: And call to your Lord, that He may admit you to a noble entrance (17:80). The nadi is the one who calls others to Allah - the da'iya. The famous hadith states: Whoever guides to good has the like of the reward of the doer. an-Nadi in Sufism is the spiritual caller - the murshid who invites the seeker to the path of Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: وَٱدۡعُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ تَضَرُّعًۭا وَخُفۡيَةً
shades.hadith_en: And call upon your Lord in humility and privately

shades.explanation: al-Munda (the one called) in the Quran is the one who is being called. The Quran says: And when the call is made from a place nearby (17:71). The munda in the Quran is the one being summoned by Allah - the believer being called to His presence. The famous hadith states: Allah says: O My servant, call upon Me and I will respond. al-Munda in Sufism is the one being summoned - the seeker whose heart is responding to the divine call.
shades.hadith_ar: إِذَا نُودِىَ لِلصَّلَوٰةِ مِن يَوۡمِ ٱلۡجُمۡعَةِ
shades.hadith_en: When the call is made for prayer on the day of Jumu'ah

shades.explanation: al-Munadi (the caller, the herald) in the Quran is one who calls out. The famous hadith states: When you call to prayer, the devils flee. The munadi is the one who announces - the mu'adhdhin. The Quran says: And We did not send any warner except from within the people of each city (25:51). al-Munadi in Sufism is the spiritual herald - the one who announces the way to Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدۡحًۭا فَمُلَـٰقِيهِ
shades.hadith_en: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord and will meet it

meaning.en: To be weak. The root denotes weakness or feebleness.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الضَّادُ وَالْعَيْنُ وَالْفَاءُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى ضِدِّ الْقُوَّةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: ضَعُفَ: وَهَنَ. وَالضَّعِيفُ: ضِدُّ الْقَوِيِّ

quran_examples.ar: وَخُلِقَ ٱلۡإِنسَـٰنُ ضَعِيفًا
quran_examples.en: And man was created weak

quran_examples.ar: لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا وُسۡعَهَا
quran_examples.en: Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity

hadith.ar: لَا تَمَلُّوا وَلَا تَسۡأَمُوا فِي الۡعَمَلِ
hadith.en: Do not become weary or discouraged

hadith.ar: إِنَّمَا الۡأَعۡمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ
hadith.en: Indeed deeds are judged by intentions

shades.explanation: ad-Daf (the weakness) in the Quran is one of the most mentioned human states.
