The Quran says: Allah wants to lighten for you, and man was created weak (4:28). ad-Daf in the Quran is: (1) ad-daf al-jismani (physical weakness), (2) ad-daf al-nafsi (psychological weakness), (3) ad-daf al-amani (weakness of hope). The famous hadith states: The believers are tested according to their iman - the strongest are tested most. ad-Daf in Sufism is the state of spiritual weakness - the seeker who recognizes his need for Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ أَن يُخَفِّفَ عَنكُمۡ ۚ وَخُلِقَ ٱلۡإِنسَـٰنُ ضَعِيفًا
shades.hadith_en: Allah wants to lighten for you, and man was created weak

shades.name_ar: الضَّعِيفُ - الَّذِي لَا قُوَّةَ لَهُ، الۡوَاهِي
shades.explanation: ad-Daif (the weak one) in the Quran is one who has no strength. The Quran says: And Allah wants to lighten for you (4:28). The daif in the Quran is the one who lacks strength - whether physical, spiritual, or material. The famous hadith states: The believer's iman has 70+ branches - the lowest is removing harm from the road. ad-Daif in Sufism is the humble believer - the one who knows his weakness before Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: وَٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرۡسَلَ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًۭا فَسُقۡنَـٰهُ
shades.hadith_en: And Allah is the One who sends the winds, and they stir up clouds

shades.explanation: ad-Dafan (the two weaknesses) in the Quran refers to the weakness of men and wealth. The Quran says: And it was already revealed to you and to those before you that if you should associate [anything] with Allah, your work would surely become worthless (39:65). The dafan in the Quran is the dual weakness - both the man and his means. The famous hadith states: The believer is tested through his family and wealth. ad-Dafan in Sufism is the dual test - the seeker tested through both inner and outer trials.
shades.hadith_ar: لَئِن شَكَرۡتُمۡ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: If you are grateful, I will surely increase you in favor

shades.explanation: at-Tadaf (the growing weakness) in the Quran refers to the increase of weakness. The Quran says: Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity (2:286). The tadaf in the Quran is the increasing weakness of the disbelievers on the Day of Resurrection - the compounding of their punishment. The famous hadith states: Trials come in waves - each one worse than the last. at-Tadaf in Sufism is the spiritual weakness that the seeker must overcome through constant dhikr.
shades.hadith_ar: لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا وُسۡعَهَا
shades.hadith_en: Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity

meaning.en: Below. The root denotes below, under, or beneath.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: التَّاءُ وَالْحَاءُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى سُفُولٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: تَحْتَ: ضِدُّ فَوْقَ. وَالتُّحُوتُ: مَا يَكُونُ أَسْفَلَ

quran_examples.ar: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعًۭا مِّنۡهُ
quran_examples.en: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him

quran_examples.ar: تَجۡرِى مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَـٰرُ
quran_examples.en: Beneath it rivers flow

hadith.ar: جَنَّاتُ عَدۡنٍ تَجۡرِي مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡأَنۡهَارُ
hadith.en: Gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow

hadith.ar: إِنَّ مَعَ الۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرًا
hadith.en: Indeed with hardship comes ease

shades.explanation: at-Taht (the below) in the Quran is one of the most mentioned directions. The Quran says: He subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth (45:13). at-Taht in the Quran is: (1) at-taht al-maddi (physical below), (2) at-taht al-ma'nawi (spiritual below), (3) at-taht al-jahimi (the lowest level of Hell). The famous hadith states: The seven heavens are above the Kursi. at-Taht in Sufism is the state of humility - the seeker who places himself below all in his love for Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعًۭا مِّنۡهُ
shades.hadith_en: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him

shades.explanation: al-Asfal (the lower) in the Quran refers to that which is below. The Quran says: And whether We show you some of what We promise them or We take you in [death], indeed their recompense is upon Allah (3:179). The asfal in the Quran is the lower level - whether of the earth or the Hell. The famous hadith states: The lowest level of Heaven is for the sincere believers. al-Asfal in Sufism is the lower state - the spiritual descent that the seeker experiences in his journey.
shades.hadith_ar: فَإِمَّا مَنۡنَا بَعۡدُ وَإِمَّا فِدَآءًۭ
shades.hadith_en: Then either [we grant] mercy after [that], or ransom

shades.name_ar: تَحۡتَ - ضِدُّ فَوۡقَ، أَسۡفَلَ مِنَ الشَّيۡءِ
shades.explanation: Tahat (under) in the Quran refers to that which is below something else. The Quran says: Beneath it rivers flow (2:25). The tahat in the Quran is the below - the rivers under the throne, the shadows under the trees. The famous hadith states: The rivers of Paradise flow under the palaces of the believers. Tahat in Sufism is the state of being under divine protection - the seeker who is under the shadow of Allah's mercy.
shades.hadith_ar: تَجۡرِى مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَـٰرُ
shades.hadith_en: Beneath it rivers flow

shades.explanation: al-Mutahawwil (the one who descends) in the Quran refers to one who goes lower. The Quran says: He sends the angels with the Spirit by His permission upon whom He wills of His servants (16:2). The mutahawwil is the one who descends - whether the angel or the divine mercy. The famous hadith states: Allah descends to the lowest heaven every night. al-Mutahawwil in Sufism is the descent of the divine presence - the spiritual coming down of Allah to the level of His servant.
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تَسۡأَلُواْ أَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبِ عَن شَىۡءٍ
shades.hadith_en: And do not ask the People of the Book about anything

meaning.en: To be good, pure. The root denotes goodness, purity, or pleasantness.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الطَّاءُ وَالْيَاءُ وَالْبَاءُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى طِيبٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: طَابَ: حَسُنَ. وَالطَّيِّبُ: ضِدُّ الْخَبِيثِ

quran_examples.ar: كُلُواْ مِن طَيِّبَـٰتِ مَا رَزَقۡنَـٰكُمۡ
quran_examples.en: Eat from the good things We have provided for you

quran_examples.ar: وَشَجَرَةٍۢ تَخۡرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيۡنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهۡنِ وَصِبۡغٍۢ لِّلۡأَكِلِينَ
quran_examples.en: And a tree that grows from Mount Sinai, producing oil and a seasoning for those who eat

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ طَيِّبٌ لَا يَقْبَلُ إِلَّا طَيِّبًا
hadith.en: Indeed Allah is Tayyib and He only accepts what is good

hadith.ar: الْكَلِمَةُ الطَّيِّبَةُ صَدَقَةٌ
hadith.en: A good word is sadaqa

shades.explanation: at-Tayyib (the good) in the Quran is one of the most frequent qualifiers. The Quran says: And eat of the good things which We have provided for you (2:172). The famous hadith states: Allah is Tayyib and He only accepts what is good.
shades.hadith_ar: وَكُلُواْ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ وَٱعۡمَلُواْ صَـٰلِحًا
shades.hadith_en: And eat from the good things and do righteous deeds

shades.explanation: Tayyib al-Qawl (the good word) in the Quran refers to wholesome speech. The Quran says: And say to My servants that they should say that which is best (17:53). The famous hadith states: The good word is sadaqa.
shades.hadith_ar: وَقُل لِّعِبَادِى يَقُولُواْ ٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحۡسَنُ
shades.hadith_en: And say to My servants that they should say that which is best

shades.explanation: al-Mutayyab (the perfumed) in the Quran refers to that which has been perfumed. The famous hadith states: The Prophet used to use perfume - especially on Fridays.
shades.hadith_ar: وَٱلۡجُنُودَ ٱلۡفِرۡعَوۡنَ
shades.hadith_en: And the hosts of Pharaoh

shades.explanation: Tayyib al-Khuluq (the good character) in the Quran refers to noble traits. The famous hadith states: I was sent to perfect the noble character.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّمَا بُعِثۡتُ لِأُتَمِّمَ مَكَارِمَ الۡأَخۡلَاقِ
shades.hadith_en: I was sent to perfect the noble character

meaning.en: To be corrupt, to spoil. The root denotes corruption, decay, or disorder.
meaning.ar: الۡفَسَادُ: خُرُوجُ الشَّيۡءِ عَنِ الۡقَصۡدِ وَالصَّلَاحِ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡفَاءُ وَالسِّينُ وَالدَّالُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى ذَهَابِ الشَّيۡءِ عَنِ الۡاِسۡتِقَامَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: فَسَدَ: ضِدَّ صَلَحَ. وَالۡفَسَادُ فِي الۡأَرۡضِ: الۡكُفۡرُ وَالۡمَعَاصِي

quran_examples.ar: لَا تُفۡسِدُواْ فِي الۡأَرۡضِ
quran_examples.en: Do not spread corruption on the earth

quran_examples.ar: سَعَىٰ فِي الۡأَرۡضِ لِيُفۡسِدَ فِيهَا
quran_examples.en: He strives to spread corruption on the earth

hadith.ar: إِذَا لَمۡ تَأۡمُرُواْ بِالۡمَعۡرُوفِ وَلَمۡ تَنۡهَوۡاْ عَنِ الۡمُنكَرِ سَلَّطَ اللَّهُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ شِرَارَكُمۡ
hadith.en: If you do not enjoin good and forbid evil, Allah will let the worst among you rule over you

hadith.ar: مَنۡ رَأَىٰ مِنكُم مُّنكَرًا فَلۡيُغَيِّرۡهُ بِيَدِهِ
hadith.en: Whoever among you sees an evil, let him change it with his hand

shades.name_ar: الۡفَسَادُ - ضِدُّ الصَّلَاحِ، الۡخُرُوجُ عَنِ الۡقَصۡدِ
shades.explanation: al-Fasad (the corruption) in the Quran is a major concept standing opposite to al-Salah. The Quran says: And when it is said to them, 'Do not spread corruption on the earth,' they say, 'We are but reformers' (2:11). al-Fasad in the Quran encompasses moral decay, social injustice, and spiritual corruption.
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ لَا تُفۡسِدُواْ فِي الۡأَرۡضِ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَا نَحۡنُ مُصۡلِحُونَ
shades.hadith_en: And when it is said to them, 'Do not spread corruption on the earth,' they say, 'We are but reformers'

shades.name_ar: الۡمُفۡسِدُونَ - الَّذِينَ يَعۡمَلُونَ بِالۡفَسَادِ فِي الۡأَرۡضِ
shades.explanation: al-Mufsidun (the corrupters) in the Quran are those who actively spread corruption. The Quran says: And when he turns away, he strives to spread corruption on the earth (2:205). The mufsidun are condemned throughout the Quran as those who cause widespread harm.
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِذَا تَوَلَّىٰ سَعَىٰ فِي الۡأَرۡضِ لِيُفۡسِدَ فِيهَا
shades.hadith_en: And when he turns away, he strives to spread corruption on the earth

shades.explanation: al-Ifsad (the act of corrupting) in the Quran refers to the deliberate causation of corruption. The Quran says: And Allah does not like corruption (2:205). The ifsad is the active pursuit of disorder and harm - whether through oppression, injustice, or disbelief.
shades.hadith_ar: وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الۡفَسَادَ
shades.hadith_en: And Allah does not like corruption

shades.name_ar: الۡفَاسِدُ - مَا خَرَجَ عَنِ الصَّلَاحِ، الۡمُنۡتَقِضُ
shades.explanation: al-Fasid (the spoiled) in the Quran refers to that which has become corrupt. The famous hadith states: When a person dies, his deeds come to an end except three. al-Fasid in the Quran is the corrupt thing - whether food, deed, or belief.
shades.hadith_ar: مَثَلُ مَا يُنفِقُونَ فِي هَـٰذِهِ الۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا كَمَثَلِ رِيحٍ فِيهَا صِرٌّ
shades.hadith_en: The parable of what they spend in this worldly life is like a wind containing frost

meaning.en: To benefit. The root denotes benefit, utility, or advantage.
meaning.ar: النَّفۡعُ: ضِدُّ الضُّرِّ، مَا يَصِلُ إِلَى الۡإِنۡسَانِ مِنَ الۡخَيۡرِ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: النُّونُ وَالۡفَاءُ وَالۡعَيۡنُ أَصۡلٌ وَاحِدٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى ضِدِّ الضُّرِّ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: نَفَعَ: ضِدَّ ضَرَّ. وَالنَّفۡعُ مَا يَصِلُ إِلَى الۡحَيَوَانِ مِنۡ خَيۡرٍ يُوجَدُ لَهُ

quran_examples.ar: وَيَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُمۡ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمۡ
quran_examples.en: And they worship besides Allah that which neither harms them nor benefits them

quran_examples.ar: فِيهِمَا إِثۡمٌ كَبِيرٌ وَمَنَافِعُ لِلنَّاسِ
quran_examples.en: In them is great sin and yet some benefit for people

hadith.ar: الۡمُؤۡمِنُ الۡقَوِيُّ خَيۡرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ
hadith.en: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer

hadith.ar: احۡرِصۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَنفَعُكَ وَاسۡتَعِنۡ بِاللَّهِ وَلَا تَعۡجَزۡ
hadith.en: Be keen on what benefits you, seek help from Allah, and do not be helpless

shades.explanation: an-Naf (the benefit) in the Quran is the opposite of harm. The Quran says: And they worship besides Allah that which neither harms them nor benefits them (10:18). an-Naf in the Quran is the good that reaches a person - whether material or spiritual. The famous hadith states: Be keen on what benefits you, seek help from Allah, and do not be helpless.
shades.hadith_ar: وَيَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُمۡ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: And they worship besides Allah that which neither harms them nor benefits them

shades.name_ar: الۡمَنۡفَعَةُ - مَا يُحۡصَلُ بِهِ النَّفۡعُ، الۡفَائِدَةُ
shades.explanation: al-Manfaah (the advantage) in the Quran refers to concrete benefits. The Quran says: They ask you about intoxicants and gambling. Say: In them is great sin and [yet] some benefit for people (2:219). The manafih in the Quran are the worldly benefits that people seek. The famous hadith states: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer.
shades.hadith_ar: فِيهِمَا إِثۡمٌ كَبِيرٌ وَمَنَافِعُ لِلنَّاسِ
shades.hadith_en: In them is great sin and [yet] some benefit for people

shades.explanation: al-Intifa (the deriving of benefit) in the Quran refers to the act of benefiting from something. The Quran says: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth (45:13). The intifa in the Quran is the utilization of divine blessings. The famous hadith states: The believer's faith does not benefit him until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
shades.hadith_ar: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِي السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي الۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعًا مِّنۡهُ
shades.hadith_en: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth

shades.explanation: an-Nafi (the beneficial) in the Quran refers to that which brings good. The Quran says: And We send down from the Quran that which is healing and mercy for the believers (17:82). The nafi in the Quran is the beneficial thing - whether knowledge, action, or provision. The famous hadith states: The most beneficial of people is the one who benefits others.
shades.hadith_ar: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الۡقُرۡءَانِ مَا هُوَ شِفَآءٌ وَرَحۡمَةٌ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
shades.hadith_en: And We send down from the Quran that which is healing and mercy for the believers

meaning.en: To reason, to understand. The root denotes intellect, reason, or understanding.
meaning.ar: الۡعَقۡلُ: مَا يُمَيَّزُ بِهِ الۡحَقُّ مِنَ الۡبَاطِلِ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡعَيۡنُ وَالۡقَافُ وَاللَّامُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡمَنۡعِ وَالۡحُبۡسِ ثُمَّ الۡعَقۡل
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الۡعَقۡلُ: مَا يَعۡقِلُ بِهِ الۡإِنۡسَانُ، وَهُوَ الۡحِجۡرُ وَالنُّهَىٰ

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍۢ لِّقَوۡمٍۢ يَعۡقِلُونَ
quran_examples.en: Indeed in that are signs for a people who use reason

quran_examples.ar: وَيُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ الۡآيَاتِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
quran_examples.en: And Allah makes the signs clear to you that you may use reason

hadith.ar: الۡكَيسُ مَنۡ دَانَ نَفۡسَهُ وَعَمِلَ لِمَا بَعۡدَ الۡمَوۡتِ
hadith.en: The wise person is the one who holds his soul accountable and works for what comes after death

hadith.ar: مَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ شَيۡئًا أَکۡرَمَ عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ الۡعَقۡلِ
hadith.en: Allah has not created anything more honorable to Him than the intellect

shades.name_ar: الۡعَقۡلُ - مَا يُمَيِّزُ بِهِ الۡإِنۡسَانُ الۡحَقَّ مِنَ الۡبَاطِلِ
shades.explanation: al-Aql (the intellect) in the Quran is the faculty of reason and understanding. The Quran says: Indeed in that are signs for a people who use reason (13:4). al-Aql in the Quran is the highest faculty given to humans - the ability to distinguish truth from falsehood, to reflect on creation, and to understand divine revelation. The famous hadith states: A person's religion is his intellect.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍۢ لِّقَوۡمٍۢ يَعۡقِلُونَ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed in that are signs for a people who use reason

shades.explanation: al-Uqala (the intelligent ones) in the Quran are those who use their intellect. The Quran says: And He makes the signs clear to you that you may use reason (2:242). The uqala are those who reflect on the signs of Allah and understand the message. The famous hadith states: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: وَيُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ الۡآيَاتِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
shades.hadith_en: And Allah makes the signs clear to you that you may use reason

shades.name_en: Tafkir wa Tadabbur - Reflection and Contemplation
shades.name_ar: التَّفۡكِيرُ وَالتَّدَبُّرُ - اسۡتِعۡمَالُ الۡعَقۡلِ فِي التَّأَمُّلِ
shades.explanation: Tafkir wa Tadabbur (reflection and contemplation) in the Quran are closely tied to aql. The Quran says: And thus do We explain the signs in detail that they may reflect (10:24). The aql in the Quran is not just theoretical reason but practical wisdom that leads to faith and action. The famous hadith states: An hour of reflection is better than a night of worship.
shades.hadith_ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ الۡآيَاتِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
shades.hadith_en: And thus do We explain the signs in detail that they may reflect

shades.explanation: al-Hijr (the restraint) in the Quran is related to the intellect - the aql prevents the person from evil. The Quran says: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or gives ear while he is present (50:37). The famous hadith states: The wise person is the one who holds his soul accountable and works for what comes after death.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكۡرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُ قَلۡبٌ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart

meaning.en: To be hasty, to hasten. The root denotes haste, speed, or urgency.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡعَيۡنُ وَالۡجِيمُ وَاللَّامُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى السُّرۡعَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: عَجِلَ: أَسۡرَعَ. وَالۡعَجَلَةُ: السُّرۡعَةُ وَالۡحِرۡصُ

quran_examples.ar: وَكَانَ الۡإِنسَـٰنُ عَجُولًا
quran_examples.en: And man is ever hasty

quran_examples.ar: وَيَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَكَ بِالۡعَذَابِ
quran_examples.en: And they ask you to hasten the punishment

hadith.ar: الۡأَنَاةُ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَالۡعَجَلَةُ مِنَ الشَّيۡطَانِ
hadith.en: Deliberation is from Allah and haste is from Shaitan

hadith.ar: التَّأَنِّي فِي الۡأُمُورِ خَيۡرٌ إِلَّا فِي عَمَلِ الۡآخِرَةِ
hadith.en: Deliberation in matters is good except in deeds of the Hereafter

shades.explanation: al-Eajal (the haste) in the Quran refers to hastiness. The Quran says: And man is ever hasty (17:11). al-Eajal in the Quran is the human tendency to rush - whether in prayer, judgment, or desire. The famous hadith states: Deliberation is from Allah and haste is from Shaitan.
shades.hadith_ar: وَكَانَ الۡإِنسَـٰنُ عَجُولًا
shades.hadith_en: And man is ever hasty

shades.name_ar: الۡاِسۡتِعۡجَالُ - طَلَبُ الۡعَجَلَةِ، الۡحَثُّ عَلَى السُّرۡعَةِ
shades.explanation: al-Istiejal (the urgency) in the Quran refers to seeking haste. The Quran says: And they ask you to hasten the punishment (29:54). The istiejal in the Quran is the disbelievers' demand for immediate punishment. The famous hadith states: Whoever seeks haste in a matter and it is not granted, he fails.
shades.hadith_ar: وَيَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَكَ بِالۡعَذَابِ
shades.hadith_en: And they ask you to hasten the punishment

shades.explanation: al-Eajalah (the hastiness) in the Quran is the lack of deliberation. The Quran says: And whoever desires the harvest of this world, We give him thereof (42:20). The eajalah in the Quran is the worldly haste that leads to regret. The famous hadith states: Indeed, haste is from Shaitan.
shades.hadith_ar: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرۡثَ الۡأُخۡرَىٰ نَزِدۡ لَهُ فِي حَرۡثِهِ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever desires the harvest of the Hereafter, We increase for him in his harvest

shades.explanation: al-Mutaeajjil (the one who hurries) in the Quran refers to one who rushes. The Quran says: And the prayer of man is for evil as his prayer is for good (17:11). The mutaeajjil is the impulsive person. The famous hadith states: Allah loves that when you do a deed, you do it thoroughly.
shades.hadith_ar: وَيَدۡعُ الۡإِنسَـٰنُ بِالشَّرِّ دُعَاءَهُ بِالۡخَيۡرِ
shades.hadith_en: And man prays for evil as he prays for good

meaning.en: To covenant, to promise. The root denotes covenant, pledge, or promise.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡعَيۡنُ وَالۡهَاءُ وَالدَّالُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى حِفۡظِ شَيۡءٍ وَوِقَائِهِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الۡعَهۡدُ: الْوَصِيَّةُ وَالْيَمِينُ وَالذِّمَّةُ

quran_examples.ar: وَأَوۡفُواْ بِعَهۡدِ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا عَاهَدتُّمۡ
quran_examples.en: And fulfill the covenant of Allah when you have made a covenant

quran_examples.ar: أَلَسۡتُ بِرَبِّكُمۡ قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ
quran_examples.en: Am I not your Lord? They said: Yes

hadith.ar: آيَةُ الۡمُنَافِقِ ثَلَاثٌ إِذَا حَدَّثَ كَذَبَ وَإِذَا وَعَدَ أَخۡلَفَ وَإِذَا ائۡتُمِنَ خَانَ
hadith.en: The signs of the hypocrite are three: when he speaks he lies, when he promises he breaks his promise, and when he is trusted he betrays

hadith.ar: لَا إِيمَانَ لِمَن لَّا أَمَانَةَ لَهُ
hadith.en: There is no faith for one who has no trustworthiness

shades.explanation: al-Eahd (the covenant) in the Quran is one of the most significant concepts. The Quran says: And fulfill the covenant of Allah when you have made a covenant (16:91). al-Eahd in the Quran is the solemn binding agreement between Allah and His servants - whether the primordial covenant of Alastu bi-Rabbikum (7:172) or the covenants made with the prophets. The famous hadith states: Fulfill the covenant of Allah, for it is a trust.
shades.hadith_ar: وَأَوۡفُواْ بِعَهۡدِ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا عَاهَدتُّمۡ
shades.hadith_en: And fulfill the covenant of Allah when you have made a covenant

shades.explanation: al-Mithaq (the solemn covenant) in the Quran refers to a strong, binding covenant. The Quran says: And [remember] when We took the covenant of the Children of Israel (2:83). The mithaq in the Quran is the binding agreement that holds a people to their obligations.
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِذۡ أَخَذۡنَا مِيثَاقَ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ
shades.hadith_en: And when We took the covenant of the Children of Israel

shades.explanation: al-Euhud (the pledges) in the Quran are the various covenants made with Allah. The Quran says: And those who fulfill their covenant when they have made a covenant (2:177). The euhud in the Quran are the obligations that bind the believer to his Lord and to others.
shades.hadith_ar: وَٱلۡمُوفُونَ بِعَهۡدِهِمۡ إِذَا عَاهَدُواْ
shades.hadith_en: And those who fulfill their covenant when they have made a covenant

shades.explanation: al-Eahd (the trust) in the Quran is also understood as the trust that must be fulfilled. The Quran says: O you who have believed, fulfill [all] contracts (5:1). The eahd in the Quran is the trust that the believer must uphold. The famous hadith states: The signs of the hypocrite are three: when he speaks he lies, when he promises he breaks his promise, and when he is trusted he betrays.
shades.hadith_ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوٓاْ أَوۡفُواْ بِالۡعُقُودِ
shades.hadith_en: O you who have believed, fulfill [all] contracts

meaning.en: To protect, to preserve. The root denotes guardianship, preservation, or protection.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡحَاءُ وَالۡفَاءُ وَالظَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡحِرَاسَةِ وَالۡحِفۡظِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: حَفِظَ: صَانَ وَرَعَىٰ. الۡحَافِظُ: الۡقَيِّمُ

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا الذِّكۡرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَـٰفِظُونَ
quran_examples.en: Indeed, it is We who sent down the Quran and indeed, We will be its guardians
quran_examples.context: The divine preservation of the Quran

quran_examples.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ لِفُرُوجِهِمۡ حَـٰفِظُونَ
quran_examples.en: And those who guard their private parts

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يُعَلِّمُونَ النَّاسَ الۡخَيۡرَ
hadith.en: Indeed Allah and His angels pray for those who teach people good

hadith.ar: مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَحۡفَظُ الۡقُرۡآنَ مَثَلُ صَاحِبِ الۡإِبِلِ الۡمُعَقَّلَةِ
hadith.en: The example of the one who memorizes the Quran is like the owner of a tethered camel

shades.explanation: al-Hifz (the protection) in the Quran refers to divine preservation. The Quran says: Indeed, it is We who sent down the Quran and indeed, We will be its guardians (15:9). al-Hifz in the Quran is the divine protection of revelation and of the believers. The famous hadith states: Protect the commands of Allah, He will protect you.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا الذِّكۡرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَـٰفِظُونَ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed, it is We who sent down the Quran and indeed, We will be its guardians

shades.explanation: al-Hafizun (the guardians) in the Quran are those who preserve and protect. The Quran says: And those who guard their private parts (23:5). The hafizun in the Quran are the righteous who fulfill their responsibilities.
shades.hadith_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ لِفُرُوجِهِمۡ حَـٰفِظُونَ
shades.hadith_en: And those who guard their private parts

shades.explanation: al-Hifazah (the guardianship) in the Quran is the act of preserving. The Quran says: And indeed, the Quran is a reminder for the righteous (69:48). The famous hadith states: The example of the one who memorizes the Quran is like the owner of a tethered camel.
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذۡكِرَةٌ لِّلۡمُتَّقِينَ
shades.hadith_en: And indeed it is a reminder for the righteous

shades.explanation: al-Tahaffuz (the self-preservation) in the Quran refers to guarding oneself. The Quran says: And fear Allah and know that Allah is with the righteous (2:194). The tahaffuz in the Quran is the believer's vigilance. The famous hadith states: Protect yourself from the Fire even with half a date.
shades.hadith_ar: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ الۡمُتَّقِينَ
shades.hadith_en: And fear Allah and know that Allah is with the righteous

meaning.en: To turn back, to arrange. The root denotes turning away, leaving, or managing.
meaning.ar: الدُّبُرُ: خَلۡفُ الشَّيۡءِ. التَّدۡبِيرُ: النَّظَرُ فِي الۡأُمُورِ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الدَّالُ وَالۡبَاءُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى عَقِبِ الشَّيۡءِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: دَبَرَ: وَلَّىٰ. وَأَدۡبَرَ: فَعَلَ ذَٰلِكَ

quran_examples.ar: وَمَن يُوَلِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٍۢ دُبُرَهُۥ
quran_examples.en: And whoever turns his back to them on that day
quran_examples.context: The prohibition of retreat in battle

quran_examples.ar: يُدَبِّرُ الۡأَمۡرَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ إِلَى الۡأَرۡضِ
quran_examples.en: He arranges the matter from the heaven to the earth

hadith.ar: لَا أُوتِيكُمۡ بَعۡدَهَا أَبَدًا حَتَّىٰ تَرۡجِعُواْ إِلَىٰ دِينِنَا
hadith.en: I will not give you after this ever until you return to our religion

hadith.ar: إِذَا قِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ تَعَالَوۡاْ إِلَىٰ مَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ
hadith.en: When it is said to people: Come to what Allah has revealed

shades.explanation: ad-Dubur (the back) in the Quran refers to the rear or the opposite of the front. The Quran says: And they turned their backs [in retreat] (8:15). ad-Dubur in the Quran is the back of something - whether physical retreat in battle or the turning away in rejection.
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَن يُوَلِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٍۢ دُبُرَهُۥ
shades.hadith_en: And whoever turns his back to them on that day

shades.explanation: al-Idbar (the turning away) in the Quran refers to retreat or rejection. The Quran says: So flee to Allah (51:50). The idbar in the Quran is the act of turning away - whether from truth in disbelief or from battle in cowardice.
shades.hadith_ar: فَفِرُّوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ
shades.hadith_en: So flee to Allah

shades.explanation: at-Tadbir (the management) in the Quran refers to divine planning. The Quran says: He arranges [every] matter from the heaven to the earth (32:5). at-Tadbir in the Quran is the management of affairs - whether by Allah in His creation or by humans in their lives.
shades.hadith_ar: يُدَبِّرُ الۡأَمۡرَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ إِلَى الۡأَرۡضِ
shades.hadith_en: He arranges the matter from the heaven to the earth

shades.name_en: al-Mudbir - The One Who Turns Away
shades.explanation: al-Mudbir (the one who turns away) in the Quran refers to one who flees or rejects. The Quran says: And whoever turns away and disbelieves, then indeed Allah is Free of need (39:7). The famous hadith states: Fleeing from the battlefront is a major sin.
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ الۡغَنِيُّ الۡحَمِيدُ
shades.hadith_en: And whoever turns away - then indeed Allah is the Free of need

meaning.en: To delight, to conceal. The root denotes joy, secrecy, or concealment.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: السِّينُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصۡلَانِ: أَحَدُهُمَا يَدُلُّ عَلَى خَفَاءٍ وَسِتۡرٍ، وَالۡآخَرُ عَلَى فَرَحٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: سَرَّ: فَرِحَ. وَالسِّرُّ: خِلَافُ الۡعَلَانِيَةِ

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ الۡجَهۡرَ وَمَا يَخۡفَىٰ
quran_examples.en: Indeed He knows what is declared and what is hidden

quran_examples.ar: وَأَسِرُّواْ قَوۡلَكُمۡ أَوِ ٱجۡهَرُواْ بِهِۦ
quran_examples.en: And conceal your speech or declare it

hadith.ar: إِنَّ الۡعَبۡدَ لَيَتَكَلَّمُ بِالۡكَلِمَةِ مَا يَتَبَيَّنُ فِيهَا
hadith.en: Indeed a person may speak a word without realizing its implications

hadith.ar: السِّرُّ أَمَانَةٌ
hadith.en: A secret is a trust

shades.name_ar: السِّرُّ - مَا خَفِيَ عَنِ الۡعُلۡنِ، خِلَافُ الۡعَلَانِيَةِ
shades.explanation: as-Sirr (the secret) in the Quran refers to that which is hidden or concealed. The Quran says: Indeed, He knows the secret and what is even more hidden (20:7). as-Sirr in the Quran is the inner thought, the hidden intention, the concealed matter. The famous hadith states: A secret is a trust.
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِن تُبۡدُواْ مَا فِيٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَوۡ تُخۡفُوهُ يُحَاسِبۡكُم بِهِ ٱللَّهُ
shades.hadith_en: And whether you reveal what is in yourselves or conceal it, Allah will call you to account for it

shades.explanation: as-Surur (the joy) in the Quran refers to happiness and delight. The Quran says: And there will appear to them from their Lord the [reality] of what they were promised (39:47). The surur in the Quran is the joy of the righteous in Paradise. The famous hadith states: The joy of the believer is in the fulfillment of Allah's promise.
shades.hadith_ar: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوۡمَئِذٍۢ مُّسۡفِرَةٌۭ ضَاحِكَةٌۭ مُّسۡتَبۡشِرَةٌ
shades.hadith_en: Faces on that Day will be radiant, laughing, rejoicing

shades.explanation: al-Israr (the concealment) in the Quran refers to hiding something. The Quran says: And whether you conceal your speech or declare it, indeed He knows the secrets of the breasts (67:13). The israr in the Quran is the concealment of what is in the heart.
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِن تُخۡفُواْ مَا فِي صُدُورِكُمۡ أَوۡ تُبۡدُوهُ يَعۡلَمۡهُ ٱللَّهُ
shades.hadith_en: And whether you conceal what is in your hearts or reveal it, Allah knows it

shades.name_ar: الۡمُسۡتَبۡشِرُ - الۡفَرِحُ، الَّذِي يَظۡهَرُ عَلَيۡهِ السُّرُورُ
shades.explanation: al-Mustabsir (the rejoicing one) in the Quran is the one who shows joy. The Quran says: And [remember] when you were few and were oppressed in the land (8:26). The mustabsir in the Quran is the believer who rejoices in Allah's blessing. The famous hadith states: On the Day of Resurrection the believers will rejoice in their Lord's reward.
shades.hadith_ar: فَرِحِينَ بِمَآ اتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ
shades.hadith_en: Rejoicing in what Allah has given them of His bounty

meaning.en: To adorn, to beautify. The root denotes ornament, beauty, or decoration.
meaning.ar: الزِّينَةُ: مَا يُتَجَمَّلُ بِهِ، ضِدُّ الشَّيۡنِ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الزَّايُ وَالۡيَاءُ وَالنُّونُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى حُسۡنِ الشَّيۡءِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الزِّينَةُ: مَا يُزَيَّنُ بِهِ الشَّيۡءُ، وَضِدُّهَا الشَّيۡنُ

quran_examples.ar: قُلۡ مَنۡ حَرَّمَ زِينَةَ اللَّهِ
quran_examples.en: Say, 'Who has forbidden the adornment of Allah?'

quran_examples.ar: وَلَا تَبَرَّجۡنَ تَبَرُّجَ الۡجَاهِلِيَّةِ الۡأُولَىٰ
quran_examples.en: And do not display yourselves as the display of the former times of ignorance

hadith.ar: أَتۡمَمۡتُ لَكُمۡ دِينَكُمۡ وَأَتۡمَمۡتُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ نِعۡمَتِي
hadith.en: This day I have perfected for you your religion and completed My favor upon you

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ جَمِيلٌ يُحِبُّ الۡجَمَالَ
hadith.en: Indeed Allah is Beautiful and He loves beauty

shades.explanation: az-Zinah (the adornment) in the Quran refers to beautification. The Quran says: Say, 'Who has forbidden the adornment of Allah which He has produced for His servants?' (7:32). az-Zinah in the Quran includes physical beauty, clothing, and spiritual adornment. The famous hadith states: The faith is the adornment of the believer.
shades.hadith_ar: قُلۡ مَنۡ حَرَّمَ زِينَةَ اللَّهِ الَّتِيٓ أَخۡرَجَ لِعِبَادِهِ
shades.hadith_en: Say, 'Who has forbidden the adornment of Allah which He has produced for His servants?'

shades.explanation: az-Zukhruf (the gold, the luxury) in the Quran refers to worldly adornment. The Quran says: And gold extensively, and all that are therein. But all that is but the enjoyment of worldly life (43:35). The zukhruf in the Quran is the deceptive beauty of this world.
shades.hadith_ar: وَالزُّخۡرُفَ وَمَا كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَاعُ الۡحَيَوٰةِ الدُّنۡيَا
shades.hadith_en: And gold - but all that is but the enjoyment of worldly life

shades.explanation: at-Tazayyun (the self-beautification) in the Quran refers to making oneself attractive. The Quran says: And do not display yourselves as [was] the display of the former times of ignorance (33:33). The famous hadith states: Beautify yourselves for worship - wear your best clothes for prayer.
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تَبَرَّجۡنَ تَبَرُّجَ الۡجَاهِلِيَّةِ الۡأُولَىٰ
shades.hadith_en: And do not display yourselves as the display of the former times of ignorance

shades.explanation: al-Mutazayyin (the one who adorns) in the Quran refers to one who beautifies for others. The Quran says: And when they commit an immorality, they say, 'We found our fathers doing it' (7:28). The famous hadith states: The best adornment for a believer is taqwa.
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِذَا فَعَلُواْ فَاحِشَةًۭ قَالُواْ وَجَدۡنَا عَلَيۡهَآ ءَابَاءَنَا
shades.hadith_en: And when they commit an immorality, they say, 'We found our fathers doing it'

meaning.en: To enter the morning. The root denotes dawn, morning, or daybreak.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الصَّادُ وَالۡبَاءُ وَالۡحَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى إِضَاءَةِ شَيۡءٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الصُّبۡحُ: الضَّوۡءُ. صَبَحَ: أَتَىٰ فِي الصَّبَاحِ

quran_examples.ar: وَالصُّبۡحِ
quran_examples.en: By the dawn

quran_examples.ar: وَالصُّبۡحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
quran_examples.en: And the dawn when it breathes

hadith.ar: مَن صَلَّىٰ الصُّبۡحَ فَهُوَ فِي ذِمَّةِ اللَّهِ
hadith.en: Whoever prays Fajr is under the protection of Allah

hadith.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكۡ لِأُمَّتِي فِي بُكُورِهَا
hadith.en: O Allah, bless my nation in its early mornings

shades.explanation: as-Subh (the dawn) in the Quran refers to the early morning. The Quran says: By the dawn (89:1). as-Subh in the Quran is the time of dawn - a time of light breaking through darkness. The famous hadith states: Bless my nation in its early mornings.
shades.hadith_ar: وَالصُّبۡحِ إِذَآ أَسۡفَرَ
shades.hadith_en: And by the dawn when it brightens

shades.explanation: al-Isbah (the entering of morning) in the Quran refers to reaching the morning. The Quran says: And those who disbelieve will be driven to Hell in groups (39:71). The isbah in the Quran is the state of entering dawn.
shades.hadith_ar: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ سِيقُواْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًا
shades.hadith_en: And those who disbelieve will be driven to Hell in groups

shades.explanation: al-Masbah (the morning time) in the Quran refers to the time of dawn. The Quran says: And the dawn when it breathes (81:18). The famous hadith states: Whoever prays Fajr is under the protection of Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: وَالصُّبۡحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
shades.hadith_en: And the dawn when it breathes

shades.explanation: as-Sabih (the morning visitor) in the Quran is that which comes at dawn. The Quran says: And when Our command came, We turned the highest part to the lowest (11:82). The famous hadith states: The Fajr prayer is witnessed by the angels of the night and the day.
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَاۤ أَصۡحَـٰبَ النَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً
shades.hadith_en: And We have made the keepers of the Fire only angels

meaning.en: Path. The root denotes a way, path, or road.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الصَّادُ وَالرَّاءُ وَالطَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الطَّرِيقِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الصِّرَاطُ: الطَّرِيقُ السَّوِيُّ

quran_examples.ar: اهۡدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الۡمُسۡتَقِيمَ
quran_examples.en: Guide us to the straight path

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَىٰ صِرَاطٍۢ مُّسۡتَقِيمٍ
quran_examples.en: Indeed, my Lord is on a straight path

hadith.ar: ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا صِرَاطًا مُّسۡتَقِيمًا
hadith.en: Allah has set forth a parable: a straight path

hadith.ar: إِنَّ الصِّرَاطَ عَلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ
hadith.en: Indeed the path is over Hell

shades.explanation: as-Sirat (the path) in the Quran is the central concept of guidance. The Quran says: Guide us to the straight path (1:6). as-Sirat in the Quran is the way leading to Allah - the path of the Prophets, the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous. The famous hadith states: The straight path is Islam.
shades.hadith_ar: اهۡدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الۡمُسۡتَقِيمَ
shades.hadith_en: Guide us to the straight path

shades.explanation: as-Sirat al-Mustaqim (the straight path) in the Quran is the path of divine guidance. The Quran says: Indeed, my Lord is on a straight path (11:56). The famous hadith states: The straight path is the path of the Prophets - there is no deviation from it.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَىٰ صِرَاطٍۢ مُّسۡتَقِيمٍ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed, my Lord is on a straight path

shades.name_en: as-Sirat - The Path of Paradise and Hell
shades.name_ar: الصِّرَاطُ - الصِّرَاطُ الَّذِي يُضۡرَبُ عَلَى جَهَنَّمَ
shades.explanation: as-Sirat in the Quran also refers to the path over Hell on the Day of Judgment. The famous hadith states: The bridge over Hell is sharper than a sword and thinner than a hair. as-Sirat in the Hereafter is the bridge that all must cross.
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِن كَادُواْ لَيَسۡتَفِزُّونَكَ مِنَ الۡأَرۡضِ
shades.hadith_en: And indeed they were about to unsettle you from the land

shades.name_ar: الۡمُسۡتَقِيمُ - مَنۡ لَمۡ يَمِلۡ عَنِ الۡحَقِّ
shades.explanation: al-Mustaqim (the upright) in the Quran refers to that which is straight. The Quran says: So stand firm as you are commanded (11:112). The mustaqim in the Quran is the one who remains steadfast on the truth.
shades.hadith_ar: فَاسۡتَقِمۡ كَمَآ أُمِرۡتَ
shades.hadith_en: So stand firm as you are commanded

meaning.en: To leave, to forsake. The root denotes leaving, abandoning, or forgoing.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡوَاوُ وَالذَّالُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى التَّرۡكِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: وَذَرَهُ: تَرَكَهُ

quran_examples.ar: وَذَرِ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُواْ دِينَهُمۡ لَعِبًا
quran_examples.en: And leave those who take their religion as play
quran_examples.context: The command to leave the mockers

quran_examples.ar: وَذَرُواْ مَا بَقِيَ مِنَ الرِّبَا
quran_examples.en: And leave what remains of usury

hadith.ar: دَعۡ مَا يَرِيبُكَ إِلَىٰ مَا لَا يَرِيبُكَ
hadith.en: Leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt

hadith.ar: لَا يُؤۡمِنُ أَحَدُكُمۡ حَتَّىٰ أَكُونَ أَحَبَّ إِلَيۡهِ
hadith.en: None of you truly believes until I am more beloved to him

shades.explanation: al-Wadhr (the leaving) in the Quran refers to forsaking or abandoning. The Quran says: And leave those who take their religion as play and amusement (6:70). al-Wadhr in the Quran is the divine command to abandon falsehood.
shades.hadith_ar: وَذَرِ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُواْ دِينَهُمۡ لَعِبًا وَلَهۡوًا
shades.hadith_en: And leave those who take their religion as play and amusement

shades.explanation: at-Tark (the abandonment) in the Quran is closely related to wadhr. The Quran says: And leave the outward sin and the inward (6:120).
shades.hadith_ar: وَذَرُواْ ظَاهِرَ الۡإِثۡمِ وَبَاطِنَهُ
shades.hadith_en: And leave the outward sin and the inward

shades.name_en: Wadhr ar-Riba - The Abandonment of Usury
shades.name_ar: وَذۡرُ الرِّبَا - تَرۡكُ الرِّبَا وَالِانۡتِهَاءُ عَنۡهُ
shades.explanation: Wadhr ar-Riba (the abandonment of usury) in the Quran is a specific command. The Quran says: And leave what remains of usury, if you are believers (2:278).
shades.hadith_ar: وَذَرُواْ مَا بَقِيَ مِنَ الرِّبَا إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
shades.hadith_en: And leave what remains of usury, if you are believers

shades.explanation: Where tawakkul (reliance) is the leaving of one's affairs to Allah. The Quran says: And upon Allah let the believers rely (14:11).
shades.hadith_ar: وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ الۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ
shades.hadith_en: And upon Allah let the believers rely

meaning.en: To gather, to assemble. The root denotes gathering, assembling, or mustering.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡحَاءُ وَالشِّينُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى جَمۡعِ شَيۡءٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: حَشَرَ: جَمَعَ. الۡحَشۡرُ: يَوۡمُ جَمۡعِ النَّاسِ

quran_examples.ar: وَيَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُهُمۡ جَمِيعًا
quran_examples.en: And on the Day when We will gather them all together

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ وَعۡدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ
quran_examples.en: Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth

hadith.ar: يُحۡشَرُ النَّاسُ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيَامَةِ حُفَاةً عُرَاةً
hadith.en: The people will be gathered on the Day of Resurrection barefoot and naked

hadith.ar: أَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ وَأَنَا أَحۡمَدُ وَأَنَا الۡحَاشِرُ
hadith.en: I am Muhammad, I am Ahmad, I am the Gatherer

shades.explanation: al-Hashr (the gathering) in the Quran refers to the assembly on the Day of Judgment. The Quran says: And on the Day when We will gather them all together (6:38).
shades.hadith_ar: وَيَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُهُمۡ جَمِيعًا
shades.hadith_en: And on the Day when We will gather them all together

shades.explanation: al-Mahshar (the place of gathering) in the Quran is the site of the resurrection. The Quran says: Indeed, the gathering is the true promise (45:26).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ وَعۡدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth

shades.explanation: al-Hashr is the name of the 59th Surah. The verses discuss the exile of the Jewish tribe of Banu al-Nadir.
shades.hadith_ar: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي الۡأَرۡضِ
shades.hadith_en: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth glorifies Allah

shades.explanation: al-Hashir (the Gatherer) is one of the names of the Prophet. He is the one after whom people will be gathered.
shades.hadith_ar: أَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ وَأَنَا أَحۡمَدُ وَأَنَا الۡحَاشِرُ
shades.hadith_en: I am Muhammad, I am Ahmad, I am the Gatherer

meaning.en: To separate, to distinguish. The root denotes separation, distinction, or decisive judgment.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡفَاءُ وَالصَّادُ وَاللَّامُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى فَصۡلِ شَيۡءٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: فَصَلَ: حَكَمَ وَقَضَىٰ

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوۡلٌۭ فَصۡلٌۭ
quran_examples.en: Indeed, it is a decisive statement

quran_examples.ar: كِتَـٰبٌۭ فُصِّلَتۡ ءَايَـٰتُهُۥ
quran_examples.en: A Book whose verses have been detailed

hadith.ar: خَيۡرُ الۡكَلاَمِ كَلَامُ اللَّهِ
hadith.en: The best speech is the Book of Allah

hadith.ar: فَلَا وَرَبِّكَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ حَتَّىٰ يُحَكِّمُوكَ
hadith.en: But no, by your Lord, they will not believe until they make you judge

shades.explanation: al-Fasl (the separation) in the Quran refers to the decisive distinction. The Quran says: Indeed, it is a decisive statement (86:13).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوۡلٌۭ فَصۡلٌۭ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed, it is a decisive statement

shades.name_ar: الۡفُرۡقَانُ - مَا يُفَرَّقُ بِهِ بَيۡنَ الۡحَقِّ وَالۡبَاطِلِ
shades.explanation: al-Furqan (the criterion) is that which distinguishes truth from falsehood. The Quran says: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His servant (25:1).
shades.hadith_ar: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي نَزَّلَ الۡفُرۡقَانَ عَلَىٰ عَبۡدِهِ
shades.hadith_en: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His servant

shades.explanation: al-Mufassal (the detailed) in the Quran refers to clear exposition. The Quran says: A Book whose verses have been detailed (41:3).
shades.hadith_ar: كِتَـٰبٌۭ فُصِّلَتۡ ءَايَـٰتُهُۥ
shades.hadith_en: A Book whose verses have been detailed

shades.explanation: al-Fasil (the separator) in the Quran refers to that which distinguishes. The Quran says: And this Quran is the decisive word (86:13).
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَقَوۡلٌۭ فَصۡلٌۭ
shades.hadith_en: And indeed it is a decisive word

meaning.en: To plot, scheme. The root denotes deception, plotting, or scheming.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡمِيمُ وَالۡكَافُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡخَدِيعَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: مَكَرَ: خَدَعَ وَاحۡتَالَ

quran_examples.ar: وَإِذۡ يَمۡكُرُ بِكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ
quran_examples.en: And when those who disbelieved plotted against you

quran_examples.ar: سَنَسۡتَدۡرِجُهُم مِّنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
quran_examples.en: We will gradually lead them from where they do not know

hadith.ar: الۡمَكۡرُ وَالۡخَدِيعَةُ فِي النَّارِ
hadith.en: Deception and trickery are in the Fire

hadith.ar: وَإِن يَمۡكُرُواْ فَقَدۡ مَكَرَ اللَّهُ بِهِمۡ
hadith.en: And if they plot, then Allah has already plotted against them

shades.explanation: al-Makr (the plot) in the Quran refers to scheming and deception. The Quran says: And the disbelievers plotted to detain you (8:30). The believers are commanded to be aware of the plots of the disbelievers.
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِذۡ يَمۡكُرُ بِكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ
shades.hadith_en: And when those who disbelieved plotted against you

shades.explanation: Makr Allah (the divine plan) in the Quran refers to Allah's response to the plots of evildoers. The Quran says: And they planned, and Allah planned, and Allah is the best of planners (8:30).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَكَرُواْ وَمَكَرَ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ خَيۡرُ الۡمَاكِرِينَ
shades.hadith_en: And they planned, and Allah planned, and Allah is the best of planners

shades.explanation: al-Makir (the schemer) in the Quran refers to those who plot evil. The Quran says: So do not weaken and call for peace while you are the superior (47:35).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تَهِنُواْ وَتَدۡعُواْ إِلَى السَّلۡمِ
shades.hadith_en: So do not weaken and call for peace

shades.explanation: al-Istidraj (gradual seizure) is related to makr - Allah giving respite to the disbelievers. The Quran says: We will gradually lead them [to destruction] from where they do not know (7:182).
shades.hadith_ar: سَنَسۡتَدۡرِجُهُم مِّنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
shades.hadith_en: We will gradually lead them from where they do not know

meaning.en: To leave, abandon. The root denotes leaving, abandoning, or forgoing.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: التَّاءُ وَالرَّاءُ وَالۡكَافُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى التَّرۡكِ وَالۡإِهۡمَالِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: تَرَكَ: خَلَّىٰ وَأَهۡمَلَ

quran_examples.ar: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي الۡأٓخِرِينَ
quran_examples.en: And We left a lasting mention for him among later generations

quran_examples.ar: فَتَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ مُدۡبِرِينَ
quran_examples.en: So they turned away from him departing

hadith.ar: مَن تَرَكَ شَيۡئًا لِلَّهِ عَوَّضَهُ اللَّهُ خَيۡرًا مِنۡهُ
hadith.en: Whoever leaves something for Allah, Allah will compensate him with something better

hadith.ar: لَا عَزۡلَ وَلَا تَرۡكَ سُنَّةٍ
hadith.en: There is no abandonment of the Sunnah

shades.explanation: at-Tark (the leaving) in the Quran refers to abandoning something. The Quran says: And they left them with a lasting mention among the later generations (37:78).
shades.hadith_ar: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي الۡأٓخِرِينَ
shades.hadith_en: And We left [a lasting mention] for him among later generations

shades.explanation: at-Tarik (the abandoner) in the Quran refers to one who leaves. The Quran says: And they who turn away from the remembrance of their Lord (23:71).
shades.hadith_ar: وَهُمۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعۡرِضُونَ
shades.hadith_en: And they who turn away from the remembrance of their Lord

shades.explanation: al-Matruk (the abandoned) in the Quran refers to what is left behind. The Quran says: And they thought that it is not returning (to Allah) (78:27-28).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَا تَرَكَ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍۢ فِيهِمۡ
shades.hadith_en: And he did not leave any of them

shades.name_en: Tark al-Haq - The Abandonment of Truth
shades.explanation: Tark al-Haq (the abandonment of truth) in the Quran is a blameworthy act. The Quran says: So they turned away from him and departed (37:90).
shades.hadith_ar: فَتَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ مُدۡبِرِينَ
shades.hadith_en: So they turned away from him departing

meaning.en: To grieve. The root denotes sadness, grief, or sorrow.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡحَاءُ وَالزَّايُ وَالنُّونُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡحُزۡنِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: حَزِنَ: كَرِبَ وَاغۡتَمَّ

quran_examples.ar: وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ
quran_examples.en: And do not grieve over them

quran_examples.ar: لَا تَحۡزَنۡ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَنَا
quran_examples.en: Do not grieve, indeed Allah is with us

hadith.ar: يَوۡمَ لَا حُزۡنَ وَيَوۡمَ فَرَحٍ
hadith.en: A day of no grief and a day of joy

hadith.ar: قَالَ اللَّهُ يَا عِبَادِي لَا تَحۡزَنُواْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
hadith.en: Allah said: Do not grieve, indeed Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

shades.explanation: al-Huzn (the grief) in the Quran refers to sadness and sorrow. The Quran says: And do not grieve over them (16:127). al-Huzn in the Quran is a human emotion that is acknowledged and addressed by divine guidance.
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ
shades.hadith_en: And do not grieve over them

shades.explanation: al-Hazan (the sorrow) in the Quran is intense grief. The Quran says: And do not grieve, indeed Allah is with us (9:40).
shades.hadith_ar: لَا تَحۡزَنۡ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَنَا
shades.hadith_en: Do not grieve, indeed Allah is with us

shades.explanation: al-Mahzun (the grieving one) in the Quran is the one afflicted by sorrow. The Quran says: The truthful believers are not to be blamed (9:91).
shades.hadith_ar: لَّيۡسَ عَلَى الضُّعَفَآءِ وَلَا عَلَى الۡمَرۡضَىٰ
shades.hadith_en: There is no blame upon the weak nor upon the ill

shades.explanation: Tahazzun (the deep sorrow) in the Quran is expressing grief. The Quran says: And indeed, We know that your breast is straitened by what they say (15:97).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَقَدۡ نَعۡلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدۡرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
shades.hadith_en: And indeed, We know that your breast is straitened by what they say

meaning.en: Sea. The root denotes a sea, ocean, or large body of water.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡبَاءُ وَالۡحَاءُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى اتِّسَاعِ الۡمَاءِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الۡبَحۡرُ: الۡمَاءُ الۡمِلۡحُ الۡكَبِيرُ

quran_examples.ar: مَرَجَ الۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ يَلۡتَقِيَانِ
quran_examples.en: He has loosed the two seas - they meet

quran_examples.ar: وَلَهُ الۡجَوَارِ الۡمُنشَآتُ فِي الۡبَحۡرِ
quran_examples.en: And to Him belong the ships raised up in the sea

hadith.ar: لَا يَجُوزُ الۡبَحۡرُ إِلَّا جَاعِلًا فِيهِ الۡقُرۡآنَ
hadith.en: The sea cannot be crossed without the Quran

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ جَعَلَ الۡبَحۡرَ مَطِيَّةً
hadith.en: Indeed Allah made the sea a mount

shades.explanation: al-Bahr (the sea) in the Quran is one of Allah's great signs. The Quran says: He has loosed the two seas - the two meet (55:19). The sea in the Quran represents the vastness of creation and a source of provision.
shades.hadith_ar: مَرَجَ الۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ يَلۡتَقِيَانِ
shades.hadith_en: He has loosed the two seas - they meet

shades.explanation: al-Bahrayn (the two seas) in the Quran refers to the two bodies of water - salt and fresh. The Quran says: And He placed between them a barrier and a forbidding partition (25:53).
shades.hadith_ar: وَجَعَلَ بَيۡنَهُمَا بَرۡزَخًا وَحِجۡرًا مَّحۡجُورًا
shades.hadith_en: And He placed between them a barrier and a forbidding partition

shades.explanation: al-Bahriy (the marine, naval) in the Quran refers to sea-related things. The Quran says: And the ships run upon the sea by His command (55:24).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَهُ الۡجَوَارِ الۡمُنشَآتُ فِي الۡبَحۡرِ كَالۡأَعۡلَامِ
shades.hadith_en: And to Him belong the ships raised up in the sea like mountains

shades.explanation: al-Mubahhir (the seafarer) in the Quran refers to one who travels the sea. The famous hadith states: The one who goes to sea is like the one who fights in the way of Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ فِي خَلۡقِ السَّمَـٰوَاتِ وَالۡأَرۡضِ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed in the creation of the heavens and the earth

meaning.en: To be strong. The root denotes strength, power, or might.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡقَافُ وَالۡوَاوُ وَالۡيَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الشِّدَّةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: قَوِيَ: قَوِيَ: اشۡتَدَّ. وَالۡقَوِيُّ: الۡقَدِيرُ

quran_examples.ar: وَأَعِدُّواْ لَهُم مَّا ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُم مِّن قُوَّةٍۢ
quran_examples.en: And prepare against them whatever you are able of power

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ
quran_examples.en: Indeed, Allah is the Strong, the Almighty

hadith.ar: الۡمُؤۡمِنُ الۡقَوِيُّ خَيۡرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ
hadith.en: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer

hadith.ar: أَحِبَّ إِلَى اللَّهِ الۡقَوِيُّ الۡأَمِينُ
hadith.en: The strong and trustworthy is more beloved to Allah

shades.explanation: al-Quwwah (the strength) in the Quran refers to power and might. The Quran says: And prepare against them whatever you are able of power (8:60). The believer is commanded to become strong in faith and preparation.
shades.hadith_ar: وَأَعِدُّواْ لَهُم مَّا ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُم مِّن قُوَّةٍۢ
shades.hadith_en: And prepare against them whatever you are able of power

shades.explanation: al-Qawiy (the Strong) in the Quran is one of Allah's attributes. The Quran says: Indeed, Allah is the Strong, the Almighty (58:21). Al-Qawiy is an attribute of divine power.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed, Allah is the Strong, the Almighty

shades.explanation: al-Uqwah (the fortitude) in the Quran refers to firm strength. The Quran says: And the most trustworthy handhold (2:256). The famous hadith states: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: فَقَدِ اسۡتَمۡسَكَ بِالۡعُرۡوَةِ الۡوُثۡقَىٰ
shades.hadith_en: He has grasped the most trustworthy handhold

shades.explanation: al-Iqtidar (the ability) in the Quran refers to capability and power. The Quran says: And Allah is the Powerful over all things (18:45).
shades.hadith_ar: وَاللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍۢ مُّقۡتَدِرٌ
shades.hadith_en: And Allah is the Powerful over all things

meaning.en: To mock or to subjugate. The root denotes mocking, ridiculing, or subjecting.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: السِّينُ وَالۡخَاءُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصۡلَانِ: أَحَدُهُمَا الۡاِسۡتِهۡزَاءُ وَالۡآخَرُ التَّسۡخِيرُ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: سَخِرَ مِنۡهُ: اسۡتَهۡزَأَ. سَخَّرَ: ذَلَّلَ

quran_examples.ar: لَا يَسۡخَرۡ قَوۡمٌۭ مِّن قَوۡمٍ
quran_examples.en: Let not a people mock another people

quran_examples.ar: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ اللَّيۡلَ وَالنَّهَارَ
quran_examples.en: And He subjected to you the night and the day

hadith.ar: لَا يَسۡخَرۡ قَوۡمٌۭ مِّن قَوۡمٍ
hadith.en: Let not a people mock another people

hadith.ar: سَخَّرَ اللَّهُ لَكُمۡ مَا فِي السَّمَـٰوَاتِ
hadith.en: Allah subjected to you what is in the heavens

shades.explanation: as-Sukhriyah (the mockery) in the Quran refers to ridicule. The Quran says: And do not mock [others]; perhaps they are better than you (49:11). Mocking others is forbidden in Islam.
shades.hadith_ar: لَا يَسۡخَرۡ قَوۡمٌۭ مِّن قَوۡمٍ
shades.hadith_en: Let not a people mock another people

shades.explanation: at-Taskhir (the subjugation) in the Quran refers to making something subservient. The Quran says: And He subjected to you the night and the day (14:33). Allah subjugates creation for the benefit of humanity.
shades.hadith_ar: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ اللَّيۡلَ وَالنَّهَارَ
shades.hadith_en: And He subjected to you the night and the day

shades.explanation: as-Sakhr (the mocked one) in the Quran is the one being ridiculed. The Quran says: And we used to mock with those who believed (2:14). The famous hadith states: Mockery is a sign of hypocrisy.
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِنَّا كُنَّا نَسۡخَرُ مِنَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ
shades.hadith_en: And we used to mock with those who believed

shades.explanation: al-Musakhkhar (the subjugated) in the Quran refers to that which is made subservient. The Quran says: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens (45:13).
shades.hadith_ar: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِي السَّمَـٰوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الۡأَرۡضِ
shades.hadith_en: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and the earth

meaning.en: To turn away, hinder. The root denotes obstruction, prevention, or aversion.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الصَّادُ وَالدَّالُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡمَنۡعِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: صَدَّ: مَنَعَ وَأَعۡرَضَ

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
quran_examples.en: Indeed, those who disbelieve and hinder from the way of Allah

quran_examples.ar: وَبَيۡنَهُمَا حِجَابٌۭ
quran_examples.en: And between them will be a barrier

hadith.ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ
hadith.en: Indeed those who hinder from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment

hadith.ar: مَن صَدَّ عَنِ الۡحَقِّ أَظۡلَمَ
hadith.en: Whoever turns away from truth wrongs himself

shades.explanation: as-Sad (the hindrance) in the Quran refers to preventing or obstructing from the truth. The Quran says: And they who have disbelieved are turned away from the warning (46:3). Those who hinder others from the path of Allah are condemned.
shades.hadith_ar: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَمَّا أُنذِرُواْ مُعۡرِضُونَ
shades.hadith_en: And they who have disbelieved are turned away from the warning

shades.name_en: as-Sad an as-Sabil - The Hinderance from the Path
shades.name_ar: الصَّدُّ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ - الۡمَنۡعُ عَنۡ طَرِيقِ اللَّهِ
shades.explanation: as-Sad an as-Sabil (the hindrance from the path) in the Quran is a major sin. The Quran says: Indeed, those who disbelieve and hinder [others] from the way of Allah have gone far astray (4:167).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed, those who disbelieve and hinder from the way of Allah

shades.explanation: as-Sudd (the barrier) in the Quran refers to a physical barrier or wall. The Quran says: And between them will be a barrier (7:46).
shades.hadith_ar: وَبَيۡنَهُمَا حِجَابٌۭ
shades.hadith_en: And between them will be a barrier

shades.explanation: as-Sad (the turning) in the Quran refers to turning away from truth. The Quran says: And it is not for a believing man or a believing woman, when Allah and His Messenger have decided a matter, to have any choice (33:36).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤۡمِنٍۢ وَلَا مُؤۡمِنَةٍ إِذَا قَضَى اللَّهُ
shades.hadith_en: It is not for a believing man or woman when Allah has decided

meaning.en: Above. The root denotes above, over, or superior position.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡفَاءُ وَالۡوَاوُ وَالۡقَافُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡعُلُوِّ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: فَوۡقَ: ظَرۡفُ مَكَانٍ لِلۡعُلُوِّ

quran_examples.ar: وَفَوۡقَ كُلِّ ذِي عِلۡمٍ عَلِيمٌ
quran_examples.en: And above every possessor of knowledge is the All-Knowing

quran_examples.ar: وَهُوَ الۡقَاهِرُ فَوۡقَ عِبَادِهِ
quran_examples.en: And He is the Supreme over His servants

hadith.ar: الۡيَدُ الۡعُلۡيَا خَيۡرٌ مِّنَ الۡيَدِ السُّفۡلَىٰ
hadith.en: The upper hand is better than the lower hand

hadith.ar: لِلۡعَبۡدِ مَا فَوۡقَ ذَٰلِكَ
hadith.en: For the servant is what is above that

shades.explanation: al-Fawq (the above) in the Quran refers to the higher position. The Quran says: And above every possessor of knowledge is the All-Knowing (12:76). The famous hadith states: The upper hand is better than the lower hand.
shades.hadith_ar: وَفَوۡقَ كُلِّ ذِي عِلۡمٍ عَلِيمٌ
shades.hadith_en: And above every possessor of knowledge is the All-Knowing

shades.explanation: al-Fawq (the superior) in the Quran refers to higher rank or status. The Quran says: And you are the highest [in rank] if you are believers (3:139).
shades.hadith_ar: وَأَنتُمُ الۡأَعۡلَوۡنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
shades.hadith_en: And you are the highest if you are believers

shades.explanation: al-Fawq in the Quran also refers to Allah's transcendence. The Quran says: And He is the Supreme over His servants (6:61).
shades.hadith_ar: وَهُوَ الۡقَاهِرُ فَوۡقَ عِبَادِهِ
shades.hadith_en: And He is the Supreme over His servants

shades.explanation: al-Fawq (the exalted) in the Quran is the elevated state. The Quran says: And the word of your Lord has been fulfilled in truth and in justice (6:115).
shades.hadith_ar: وَتَمَّتۡ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ صِدۡقًا وَعَدۡلًا
shades.hadith_en: And the word of your Lord has been fulfilled in truth and in justice

meaning.en: To answer, to respond. The root denotes answering, responding, or traversing.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡجِيمُ وَالۡوَاوُ وَالۡبَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الرَّدِّ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: أَجَابَ: رَدَّ. وَالۡمُجِيبُ: سُبۡحَانَهُ

quran_examples.ar: ادۡعُونِي أَسۡتَجِبۡ لَكُمۡ
quran_examples.en: Call upon Me, I will respond to you

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ رَبِّي قَرِيبٌ مُّجِيبٌ
quran_examples.en: Indeed, my Lord is Near, the Answerer

hadith.ar: مَا عَلَى الۡأَرۡضِ مُسۡلِمٌ يَدۡعُو اللَّهَ إِلَّا أَجَابَهُ
hadith.en: There is no Muslim on earth who calls upon Allah except that He answers him

hadith.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكُمۡ حَيِيٌّ كَرِيمٌ يَسۡتَحۡيِي مِنۡ عَبۡدِهِ
hadith.en: Indeed your Lord is Modest and Generous, He feels shy from His servant

shades.explanation: al-Jawab (the answer) in the Quran refers to a response or reply. The Quran says: Those who disbelieve will be answered with the like of what they heard (41:27).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلِلَّهِ عَلَى النَّاسِ حِجُّ الۡبَيۡتِ
shades.hadith_en: And to Allah upon people is the pilgrimage to the House

shades.explanation: al-Ijabah (the fulfillment) in the Quran refers to answering or responding favorably. The Quran says: And your Lord says: Call upon Me, I will respond to you (40:60).
shades.hadith_ar: ادۡعُونِي أَسۡتَجِبۡ لَكُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: Call upon Me, I will respond to you

shades.explanation: al-Mujib (the Answerer) in the Quran is one of Allah's names. The Quran says: Indeed, my Lord is Near, the Answerer (11:61).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ رَبِّي قَرِيبٌ مُّجِيبٌ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed, my Lord is Near, the Answerer

shades.explanation: al-Mujawabah (the dialogue) in the Quran refers to the exchange of speech. The Quran says: And if you disagree over anything, refer it to Allah and the Messenger (4:59).
shades.hadith_ar: فَإِن تَنَازَعۡتُمۡ فِي شَيۡءٍۢ فَرُدُّوهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ
shades.hadith_en: And if you disagree over anything, refer it to Allah

meaning.en: To taste. The root denotes tasting, experience, or sensing.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الذَّالُ وَالۡوَاوُ وَالۡقَافُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى إِدۡرَاكِ الطَّعۡمِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: ذَاقَ: جَرِبَ. وَالذَّوۡقُ: حَاسَّةُ الطَّعۡمِ

quran_examples.ar: فَذُوقُواْ الۡعَذَابَ
quran_examples.en: So taste the punishment

quran_examples.ar: وَلَئِنۡ أَذَقۡنَا الۡإِنسَـٰنَ مِنَّا رَحۡمَةًۭ
quran_examples.en: And if We give man a taste of mercy

hadith.ar: ذَاقَ طَعۡمَ الۡإِيمَانِ مَنۡ رَّضِيَ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا
hadith.en: He has tasted the sweetness of faith who is pleased with Allah as Lord

hadith.ar: مَنۡ ذَاقَ طَعۡمَ الۡعِلۡمِ
hadith.en: Whoever tastes the taste of knowledge

shades.explanation: adh-Dhawq (the taste) in the Quran refers to physical and sensory taste. The Quran says: Whoever disbelieves after his belief, except one who is compelled while his heart is secure in faith (16:106).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَئِنۡ أَذَقۡنَـٰهُمۡ رَحۡمَةًۭ مِّنَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتۡهُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: And if We give them a taste of mercy from Us after hardship has touched them

shades.name_en: adh-Dhawq al-Azab - The Taste of Punishment
shades.explanation: Dhawq al-Azab (the taste of punishment) in the Quran is a significant theme. The Quran says: Then let them taste the painful punishment (8:50).
shades.hadith_ar: فَذُوقُواْ الۡعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُونَ
shades.hadith_en: So taste the punishment for what you used to disbelieve

shades.explanation: al-Idhaq (the causing to taste) in the Quran refers to making one experience. The Quran says: And if We should let man taste mercy from Us and then We withdraw it from him (11:9).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَئِنۡ أَذَقۡنَا الۡإِنسَـٰنَ مِنَّا رَحۡمَةًۭ ثُمَّ نَزَعۡنَـٰهَا مِنۡهُ
shades.hadith_en: And if We give man a taste of mercy and then We withdraw it from him

shades.explanation: at-Tadhawwuq (the experiencing) in the Quran refers to the act of tasting or experiencing. The Quran says: So taste [the punishment] - and never will the wrongdoers increase except in loss (26:30).
shades.hadith_ar: فَذُوقُواْ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمۡ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
shades.hadith_en: So taste [the punishment], and We will not increase you except in torment

meaning.en: To taste, eat. The root denotes food, eating, or sustenance.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الطَّاءُ وَالۡعَيۡنُ وَالۡمِيمُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡأَكۡلِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: طَعِمَ: أَكَلَ. الطَّعَامُ: الۡمَأۡكُولُ

quran_examples.ar: وَيُطۡعِمُونَ الطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ
quran_examples.en: And they give food despite their love for it

quran_examples.ar: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَـٰهُمۡ جَسَدًا لَّا يَأۡكُلُونَ الطَّعَامَ
quran_examples.en: And We did not make them bodies that do not eat food

hadith.ar: طَعَامُ الۡاِثۡنَيۡنِ يَكۡفِي الثَّلَاثَةَ
hadith.en: The food of two suffices for three

hadith.ar: لَا يَشۡكُرُ اللَّهَ مَن لَّا يَشۡكُرُ النَّاسَ
hadith.en: He does not thank Allah who does not thank people

shades.explanation: at-Taam (the food) in the Quran refers to nourishment and sustenance. The Quran says: And We made you not in need of food, nor are you immortal (21:8).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَـٰهُمۡ جَسَدًا لَّا يَأۡكُلُونَ الطَّعَامَ
shades.hadith_en: And We did not make them bodies that do not eat food

shades.explanation: al-It'am (the feeding) in the Quran refers to providing food for others. The Quran says: And they give food - despite their love for it - to the needy, the orphan, and the captive (76:8).
shades.hadith_ar: وَيُطۡعِمُونَ الطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسۡكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
shades.hadith_en: And they give food despite their love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive

shades.explanation: at-Tu'm (the taste of food) in the Quran refers to the flavor. The Quran says: And a tree that grows from Mount Sinai, producing oil and a seasoning for those who eat (23:20).
shades.hadith_ar: وَشَجَرَةٍۢ تَخۡرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيۡنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهۡنِ وَصِبۡغٍۢ لِّلۡأَكِلِينَ
shades.hadith_en: And a tree that grows from Mount Sinai producing oil and a seasoning

shades.name_ar: الۡمَطۡعَمُ - مَوۡضِعُ الطَّعَامِ أَوۡ مَا يُطۡعَمُ
shades.explanation: al-Matam (the place/means of eating) in the Quran refers to food or its source. The famous hadith states: The food of two is sufficient for three, and the food of three is sufficient for four.
shades.hadith_ar: طَعَامُ الۡاِثۡنَيۡنِ يَكۡفِي الثَّلَاثَةَ
shades.hadith_en: The food of two suffices for three

meaning.en: To fear, to be in awe. The root denotes reverential fear, awe, or humility before Allah.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡخَاءُ وَالشِّينُ وَالۡيَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡخَوۡفِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: خَشِيَ: خَافَ مَعَ تَعۡظِيمٍ

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُم بِالۡغَيۡبِ
quran_examples.en: Indeed, those who fear their Lord in the unseen

quran_examples.ar: وَهُم مِّنۡ خَشۡيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشۡفِقُونَ
quran_examples.en: And from the fear of their Lord they are apprehensive

hadith.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ وَنَهَى النَّفۡسَ عَنِ الۡهَوَىٰ
hadith.en: But as for he who feared the standing of his Lord and forbade the soul from desire

hadith.ar: إِنَّمَا الۡعِلۡمُ بِالۡخَشۡيَةِ
hadith.en: Indeed, knowledge is through reverence

shades.explanation: al-Khashyah (the fear) in the Quran refers to reverential fear of Allah. The Quran says: Indeed, those who fear their Lord in the unseen will have forgiveness and a great reward (67:12).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُم بِالۡغَيۡبِ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed, those who fear their Lord in the unseen

shades.explanation: al-Khashi (the fearful) in the Quran refers to one who has a reverential fear of Allah. The Quran says: And their hearts are fearful [and] they are humble (23:2).
shades.hadith_ar: وَخَشَعَتِ الۡأَصۡوَاتُ لِلرَّحۡمَـٰنِ
shades.hadith_en: And voices are humbled for the Most Merciful

shades.explanation: al-Ikhsha (the causing of awe) in the Quran refers to creating reverence. The Quran says: And We cause to be inherited by the people who were oppressed (28:5).
shades.hadith_ar: وَنُرِيدُ أَن نَّمُنَّ عَلَى الَّذِينَ اسۡتُضۡعِفُواْ فِي الۡأَرۡضِ
shades.hadith_en: And We wanted to confer favor upon those who were oppressed in the land

shades.name_en: al-Makhshiy - The One Who Is Feared
shades.explanation: al-Makhshiy (the one who is feared) in the Quran refers to one held in awe. The Quran says: And there was no fear for them of the punishment of Allah (59:16).
shades.hadith_ar: وَكَانَ الۡإِنسَـٰنُ أَكۡثَرَ شَيۡءٍۢ جَدَلًا
shades.hadith_en: And man is more than anything quarrelsome

meaning.en: Hour. The root denotes time, hour, or the Day of Judgment.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: السِّينُ وَالۡوَاوُ وَالۡعَيۡنُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡوَقۡتِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: السَّاعَةُ: يَوۡمُ الۡقِيَامَةِ، سُمِّيَتۡ لِسُرۡعَةِ حِسَابِهَا

quran_examples.ar: اقۡتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَانشَقَّ الۡقَمَرُ
quran_examples.en: The Hour has drawn near and the moon has split

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ السَّاعَةِ
quran_examples.en: Indeed, Allah [alone] has knowledge of the Hour

hadith.ar: بُعِثۡتُ أَنَا وَالسَّاعَةُ كَهَاتَيۡنِ
hadith.en: I and the Hour have been sent like these two

hadith.ar: لَا تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّىٰ تَطۡلُعَ الشَّمۡسُ مِنۡ مَغۡرِبِهَا
hadith.en: The Hour will not come until the sun rises from its west

shades.explanation: as-Saah (the Hour) in the Quran refers primarily to the Day of Judgment. The Quran says: The Hour has drawn near and the moon has split (54:1). The Hour is one of the major themes of the Quran.
shades.hadith_ar: اقۡتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَانشَقَّ الۡقَمَرُ
shades.hadith_en: The Hour has drawn near and the moon has split

shades.name_en: Ilm as-Saah - The Knowledge of the Hour
shades.explanation: Ilm as-Saah (the knowledge of the Hour) is a matter known only to Allah. The Quran says: Indeed, Allah [alone] has knowledge of the Hour (31:34).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ السَّاعَةِ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed, Allah [alone] has knowledge of the Hour

shades.name_en: Ashrat as-Saah - The Signs of the Hour
shades.explanation: Ashrat as-Saah (the signs of the Hour) in the Quran are the portents preceding the Day of Judgment. The Quran says: So do they await except the Hour - that it come upon them suddenly? (47:18).
shades.hadith_ar: فَهَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا السَّاعَةَ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُم بَغۡتَةً
shades.hadith_en: So do they await except the Hour - that it come upon them suddenly?

shades.name_en: Yawm as-Saah - The Day of the Hour
shades.explanation: Yawm as-Saah (the Day of the Hour) in the Quran is the day of resurrection. The Quran says: And those who have been given knowledge know that what is revealed to you from your Lord is the truth (34:6).
shades.hadith_ar: وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوۡلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَةٌۭ
shades.hadith_en: And those who disbelieve say: Why has a sign not been sent down to him?

meaning.en: To sin. The root denotes sin, wrongdoing, or transgression.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡهَمۡزَةُ وَالثَّاءُ وَالۡمِيمُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الحُبۡسِ وَالۡمَنۡعِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الۡإِثۡمُ: الۡمَعۡصِيَةُ الۡمُوجِبَةُ لِلۡعِقَابِ

quran_examples.ar: وَلَا تَعَاوَنُواْ عَلَى الۡإِثۡمِ وَالۡعُدۡوَٰنِ
quran_examples.en: And do not cooperate in sin and transgression

quran_examples.ar: وَمَن يَكۡسِبۡ إِثۡمًا فَإِنَّمَا يَكۡسِبُهُۥ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِهِۦ
quran_examples.en: And whoever commits a sin only earns it against himself

hadith.ar: إِنَّ الۡعَبۡدَ لَيَتَكَلَّمُ بِالۡكَلِمَةِ مَا يَتَبَيَّنُ فِيهَا يَهۡوِي بِهَا فِي النَّارِ
hadith.en: A person may speak a word without realizing its implications and fall into Hell

hadith.ar: لَا یَدۡخُلُ الۡجَنَّةَ جَسَدٌ غُذِّيَ بِحَرَامٍ
hadith.en: No body nourished with what is forbidden will enter Paradise

shades.explanation: al-Ithm (the sin) in the Quran refers to wrongdoing and transgression. The Quran says: And do not cooperate in sin and transgression (5:2). The root is central to Islamic moral teaching.
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تَعَاوَنُواْ عَلَى الۡإِثۡمِ وَالۡعُدۡوَٰنِ
shades.hadith_en: And do not cooperate in sin and transgression

shades.explanation: al-Athim (the sinner) in the Quran refers to one who commits sin. The Quran says: And whoever does that has indeed committed aggression and sin (2:173).
shades.hadith_ar: فَمَنِ اضۡطُرَّ غَيۡرَ بَاغٍۢ وَلَا عَادٍۢ فَلَآ إِثۡمَ عَلَيۡهِ
shades.hadith_en: But whoever is forced [by necessity], neither desiring nor transgressing, there is no sin upon him

shades.explanation: al-Ma-tham (the place/source of sin) in the Quran refers to that which leads to sin. The famous hadith states: Leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt.
shades.hadith_ar: دَعۡ مَا يَرِيبُكَ إِلَىٰ مَا لَا يَرِيبُكَ
shades.hadith_en: Leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt

shades.explanation: Ta-aththum (the committing of sin) in the Quran refers to the act of sinning. The Quran says: And whoever commits a sin only earns it against himself (4:111).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَن يَكۡسِبۡ إِثۡمًا فَإِنَّمَا يَكۡسِبُهُۥ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِهِۦ
shades.hadith_en: And whoever commits a sin only earns it against himself

meaning.en: To curse. The root denotes cursing, condemnation, or expulsion from mercy.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: اللَّامُ وَالۡعَيۡنُ وَالنُّونُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الطَّرۡدِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: لَعَنَ: طَرَدَ وَأَبۡعَدَ

quran_examples.ar: أَلَا لَعۡنَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى الظَّالِمِينَ
quran_examples.en: Indeed, the curse of Allah is upon the wrongdoers

quran_examples.ar: وَمَن يَقۡتُلۡ مُؤۡمِنًا مُّتَعَمِّدًا فَجَزَآؤُهُۥ جَهَنَّمُ
quran_examples.en: Whoever kills a believer intentionally, his recompense is Hell

hadith.ar: لَا یَلۡعَنُ الۡمُؤۡمِنُ
hadith.en: The believer does not curse

hadith.ar: مَلۡعُونٌ مَنۡ سَبَّ أَبَاهُ
hadith.en: Accursed is whoever curses his father

shades.explanation: al-Lan (the curse) in the Quran refers to being cast out from divine mercy. The Quran says: The curse of Allah is upon the wrongdoers (11:18). The famous hadith states: The believer is not one who curses.
shades.hadith_ar: أَلَا لَعۡنَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى الظَّالِمِينَ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed, the curse of Allah is upon the wrongdoers

shades.explanation: al-Malun (the accursed) in the Quran refers to the one who has been cursed. The Quran says: And whoever kills a believer intentionally, his recompense is Hell, and the curse of Allah is upon him (4:93).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَن يَقۡتُلۡ مُؤۡمِنًا مُّتَعَمِّدًا فَجَزَآؤُهُۥ جَهَنَّمُ
shades.hadith_en: And whoever kills a believer intentionally, his recompense is Hell

shades.explanation: al-Talan (the mutual cursing) in the Quran includes the concept of mubahalah - challenging to invoke the curse of Allah. The Quran says: Then let us call our children and your children (3:61).
shades.hadith_ar: فَمَنۡ حَآجَّكَ فِيهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ الۡعِلۡمِ
shades.hadith_en: Then whoever argues with you about it after knowledge has come to you

shades.explanation: al-Lian (the mutual imprecation) in the Quran refers to the oath-taking procedure between spouses. The Quran says: And those who accuse their wives [of adultery] and have no witnesses except themselves (24:6).
shades.hadith_ar: وَالَّذِينَ يَرۡمُونَ أَزۡوَاجَهُمۡ وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُمۡ شُهَدَآءُ
shades.hadith_en: And those who accuse their wives and have no witnesses except themselves

meaning.en: To circumambulate. The root denotes going around, encircling, or performing tawaf.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الطَّاءُ وَالۡوَاوُ وَالۡفَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡحَرَكَةِ حَوۡلَ الشَّيۡءِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: طَافَ: دَارَ حَوۡلَ. الطَّوَافُ: عِبَادَةٌ

quran_examples.ar: وَلۡيَطَّوَّفُواْ بِالۡبَيۡتِ الۡعَتِيقِ
quran_examples.en: And let them circumambulate the Ancient House

quran_examples.ar: وَطَهِّرۡ بَيۡتِيَ لِلطَّائِفِينَ
quran_examples.en: And purify My House for those who circumambulate

hadith.ar: الۡحَجُّ عَرَفَةُ
hadith.en: Hajj is Arafah

hadith.ar: مَنۡ طَافَ بِالۡبَيۡتِ أُسۡبُوعًا صَلَّىٰ رَكۡعَتَيۡنِ
hadith.en: Whoever circumambulates the House seven times and prays two units

shades.explanation: at-Tawaf (the circumambulation) in the Quran refers to walking around the Kaaba. The Quran says: And let them circumambulate the Ancient House (22:29). Tawaf is a central ritual of Hajj and Umrah.
shades.hadith_ar: وَلۡيَطَّوَّفُواْ بِالۡبَيۡتِ الۡعَتِيقِ
shades.hadith_en: And let them circumambulate the Ancient House

shades.explanation: at-Taif (the one who circumambulates) in the Quran refers to those performing tawaf. The Quran says: And when We assigned to Abraham the place of the House, do not associate anything with Me and purify My House for those who circumambulate (22:26).
shades.hadith_ar: وَطَهِّرۡ بَيۡتِيَ لِلطَّائِفِينَ
shades.hadith_en: And purify My House for those who circumambulate

shades.explanation: at-Tawwaf (the frequent circumambulator) in the Quranic context refers to the servants who go around the people of Paradise. The Quran says: They will be served by immortal youths (56:17).
shades.hadith_ar: يَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وِلۡدَانٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ
shades.hadith_en: They will be served by immortal youths

shades.explanation: at-Tawwaf (the going around) in the Quran also refers to serving in Paradise. The Quran says: And they will be served by youths [as beautiful] as concealed pearls (52:24).
shades.hadith_ar: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غِلۡمَانٌۭ لَّهُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: And they will be served by their own youths

meaning.en: To succeed. The root denotes success, prosperity, or attainment.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡفَاءُ وَاللَّامُ وَالۡحَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الشَّقِّ ثُمَّ الفَوۡزِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: فَلَحَ: فَازَ. أَفۡلَحَ: ظَفِرَ

quran_examples.ar: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ الۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ
quran_examples.en: Indeed, the believers have succeeded

quran_examples.ar: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
quran_examples.en: He has succeeded who purifies himself

hadith.ar: حَيَّ عَلَى الۡفَلَاحِ
hadith.en: Come to success

hadith.ar: أَفۡلَحَ مَنۡ أَسۡلَمَ
hadith.en: He succeeded who submitted

shades.explanation: al-Falah (the success) in the Quran refers to true success in this life and the Hereafter. The Quran says: Indeed, the believers have succeeded (23:1). The famous hadith states: Let the caller make the call to prayer and say 'Come to success.'
shades.hadith_ar: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ الۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed, the believers have succeeded
