shades.explanation: al-Muflihun (the successful ones) in the Quran are those who attain Paradise. The Quran says: And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger has certainly attained a great success (33:71).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَن يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَقَدۡ فَازَ فَوۡزًا عَظِيمًا
shades.hadith_en: And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger has attained a great success

shades.explanation: al-Fallaha (the cultivation) is the original meaning of the root - to plow or till the earth. The Quran says: Do you not see that We drive the clouds to a land that is barren and bring forth vegetation (22:63).
shades.hadith_ar: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً
shades.hadith_en: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky

shades.explanation: al-Iflah (the achievement) in the Quran is the attainment of success. The Quran says: Successful indeed are the believers who are humble in their prayer (23:1-2).
shades.hadith_ar: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
shades.hadith_en: He has succeeded who purifies himself

meaning.en: To perceive. The root denotes perception, awareness, poetry, or knowing.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الشِّينُ وَالۡعَيۡنُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡعِلۡمِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: شَعَرَ: عَلِمَ وَأَدۡرَكَ

quran_examples.ar: هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِي الَّذِينَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
quran_examples.en: Are those who know equal to those who do not know?

quran_examples.ar: وَالشُّعَرَآءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ الۡغَاوُۥنَ
quran_examples.en: And the poets - the erring follow them

hadith.ar: إِنَّ بَعۡضَ الۡبَيَانِ لَسِحۡرٌ
hadith.en: Indeed, some eloquence is magic

hadith.ar: لَأَنۡ يَمۡتَلِئَ جَوۡفُ رَجُلٍ قَيۡحًا خَيۡرٌ مِّنۡ أَنۡ يَمۡتَلِئَ شِعۡرًا
hadith.en: That a man's belly be filled with pus is better than to be filled with poetry

shades.explanation: ash-Shur (the perception) in the Quran refers to awareness and understanding. The Quran says: Say, 'Are those who know equal to those who do not know?' (39:9).
shades.hadith_ar: هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِي الَّذِينَ يَعۡلَمُونَ وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
shades.hadith_en: Are those who know equal to those who do not know?

shades.explanation: ash-Shara (the law) in the Quran refers to the divinely revealed way. The Quran says: For each of you We made a law and a method (5:48).
shades.hadith_ar: لِكُلٍّ جَعَلۡنَا مِنكُمۡ شِرۡعَةًۭ وَمِنۡهَاجًا
shades.hadith_en: For each of you We made a law and a method

shades.explanation: ash-Shair (the poet) in the Quran refers to those who compose poetry. The Quran says: And the poets - the erring follow them (26:224). The Prophet was not a poet, as the Quran clarifies.
shades.hadith_ar: وَالشُّعَرَآءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ الۡغَاوُۥنَ
shades.hadith_en: And the poets - the erring follow them

shades.explanation: al-Mashur (the perceived) in the Quran refers to what is sensed or known. The famous hadith states: The poet's words can be like magic.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ بَعۡضَ الۡبَيَانِ لَسِحۡرٌ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed, some eloquence is magic

meaning.en: To fill. The root denotes filling, completing, or the elite class.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡمِيمُ وَاللَّامُ وَالۡهَمۡزَةُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡمِلۡءِ وَالۡجَمۡعِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: مَلَأَ: شَغَلَ. الۡمَلَأُ: الْوُجُوهُ وَالرُّؤَسَاءُ

quran_examples.ar: وَقَالَ الۡمَلَأُ مِن قَوۡمِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ
quran_examples.en: And the chiefs of the people of Pharaoh said

quran_examples.ar: لَأَمۡلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الۡجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجۡمَعِينَ
quran_examples.en: I will surely fill Hell with jinn and people all together

hadith.ar: لَأَمۡلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ بِكَ وَلِمَن تَبِعَكَ
hadith.en: I will surely fill Hell with you and whoever follows you

hadith.ar: كُلُّكُمۡ رَاعٍۢ وَكُلُّكُمۡ مَسۡئُولٌ عَن رَّعِيَّتِهِ
hadith.en: All of you are shepherds and all of you are responsible for your flock

shades.explanation: al-Mala (the chiefs) in the Quran refers to the elite and leaders of a community. The Quran says: The chiefs of the people of Pharaoh said (7:103). The mala are often portrayed as opposing the prophets.
shades.hadith_ar: وَقَالَ الۡمَلَأُ مِن قَوۡمِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ
shades.hadith_en: And the chiefs of the people of Pharaoh said

shades.explanation: al-Mal (the filling) in the Quran refers to filling up. The Quran says: To fill Hell with jinn and people all together (11:119).
shades.hadith_ar: لَأَمۡلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الۡجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجۡمَعِينَ
shades.hadith_en: I will surely fill Hell with jinn and people all together

shades.explanation: al-Mila (the religious community) in the Quran refers to a religious system or faith. The Quran says: The religion of Abraham (2:130).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَن يَرۡغَبُ عَن مِّلَّةِ إِبۡرَٰهِـۧمَ إِلَّا مَن سَفِهَ نَفۡسَهُ
shades.hadith_en: And who would be averse to the religion of Abraham except one who makes a fool of himself?

shades.explanation: al-Mala (the assembly) in the Quran refers to the council of leaders. The Quran says: The eminent among his people who disbelieved said (7:66).
shades.hadith_ar: قَالَ الۡمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن قَوۡمِهِۦ
shades.hadith_en: The eminent among his people who disbelieved said

meaning.en: To drink. The root denotes drinking, beverages, or imbibing.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الشِّينُ وَالرَّاءُ وَالۡبَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡاِبۡتِلَاعِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: شَرِبَ: جَرِعَ. الشَّرَابُ: مَا يُشۡرَبُ

quran_examples.ar: وَسُقۡيَٰكُم مَّاءًۭ فُرَاتًا
quran_examples.en: And We gave you to drink sweet water

quran_examples.ar: خِتَامُهُۥ مِسۡكٌۭ
quran_examples.en: Its seal is musk

hadith.ar: لَا يَشۡرَبۡ مِنۡ حَوۡضِي مَن لَّعَنَ النَّاسَ
hadith.en: No one who curses people will drink from my basin

hadith.ar: إِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ شُرۡبًا فِي الۡجَنَّةِ الَّذِينَ يَقۡرَءُونَ الۡقُرۡآنَ
hadith.en: The people who drink most in Paradise are those who recite the Quran

shades.explanation: ash-Shurb (the drinking) in the Quran refers to the act of drinking. The Quran says: And We gave you to drink sweet water (77:27).
shades.hadith_ar: وَسُقۡيَٰكُم مَّاءًۭ فُرَاتًا
shades.hadith_en: And We gave you to drink sweet water

shades.explanation: ash-Sharab (the beverage) in the Quran refers to drink. The Quran says: Their drink will be sealed with musk (83:26).
shades.hadith_ar: خِتَامُهُۥ مِسۡكٌۭ
shades.hadith_en: Its seal is musk

shades.explanation: ash-Sharib (the drinker) in the Quran is one who drinks. The Quran says: Drink, O you who drink the water of the springs (77:27).
shades.hadith_ar: فَاشۡرَبُواْ
shades.hadith_en: So drink

shades.explanation: al-Mashrab (the place of drinking) in the Quran refers to a drinking place. The Quran says: And your Lord has inspired the bee, take for yourself among the mountains houses (16:68).
shades.hadith_ar: فَاشۡرَبُواْ مِنۡهُ
shades.hadith_en: So drink from it

meaning.en: Sin. The root denotes sin, crime, or wrongdoing.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الذَّالُ وَالنُّونُ وَالۡبَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡإِثۡمِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الذَّنۡبُ: الۡجُرۡمُ وَالۡخَطِيئَةُ

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغۡفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا
quran_examples.en: Indeed Allah forgives all sins

quran_examples.ar: فَكُلًّا أَخَذۡنَا بِذَنۢبِهِۦ
quran_examples.en: So We punished each for his sin

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغۡفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ
hadith.en: Indeed Allah forgives sins

hadith.ar: كُلُّ بَنِيٓ آدَمَ خَطَّاءٌۭ وَخَيۡرُ الۡخَطَّائِينَ التَّوَّابُونَ
hadith.en: All children of Adam make mistakes and the best of those who make mistakes are those who repent

shades.explanation: adh-Dhanb (the sin) in the Quran refers to wrongdoing and transgression. The Quran says: Indeed Allah forgives all sins (39:53).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغۡفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا
shades.hadith_en: Indeed Allah forgives all sins

shades.explanation: al-Mudhnib (the sinner) in the Quran refers to the one who commits sin. The Quran says: So We punished each for his sin (29:40).
shades.hadith_ar: فَكُلًّا أَخَذۡنَا بِذَنۢبِهِۦ
shades.hadith_en: So We punished each for his sin

shades.explanation: al-I*dhan or istighfar (the seeking of forgiveness) in the Quran is closely tied to dhanb. The Quran says: And ask forgiveness for your sin (40:55).
shades.hadith_ar: وَاسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لِذَنۢبِكَ
shades.hadith_en: And ask forgiveness for your sin

shades.explanation: Dhanb (the consequence of sin) in the Quran refers to the effect of transgression. The famous hadith states: My sins and the sins of my nation were presented to me.
shades.hadith_ar: عُرِضَتۡ عَلَيَّ ذُنُوبُ أُمَّتِي
shades.hadith_en: My nation's sins were presented to me

meaning.en: To transgress. The root denotes transgression, exceeding bounds, or tyranny.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الطَّاءُ وَالۡغَيۡنُ وَالۡيَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡمُجَاوَزَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: طَغَى: جَاوَزَ الۡحَدَّ

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا الۡمَاءُ
quran_examples.en: Indeed when the water transgressed

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ الۡإِنسَـٰنَ لَيَطۡغَىٰٓ أَن رَّءَاهُ اسۡتَغۡنَىٰ
quran_examples.en: Indeed man transgresses because he sees himself self-sufficient

hadith.ar: لَا يَدۡخُلُ الۡجَنَّةَ مَن كَانَ فِي قَلۡبِهِ مِثۡقَالُ حَبَّةٍۢ مِنۡ خَرۡدَلٍۢ مِنۡ كِبۡرٍ
hadith.en: No one enters Paradise who has an atom's weight of pride in his heart

hadith.ar: لَقَدۡ هَلَكَ الۡمُتَنَطِّعُونَ
hadith.en: Those who go to extremes are destroyed

shades.explanation: at-Tughyan (the transgression) in the Quran refers to exceeding bounds. The Quran says: Indeed, when the water transgressed [all limits], We carried you in the ship (69:11).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا الۡمَاءُ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed when the water transgressed

shades.name_ar: الطَّاغُوتُ - مَا يُعۡبَدُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ
shades.explanation: at-Taghut (the false deity) in the Quran refers to objects of worship besides Allah. The Quran says: Whoever disbelieves in Taghut and believes in Allah has grasped the most trustworthy handhold (2:256).
shades.hadith_ar: فَمَن يَكۡفُرۡ بِالطَّاغُوتِ وَيُؤۡمِنۢ بِاللَّهِ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever disbelieves in Taghut and believes in Allah

shades.explanation: at-Tagi (the transgressor) in the Quran is one who exceeds limits. The Quran says: But as for Thamud, they were destroyed by the overwhelming [blast] (69:5).
shades.hadith_ar: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهۡلِكُواْ بِالطَّاغِيَةِ
shades.hadith_en: But as for Thamud, they were destroyed by the overwhelming blast

shades.explanation: al-Itghyan (the causing to transgress) in the Quran refers to leading others to exceed bounds. The Quran says: Nay, man is indeed transgressing (96:6-7).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ الۡإِنسَـٰنَ لَيَطۡغَىٰٓ أَن رَّءَاهُ اسۡتَغۡنَىٰ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed, man transgresses because he sees himself self-sufficient

meaning.en: To empower, give authority. The root denotes authority, power, or clear proof.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: السِّينُ وَاللَّامُ وَالطَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡقُوَّةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: السُّلۡطَانُ: سُلۡطَةٌ وَحُجَّةٌ

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ عِبَادِي لَيۡسَ لَكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سُلۡطَٰنٌ
quran_examples.en: My servants - you have no authority over them

quran_examples.ar: وَمَن يَدۡعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا آخَرَ لَا بُرۡهَانَ لَهُۥ
quran_examples.en: Whoever invokes another god with Allah for which he has no proof

hadith.ar: الۡحَجُّ عَرَفَةُ
hadith.en: Hajj is Arafah

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ أَنۡ تُرَىٰ نِعۡمَتُهُۥ عَلَىٰ عَبۡدِهِ
hadith.en: Allah loves to see the effect of His blessing on His servant

shades.explanation: as-Sultan (the authority) in the Quran refers to power, proof, or dominion. The Quran says: And [remember] when We took your covenant and raised above you the mount (2:63).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَا كَانَ لِي عَلَيۡكُم مِّن سُلۡطَٰنٍ
shades.hadith_en: And I had no authority over you

shades.explanation: at-Taslit (the empowering) in the Quran refers to giving authority or power. The Quran says: And if Allah had not repelled some people by others, the earth would have been corrupted (2:251).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَوۡلَا دَفۡعُ اللَّهِ النَّاسَ
shades.hadith_en: And if Allah had not repelled people

shades.explanation: al-Musallat (the empowered) in the Quran refers to one given authority. The Quran says: There is no soul over which I have been given power (15:42).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ عِبَادِي لَيۡسَ لَكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سُلۡطَٰنٌ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed My servants, you have no authority over them

shades.explanation: as-Sultan (the proof) in the Quran is a clear argument. The Quran says: And whoever invokes besides Allah another god for which he has no proof (23:117).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَن يَدۡعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا آخَرَ لَا بُرۡهَانَ لَهُۥ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever invokes another god with Allah for which he has no proof

meaning.en: To open. The root denotes opening, victory, conquest, or judging.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡفَاءُ وَالتَّاءُ وَالۡحَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى نَقِيضِ الۡإِغۡلَاقِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: فَتَحَ: نَصَرَ وَحَكَمَ

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّا فَتَحۡنَا لَكَ فَتۡحًا مُّبِينًا
quran_examples.en: Indeed We have given you a clear conquest

quran_examples.ar: فَفَتَحۡنَآ أَبۡوَٰبَ السَّمَآءِ بِمَاءٍۢ مُّنۡهَمِرٍ
quran_examples.en: And We opened the gates of heaven with pouring rain

hadith.ar: اللَّهُمَّ افۡتَحۡ لِي أَبۡوَٰبَ رَحۡمَتِكَ
hadith.en: O Allah open for me the doors of Your mercy

hadith.ar: إِذَا دَخَلَ رَمَضَانُ فُتِّحَتۡ أَبۡوَٰبُ الۡجَنَّةِ
hadith.en: When Ramadan enters, the gates of Paradise are opened

shades.explanation: al-Fath (the opening) in the Quran refers to victory and opening. The Quran says: Indeed, We have given you a clear conquest (48:1).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّا فَتَحۡنَا لَكَ فَتۡحًا مُّبِينًا
shades.hadith_en: Indeed We have given you a clear conquest

shades.explanation: al-Fat'h (the judgment) in the Quran refers to divine judgment. The Quran says: He said, 'My Lord, judge between us in truth. And our Lord is the Most Gracious, the One Whose help is sought' (21:112).
shades.hadith_ar: رَبَّنَا افۡتَحۡ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَ قَوۡمِنَا بِالۡحَقِّ
shades.hadith_en: Our Lord, judge between us and our people in truth

shades.explanation: al-Fat'ah (the conquest) in the Quran is victory. The Quran says: And the conquest of Mecca (48:1 context).
shades.hadith_ar: فَإِذَا جَآءَ نَصۡرُ اللَّهِ وَالۡفَتۡحُ
shades.hadith_en: When the victory of Allah and the conquest comes

shades.explanation: al-Iftitah (the beginning) in the Quran is the opening. The Quran says: And We opened the gates of heaven with pouring rain (54:11).
shades.hadith_ar: فَفَتَحۡنَآ أَبۡوَٰبَ السَّمَآءِ بِمَاءٍۢ مُّنۡهَمِرٍ
shades.hadith_en: And We opened the gates of heaven with pouring rain

meaning.en: To test, try. The root denotes testing, trial, affliction, or proving.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡبَاءُ وَاللَّامُ وَالۡوَاوُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡاِخۡتِبَارِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: بَلَاهُ: اخۡتَبَرَهُ

quran_examples.ar: وَلَنَبۡلُوَنَّكُمۡ حَتَّىٰ نَعۡلَمَ الۡمُجَٰهِدِينَ
quran_examples.en: We will test you until We know those who strive

quran_examples.ar: وَلَنَبۡلُوَنَّكُم بِشَيۡءٍۢ مِّنَ الۡخَوۡفِ وَالۡجُوعِ
quran_examples.en: We will test you with something of fear and hunger

hadith.ar: إِنَّ عِظَمَ الۡجَزَآءِ مَعَ عِظَمِ الۡبَلَاءِ
hadith.en: The greatest reward comes with the greatest trial

hadith.ar: أَشَدُّ النَّاسِ بَلَاءً الۡأَنۢبِيَآءُ
hadith.en: The people most tested are the prophets

shades.explanation: al-Bala (the trial) in the Quran refers to testing from Allah. The Quran says: And We will surely test you until We know those who strive among you and the patient (47:31).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَنَبۡلُوَنَّكُمۡ حَتَّىٰ نَعۡلَمَ الۡمُجَٰهِدِينَ مِنكُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: And We will surely test you until We know those who strive among you

shades.explanation: al-Balwa (the affliction) in the Quran refers to hardship as a test. The Quran says: And We test you with evil and with good as trial (21:35).
shades.hadith_ar: وَنَبۡلُوكُم بِالشَّرِّ وَالۡخَيۡرِ فِتۡنَةً
shades.hadith_en: And We test you with evil and with good as trial

shades.explanation: al-Ibtila (the testing) in the Quran is the act of testing. The Quran says: And We will test you with something of fear and hunger (2:155).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَنَبۡلُوَنَّكُم بِشَيۡءٍۢ مِّنَ الۡخَوۡفِ وَالۡجُوعِ
shades.hadith_en: And We will surely test you with something of fear and hunger

shades.explanation: al-Mubtala (the tested one) in the Quran refers to one who undergoes trial. The famous hadith states: The greatest reward comes with the greatest trial.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ عِظَمَ الۡجَزَآءِ مَعَ عِظَمِ الۡبَلَاءِ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed the greatest reward comes with the greatest trial

meaning.en: To inherit. The root denotes inheritance, succession, or bequeathing.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡوَاوُ وَالرَّاءُ وَالثَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى بَقَاءِ شَيۡءٍ بَعۡدَ آخَرَ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: وَرِثَ: صَارَ لَهُ الۡمَالُ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِ صَاحِبِهِ

quran_examples.ar: وَنَحۡنُ الۡوَٰرِثُونَ
quran_examples.en: And We are the Inheritor

quran_examples.ar: لِّلرِّجَالِ نَصِيبٌۭ مِّمَّا تَرَكَ الۡوَالِدَانِ
quran_examples.en: For men is a share of what the parents leave

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَسَمَ لَكُمُ الۡمِيرَاثَ
hadith.en: Indeed Allah has apportioned inheritance for you

hadith.ar: لَا يَمُوتُ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِ ثَلَاثَةٌ مِنَ الۡوَلَدِ
hadith.en: No believer loses three children

shades.explanation: al-Irth (the inheritance) in the Quran refers to wealth passed on. The Quran says: And give the orphans their property (4:2).
shades.hadith_ar: وَآتُواْ الۡيَتَٰمَىٰٓ أَمۡوَٰلَهُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: And give the orphans their property

shades.explanation: al-Miraath (the inheritance) in the Quran is a major topic. The Quran says: For men is a share of what the parents and near relatives leave (4:7).
shades.hadith_ar: لِّلرِّجَالِ نَصِيبٌۭ مِّمَّا تَرَكَ الۡوَالِدَانِ
shades.hadith_en: For men is a share of what the parents leave

shades.explanation: al-Warith (the Inheritor) in the Quran is one of Allah's names - He who remains after all creation perishes. The Quran says: And indeed, We - it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor (15:23).
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ نُحۡيِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحۡنُ الۡوَٰرِثُونَ
shades.hadith_en: And indeed We give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor

shades.explanation: at-Tawrith (the bequeathing) in the Quran refers to causing something to be inherited. The Quran says: And [We] caused the People who were oppressed to inherit the east of the land and its west (7:137).
shades.hadith_ar: وَأَوۡرَثۡنَا الۡقَوۡمَ الَّذِينَ كَانُواْ يُسۡتَضۡعَفُونَ
shades.hadith_en: And We caused the people who were oppressed to inherit

meaning.en: To plot, scheme. The root denotes plotting, deception, or cunning.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡكَافُ وَالۡيَاءُ وَالدَّالُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡخَدِيعَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: كَادَ: مَكَرَ. وَالۡكَيۡدُ: الۡمَكۡرُ

quran_examples.ar: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكۡرًا وَمَكَرۡنَا مَكۡرًا
quran_examples.en: They plotted a plot and We plotted a plot

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ كَيۡدَ الشَّيۡطَٰنِ كَانَ ضَعِيفًا
quran_examples.en: The plot of Satan is ever weak

hadith.ar: مَا مِنۡ عَبۡدٍ یَكِيدُ قَوۡمًا إِلَّا كَادَهُ اللَّهُ
hadith.en: No servant plots against people except that Allah plots against him

hadith.ar: لَا یَدۡخُلُ الۡجَنَّةَ مُخَادِعٌ
hadith.en: No deceiver enters Paradise

shades.explanation: al-Kayd (the plot) in the Quran refers to scheming and deception. The Quran says: And they plotted a plot, and We plotted a plot while they did not perceive (27:50).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكۡرًا وَمَكَرۡنَا مَكۡرًا وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
shades.hadith_en: And they plotted a plot, and We plotted a plot while they did not perceive

shades.explanation: al-Ka'id (the plotter) in the Quran refers to one who schemes. The Quran says: Indeed, the plot of Satan has ever been weak (4:76).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ كَيۡدَ الشَّيۡطَٰنِ كَانَ ضَعِيفًا
shades.hadith_en: Indeed the plot of Satan has ever been weak

shades.explanation: al-Kadi (the deceiver) in the Quran is the one who acts with guile. The Quran says: And they schemed, and Allah schemed, and Allah is the best of schemers (3:54).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَكَرُواْ وَمَكَرَ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ خَيۡرُ الۡمَاكِرِينَ
shades.hadith_en: And they schemed and Allah schemed and Allah is the best of schemers

shades.explanation: al-Imtidad (the prolonging) in the Quran refers to extended scheming. The famous hadith states: The most hated people to Allah are the stubborn disputers.
shades.hadith_ar: أَبۡغَضُ الرِّجَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ الۡأَلَدُّ الۡخَصِمُ
shades.hadith_en: The most hated person to Allah is the stubborn disputer

meaning.en: To pardon. The root denotes forgiveness, remission, or overlooking.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡعَيۡنُ وَالۡفَاءُ وَالۡوَاوُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡمَحۡوِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: عَفَا: تَجَاوَزَ. الۡعَفۡوُ: الۡغُفۡرَانُ

quran_examples.ar: فَاعۡفُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَٱصۡفَحۡ
quran_examples.en: So pardon them and forgive

quran_examples.ar: قُلِ الۡعَفۡوَ
quran_examples.en: Say, 'The excess'

hadith.ar: خُذِ الۡعَفۡوَ وَأۡمُرۡ بِالۡعُرۡفِ
hadith.en: Take what is given freely and command what is right

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَفُوٌّ يُحِبُّ الۡعَفۡوَ
hadith.en: Indeed Allah is Pardoning and loves pardon

shades.explanation: al-Eafw (the pardon) in the Quran refers to forgiveness and overlooking offenses. The Quran says: So pardon [them] and forgive - indeed Allah loves the doers of good (5:13).
shades.hadith_ar: فَاعۡفُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَٱصۡفَحۡ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
shades.hadith_en: So pardon them and forgive - indeed Allah loves the doers of good

shades.explanation: al-Eafw (the divine pardon) in the Quran is one of Allah's attributes. The Quran says: And let them pardon and overlook. Would you not like that Allah should forgive you? (24:22).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلۡيَعۡفُواْ وَلۡيَصۡفَحُوٓاْ أَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَن يَغۡفِرَ اللَّهُ لَكُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: And let them pardon and overlook. Would you not like Allah to forgive you?

shades.explanation: al-Eafwah (the remission) in the Quran also refers to that which is extra. The Quran says: And they ask you what they should spend. Say, 'The excess [beyond needs]' (2:219).
shades.hadith_ar: وَيَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ مَاذَا يُنفِقُونَ قُلِ الۡعَفۡوَ
shades.hadith_en: And they ask you what they should spend. Say, 'The excess'

shades.explanation: al-I'tifa (the seeking of pardon) in the Quran is the act of asking for forgiveness. The famous hadith states: Be forgiving, command what is right, and turn away from the ignorant.
shades.hadith_ar: خُذِ الۡعَفۡوَ وَأۡمُرۡ بِالۡعُرۡفِ وَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ الۡجَٰهِلِينَ
shades.hadith_en: Take what is given freely, enjoin what is good, and turn away from the ignorant

meaning.en: To cut, sever. The root denotes cutting, severing, or separating.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡقَافُ وَالطَّاءُ وَالۡعَيۡنُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى فَصۡلِ شَيۡءٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: قَطَعَ: فَصَلَ. قَطَعَ الرَّحِمَ: هَجَرَهُ

quran_examples.ar: وَيَقۡطَعُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ اللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ أَن يُوصَلَ
quran_examples.en: They sever what Allah commanded to be joined

quran_examples.ar: وَتُقَطِّعُوٓاْ أَرۡحَامَكُمۡ
quran_examples.en: And sever your ties of kinship

hadith.ar: لَا يَحِلُّ لِمُؤۡمِنٍ أَن يَهۡجُرَ أَخَاهُ فَوۡقَ ثَلَاثٍ
hadith.en: It is not permissible for a believer to shun his brother for more than three days

hadith.ar: الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرۡحَمُهُمُ الرَّحۡمَٰنُ
hadith.en: Those who show mercy will be shown mercy by the Most Merciful

shades.explanation: al-Qat (the cutting) in the Quran refers to severing or separating. The Quran says: And those who break the covenant of Allah after its ratification and sever what Allah has commanded to be joined (2:27).
shades.hadith_ar: وَيَقۡطَعُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ اللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ أَن يُوصَلَ
shades.hadith_en: And they sever what Allah has commanded to be joined

shades.explanation: al-Qitah (the piece) in the Quran is a severed portion. The Quran says: And We made the earth a fragment (18:42).
shades.hadith_ar: وَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي لَمۡ أُشۡرِكۡ بِرَبِّيٓ أَحَدًا
shades.hadith_en: And he says: Oh, I wish I had not associated anyone with my Lord

shades.explanation: al-Muqata'ah (the mutual severance) in the Quran refers to the cutting of ties. The famous hadith states: It is not permissible for a believer to shun his brother for more than three days.
shades.hadith_ar: لَا يَحِلُّ لِمُؤۡمِنٍ أَن يَهۡجُرَ أَخَاهُ فَوۡقَ ثَلَاثٍ
shades.hadith_en: It is not permissible for a believer to shun his brother for more than three days

shades.explanation: al-Qita (the severing of ties) in the Quran refers to breaking family relations. The Quran says: Would you then, if you were given authority, cause corruption in the land and sever your ties of kinship? (47:22).
shades.hadith_ar: فَهَلۡ عَسَيۡتُمۡ إِن تَوَلَّيۡتُمۡ أَن تُفۡسِدُواْ فِي الۡأَرۡضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوٓاْ أَرۡحَامَكُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: Would you then cause corruption and sever your ties of kinship?

meaning.en: To be false. The root denotes falsehood, vanity, invalidity, or worthlessness.
meaning.ar: الۡبَاطِلُ: ضِدُّ الۡحَقِّ، مَا لَا جَدۡوَىٰ مِنۡهُ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡبَاءُ وَالطَّاءُ وَاللَّامُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى ضِدِّ الۡحَقِّ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: بَطَلَ: فَسَدَ. وَالۡبَاطِلُ: نَقِيضُ الۡحَقِّ

quran_examples.ar: جَآءَ الۡحَقُّ وَزَهَقَ الۡبَاطِلُ
quran_examples.en: Truth has come and falsehood has vanished

quran_examples.ar: وَلَا تَلۡبِسُواْ الۡحَقَّ بِالۡبَاطِلِ
quran_examples.en: Do not mix truth with falsehood

hadith.ar: الۡحَقُّ بَيِّنٌ وَالۡبَاطِلُ بَيِّنٌ
hadith.en: Truth is clear and falsehood is clear

hadith.ar: إِيَّاكُمۡ وَالۡكَذِبَ فَإِنَّ الۡكَذِبَ يَهۡدِي إِلَى الۡفُجُورِ
hadith.en: Beware of lying, for lying leads to wickedness

shades.explanation: al-Batil (the falsehood) in the Quran refers to untruth and vanity. The Quran says: And say: Truth has come and falsehood has vanished - indeed falsehood is ever vanishing (17:81).
shades.hadith_ar: وَقُلۡ جَآءَ الۡحَقُّ وَزَهَقَ الۡبَاطِلُ إِنَّ الۡبَاطِلَ كَانَ زَهُوقًا
shades.hadith_en: And say: Truth has come and falsehood has vanished

shades.explanation: al-Butlan (the vanity) in the Quran refers to worthlessness. The Quran says: Do not mix the truth with falsehood (2:42).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تَلۡبِسُواْ الۡحَقَّ بِالۡبَاطِلِ
shades.hadith_en: And do not mix the truth with falsehood

shades.explanation: al-Mubtil (the falsifier) in the Quran refers to one who promotes falsehood. The Quran says: But We hurl the truth against falsehood, and it destroys it (21:18).
shades.hadith_ar: بَلۡ نَقۡذِفُ بِالۡحَقِّ عَلَى الۡبَاطِلِ فَيَدۡمَغُهُۥ
shades.hadith_en: But We hurl the truth against falsehood and it destroys it

shades.explanation: al-Tabtil (the invalidating) in the Quran is the act of making something void. The famous hadith states: The best of deeds are those that are most consistent - even if small.
shades.hadith_ar: أَحَبُّ الۡأَعۡمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَدۡوَمُهَا وَإِن قَلَّ
shades.hadith_en: The most beloved deeds to Allah are the most consistent, even if small

meaning.en: To precede. The root denotes precedence, forerunning, or outstripping.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: السِّينُ وَالۡبَاءُ وَالۡقَافُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى التَّقَدُّمِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: سَبَقَ: تَقَدَّمَ. وَالسَّابِقُونَ: الۡمُتَقَدِّمُونَ

quran_examples.ar: وَالسَّـٰبِقُونَ السَّـٰبِقُونَ
quran_examples.en: And the foremost will be the foremost

quran_examples.ar: سَابِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ مَغۡفِرَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ
quran_examples.en: Race toward forgiveness from your Lord

hadith.ar: أَوَّلُ مَن يَدۡخُلُ الۡجَنَّةَ الۡمُتَّقُونَ
hadith.en: The first to enter Paradise are the righteous

hadith.ar: السَّـٰبِقُونَ السَّـٰبِقُونَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ الۡمُقَرَّبُونَ
hadith.en: The foremost are the foremost - they are those brought near

shades.explanation: as-Sabq (the precedence) in the Quran refers to outstripping or getting ahead. The Quran says: And the foremost [in faith] will be the foremost [in reward] (56:10).
shades.hadith_ar: وَالسَّـٰبِقُونَ السَّـٰبِقُونَ
shades.hadith_en: And the foremost will be the foremost

shades.explanation: as-Sabiq (the forerunner) in the Quran refers to those who are first in faith and good deeds. The Quran says: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - they are the best of creatures (98:7).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds

shades.explanation: as-Sabaq (the race) in the Quran refers to competing in righteousness. The Quran says: Race toward forgiveness from your Lord (57:21).
shades.hadith_ar: سَابِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ مَغۡفِرَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: Race toward forgiveness from your Lord

shades.explanation: as-Sabiqah (the former) in the Quran refers to previous events. The famous hadith states: The first to enter Paradise are the first in faith.
shades.hadith_ar: أَوَّلُ مَن يَدۡخُلُ الۡجَنَّةَ
shades.hadith_en: The first to enter Paradise

meaning.en: To desire, to fall. The root denotes desire, passion, love, or falling.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡهَاءُ وَالۡوَاوُ وَالۡيَاءُ أَصۡلَانِ: أَحَدُهُمَا السُّقُوطُ وَالۡآخَرُ الۡمَيۡلُ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: هَوِيَ: أَحَبَّ. الۡهَوَىٰ: الۡمَيۡلُ

quran_examples.ar: مَنۡ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنِ اتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ
quran_examples.en: Who is more astray than one who follows his desire?

quran_examples.ar: وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ الۡهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ
quran_examples.en: Do not follow desire lest it lead you astray

hadith.ar: لَا يُؤۡمِنُ أَحَدُكُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يَكُونَ هَوَاهُ تَبَعًا لِّمَا جِئۡتُ بِهِ
hadith.en: None of you truly believes until his desire follows what I have brought

hadith.ar: إِيَّاكُمۡ وَالۡهَوَىٰ فَإِنَّ الۡهَوَىٰ يُصِمُّ وَيُعۡمِي
hadith.en: Beware of desire, for it deafens and blinds

shades.explanation: al-Hawa (the desire) in the Quran refers to carnal desires. The Quran says: And who is more astray than one who follows his desire without guidance from Allah? (28:50).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَنۡ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنِ اتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ بِغَيۡرِ هُدًۭى مِّنَ اللَّهِ
shades.hadith_en: Who is more astray than one who follows his desire without guidance from Allah?

shades.explanation: al-Hawy (the falling) in the Quran refers to plummeting. The Quran says: So his mother is the Abyss (101:9).
shades.hadith_ar: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٌۭ
shades.hadith_en: His mother is the Abyss

shades.name_en: al-Mutahawwi - The One Who Follows Desire
shades.explanation: al-Mutahawwi (the follower of desire) in the Quran is one who is led by his whims. The Quran says: And do not follow desire, lest it lead you astray (38:26).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ الۡهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
shades.hadith_en: And do not follow desire, lest it lead you astray from the way of Allah

shades.explanation: al-Hawa (the passion) in the Quran refers to intense love that can lead astray. The famous hadith states: The one who loves something becomes blind and deaf.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّكَ اتَّخَذۡتَ إِلَٰهَكَ هَوَىٰكَ
shades.hadith_en: You have taken your desire as your god

meaning.en: To settle, be firm. The root denotes settlement, stability, establishment, or confession.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡقَافُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى ثَبَاتِ الشَّيۡءِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: قَرَّ: ثَبَتَ. وَالۡقَرَارُ: الۡمَوۡضِعُ الَّذِي يَسۡتَقِرُّ فِيهِ

quran_examples.ar: وَلَقَدۡ مَكَّنَّٰكُمۡ فِي الۡأَرۡضِ
quran_examples.en: And We settled you on the earth

quran_examples.ar: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۢ بُيُوتِكُمۡ سَكَنًا
quran_examples.en: Allah made for you a place of rest

hadith.ar: أَلَا وَإِنَّ فِي الۡجَسَدِ مُضۡغَةً إِذَا صَلَحَتۡ صَلَحَ الۡجَسَدُ كُلُّهُۥ
hadith.en: In the body is a clot of blood; if it is sound the whole body is sound

hadith.ar: لَا یَسۡتَقِرُّ إِیمَانُ عَبۡدٍ حَتَّىٰ یَسۡتَقِرَّ قَلۡبُهُۥ
hadith.en: A servant's faith does not settle until his heart settles

shades.explanation: al-Qarar (the settlement) in the Quran refers to a stable dwelling. The Quran says: And We settled you on the earth and made for you therein means of livelihood (7:10).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَقَدۡ مَكَّنَّٰكُمۡ فِي الۡأَرۡضِ
shades.hadith_en: And We settled you on the earth

shades.explanation: al-Qarar (the stability) in the Quran refers to firmness and permanence. The Quran says: And Allah has made for you from your homes a place of rest (16:80).
shades.hadith_ar: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۢ بُيُوتِكُمۡ سَكَنًا
shades.hadith_en: And Allah has made for you from your homes a place of rest

shades.explanation: al-Mustaqirr (the fixed place) in the Quran refers to the settled destination. The Quran says: Then indeed, after that you will die (23:15).
shades.hadith_ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ
shades.hadith_en: Then indeed after that you will die

shades.explanation: al-Iqrar (the confession) in the Quran refers to acknowledgment and affirmation. The famous hadith states: The confession of the adulterer was the basis for his punishment.
shades.hadith_ar: أَقَرَّ الرَّجُلُ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِهِۦ
shades.hadith_en: The man confessed against himself

meaning.en: To deny, reject. The root denotes denial, disapproval, or evil.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: النُّونُ وَالۡكَافُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى ضِدِّ الۡمَعۡرُوفِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: أَنكَرَ: جَحَدَ. الۡمُنكَرُ: مَا لَا يُعۡرَفُ

quran_examples.ar: وَجَحَدُواْ بِهَا وَٱسۡتَيۡقَنَتۡهَآ أَنفُسُهُمۡ
quran_examples.en: They denied them while their souls were certain

quran_examples.ar: وَٱنۡهَ عَنِ الۡمُنكَرِ
quran_examples.en: And forbid what is wrong

hadith.ar: مَن رَأَىٰ مِنكُم مُّنكَرًا فَلۡيُغَيِّرۡهُ
hadith.en: Whoever sees an evil, let him change it

hadith.ar: لَا یَسۡتَحۡيِي الۡمُؤۡمِنُ أَن يَكُونَ مَعۡرُوفًا
hadith.en: The believer should not be shy to do what is right

shades.explanation: al-Inkar (the denial) in the Quran refers to rejection and disavowal. The Quran says: They denied them [Our signs] while their souls were certain of them (27:14).
shades.hadith_ar: وَجَحَدُواْ بِهَا وَٱسۡتَيۡقَنَتۡهَآ أَنفُسُهُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: And they denied them while their souls were certain of them

shades.explanation: al-Munkar (the evil) in the Quran is what is disapproved and forbidden. The Quran says: And enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong (31:17).
shades.hadith_ar: وَأۡمُرۡ بِالۡمَعۡرُوفِ وَٱنۡهَ عَنِ الۡمُنكَرِ
shades.hadith_en: And enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong

shades.explanation: an-Nakir (the denier) in the Quran is one who rejects. The famous hadith states: The two angels who question in the grave are Munkar and Nakir.
shades.hadith_ar: مُنكَرٌۭ وَنَكِيرٌ
shades.hadith_en: Munkar and Nakir

shades.explanation: al-Istinkar (the disapproval) in the Quran refers to finding something objectionable. The Quran says: [Musa] said, 'Do not take me for what I forgot' (18:73).
shades.hadith_ar: لَا تُؤَاخِذۡنِي بِمَا نَسِيتُ
shades.hadith_en: Do not take me for what I forgot

meaning.en: To scatter. The root denotes scattering, spreading, or the atom.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الذَّالُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصۡلَانِ: أَحَدُهُمَا التَّفۡرِيقُ وَالۡآخَرُ النَّمۡلُ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: ذَرَّ: فَرَّقَ. الذَّرَّةُ: النَّمۡلَةُ الصَّغِيرَةُ

quran_examples.ar: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرًا يَرَهُۥ
quran_examples.en: Whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it

quran_examples.ar: وَالذَّارِيَاتِ ذَرۡوًا
quran_examples.en: By the [winds] that scatter [dust]

hadith.ar: لَا یَدۡخُلُ الۡجَنَّةَ مَن كَانَ فِي قَلۡبِهِ مِثۡقَالُ ذَرَّةٍۢ مِنۡ كِبۡرٍ
hadith.en: No one enters Paradise who has an atom's weight of pride in his heart

hadith.ar: إِنۡ تَجۡتَنِبُواْ كَبَآئِرَ مَا تُنۡهَوۡنَ عَنۡهُ نُكَفِّرۡ عَنكُمۡ
hadith.en: If you avoid the major sins, We will remit your minor sins

shades.explanation: adh-Dharr (the atom) in the Quran refers to the smallest particle. The Quran says: And whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it (99:7).
shades.hadith_ar: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرًا يَرَهُۥ
shades.hadith_en: And whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it

shades.explanation: adh-Dhar (the scattering) in the Quran refers to spreading or dispersing. The Quran says: And He scattered throughout them [creatures] (25:54).
shades.hadith_ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ مِنَ الۡمَآءِ بَشَرًا
shades.hadith_en: And it is He who created from water a human

shades.explanation: adh-Dhariyat (the scattering winds) in the Quran is the name of Surah 51. The Quran says: By the [winds] that scatter [dust] (51:1).
shades.hadith_ar: وَالذَّارِيَاتِ ذَرۡوًا
shades.hadith_en: By the [winds] that scatter [dust]

shades.explanation: al-Madhrur (the scattered) in the Quran refers to that which is spread about. The famous hadith states: The example of the one who recites the Quran is like the colocynth.
shades.hadith_ar: مَثَلُ الَّذِي یَقۡرَأُ الۡقُرۡآنَ
shades.hadith_en: The example of the one who recites the Quran

meaning.en: To doubt. The root denotes doubt, suspicion, or uncertainty.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الرَّاءُ وَالۡيَاءُ وَالۡبَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى اضۡطِرَابِ النَّفۡسِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: رَابَ: شَكَّ. الرَّيۡبُ: الۡتَّرَدُّدُ

quran_examples.ar: ذَٰلِكَ الۡكِتَـٰبُ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهِ
quran_examples.en: That is the Book about which there is no doubt

quran_examples.ar: وَإِنَّا لَفِي شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا تَدۡعُونَنَآ إِلَيۡهِ
quran_examples.en: We are in doubt about what you call us to

hadith.ar: دَعۡ مَا يَرِيبُكَ إِلَىٰ مَا لَا يَرِيبُكَ
hadith.en: Leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt

hadith.ar: الۡيَقِينُ لَا یُزِيلُهُ الشَّكُّ
hadith.en: Certainty is not removed by doubt

shades.explanation: ar-Rayb (the doubt) in the Quran refers to uncertainty and suspicion. The Quran says: That is the Book about which there is no doubt (2:2).
shades.hadith_ar: ذَٰلِكَ الۡكِتَـٰبُ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهِ
shades.hadith_en: That is the Book about which there is no doubt

shades.explanation: al-Murib (the doubtful) in the Quran refers to things that cause uncertainty. The famous hadith states: Leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt.
shades.hadith_ar: دَعۡ مَا يَرِيبُكَ إِلَىٰ مَا لَا يَرِيبُكَ
shades.hadith_en: Leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt

shades.explanation: ar-Rayb (the suspicion) in the Quran refers to negative assumptions. The Quran says: And do not obey the one whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance and who follows his desire (18:28).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تُطِعۡ مَنۡ أَغۡفَلۡنَا قَلۡبَهُۥ عَن ذِكۡرِنَا
shades.hadith_en: And do not obey one whose heart We made heedless

shades.explanation: al-Irtiyab (the being in doubt) in the Quran refers to the state of uncertainty. The Quran says: And those who are in doubt about that which is revealed to you (11:62).
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِنَّا لَفِي شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا تَدۡعُونَنَآ إِلَيۡهِ
shades.hadith_en: And indeed we are in doubt about what you call us to

meaning.en: To be heedless. The root denotes heedlessness, neglect, or inattention.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡغَيۡنُ وَالۡفَاءُ وَاللَّامُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى التَّرۡكِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: غَفَلَ: سَهَا. الۡغَفۡلَةُ: ضِدُّ الۡیَقَظَةِ

quran_examples.ar: وَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ الۡغَٰفِلِينَ
quran_examples.en: And do not be among the heedless

quran_examples.ar: وَلَا تُطِعۡ مَنۡ أَغۡفَلۡنَا قَلۡبَهُۥ عَن ذِكۡرِنَا
quran_examples.en: Do not obey one whose heart We made heedless

hadith.ar: أَقۡبِلۡ عَلَىٰ ذِكۡرِ اللَّهِ وَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ الۡغَفۡلَةِ
hadith.en: Turn to the remembrance of Allah and turn away from heedlessness

hadith.ar: أَفۡضَلُ الذِّكۡرِ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
hadith.en: The best remembrance is La ilaha illa Allah

shades.explanation: al-Ghaflah (the heedlessness) in the Quran refers to being unaware or neglectful. The Quran says: And indeed, We have created for Hell many of the jinn and mankind - they have hearts with which they do not understand (7:179).
shades.hadith_ar: لَهُمۡ قُلُوبٌۭ لَّا يَفۡقَهُونَ بِهَا
shades.hadith_en: They have hearts with which they do not understand

shades.explanation: al-Ghafil (the heedless) in the Quran refers to one who is inattentive. The Quran says: And do not be among the heedless (7:205).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ الۡغَٰفِلِينَ
shades.hadith_en: And do not be among the heedless

shades.explanation: al-Ighfal (the making heedless) in the Quran refers to causing neglect. The famous hadith states: Beware of heedlessness, for heedlessness is the cause of all evil.
shades.hadith_ar: إِيَّاكُمۡ وَالۡغَفۡلَةَ فَإِنَّ الۡغَفۡلَةَ رَأۡسُ الۡخَطَايَا
shades.hadith_en: Beware of heedlessness, for it is the source of all sins

shades.explanation: al-Ghaflah (the forgetfulness) in the Quran refers to forgetting Allah and His commands. The Quran says: And do not obey one whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance (18:28).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تُطِعۡ مَنۡ أَغۡفَلۡنَا قَلۡبَهُۥ عَن ذِكۡرِنَا
shades.hadith_en: And do not obey one whose heart We made heedless of Our remembrance

meaning.en: To be pure. The root denotes purity, cleanliness, or sanctification.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الطَّاءُ وَالۡهَاءُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى النَّظَافَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: طَهُرَ: نَظُفَ. الطَّهُورُ: الۡمَاءُ الَّذِي يُتَطَهَّرُ بِهِ

quran_examples.ar: فِيهِ رِجَالٌۭ يُحِبُّونَ أَن يَتَطَهَّرُواْ
quran_examples.en: Men who love to purify themselves

quran_examples.ar: وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَاءًۭ طَهُورًا
quran_examples.en: And We sent down pure water from the sky

hadith.ar: الطَّهُورُ شَطۡرُ الۡإِيمَانِ
hadith.en: Purity is half of faith

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ التَّوَّٰبِينَ وَيُحِبُّ الۡمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
hadith.en: Allah loves those who repent and those who purify themselves

shades.explanation: at-Taharah (the purity) in the Quran refers to cleanliness and sanctity. The Quran says: Therein are men who love to purify themselves, and Allah loves those who purify themselves (9:108).
shades.hadith_ar: فِيهِ رِجَالٌۭ يُحِبُّونَ أَن يَتَطَهَّرُواْ وَاللَّهُ يُحِبُّ الۡمُطَّهِّرِينَ
shades.hadith_en: Therein are men who love to purify themselves and Allah loves those who purify themselves

shades.explanation: at-Tuhur (the purification) in the Quran refers to the means of purity. The Quran says: And We sent down from the sky pure water (25:48).
shades.hadith_ar: وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَاءًۭ طَهُورًا
shades.hadith_en: And We sent down from the sky pure water

shades.explanation: al-Mutahhirat (the purifying things) in the Quran refer to acts and means of purification. The famous hadith states: Purity is half of faith.
shades.hadith_ar: الطَّهُورُ شَطۡرُ الۡإِيمَانِ
shades.hadith_en: Purity is half of faith

shades.explanation: at-Tahir (the pure) in the Quran refers to that which is clean. The Quran says: And your Lord has sent down to you a clear statement (11:57).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ التَّوَّٰبِينَ وَيُحِبُّ الۡمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed Allah loves those who repent and those who purify themselves

meaning.en: Sun. The root denotes the sun or sunlight.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الشِّينُ وَالۡمِيمُ وَالسِّينُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى ضِيَاءِ النَّهَارِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الشَّمۡسُ: الكَوۡكَبُ النَّهَارِيُّ

quran_examples.ar: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِ الَّيۡلُ وَالنَّهَارُ وَالشَّمۡسُ وَالۡقَمَرُ
quran_examples.en: Of His signs are the night, day, sun and moon

quran_examples.ar: وَالشَّمۡسُ تَجۡرِي لِمُسۡتَقَرٍّۢ لَّهَا
quran_examples.en: The sun runs toward its stopping point

hadith.ar: الشَّمۡسُ وَالۡقَمَرُ آيَتَانِ مِنۡ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ
hadith.en: The sun and moon are two signs of Allah

hadith.ar: إِذَا رَأَيۡتُمُ الشَّمۡسَ فَصَلُّواْ
hadith.en: When you see the sun, pray

shades.explanation: ash-Shams (the sun) in the Quran is one of Allah's great signs. The Quran says: And [of] His signs are the night and the day and the sun and the moon (41:37).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِ الَّيۡلُ وَالنَّهَارُ وَالشَّمۡسُ وَالۡقَمَرُ
shades.hadith_en: And of His signs are the night and the day and the sun and the moon

shades.explanation: Surah ash-Shams (the Sun chapter) is Surah 91 of the Quran. The Quran swears by the sun and its brightness.
shades.hadith_ar: وَالشَّمۡسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
shades.hadith_en: By the sun and its brightness

shades.name_en: ash-Shams - The Sun as a Divine Sign
shades.explanation: ash-Shams (the sun) as a divine sign in the Quran points to the Creator. The famous hadith states: The sun and the moon are two signs of Allah - they do not eclipse for anyone's death.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ الشَّمۡسَ وَالۡقَمَرَ آيَتَانِ مِنۡ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed the sun and the moon are two signs of Allah

shades.explanation: ash-Shams (the sun) in the cosmic order of the Quran runs its course. The Quran says: And the sun runs [its course] toward its stopping point (36:38).
shades.hadith_ar: وَالشَّمۡسُ تَجۡرِي لِمُسۡتَقَرٍّۢ لَّهَا
shades.hadith_en: And the sun runs toward its stopping point

meaning.en: To be blind. The root denotes blindness, whether physical or spiritual.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡعَيۡنُ وَالۡمِيمُ وَالۡيَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى ذَهَابِ البَصَرِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: عَمِيَ: ذَهَبَ بَصَرُهُ. وَعَمِيَ عَلَيۡهِ: خَفِيَ

quran_examples.ar: فَإِنَّهَا لَا تَعۡمَى الۡأَبۡصَٰرُ وَلَٰكِن تَعۡمَى الۡقُلُوبُ
quran_examples.en: It is not the eyes that are blind but the hearts

quran_examples.ar: وَمَن كَانَ فِي هَٰذِهِۦٓ أَعۡمَىٰ فَهُوَ فِي الۡأٓخِرَةِ أَعۡمَىٰ
quran_examples.en: Whoever is blind in this world will be blind in the Hereafter

hadith.ar: لَا تَکُونُواْ كَالَّذِينَ کَفَرُواْ
hadith.en: Do not be like those who disbelieved

hadith.ar: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا مِنَ الۡعُمۡيَانِ
hadith.en: O Allah, do not make us among the blind

shades.explanation: al-Eama (the blindness) in the Quran refers to physical and spiritual blindness. The Quran says: Indeed it is not the eyes that are blind, but the hearts within the breasts that are blind (22:46).
shades.hadith_ar: فَإِنَّهَا لَا تَعۡمَى الۡأَبۡصَٰرُ وَلَٰكِن تَعۡمَى الۡقُلُوبُ الَّتِي فِي الصُّدُورِ
shades.hadith_en: It is not the eyes that are blind but the hearts within the breasts

shades.explanation: al-Ama (the blind person) in the Quran refers to one who cannot see. The Quran says: He frowned and turned away because the blind man came to him (80:1-2).
shades.hadith_ar: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ أَن جَآءَهُ الۡأَعۡمَىٰ
shades.hadith_en: He frowned and turned away because the blind man came to him

shades.explanation: al-Eami (the spiritually blind) in the Quran refers to one who does not see the truth. The Quran says: But he who is blind in this [world] will be blind in the Hereafter (17:72).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَن كَانَ فِي هَٰذِهِۦٓ أَعۡمَىٰ فَهُوَ فِي الۡأٓخِرَةِ أَعۡمَىٰ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever is blind in this [world] will be blind in the Hereafter

shades.explanation: al-Eamiyah (the blindness of ignorance) in the Quran refers to heedless wandering. The famous hadith states: The blind man is not the one whose eyes are blind, but the one whose insight is blind.
shades.hadith_ar: لَيۡسَ الۡأَعۡمَىٰ مَنۡ عَمِيَتۡ عَيۡنَاهُ
shades.hadith_en: The blind is not one whose eyes are blind

meaning.en: Throne. The root denotes a throne, arbor, or structure.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡعَيۡنُ وَالرَّاءُ وَالشِّينُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡعُلُوِّ وَالرَّفۡعَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الۡعَرۡشُ: سَرِيرُ الۡمَلِكِ

quran_examples.ar: ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ
quran_examples.en: The Most Merciful is established over the Throne

quran_examples.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَحۡمِلُونَ ٱلۡعَرۡشَ
quran_examples.en: Those who bear the Throne

hadith.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ الۡعَرۡشِ الۡعَظِيمِ
hadith.en: O Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne

hadith.ar: لَا یَزَالُ عَبۡدِي یَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَيَّ
hadith.en: My servant continues to draw near to Me

shades.explanation: al-Earsh (the Throne) in the Quran refers to the Throne of Allah. The Quran says: The Most Merciful [who] is established over the Throne (20:5).
shades.hadith_ar: ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ
shades.hadith_en: The Most Merciful is established over the Throne

shades.name_en: Dhu al-Earsh - The Possessor of the Throne
shades.explanation: Dhu al-Earsh (the Possessor of the Throne) is one of Allah's descriptions. The Quran says: He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne (9:129).
shades.hadith_ar: رَبُّ الۡعَرۡشِ الۡعَظِيمِ
shades.hadith_en: Lord of the Mighty Throne

shades.name_en: Ulu al-Earsh - The Bearers of the Throne
shades.explanation: Ulu al-Earsh (the Bearers of the Throne) in the Quran are the angels. The Quran says: Those who bear the Throne and those around it exalt [Allah] (40:7).
shades.hadith_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَحۡمِلُونَ ٱلۡعَرۡشَ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهُۥ
shades.hadith_en: Those who bear the Throne and those around it

shades.explanation: al-Earsh (the seat of authority) in the Quran refers to a throne of power. The Quran says: And [she] said, 'Bring me his throne' (27:41).
shades.hadith_ar: قَالَتِ ٱئۡتُونِي بِعَرۡشِهِۦ
shades.hadith_en: She said: Bring me his throne

meaning.en: To bless. The root denotes blessing, abundance, or increase.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡبَاءُ وَالرَّاءُ وَالۡكَافُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الثَّبَاتِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: بَارَكَ: جَعَلَ فِيهِ الۡبَرَكَةَ

quran_examples.ar: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي نَزَّلَ الۡفُرۡقَانَ
quran_examples.en: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion

quran_examples.ar: تَبَارَكَ ٱسۡمُ رَبِّكَ
quran_examples.en: Blessed is the name of your Lord

hadith.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكۡ لَنَا فِيهِ
hadith.en: O Allah, bless us in it

hadith.ar: تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحۡسَنُ الۡخَٰلِقِينَ
hadith.en: Blessed is Allah, the Best of Creators

shades.explanation: al-Barakah (the blessing) in the Quran refers to divine increase and favor. The Quran says: And We blessed him [Abraham] and Isaac (37:113).
shades.hadith_ar: وَبَارَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ
shades.hadith_en: And We blessed him

shades.explanation: al-Mubarak (the blessed) in the Quran refers to that which receives divine blessing. The Quran says: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion (25:1).
shades.hadith_ar: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي نَزَّلَ الۡفُرۡقَانَ
shades.hadith_en: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion

shades.explanation: Tabarak (Blessed) in the Quran is ascribed to Allah alone. The Quran says: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Full of Majesty and Honor (55:78).
shades.hadith_ar: تَبَارَكَ ٱسۡمُ رَبِّكَ ذِي الۡجَلَٰلِ وَالۡإِكۡرَامِ
shades.hadith_en: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Full of Majesty and Honor

shades.explanation: al-Barik (the Bestower of Blessings) in the Quran refers to the One who blesses. The famous hadith states: O Allah, bless our Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
shades.hadith_ar: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكۡ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍۢ
shades.hadith_en: O Allah, bless Muhammad

meaning.en: To extend. The root denotes extension, stretching, or prolonging.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡمِيمُ وَالدَّالُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الزِّيَادَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: مَدَّ: بَسَطَ. الۡمِدَادُ: مَا يُكۡتَبُ بِهِ

quran_examples.ar: لَوۡ أَنَّمَا فِي الۡأَرۡضِ مِن شَجَرَةٍ أَقۡلَٰمٌۭ
quran_examples.en: If whatever trees on earth were pens

quran_examples.ar: لَوۡ كَانَ الۡبَحۡرُ مِدَادًا لِّكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّي
quran_examples.en: If the sea were ink for the words of my Lord

hadith.ar: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلۡأٓخِرَةَ وَالۡأُولَىٰ
hadith.en: And indeed to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life]

hadith.ar: مَن صَامَ رَمَضَانَۭ إِيمَانًاۭ وَاحۡتِسَابًا
hadith.en: Whoever fasts Ramadan with faith and seeking reward

shades.explanation: al-Madd (the extension) in the Quran refers to stretching or prolonging. The Quran says: And the sea - seven seas would not exhaust it before the words of Allah are exhausted (31:27).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَوۡ أَنَّمَا فِي الۡأَرۡضِ مِن شَجَرَةٍ أَقۡلَٰمٌۭ
shades.hadith_en: And if whatever trees on earth were pens

shades.explanation: al-Midad (the ink) in the Quran is what is used for writing. The Quran says: The sea would be exhausted before the words of my Lord (18:109).
shades.hadith_ar: لَوۡ كَانَ الۡبَحۡرُ مِدَادًا لِّكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّي
shades.hadith_en: If the sea were ink for the words of my Lord

shades.explanation: al-Muddat (the extended period) in the Quran refers to a duration. The famous hadith states: The one who recites the Quran and acts upon it - his parents will be crowned.
shades.hadith_ar: مَن قَرَأَ الۡقُرۡآنَ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever recites the Quran

shades.explanation: al-Imdad (the supplying) in the Quran refers to providing support. The Quran says: And We will supply you with relief in your prayer (19:22).
shades.hadith_ar: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرًا
shades.hadith_en: Indeed with hardship comes ease

meaning.en: To intercede. The root denotes intercession, mediation, or pairing.
meaning.ar: الشَّفَاعَةُ: الۡوَسَاطَةُ، ضَمُّ الشَّيۡءِ إِلَى الشَّيۡءِ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الشِّينُ وَالۡفَاءُ وَالۡعَيۡنُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى ضَمِّ شَيۡءٍ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: شَفَعَ: ضَمَّ. الشَّفَاعَةُ: الطَّلَبُ لِلۡغَيۡرِ

quran_examples.ar: مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشۡفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِهِۦ
quran_examples.en: Who can intercede with Him except by His permission?

quran_examples.ar: وَلَا يَشۡفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ارۡتَضَىٰ
quran_examples.en: They do not intercede except for those He approves

hadith.ar: شَفَاعَتِي لِأَهۡلِ الۡكَبَائِرِ مِنۡ أُمَّتِي
hadith.en: My intercession is for those who commit major sins from my nation

hadith.ar: أَنَا أَوَّلُ شَفِيعٍۢ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيَامَةِ
hadith.en: I am the first intercessor on the Day of Resurrection

shades.explanation: ash-Shafaa (the intercession) in the Quran refers to pleading on behalf of another. The Quran says: Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? (2:255).
shades.hadith_ar: مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشۡفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِهِۦ
shades.hadith_en: Who can intercede with Him except by His permission?

shades.explanation: ash-Shafi (the intercessor) in the Quran is one who intercedes. The Quran says: They do not intercede except for those He approves (21:28).
shades.hadith_ar: وَيَشۡفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ارۡتَضَىٰ
shades.hadith_en: And they do not intercede except for those He approves

shades.explanation: ash-Shuf'a (the intercession) in the Quran is a divine prerogative. The famous hadith states: My intercession will be for those who commit major sins from my nation.
shades.hadith_ar: شَفَاعَتِي لِأَهۡلِ الۡكَبَائِرِ مِنۡ أُمَّتِي
shades.hadith_en: My intercession is for those who commit major sins from my nation

shades.name_en: al-Mushaffa - The One Whose Intercession Is Accepted
shades.explanation: al-Mushaffa (the one whose intercession is accepted) in the Quran refers to the Prophet. The famous hadith states: I will intercede on the Day of Resurrection.
shades.hadith_ar: أَنَا سَيِّدُ وَلَدِ آدَمَ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيَامَةِ
shades.hadith_en: I am the leader of mankind on the Day of Resurrection

meaning.en: To be hidden. The root denotes concealment, secrecy, or being hidden.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡخَاءُ وَالۡفَاءُ وَالۡيَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى السَّتۡرِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: خَفِيَ: اسۡتَتَرَ. الۡإِخۡفَاءُ: الۡكِتۡمَانُ

quran_examples.ar: يَعۡلَمُ الۡغَيۡبَ وَالشَّهَادَةَ
quran_examples.en: He knows the unseen and the witnessed

quran_examples.ar: وَأَسِرُّواْ قَوۡلَكُمۡ أَوِ ٱجۡهَرُواْ بِهِۦٓ
quran_examples.en: Conceal your speech or declare it

hadith.ar: أَنَا عِنۡدَ ظَنِّ عَبۡدِي بِي
hadith.en: I am as My servant thinks of Me

hadith.ar: التَّقۡوَىٰ هَاهُنَا - وَيُشِيرُ إِلَى صَدۡرِهِ
hadith.en: Piety is here - pointing to his chest

shades.explanation: al-Khafya (the hidden) in the Quran refers to what is concealed. The Quran says: And He knows what is hidden and what is manifest (6:73).
shades.hadith_ar: يَعۡلَمُ الۡغَيۡبَ وَالشَّهَادَةَ
shades.hadith_en: He knows the unseen and the witnessed

shades.explanation: al-Ikhfa (the concealment) in the Quran refers to hiding something. The Quran says: And whether you conceal your speech or declare it, He knows the secrets of the breasts (67:13).
shades.hadith_ar: وَأَسِرُّواْ قَوۡلَكُمۡ أَوِ ٱجۡهَرُواْ بِهِۦٓ
shades.hadith_en: And conceal your speech or declare it

shades.explanation: al-Khafi (the hidden) in the Quran refers to that which is not apparent. The Quran says: And whether you conceal it or make it known, indeed Allah knows all things (24:29).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تَبۡدُونَ وَمَا تَكۡتُمُونَ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed Allah knows what you reveal and what you conceal

shades.explanation: al-Khafiyyah (the secret state) in the Quran refers to hidden circumstances. The famous hadith states: Allah said: I am as My servant thinks of Me.
shades.hadith_ar: أَنَا عِنۡدَ ظَنِّ عَبۡدِي بِي
shades.hadith_en: I am as My servant thinks of Me

meaning.en: To trust. The root denotes trust, confidence, or binding covenant.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡوَاوُ وَالثَّاءُ وَالۡقَافُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الشَّدِّ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: وَثِقَ: اِعۡتَمَدَ. الۡمِيثَاقُ: الۡعَهۡدُ

quran_examples.ar: وَٱعۡتَصِمُواْ بِحَبۡلِ اللَّهِ
quran_examples.en: Hold fast to the rope of Allah

quran_examples.ar: وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَتَوَكَّلُواْ
quran_examples.en: Put your trust in Allah

hadith.ar: تَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى اللَّهِ
hadith.en: Put your trust in Allah

hadith.ar: الۡحَيَاءُ لَا يَأۡتِي إِلَّا بِخَيۡرٍ
hadith.en: Modesty does not bring anything but good

shades.explanation: al-Withaq (the trust) in the Quran refers to a binding covenant. The Quran says: And hold fast to the covenant of Allah (3:103).
shades.hadith_ar: وَٱعۡتَصِمُواْ بِحَبۡلِ اللَّهِ
shades.hadith_en: And hold fast to the rope of Allah

shades.explanation: ath-Thiqah (the confidence) in the Quran refers to trust and reliance. The Quran says: And put your trust in Allah if you are believers (5:23).
shades.hadith_ar: وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَتَوَكَّلُواْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
shades.hadith_en: And put your trust in Allah if you are believers

shades.explanation: al-Mawthuq (the trustworthy) in the Quran refers to that which is reliable. The famous hadith states: The best provision is trust in Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: تَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى اللَّهِ
shades.hadith_en: Put your trust in Allah

shades.explanation: al-Itht?q (the securing) in the Quran refers to binding firmly. The famous hadith states: Whoever dies while not having taken an oath of allegiance dies the death of ignorance.
shades.hadith_ar: مَن مَّاتَ وَلَيۡسَ عَلَيۡهِ إِمَامٌۭ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever dies without a leader

meaning.en: To live. The root denotes life, living, or being alive.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡحَاءُ وَالۡيَاءُ أَصۡلٌ وَاحِدٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡحَيَاةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الۡحَيَاةُ: نَمَاءُ الۡقُوَى. الۡحَيُّ: اللَّهُ سُبۡحَانَهُ

quran_examples.ar: اللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الۡحَيُّ الۡقَيُّومُ
quran_examples.en: Allah, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer

quran_examples.ar: كُلُّ نَفۡسٍۢ ذَآئِقَةُ الۡمَوۡتِ
quran_examples.en: Every soul will taste death

hadith.ar: لَا تَمُوتُواْ إِلَّا وَأَنتُم مُّسۡلِمُونَ
hadith.en: Do not die except in a state of submission

hadith.ar: مَنۡ أَحۡيَاهَا فَكَأَنَّمَا أَحۡيَا النَّاسَ جَمِيعًا
hadith.en: Whoever gives life to one person, it is as if he gave life to all mankind

shades.explanation: al-Hayah (the life) in the Quran refers to existence and vitality. The Quran says: Every soul will taste death (3:185).
shades.hadith_ar: كُلُّ نَفۡسٍۢ ذَآئِقَةُ الۡمَوۡتِ
shades.hadith_en: Every soul will taste death

shades.explanation: al-Hayy (the Ever-Living) in the Quran is one of Allah's names. The Quran says: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer (2:255).
shades.hadith_ar: اللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الۡحَيُّ الۡقَيُّومُ
shades.hadith_en: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer

shades.name_en: al-Hayat ad-Dunya - The Life of This World
shades.explanation: al-Hayat ad-Dunya (the life of this world) in the Quran refers to temporal existence. The Quran says: The life of this world is but amusement and diversion (57:20).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّمَا الۡحَيَوٰةُ الدُّنۡيَا لَعِبٌۭ وَلَهۡوٌۭ
shades.hadith_en: The life of this world is but amusement and diversion

shades.explanation: al-Ihya (the giving of life) in the Quran refers to bringing back to life. The Quran says: And We made from water every living thing (21:30).
shades.hadith_ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنَ الۡمَآءِ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ حَيٍّ
shades.hadith_en: And We made from water every living thing

meaning.en: To incline. The root denotes inclining, sinning, or a wing.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡجِيمُ وَالنُّونُ وَالۡحَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡمَيۡلِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الۡجَنَاحُ: مَا يَطِيرُ بِهِ الطَّائِرُ. جَنَحَ: مَالَ

quran_examples.ar: وَٱخۡفِضۡ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ الـذُّلِّ مِنَ الرَّحۡمَةِ
quran_examples.en: Lower to them the wing of humility

quran_examples.ar: لَّآ جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡهِنَّ
quran_examples.en: No sin upon them

hadith.ar: لَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡكَ
hadith.en: There is no fault upon you

hadith.ar: مَنۡ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيۡرًا يَفۡقَهۡهُ فِي الدِّينِ
hadith.en: Whoever Allah intends good for, He gives him understanding in the religion

shades.explanation: al-Junah (the inclination) in the Quran carries the meaning of sin or blame. The Quran says: There is no sin upon you if you enter houses (33:55).
shades.hadith_ar: لَّآ جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: There is no sin upon you

shades.explanation: al-Janah (the wing) in the Quran refers to a wing of a bird. The Quran says: Lower to them the wing of humility (17:24).
shades.hadith_ar: وَٱخۡفِضۡ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ الـذُّلِّ مِنَ الرَّحۡمَةِ
shades.hadith_en: And lower to them the wing of humility

shades.explanation: al-Jawani (the sides) in the Quran refers to the ribs or sides. The famous hadith states: Nothing is wrong with me - I have eaten wings.
shades.hadith_ar: أَكَلَ جَنَاحَيۡ طَيۡرٍۢ
shades.hadith_en: He ate the two wings of a bird

shades.explanation: al-Mujannah (the shield) in the Quran refers to a covering or protection. The Quran says: And prepare against them whatever you are able of power (8:60).
shades.hadith_ar: وَأَعِدُّواْ لَهُم مَّا ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُم مِّن قُوَّةٍۢ
shades.hadith_en: And prepare against them whatever you can of power

meaning.en: To suffice. The root denotes sufficiency, adequacy, or being enough.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡكَافُ وَالۡفَاءُ وَالۡيَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡقِيَامِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: كَفَى: اِكۡتَفَى. الۡكَافِي: اللَّهُ سُبۡحَانَهُ

quran_examples.ar: حَسۡبِيَ اللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ
quran_examples.en: Allah is sufficient for me

quran_examples.ar: أَلَيۡسَ اللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبۡدَهُۥ
quran_examples.en: Is not Allah sufficient for His servant?

hadith.ar: مَن قَالَ حَسۡبِيَ اللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُ
hadith.en: Whoever says 'Allah is sufficient for me...'

hadith.ar: حَسۡبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعۡمَ الۡوَكِيلُ
hadith.en: Allah is sufficient for us and the best Disposer of affairs

shades.explanation: al-Kifayah (the sufficiency) in the Quran refers to what is enough. The Quran says: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no deity except Him (9:129).
shades.hadith_ar: حَسۡبِيَ اللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ
shades.hadith_en: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no deity except Him

shades.explanation: al-Kafi (the Sufficient One) in the Quran refers to Allah. The Quran says: Is not Allah sufficient for His servant? (39:36).
shades.hadith_ar: أَلَيۡسَ اللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبۡدَهُۥ
shades.hadith_en: Is not Allah sufficient for His servant?

shades.explanation: al-Iktifa (the being content) in the Quran refers to being satisfied. The famous hadith states: Whoever says La ilaha illa Allah enters Paradise.
shades.hadith_ar: مَن قَالَ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ دَخَلَ الۡجَنَّةَ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever says La ilaha illa Allah enters Paradise

shades.explanation: al-Ikfa (the covering) in the Quran refers to turning away. The Quran says: And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed that is of the matters [requiring] resolve (42:43).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمِنۡ عَزۡمِ الۡأُمُورِ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever is patient and forgives, that is of the matters of resolve

meaning.en: To shade. The root denotes shade, shadow, or covering.
meaning.ar: الظِّلُّ: مَا لَا تَصِلُ إِلَيۡهِ الشَّمۡسُ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الظَّاءُ وَاللَّامُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى السَّتۡرِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الظِّلُّ: الۡغَيۡمُ أَوۡ مَا يُظِلُّ. ظَلَّ: بَقِيَ

quran_examples.ar: وَظَلَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمُ الۡغَمَامَ
quran_examples.en: And We shaded you with clouds

quran_examples.ar: فِي ظِلَٰلٍۢ عَلَى الۡأَرَآئِكِ
quran_examples.en: In shade on couches

hadith.ar: سَبۡعَةٌ يُظِلُّهُمُ اللَّهُ فِي ظِلِّهِ
hadith.en: Seven [people] Allah will shade in His shade

hadith.ar: الۡعَدۡلُ يُظِلُّ الۡعَبۡدَ
hadith.en: Justice gives shade to the servant

shades.name_ar: الظِّلُّ - مَا لَا تَصِلُ إِلَيۡهِ الشَّمۡسُ
shades.explanation: az-Zill (the shade) in the Quran refers to a shadow or covering. The Quran says: In its cool shade its fruit will be hanging low (36:56).
shades.hadith_ar: فِي ظِلَٰلٍۢ عَلَى الۡأَرَآئِكِ
shades.hadith_en: In shade [of trees] on couches

shades.explanation: az-Zilal (the shades) in the Quran refers to heavenly shades. The Quran says: Enter upon them in peace - that is the Day of Eternity (19:61).
shades.hadith_ar: يَوۡمَ يَأۡتِي بَعۡضُ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّكَ
shades.hadith_en: The Day some signs of your Lord come

shades.explanation: al-Zhillah (the shade) in the Quran refers to a cloud cover. The Quran says: And We shaded you with clouds (2:57).
shades.hadith_ar: وَظَلَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمُ الۡغَمَامَ
shades.hadith_en: And We shaded you with clouds

shades.explanation: az-Zull (the shadow) in the Quran refers to seeking shade. The famous hadith states: Seven will be shaded by Allah on the Day of Judgment.
shades.hadith_ar: سَبۡعَةٌ يُظِلُّهُمُ اللَّهُ فِي ظِلِّهِ
shades.hadith_en: Seven [people] Allah will shade in His shade

meaning.en: To avoid. The root denotes the side, avoiding, or being distant.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡجِيمُ وَالنُّونُ وَالۡبَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡبُعۡدِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: جَنۡبُ الشَّيۡءِ: جَانِبُهُ. جَنِبَ: بَعُدَ

quran_examples.ar: فَاجۡتَنِبُواْ الرِّجۡسَ مِنَ الۡأَوۡثَٰنِ
quran_examples.en: Avoid the defilement of idols

quran_examples.ar: تَتَجَافَىٰ جُنُوبُهُمۡ عَنِ الۡمَضَاجِعِ
quran_examples.en: Their sides leave their beds

hadith.ar: مَا زَالَ جِبۡرِيلُ يُوصِينِي بِالۡجَارِ
hadith.en: Gabriel kept advising about the neighbor

hadith.ar: مَنۡ جَانِبَ اللَّهَ جَانِبَهُ اللَّهُ
hadith.en: Whoever turns away from Allah, Allah turns away from him

shades.explanation: al-Janb (the side) in the Quran refers to the physical side. The Quran says: And Allah turned him [to Him] - he who fears Allah (59:9).
shades.hadith_ar: تَتَجَافَىٰ جُنُوبُهُمۡ عَنِ الۡمَضَاجِعِ
shades.hadith_en: Their sides leave [their] beds

shades.explanation: al-Junub (the outcast) in the Quran refers to driving away. The Quran says: And do not let your hand be chained to your neck nor extend it completely (17:29).
shades.hadith_ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدۡنِي عِلۡمًا
shades.hadith_en: And say: My Lord, increase me in knowledge

shades.explanation: al-Ijtinab (the avoidance) in the Quran refers to shunning evil. The Quran says: So avoid the defilement of idols (22:30).
shades.hadith_ar: فَاجۡتَنِبُواْ الرِّجۡسَ مِنَ الۡأَوۡثَٰنِ
shades.hadith_en: So avoid the defilement of idols

shades.explanation: al-Janib (the neighbor) in the Quran refers to the companion at one's side. The famous hadith states: Gabriel kept advising me about the neighbor until I thought he would make him an heir.
shades.hadith_ar: مَا زَالَ جِبۡرِيلُ يُوصِينِي بِالۡجَارِ حَتَّىٰ ظَنَنتُ أَنَّهُ سَيُوَرِّثُهُ
shades.hadith_en: Gabriel kept advising about the neighbor until I thought he would make him inherit

meaning.en: To be difficult. The root denotes hardship, difficulty, or severity.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡعَيۡنُ وَالسِّينُ وَالۡيَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡعُسۡرِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الۡعُسۡرُ: ضِدُّ الۡيُسۡرِ. عَسِيَ: صَعُبَ

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ مَعَ الۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرًا
quran_examples.en: Indeed with hardship comes ease

quran_examples.ar: فِي يَوۡمِ نَحۡسٍۢ مُّسۡتَمِرٍّۢ
quran_examples.en: On a day of continuous calamity

hadith.ar: مَنۡ یُیَسِّرۡ عَلَىٰ مُعۡسِرٍۢ یَسَّرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِ
hadith.en: Whoever makes it easy on the one in difficulty, Allah will make it easy on him

hadith.ar: إِنَّ مَعَ الۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرًا
hadith.en: Indeed with hardship comes ease

shades.explanation: al-Easa (the difficulty) in the Quran refers to hardship. The Quran says: The setting of the sun was heavy upon them (54:19).
shades.hadith_ar: فِي يَوۡمِ نَحۡسٍۢ مُّسۡتَمِرٍّۢ
shades.hadith_en: On a day of continuous calamity

shades.explanation: al-Easi (the hard) in the Quran refers to rigidity. The famous hadith states: Allah does not love the harsh and strong.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الۡفَاحِشَ الۡمُتَفَحِّشَ
shades.hadith_en: Allah does not love the obscene

shades.explanation: al-Eust (the hardship) in the Quran refers to difficulty. The Quran says: Indeed with hardship comes ease (94:6).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ مَعَ الۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرًا
shades.hadith_en: Indeed with hardship comes ease

shades.explanation: al-Easir (the difficult) in the Quran refers to what is hard. The famous hadith states: Allah will make things easy for the one who seeks ease for the believer.
shades.hadith_ar: مَنۡ یُیَسِّرۡ عَلَىٰ مُعۡسِرٍۢ یَسَّرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever makes it easy on the one in difficulty, Allah will make it easy on him

meaning.en: To enter. The root denotes entering, going in, or insertion.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡوَاوُ وَاللَّامُ وَالۡجِيمُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الدُّخُولِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: وَلَجَ: دَخَلَ. الۡوَلِيجَةُ: بِطَانَةُ الرَّجُلِ

quran_examples.ar: وَرَأَيۡتَ النَّاسَ يَدۡخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ
quran_examples.en: People entering the religion of Allah

quran_examples.ar: يُولِجُ اللَّيۡلَ فِي النَّهَارِ
quran_examples.en: He causes the night to enter the day

hadith.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسۡأَلُكَ مُولَجَ الۡخَيۡرِ وَمَخۡرَجَهُ
hadith.en: O Allah, I ask You for the entry of good and its exit

hadith.ar: لَا يَلِجُ الۡجَنَّةَ مَن كَانَ فِي قَلۡبِهِ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍۢ مِن كِبۡرٍ
hadith.en: None will enter Paradise who has an atom's weight of pride in his heart

shades.explanation: al-Wuluj (the entering) in the Quran refers to entering a place. The Quran says: You see them entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes (110:2).
shades.hadith_ar: وَرَأَيۡتَ النَّاسَ يَدۡخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ أَفۡوَاجًا
shades.hadith_en: You see people entering the religion of Allah in multitudes

shades.explanation: al-Iylaj (the insertion) in the Quran is bringing something into something else. The Quran says: He causes the night to enter the day and the day to enter the night (57:6).
shades.hadith_ar: يُولِجُ اللَّيۡلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيۡلِ
shades.hadith_en: He causes the night to enter the day and the day to enter the night

shades.explanation: al-Walijah (the confidant) in the Quran refers to a trusted friend. The Quran says: And they have taken besides Allah allies (9:16).
shades.hadith_ar: وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ الۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ
shades.hadith_en: And let the believers rely upon Allah

shades.explanation: al-Tawalluj (the evading) in the Quran refers to seeking shelter. The famous hadith states: O Allah, I ask You for righteous entry and righteous exit.
shades.hadith_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسۡأَلُكَ مُولَجَ الۡخَيۡر
shades.hadith_en: O Allah, I ask You for the entry of good

meaning.en: To arrive. The root denotes arriving, connecting, or reaching.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡوَاوُ وَالصَّادُ وَاللَّامُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡاِتِّصَالِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: وَصَلَ: بَلَغَ. الصِّلَةُ: الۡعَطَاءُ وَالۡرَّبۡطُ

quran_examples.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَغۡرِبَ الشَّمۡسِ
quran_examples.en: Until he reached the setting place of the sun

quran_examples.ar: وَالَّذِينَ يَصِلُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ اللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ
quran_examples.en: Those who join what Allah commanded

hadith.ar: مَن كَانَ يُؤۡمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالۡيَوۡمِ الۡأٓخِرِ فَلۡيَصِلۡ رَحِمَهُ
hadith.en: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him maintain the ties of kinship

hadith.ar: إِنَّ الرَّحِمَ شُجۡنَةٌۭ مِنَ الرَّحۡمَٰنِ
hadith.en: Indeed the womb is derived from the Most Merciful

shades.explanation: al-Wusul (the arrival) in the Quran refers to coming to something. The Quran says: Until when they reach the water (18:86).
shades.hadith_ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَغۡرِبَ الشَّمۡسِ
shades.hadith_en: Until when he reached the setting place of the sun

shades.explanation: as-Silah (the connection) in the Quran refers to maintaining ties. The Quran says: And those who join what Allah has commanded to be joined (13:21).
shades.hadith_ar: وَالَّذِينَ يَصِلُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ اللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ
shades.hadith_en: And those who join what Allah has commanded to be joined

shades.explanation: al-Ittisal (the continuity) in the Quran refers to persistent connection. The famous hadith states: The one who severs ties will not enter Paradise.
shades.hadith_ar: لَا يَدۡخُلُ الۡجَنَّةَ قَاطِعُ رَحِمٍۢ
shades.hadith_en: One who severs family ties will not enter Paradise

shades.explanation: al-Tawasil (the interconnection) in the Quran refers to mutual bonds. The famous hadith states: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him maintain the ties of kinship.
shades.hadith_ar: مَن كَانَ يُؤۡمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالۡيَوۡمِ الۡأٓخِرِ فَلۡيَصِلۡ رَحِمَهُ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him maintain the ties of kinship

meaning.en: To inherit. The root denotes inheritance, bequeathing, or succession.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡوَاوُ وَالرَّاءُ وَالۡيَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى البَقَاءِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: وَرِثَ الۡمَيِّتُ خَلَفَهُ. الۡوَارِثُ: اللَّهُ سُبۡحَانَهُ

quran_examples.ar: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيۡمَٰنُ دَاوُۥدَ
quran_examples.en: Solomon inherited from David

quran_examples.ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ نُحۡيِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحۡنُ الۡوَٰرِثُونَ
quran_examples.en: We give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritors

hadith.ar: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمۡ
hadith.en: O mankind, fear your Lord who created you

hadith.ar: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًاۭ
hadith.en: It is not befitting for the Most Merciful to take a son

shades.explanation: al-Irth (the inheritance) in the Quran refers to what is inherited. The Quran says: And We made the Children of Israel inherit the Book (40:53).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَىٰ الۡهُدَىٰ
shades.hadith_en: And We gave Moses the guidance

shades.explanation: al-Irth (the heirship) in the Quran refers to inheritance rights. The Quran says: And Solomon inherited from David (27:16).
shades.hadith_ar: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيۡمَٰنُ دَاوُۥدَ
shades.hadith_en: And Solomon inherited from David

shades.explanation: al-Warith (the Inheritor) in the Quran is one of Allah's names. The Quran says: And indeed it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritors (15:23).
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ نُحۡيِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحۡنُ الۡوَٰرِثُونَ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed We give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritors

shades.explanation: al-Mirath (the legacy) in the Quran refers to what is left behind. The famous hadith states: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the annihilation of my blessings.
shades.hadith_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن زَوَالِ نِعۡمَتِكَ
shades.hadith_en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the removal of Your blessing

meaning.en: To be first. The root denotes firstness, beginning, or precedence.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡهَمۡزَةُ وَالۡوَاوُ وَاللَّامُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡبِدَايَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: أَوَّلُ: قَبۡلَ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ. الۡأَوَّلُ: اللَّهُ سُبۡحَانَهُ

quran_examples.ar: هُوَ الۡأَوَّلُ وَالۡأٓخِرُ
quran_examples.en: He is the First and the Last

quran_examples.ar: وَالسَّٰبِقُونَ السَّٰبِقُونَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ الۡمُقَرَّبُونَ
quran_examples.en: The foremost are the foremost - they are the ones brought near

hadith.ar: مَن سَنَّ فِي الۡإِسۡلَٰمِ سُنَّةً حَسَنَةً
hadith.en: Whoever initiates a good practice in Islam

hadith.ar: إِنَّمَا الۡأَعۡمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ
hadith.en: Deeds are [judged] by intentions

shades.explanation: al-Awwal (the First) in the Quran is one of Allah's names. The Quran says: He is the First and the Last (57:3).
shades.hadith_ar: هُوَ الۡأَوَّلُ وَالۡأٓخِرُ
shades.hadith_en: He is the First and the Last

shades.explanation: al-Ula (the first) in the Quran refers to earlier times. The Quran says: The first [ones] and the later [ones] will be gathered (56:49-50).
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِنَّ الۡأَوَّلِينَ وَالۡأٓخِرِينَ لَمَجۡمُوعُونَ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed the first and the later will be gathered

shades.explanation: al-Awali (the foremost) in the Quran refers to the first in faith. The Quran says: The foremost [in faith] are the foremost - they are the ones brought near (56:10-11).
shades.hadith_ar: وَالسَّٰبِقُونَ السَّٰبِقُونَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ الۡمُقَرَّبُونَ
shades.hadith_en: And the foremost are the foremost - they are the ones brought near

shades.explanation: al-Istila (the beginning) in the Quran refers to starting. The famous hadith states: Whoever starts a good practice in Islam.
shades.hadith_ar: مَن سَنَّ فِي الۡإِسۡلَٰمِ سُنَّةً حَسَنَةً
shades.hadith_en: Whoever initiates a good practice in Islam

meaning.en: To be ready. The root denotes time, readiness, or nearing.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡهَمۡزَةُ وَالنُّونُ وَالۡيَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الحِينِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: آنَ: حَانَ وَقۡتُهُ. الۡآنَ: ظَرۡفُ الزَّمَانِ

quran_examples.ar: قَدۡ جَآءَكُمُ الۡحَقُّ
quran_examples.en: Now has come to you the truth

quran_examples.ar: مِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرۡذَلِ الۡعُمُرِ
quran_examples.en: And among you is he who is returned to the worst of life

hadith.ar: لَبَّيۡكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيۡكَ
hadith.en: Here I am, O Allah, here I am

hadith.ar: آنَ أَوَانُهَا
hadith.en: Its time has come

shades.explanation: al-An (the now) in the Quran refers to the present moment. The Quran says: Now has come to you the truth (10:76).
shades.hadith_ar: قَدۡ جَآءَكُمُ الۡحَقُّ
shades.hadith_en: Now has come to you the truth

shades.explanation: al-Awan (the time) in the Quran refers to a specific time. The Quran says: And then He will return you to [the grave] once again (16:70).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرۡذَلِ الۡعُمُرِ
shades.hadith_en: And among you is he who is returned to the worst of life

shades.explanation: al-Iyan (the coming) in the Quran refers to an appointed time. The famous hadith states: The servant continues to be tested until he walks on the earth with no sin.
shades.hadith_ar: مَا يَزَالُ الۡبَلَاءُ بِالۡمُؤۡمِنِ
shades.hadith_en: The believer continues to be tested

shades.explanation: al-Inah (the readiness) in the Quran refers to being prepared. The famous hadith states: I am ready. Here I am, O Allah, here I am.
shades.hadith_ar: لَبَّيۡكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيۡكَ
shades.hadith_en: Here I am, O Allah, here I am

meaning.en: To shelter. The root denotes taking refuge, shelter, or abode.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡهَمۡزَةُ وَالۡوَاوُ وَالۡيَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الضَّمِّ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: أَوَى: ضَمَّ. الۡمَأۡوَىٰ: المَنۡزِلُ

quran_examples.ar: فَالۡجَنَّةُ هِيَ الۡمَأۡوَىٰ
quran_examples.en: Paradise is the abode

quran_examples.ar: فَإِنَّ الۡجَحِيمَ هِيَ الۡمَأۡوَىٰ
quran_examples.en: Indeed Hellfire is the abode

hadith.ar: مَنۡ أَوَىٰ لَاجِئًا فَهُوَ آمِنٌ
