shades.hadith_ar: تُنكَحُ الۡمَرۡأَةُ لِأَرۡبَعٍۢ
shades.hadith_en: A woman is married for four [qualities]

shades.explanation: an-Nabt (the growth) in the Quran refers to germination. The famous hadith states: Allah will cause righteousness to grow like a plant.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُنۡبِتُ الحَقَّ
shades.hadith_en: Allah causes truth to grow

meaning.en: To put. The root denotes putting, placing, or laying down.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡوَاوُ وَالضَّادُ وَالۡعَيۡنُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الحَطِّ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: وَضَعَ: حَطَّ. الوَضۡعُ: ضِدُّ الرَّفۡعِ

quran_examples.ar: أَلَمۡ نَجۡعَلِ الۡأَرۡضَ مِهَٰدًا
quran_examples.en: Did We not make the earth a resting place?

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأۡمُرُكُمۡ أَن تُؤَدُّواْ الۡأَمَٰنَٰتِ
quran_examples.en: Allah commands you to render trusts

hadith.ar: وَضۡعُ الۡأَثۡقَالِ رِفۡعَةٌ
hadith.en: Laying down burdens is elevation

hadith.ar: وَدَّعَ النَّبِيُّ أَصۡحَابَهُ
hadith.en: The Prophet bid farewell to his companions

shades.explanation: al-Wad (the putting) in the Quran refers to placing or laying down. The Quran says: And We have made for you the earth a resting place (78:6-7).
shades.hadith_ar: أَلَمۡ نَجۡعَلِ الۡأَرۡضَ مِهَٰدًا
shades.hadith_en: Did We not make the earth a resting place?

shades.explanation: al-WadiEah (the deposit) in the Quran refers to a trust. The Quran says: Indeed Allah commands you to render trusts to their owners (4:58).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأۡمُرُكُمۡ أَن تُؤَدُّواْ الۡأَمَٰنَٰتِ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهَا
shades.hadith_en: Allah commands you to render trusts to their owners

shades.explanation: al-WadiE (the depositor) in the Quran refers to one who places. The famous hadith states: Laying down burdens builds character.
shades.hadith_ar: وَضۡعُ الۡأَثۡقَالِ رِفۡعَةٌ
shades.hadith_en: Laying down burdens is elevation

shades.explanation: at-TawdiE (the farewell) in the Quran refers to bidding farewell. The famous hadith states: The Prophet bid farewell to his companions before a journey.
shades.hadith_ar: وَدَّعَ النَّبِيُّ أَصۡحَابَهُ
shades.hadith_en: The Prophet bid farewell to his companions

meaning.en: To be humiliated. The root denotes disgrace, shame, or humiliation.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡخَاءُ وَالزَّايُ وَالۡيَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الذُّلِّ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: خَزِيَ: ذَلَّ. أَخۡزَاهُ: فَضَحَهُ

quran_examples.ar: وَلَا تُخۡزِنَا يَوۡمَ الۡقِيَٰمَةِ
quran_examples.en: Do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection

quran_examples.ar: فَبَآءُو بِغَضَبٍ عَلَىٰ غَضَبٍۢ
quran_examples.en: They earned anger upon anger

hadith.ar: وَاللَّهِ لَا يُخۡزِيكَ اللَّهُ أَبَدًا
hadith.en: By Allah, Allah will never disgrace you

hadith.ar: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تُخۡزِنِي يَوۡمَ الۡقِيَامَةِ
hadith.en: O Allah, do not disgrace me on the Day of Judgment

shades.explanation: al-Khizyu (the humiliation) in the Quran refers to disgrace. The Quran says: And who are humiliated among those whom Allah has given the Book (2:90).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ
shades.hadith_en: And for them is a humiliating punishment

shades.explanation: al-Ikhza (the disgracing) in the Quran refers to bringing shame. The Quran says: Do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection (3:194).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تُخۡزِنَا يَوۡمَ الۡقِيَٰمَةِ
shades.hadith_en: Do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection

shades.explanation: al-Khizyan (the disgraceful) in the Quran refers to one who is put to shame. The famous hadith states: O Allah, do not disgrace me on the Day they are resurrected.
shades.hadith_ar: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تُخۡزِنِي يَوۡمَ الۡمَعَادِ
shades.hadith_en: O Allah, do not disgrace me on the Day of Return

shades.explanation: al-Makhza (the place of shame) in the Quran refers to a state of disgrace. The famous hadith states: Allah will not disgrace you ever.
shades.hadith_ar: وَاللَّهِ لَا يُخۡزِيكَ اللَّهُ أَبَدًا
shades.hadith_en: By Allah, Allah will never disgrace you

meaning.en: To hold. The root denotes holding, grasping, or restraining.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡمِيمُ وَالسِّينُ وَالۡكَافُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الأَخۡذِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: مَسَكَ: أَمۡسَكَ. الۡمِسَاكُ: مَا يُتَمَسَّكُ بِهِ

quran_examples.ar: وَٱعۡتَصِمُواْ بِحَبۡلِ اللَّهِ
quran_examples.en: Hold fast to the rope of Allah

quran_examples.ar: وَمَن يَعۡتَصِم بِاللَّهِ فَقَدۡ هُدِيَ
quran_examples.en: Whoever holds fast to Allah has been guided

hadith.ar: لَيۡسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ
hadith.en: The strong person is not the one who overcomes people

hadith.ar: عَلَيۡكَ بِكَفِّ يَدِكَ عَنِ النَّاسِ
hadith.en: Hold back your hand from harming people

shades.explanation: al-Mask (the holding) in the Quran refers to grasping firmly. The Quran says: And hold fast to the rope of Allah (3:103).
shades.hadith_ar: وَٱعۡتَصِمُواْ بِحَبۡلِ اللَّهِ جَمِيعًا
shades.hadith_en: And hold fast to the rope of Allah together

shades.explanation: al-Masik (the holder) in the Quran refers to one who retains. The Quran says: And whoever holds fast to Allah has been guided (3:101).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَن يَعۡتَصِم بِاللَّهِ فَقَدۡ هُدِيَ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever holds fast to Allah has been guided

shades.explanation: al-Imsak (the restraint) in the Quran refers to withholding. The famous hadith states: The strong person is not the one who overcomes people but the one who controls himself.
shades.hadith_ar: لَيۡسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمۡلِكُ نَفۡسَهُ
shades.hadith_en: The strong person is not the one who overcomes people but the one who controls himself

shades.explanation: al-Masik (the self-controlled) in the Quran refers to self-restraint. The famous hadith states: Your duty is to hold back your hand from harming others.
shades.hadith_ar: عَلَيۡكَ بِكَفِّ يَدِكَ عَنِ النَّاسِ
shades.hadith_en: Hold back your hand from harming people

meaning.en: To bestow. The root denotes bestowing favors, grace, or being generous.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡمِيمُ وَالنُّونُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى القَطۡعِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: مَنَّ: أَعۡطَىٰ. مَنَّ عَلَيۡهِ: أَنۡعَمَ

quran_examples.ar: لَقَدۡ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَى الۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
quran_examples.en: Allah conferred favor upon the believers

quran_examples.ar: وَلَا تَمۡنُن تَسۡتَكۡثِرُ
quran_examples.en: Do not bestow favor expecting more

hadith.ar: اللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنَّانُ يَا بَدِيعَ السَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالۡأَرۡضِ
hadith.en: O Allah, O Bestower, Originator of the heavens and earth

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الۡقُوَّةِ الۡمَتِينُ
hadith.en: Allah is the Provider, the Possessor of Power, the Mighty

shades.explanation: al-Mann (the favor) in the Quran refers to a gracious gift. The Quran says: Indeed We have revealed to you as We revealed to Noah (4:163).
shades.hadith_ar: لَقَدۡ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَى الۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
shades.hadith_en: Allah has conferred favor upon the believers

shades.explanation: al-Mann (the bestowal) in the Quran refers to divine grace. The Quran says: But Allah has bestowed upon you His favor (4:113).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَوۡلَا فَضۡلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيۡكَ
shades.hadith_en: And were it not for the favor of Allah upon you

shades.explanation: al-Minnah (the reminder of favor) in the Quran refers to mentioning a favor as a reproach. The Quran says: Do not remind me of your favor (74:6).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تَمۡنُن تَسۡتَكۡثِرُ
shades.hadith_en: And do not bestow favor expecting more

shades.explanation: al-Mannan (the Great Bestower) in the Quran refers to Allah as the generous giver. The famous hadith states: O Allah, the Bestower of favors and blessings.
shades.hadith_ar: اللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنَّانُ
shades.hadith_en: O Allah, O Great Bestower

meaning.en: Moon. The root denotes the moon, month, or lunar cycle.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡقَافُ وَالۡمِيمُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى البَيَاضِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: قَمَرٌ: نَيِّرُ اللَّيۡلِ

quran_examples.ar: وَالۡقَمَرَ قَدَّرۡنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ
quran_examples.en: The moon - We have determined phases

quran_examples.ar: وَإِذۡ وَٰعَدۡنَا مُوسَىٰٓ أَرۡبَعِينَ لَيۡلَةً
quran_examples.en: When We appointed for Moses forty nights

hadith.ar: إِنَّ الشَّمۡسَ وَالۡقَمَرَ آيَتَانِ مِنۡ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ
hadith.en: The sun and moon are two signs of Allah

hadith.ar: لَا تَصُومُواْ حَتَّىٰ تَرَوُاْ الۡهِلَالَ
hadith.en: Do not fast until you see the crescent

shades.explanation: al-Qamar (the moon) in the Quran refers to the celestial body. The Quran says: And the moon - We have determined for it phases (36:39).
shades.hadith_ar: وَالۡقَمَرَ قَدَّرۡنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ
shades.hadith_en: And the moon - We have determined for it phases

shades.explanation: al-Qamar (the month) in the Quran refers to a lunar month. The Quran says: And [mention] when We appointed for Moses forty nights (2:51).
shades.hadith_ar: شَهۡرُ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِيٓ أُنزِلَ فِيهِ الۡقُرۡءَانُ
shades.hadith_en: The month of Ramadan in which the Quran was revealed

shades.explanation: al-Qamar (the moon) in the Quran is paired with the sun as Allah's signs. The famous hadith states: The sun and the moon are two signs of Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ الشَّمۡسَ وَالۡقَمَرَ آيَتَانِ مِنۡ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ
shades.hadith_en: The sun and the moon are two signs of Allah

shades.explanation: al-Iqmar (the moonlight) in the Quran refers to moon illumination. The famous hadith states: We should not fast on the day of doubt.
shades.hadith_ar: لَا تَصُومُواْ حَتَّىٰ تَرَوُاْ الۡهِلَالَ
shades.hadith_en: Do not fast until you see the crescent

meaning.en: To journey. The root denotes traveling, night journey, or moving.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: السِّينُ وَالۡيَاءُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى المَشۡيِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: سَارَ: مَشَىٰ. أَسۡرَىٰ: سَارَ لَيۡلًا

quran_examples.ar: فَأَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيۡلًا
quran_examples.en: Travel by night with My servants
quran_examples.context: The exodus of the Children of Israel

quran_examples.ar: سُبۡحَانَ الَّذِيٓ أَسۡرَىٰ بِعَبۡدِهِۦ لَيۡلًا
quran_examples.en: Exalted is He who took His servant by night

hadith.ar: السَّفَرُ قِطۡعَةٌۭ مِنَ الۡعَذَابِ
hadith.en: Travel is a portion of punishment

hadith.ar: مَنۡ سَارَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
hadith.en: Whoever travels in the cause of Allah

shades.explanation: as-Sayr (the evening journey) in the Quran refers to traveling. The Quran says: And travel by night with my servants (44:23).
shades.hadith_ar: فَأَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيۡلًا
shades.hadith_en: Travel by night with My servants

shades.explanation: as-Sari (the night traveler) in the Quran refers to one who journeys at night. The Quran says: By the night when it covers (92:1-2).
shades.hadith_ar: وَالَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَغۡشَىٰ
shades.hadith_en: By the night when it covers

shades.explanation: al-Isra (the night journey) in the Quran refers to the Prophet's miraculous journey. The Quran says: Exalted is He who took His servant by night (17:1).
shades.hadith_ar: سُبۡحَانَ الَّذِيٓ أَسۡرَىٰ بِعَبۡدِهِۦ لَيۡلًا
shades.hadith_en: Exalted is He who took His servant by night

shades.explanation: as-Sariyy (the fast traveler) in the Quran refers to swift movement. The famous hadith states: Journey is a portion of punishment.
shades.hadith_ar: السَّفَرُ قِطۡعَةٌۭ مِنَ الۡعَذَابِ
shades.hadith_en: Travel is a portion of punishment

meaning.en: To repent. The root denotes repentance, returning, or turning back.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: التَّاءُ وَالۡوَاوُ وَالۡبَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الرُّجُوعِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: تَابَ: رَجَعَ عَنِ الَّذۡنۡبِ

quran_examples.ar: تُوبُوٓاْ إِلَى اللَّهِ تَوۡبَةً نَّصُوحًا
quran_examples.en: Repent to Allah with sincere repentance

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ التَّوَّابِينَ
quran_examples.en: Allah loves those who repent

hadith.ar: كُلُّ بَنِي آدَمَ خَطَّاءٌۭ وَخَيۡرُ الۡخَطَّائِينَ التَّوَّابُونَ
hadith.en: Every son of Adam errs and the best of the errant are the repentant

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَبۡسُطُ يَدَهُۥ بِاللَّيۡلِ
hadith.en: Allah extends His hand at night to accept the repentance of the sinner of the day

shades.explanation: at-Tawbah (the repentance) in the Quran refers to turning back to Allah. The Quran says: Repent to Allah with sincere repentance (66:8).
shades.hadith_ar: تُوبُوٓاْ إِلَى اللَّهِ تَوۡبَةً نَّصُوحًا
shades.hadith_en: Repent to Allah with sincere repentance

shades.explanation: at-Taib (the repentant) in the Quran refers to one who returns to Allah. The Quran says: Indeed Allah loves those who repent (2:222).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ التَّوَّابِينَ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed Allah loves those who repent

shades.explanation: at-Tawwab (the Acceptor of Repentance) in the Quran is one of Allah's names. The Quran says: Indeed He is the Acceptor of Repentance, the Merciful (2:37).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed He is the Acceptor of Repentance, the Merciful

shades.explanation: al-Matab (the place of return) in the Quran refers to a good outcome. The famous hadith states: Every son of Adam errs, and the best of those who err are the repentant.
shades.hadith_ar: كُلُّ بَنِي آدَمَ خَطَّاءٌۭ وَخَيۡرُ الۡخَطَّائِينَ التَّوَّابُونَ
shades.hadith_en: Every son of Adam errs, and the best of those who err are the repentant

meaning.en: To be weak. The root denotes weakness, incapacity, or being unable.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡعَيۡنُ وَالۡجِيمُ وَالزَّايُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الضَّعۡفِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: عَجَزَ: ضَعُفَ. الۡإِعۡجَازُ: الفَوۡقِيَّةُ

quran_examples.ar: فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا
quran_examples.en: They will not be able to repel it

quran_examples.ar: فَرِحَ الۡمُخَلَّفُونَ بِمَقۡعَدِهِمۡ
quran_examples.en: Those left behind rejoiced in their sitting

hadith.ar: الۡمُؤۡمِنُ الۡقَوِيُّ خَيۡرٌۭ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ
hadith.en: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer

hadith.ar: الۡقُرۡآنُ مُعۡجِزٌ لَا یُعَارَضُ
hadith.en: The Quran is a miracle that cannot be rivaled

shades.explanation: al-Eajz (the weakness) in the Quran refers to inability. The Quran says: And they will not be able to repel it from them (21:40).
shades.hadith_ar: فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا
shades.hadith_en: So they will not be able to repel it

shades.explanation: al-Eajiz (the incapable) in the Quran refers to one lacking power. The Quran says: And those who are left behind rejoiced in their sitting [at home] (9:81).
shades.hadith_ar: فَرِحَ الۡمُخَلَّفُونَ بِمَقۡعَدِهِمۡ
shades.hadith_en: Those who were left behind rejoiced in their sitting

shades.explanation: al-Iejaz (the inimitability) in the Quran refers to the miraculous nature of the Quran. The famous hadith states: The Quran is a miracle that cannot be matched.
shades.hadith_ar: الۡقُرۡآنُ مُعۡجِزٌ لَا یُعَارَضُ
shades.hadith_en: The Quran is a miracle that cannot be matched

shades.explanation: al-Mu'jiz (the miraculous) in the Quran refers to that which cannot be imitated. The famous hadith states: Every prophet was given a miracle.
shades.hadith_ar: كُلُّ نَبِيٍّ أُوتِيَ آيَةً
shades.hadith_en: Every prophet was given a sign

meaning.en: To change. The root denotes change, power, or interposition.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡحَاءُ وَالۡوَاوُ وَاللَّامُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الحَرَكَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: حَالَ: تَغَيَّرَ. الحَوۡلُ: القُوَّةُ

quran_examples.ar: يَحُولُ بَيۡنَ الۡمَرۡءِ وَقَلۡبِهِۦ
quran_examples.en: He intervenes between a man and his heart

quran_examples.ar: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكۡرًا وَمَكَرۡنَا مَكۡرًا
quran_examples.en: They plotted and We plotted

hadith.ar: لَا حَوۡلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
hadith.en: There is no power nor strength except with Allah

hadith.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ نَصُولُ وَبِكَ نَحُولُ
hadith.en: O Allah, with You we advance and with You we change

shades.explanation: al-Hawl (the change) in the Quran refers to transformation. The Quran says: And know that Allah intervenes between a man and his heart (8:24).
shades.hadith_ar: وَاعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَحُولُ بَيۡنَ الۡمَرۡءِ وَقَلۡبِهِۦ
shades.hadith_en: Know that Allah intervenes between a man and his heart

shades.explanation: al-Hawl (the power) in the Quran refers to might. The famous hadith states: There is no power and no strength except with Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: لَا حَوۡلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
shades.hadith_en: There is no power nor strength except with Allah

shades.explanation: al-Hiyal (the stratagem) in the Quran refers to scheming. The Quran says: And they planned a plan, and We planned a plan while they did not perceive (27:50).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكۡرًا وَمَكَرۡنَا مَكۡرًا
shades.hadith_en: They plotted a plot and We plotted a plot

shades.explanation: at-Tahawul (the transformation) in the Quran refers to changing state. The famous hadith states: The most beloved of places to Allah are the mosques.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ أَحَبَّ البِلَادِ إِلَى اللَّهِ مَسَاجِدُهَا
shades.hadith_en: Indeed the most beloved lands to Allah are its mosques

meaning.en: To bear. The root denotes bearing a burden, sin, or helping.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡوَاوُ وَالزَّايُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الثِّقَلِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: وَزَرَ: حَمَلَ. الوَزِيرُ: المُعِينُ

quran_examples.ar: وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِّزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰ
quran_examples.en: No bearer bears the burden of another

quran_examples.ar: وَٱجۡعَل لِّي وَزِيرًا مِّنۡ أَهۡلِي
quran_examples.en: Appoint for me a minister from my family

hadith.ar: مَن قَتَلَ مُؤۡمِنًا مُّتَعَمِّدًا فَجَزَاؤُهُۥ جَهَنَّمُ
hadith.en: Whoever kills a believer intentionally, his recompense is Hellfire

hadith.ar: كُلُّ نَفۡسٍۢ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ رَهِينَةٌ
hadith.en: Every soul is held in pledge for what it earns

shades.explanation: al-Wizr (the burden) in the Quran refers to sin or heavy load. The Quran says: And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another (35:18).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِّزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰ
shades.hadith_en: And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another

shades.explanation: al-Wazir (the minister) in the Quran refers to a helper. The Quran says: And appoint for me a minister from my family (20:29-30).
shades.hadith_ar: وَٱجۡعَل لِّي وَزِيرًا مِّنۡ أَهۡلِي
shades.hadith_en: And appoint for me a minister from my family

shades.explanation: al-Wazar (the refuge) in the Quran refers to a place of safety. The Quran says: No refuge (75:11).
shades.hadith_ar: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
shades.hadith_en: No, there is no refuge

shades.explanation: al-Ittizar (the taking of burden) in the Quran refers to assuming responsibility. The famous hadith states: Whoever kills a believer unjustly carries his own burden.
shades.hadith_ar: مَن قَتَلَ مُؤۡمِنًا مُّتَعَمِّدًا فَجَزَاؤُهُۥ جَهَنَّمُ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever intentionally kills a believer, his recompense is Hellfire

meaning.en: To be present. The root denotes presence, attendance, or witnessing.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡحَاءُ وَالضَّادُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الشُّهُودِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: حَضَرَ: شَهِدَ. الحَاضِرُ: الشَّاهِدُ

quran_examples.ar: وَإِذَا حَضَرَ الۡقِسۡمَةَ
quran_examples.en: When the relatives are present at the division

quran_examples.ar: إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمُ الۡمَوۡتُ
quran_examples.en: When death approaches one of you

hadith.ar: مَنۡ حَضَرَ الۡجُمُعَةَ فَلۡيَغۡتَسِلۡ
hadith.en: Whoever attends Friday prayer let him bathe

hadith.ar: خَيۡرُ يَوۡمٍۢ طَلَعَتۡ عَلَيۡهِ الشَّمۡسُ يَوۡمُ الۡجُمُعَةِ
hadith.en: The best day on which the sun rises is Friday

shades.explanation: al-Hudur (the presence) in the Quran refers to being present. The Quran says: And when the relatives and orphans are present at the division, provide for them (4:8).
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِذَا حَضَرَ الۡقِسۡمَةَ أُو۟لُواْ الۡقُرۡبَىٰ
shades.hadith_en: And when the relatives are present at the division

shades.explanation: al-Hadir (the present one) in the Quran refers to one who attends. The Quran says: O you who believe, when death approaches one of you, let witnesses be present (5:106).
shades.hadith_ar: إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمُ الۡمَوۡتُ
shades.hadith_en: When death approaches one of you

shades.explanation: al-Hadrah (the attendance) in the Quran refers to being in attendance. The famous hadith states: The best of days on which the sun rises is Friday.
shades.hadith_ar: خَيۡرُ يَوۡمٍۢ طَلَعَتۡ عَلَيۡهِ الشَّمۡسُ يَوۡمُ الۡجُمُعَةِ
shades.hadith_en: The best day on which the sun rises is Friday

shades.explanation: al-IhDar (the summoning) in the Quran refers to calling forth. The famous hadith states: The people will be gathered on the Day of Judgment barefoot and naked.
shades.hadith_ar: يُحۡشَرُ النَّاسُ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيَامَةِ حُفَاةً عُرَاةً
shades.hadith_en: The people will be gathered on the Day of Judgment barefoot and naked

meaning.en: To limit. The root denotes limits, boundaries, sharpness, or prevention.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡحَاءُ وَالدَّالُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى المَنۡعِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: حَدُّ الشَّيۡءِ: مُنتَهَاهُ

quran_examples.ar: تِلۡكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ فَلَا تَقۡرَبُوهَا
quran_examples.en: These are Allah's limits, do not approach them

quran_examples.ar: وَأَنزَلۡنَا الۡحَدِيدَ فِيهِ بَأۡسٌ شَدِيدٌ
quran_examples.en: We sent down iron with great might

hadith.ar: الۡحَدِيدُ أَشَدُّ الۡمَعَادِنِ
hadith.en: Iron is the strongest of metals

hadith.ar: مَنۡ تَعَدَّى حُدُودَ اللَّهِ فَقَدۡ ظَلَمَ
hadith.en: Whoever transgresses Allah's boundaries has wronged

shades.explanation: al-Hadd (the limit) in the Quran refers to boundaries set by Allah. The Quran says: These are the limits of Allah, so do not approach them (2:187).
shades.hadith_ar: تِلۡكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ فَلَا تَقۡرَبُوهَا
shades.hadith_en: These are the limits of Allah, so do not approach them

shades.explanation: al-Hadd (the prevention) in the Quran refers to restraining. The Quran says: And this is a Book sent down from Allah - so do not be in doubt (6:114).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَن يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ اللَّهِ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever transgresses the limits of Allah

shades.explanation: al-Hadid (the iron) in the Quran refers to metal. The Quran says: And We sent down iron, wherein is great might (57:25).
shades.hadith_ar: وَأَنزَلۡنَا الۡحَدِيدَ فِيهِ بَأۡسٌ شَدِيدٌ
shades.hadith_en: And We sent down iron, wherein is great might

shades.explanation: al-Hidada (the sharpness) in the Quran refers to intensity. The famous hadith states: The sharpest of people in faith are those who love for Allah and hate for Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: أَحَدُّهُمۡ إِيمَانًا أَحَبُّهُمۡ فِي اللَّهِ وَأَبۡغَضُهُمۡ فِي اللَّهِ
shades.hadith_en: The sharpest in faith are those who love and hate for Allah

meaning.en: To burn. The root denotes burning, roasting, or entering fire.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الصَّادُ وَاللَّامُ وَالۡيَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الإِحۡرَاقِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: صَلَى النَّارَ: دَخَلَهَا. صَلَّاهُ: أَحۡرَقَهُ

quran_examples.ar: وَهُوَ يَصۡلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
quran_examples.en: And he will burn in a blazing fire

quran_examples.ar: وَتَصۡلِيَةُ جَحِيمٍ
quran_examples.en: And roasting in Hellfire

hadith.ar: اتَّقُواْ النَّارَ وَلَوۡ بِشِقِّ تَمۡرَةٍ
hadith.en: Fear the Fire even with half a date

hadith.ar: النَّارُ تُوقَدُ عَلَى الۡمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
hadith.en: The Fire is kindled for the arrogant

shades.explanation: as-Sila (the burning) in the Quran refers to hellfire. The Quran says: They will burn in Hellfire - what an evil resting place! (2:126).
shades.hadith_ar: وَهُوَ يَصۡلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
shades.hadith_en: And he will burn in a blazing fire

shades.explanation: al-Musalli (the one who roasts) in the Quran refers to one exposed to fire. The Quran says: [As] they will be roasted therein (56:94).
shades.hadith_ar: وَتَصۡلِيَةُ جَحِيمٍ
shades.hadith_en: And roasting in Hellfire

shades.name_en: as-Sali - The One Exposed to Fire
shades.explanation: as-Sali (the one exposed to fire) in the Quran refers to punishment. The famous hadith states: The Fire will be kindled for the arrogant.
shades.hadith_ar: النَّارُ تُوقَدُ عَلَى الۡمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
shades.hadith_en: The Fire is kindled for the arrogant

shades.explanation: as-Salyan (the burning pain) in the Quran refers to severe burning. The famous hadith states: Fear the Fire whose fuel is people and stones.
shades.hadith_ar: اتَّقُواْ النَّارَ الَّتِي وَقُودُهَا النَّاسُ وَالۡحِجَارَةُ
shades.hadith_en: Fear the Fire whose fuel is people and stones

meaning.en: To be hidden. The root denotes inner, hidden, or inward.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡبَاءُ وَالطَّاءُ وَالنُّونُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الخَفَاءِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: بَطَنَ: خَفِيَ. بَاطِنُ الشَّيۡءِ: دَاخِلُهُ

quran_examples.ar: هُوَ الۡأَوَّلُ وَالۡأٓخِرُ وَالظَّٰهِرُ وَالۡبَاطِنُ
quran_examples.en: He is the First, Last, Manifest, and Hidden

quran_examples.ar: يَعۡلَمُ السِّرَّ وَأَخۡفَىٰ
quran_examples.en: He knows the secret and what is even more hidden

hadith.ar: إِنَّمَا الۡأَعۡمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ
hadith.en: Actions are judged by intentions

hadith.ar: الۡبَاطِنُ الَّذِي لَا يُرَىٰ
hadith.en: The Hidden One who cannot be seen

shades.explanation: al-Batin (the inner) in the Quran refers to the hidden aspect. The Quran says: He knows the secret and what is even more hidden (20:7).
shades.hadith_ar: يَعۡلَمُ السِّرَّ وَأَخۡفَىٰ
shades.hadith_en: He knows the secret and what is even more hidden

shades.explanation: al-Batin (the Hidden One) in the Quran is one of Allah's names. The Quran says: He is the First and the Last and the Manifest and the Hidden (57:3).
shades.hadith_ar: هُوَ الۡأَوَّلُ وَالۡأٓخِرُ وَالظَّٰهِرُ وَالۡبَاطِنُ
shades.hadith_en: He is the First, the Last, the Manifest, and the Hidden

shades.explanation: al-Batn (the belly) in the Quran refers to the abdomen. The famous hadith states: The stomach is the basin of the body.
shades.hadith_ar: الۡمِعۡدَةُ حَوۡضُ الجَسَدِ
shades.hadith_en: The stomach is the basin of the body

shades.explanation: al-Batinah (the inward) in the Quran refers to the inner self. The famous hadith states: Actions are judged by intentions.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّمَا الۡأَعۡمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ
shades.hadith_en: Actions are judged by intentions

meaning.en: To spread. The root denotes spreading, extending, or expanding.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡبَاءُ وَالسِّينُ وَالطَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى المَدِّ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: بَسَطَ: مَدَّ. البَاسِطُ: اللَّهُ سُبۡحَانَهُ

quran_examples.ar: اللَّهُ يَبۡسُطُ الرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ
quran_examples.en: Allah extends provision for whom He wills

quran_examples.ar: وَإِن مِّن شَيۡءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ
quran_examples.en: With Us are the treasures of all things

hadith.ar: جُعِلَتۡ لِيَ الۡأَرۡضُ مَسۡجِدًا
hadith.en: The earth has been made a mosque for me

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ أَن تُقۡبَلَ رُخَصُهُۥ
hadith.en: Allah loves that His concessions be accepted

shades.explanation: al-Bast (the spreading) in the Quran refers to extending. The Quran says: And He sends down the sky in portions (42:27).
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِن مِّن شَيۡءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ
shades.hadith_en: With Us are the treasures of all things

shades.explanation: al-Basit (the Extender) in the Quran refers to Allah who expands provision. The Quran says: Allah extends provision for whom He wills and restricts it (13:26).
shades.hadith_ar: اللَّهُ يَبۡسُطُ الرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُ
shades.hadith_en: Allah extends provision for whom He wills and restricts

shades.explanation: al-Basitah (the earth) in the Quran refers to the spread-out land. The famous hadith states: The earth has been made a mosque for me.
shades.hadith_ar: جُعِلَتۡ لِيَ الۡأَرۡضُ مَسۡجِدًا
shades.hadith_en: The earth has been made a mosque for me

shades.explanation: al-Bastah (the vastness) in the Quran refers to abundance. The famous hadith states: Allah's mercy encompasses all things.
shades.hadith_ar: رَحۡمَتِي وَسِعَتۡ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍۢ
shades.hadith_en: My mercy encompasses all things

meaning.en: To be in an orbit. The root denotes a ship, celestial orbit, or sphere.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡفَاءُ وَاللَّامُ وَالۡكَافُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡاِسۡتِدَارَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: فَلَكُ السَّمَاءِ: مَجۡرَى النُّجُومِ

quran_examples.ar: أَنَّا حَمَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ فِي الۡفُلۡكِ
quran_examples.en: We carried their offspring in the ship

quran_examples.ar: كُلٌّۭ فِي فَلَكٍۢ يَسۡبَحُونَ
quran_examples.en: Each in an orbit are swimming

hadith.ar: الشَّمۡسُ وَالۡقَمَرُ يَجۡرِيَانِ
hadith.en: The sun and the moon run their courses

hadith.ar: الۡفَلَكُ مَجۡرَى النُّجُومِ
hadith.en: The orbit is the course of the stars

shades.explanation: al-Fulk (the ship) in the Quran refers to a vessel. The Quran says: And We carried them on the ship (36:41).
shades.hadith_ar: وَآيَةٌۭ لَّهُمۡ أَنَّا حَمَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ فِي الۡفُلۡكِ الۡمَشۡحُونِ
shades.hadith_en: A sign for them is that We carried their offspring in the laden ship

shades.explanation: al-Falak (the orbit) in the Quran refers to the celestial sphere. The Quran says: And each is floating in an orbit (36:40).
shades.hadith_ar: كُلٌّۭ فِي فَلَكٍۢ يَسۡبَحُونَ
shades.hadith_en: Each in an orbit are swimming

shades.explanation: al-Falk (the splitting) in the Quran refers to cleaving. The famous hadith states: The sky will split open like a bud.
shades.hadith_ar: السَّمَاءُ تَنفَطِرُ
shades.hadith_en: The sky will split apart

shades.explanation: al-Iflak (the orbit's path) in the Quran refers to celestial motion. The famous hadith states: The sun and the moon follow their appointed courses.
shades.hadith_ar: الشَّمۡسُ وَالۡقَمَرُ يَجۡرِيَانِ
shades.hadith_en: The sun and the moon run their courses

meaning.en: To tongue. The root denotes the tongue, language, or speech.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: اللَّامُ وَالسِّينُ وَالنُّونُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى النُّطۡقِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: لِسَانُ الرَّجُلِ: آلَةُ نُطۡقِهِ

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ
quran_examples.en: We have made it easy in your tongue

quran_examples.ar: هَٰذَا لِسَانٌ عَرَبِيٌّ مُّبِينٌ
quran_examples.en: This is a clear Arabic tongue

hadith.ar: مَن كَانَ يُؤۡمِنُ بِاللَّهِ فَلۡيَقُلۡ خَيۡرًا أَوۡ لِيَصۡمُتۡ
hadith.en: Whoever believes in Allah let him speak good or remain silent

hadith.ar: إِنَّ الۡعَبۡدَ لَيَتَكَلَّمُ بِالۡكَلِمَةِ
hadith.en: Indeed a servant speaks a word that causes him to slip into the Fire

shades.explanation: al-Lisan (the tongue) in the Quran refers to the organ of speech. The Quran says: And We have made the Quran easy in your tongue (19:97).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ الۡمُتَّقِينَ
shades.hadith_en: We have made it easy in your tongue to give good news to the righteous

shades.explanation: al-Lisan (the language) in the Quran refers to a means of communication. The Quran says: And the tongues of people to which they incline (16:103).
shades.hadith_ar: وَهَٰذَا لِسَانٌ عَرَبِيٌّ مُّبِينٌ
shades.hadith_en: And this is a clear Arabic tongue

shades.explanation: al-Lisan (the spokesperson) in the Quran refers to one who speaks. The famous hadith states: The tongue is the interpreter of the heart.
shades.hadith_ar: اللِّسَانُ تَرۡجُمَانُ الۡقَلۡبِ
shades.hadith_en: The tongue is the interpreter of the heart

shades.explanation: al-Lisaniyyah (the linguistics) in the Quran refers to speech science. The famous hadith states: Whoever believes in Allah let him speak good or remain silent.
shades.hadith_ar: مَن كَانَ يُؤۡمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالۡيَوۡمِ الۡأٓخِرِ فَلۡيَقُلۡ خَيۡرًا أَوۡ لِيَصۡمُتۡ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever believes in Allah let him speak good or remain silent

meaning.en: To be just. The root denotes justice, equity, or fairness.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡقَافُ وَالسِّينُ وَالطَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى العَدۡلِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: قَسَطَ: جَارَ. أَقۡسَطَ: عَدَلَ

quran_examples.ar: وَزِنُواْ بِالۡقِسۡطَاسِ الۡمُسۡتَقِيمِ
quran_examples.en: Weigh with an even balance

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الۡمُقۡسِطِينَ
quran_examples.en: Allah loves those who are just

hadith.ar: الۡمُقۡسِطُونَ عَلَىٰ مَنَابِرَ مِن نُّورٍۢ
hadith.en: The just will be on thrones of light

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَدۡلٌۭ یُحِبُّ الۡعَدۡلَ
hadith.en: Allah is Just and loves justice

shades.explanation: al-Qist (the justice) in the Quran refers to equity. The Quran says: And give full measure when you measure, and weigh with an even balance (17:35).
shades.hadith_ar: وَأَوۡفُواْ الۡكَيۡلَ إِذَا كِلۡتُمۡ وَزِنُواْ بِالۡقِسۡطَاسِ الۡمُسۡتَقِيمِ
shades.hadith_en: Give full measure when you measure and weigh with an even balance

shades.explanation: al-Muqsit (the just) in the Quran refers to one who is equitable. The Quran says: Indeed Allah loves those who are just (5:42).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الۡمُقۡسِطِينَ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed Allah loves those who are just

shades.explanation: al-Qasitun (the unjust) in the Quran refers to those who deviate from justice. The Quran says: And as for the unjust, they are firewood for Hell (72:15).
shades.hadith_ar: وَأَمَّا الۡقَاسِطُونَ فَكَانُواْ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا
shades.hadith_en: And as for the unjust, they are firewood for Hell

shades.explanation: al-Iqsat (the equity) in the Quran refers to fairness in judgment. The famous hadith states: The just will be seated on thrones of light on the Day of Judgment.
shades.hadith_ar: الۡمُقۡسِطُونَ عَلَىٰ مَنَابِرَ مِن نُّورٍۢ
shades.hadith_en: The just will be on thrones of light

meaning.en: To give drink. The root denotes watering, giving drink, or irrigation.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: السِّينُ وَالۡقَافُ وَالۡيَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الشُّرۡبِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: سَقَى: أَعۡطَىٰ شَرَابًا

quran_examples.ar: فَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰكُمُوهُ
quran_examples.en: And We gave it to you to drink

quran_examples.ar: وَوَرَدُواْ مَآءَ مَدۡيَنَ
quran_examples.en: They came to the water of Madyan

hadith.ar: لَا تَحۡقِرَنَّ مِنَ الۡمَعۡرُوفِ شَيۡئًا
hadith.en: Do not belittle any good deed

hadith.ar: سَقَى اللَّهُ عَبۡدًا سَمِعَ مَقَالَتِي
hadith.en: May Allah bless a servant who heard my words

shades.explanation: as-Suya (the giving of drink) in the Quran refers to providing water. The Quran says: And We send down water from the sky then We give it to you to drink (15:22).
shades.hadith_ar: وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰكُمُوهُ
shades.hadith_en: And We sent down water from the sky and gave it to you to drink

shades.explanation: as-Saqi (the waterer) in the Quran refers to one who provides drink. The Quran says: And from them is one who drinks from your drinking place (6:70).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَشۡرَبُ مِنۡهُ
shades.hadith_en: And among them is one who drinks from it

shades.explanation: as-Saqaya (the watering place) in the Quran refers to a place of drinking. The Quran says: And he drew water from the well (12:19).
shades.hadith_ar: وَوَرَدُواْ مَآءَ مَدۡيَنَ
shades.hadith_en: And they came to the water of Madyan

shades.explanation: al-Istiqya (the drawing of water) in the Quran refers to seeking water. The famous hadith states: Give water to the thirsty.
shades.hadith_ar: أَسۡقُواْ العَطۡشَانَ
shades.hadith_en: Give water to the thirsty

meaning.en: To admonish. The root denotes preaching, admonition, or advising.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡوَاوُ وَالۡعَيۡنُ وَالظَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى التَّذۡكِيرِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: وَعَظَ: نَصَحَ. المَوۡعِظَةُ: النَّصِيحَةُ

quran_examples.ar: وَذَكِّرۡ فَإِنَّ الذِّكۡرَىٰ تَنفَعُ الۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
quran_examples.en: Remind, for the reminder benefits the believers

quran_examples.ar: قَدۡ جَآءَتۡكُم مَّوۡعِظَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ
quran_examples.en: There has come to you an admonition from your Lord

hadith.ar: الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ
hadith.en: The religion is sincere advice

hadith.ar: لَا يُؤۡمِنُ أَحَدُكُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ
hadith.en: None of you believes until he loves for his brother

shades.explanation: al-WaEZ (the admonition) in the Quran refers to exhortation. The Quran says: And remind, for the reminder benefits the believers (51:55).
shades.hadith_ar: وَذَكِّرۡ فَإِنَّ الذِّكۡرَىٰ تَنفَعُ الۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
shades.hadith_en: And remind, for the reminder benefits the believers

shades.explanation: al-Wa'iz (the preacher) in the Quran refers to one who gives advice. The Quran says: And when they are admonished, they do not benefit (2:66).
shades.hadith_ar: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهَا نَكَٰلًا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهَا
shades.hadith_en: We made it a deterrent for what was before and after

shades.explanation: al-Maw'izah (the sermon) in the Quran refers to good counsel. The Quran says: O mankind, there has come to you an admonition from your Lord (10:57).
shades.hadith_ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدۡ جَآءَتۡكُم مَّوۡعِظَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: O mankind, there has come to you an admonition from your Lord

shades.explanation: al-IttiaZ (the receiving of admonition) in the Quran refers to being advised. The famous hadith states: The religion is sincere advice.
shades.hadith_ar: الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ
shades.hadith_en: The religion is sincere advice

meaning.en: To give. The root denotes giving, bestowing, or granting.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡوَاوُ وَالۡهَاءُ وَالۡبَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الإِعۡطَاءِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: وَهَبَ: أَعۡطَىٰ. الوَهَّابُ: اللَّهُ سُبۡحَانَهُ

quran_examples.ar: يُؤۡتِي الۡحِكۡمَةَ مَن يَشَآءُ
quran_examples.en: He gives wisdom to whom He wills

quran_examples.ar: وَهُوَ الۡعَزِيزُ الۡوَهَّابُ
quran_examples.en: He is the Mighty, the Great Giver

hadith.ar: خَيۡرُ مَا يُوهَبُ لِلۡإِنسَانِ وَلَدٌۭ صَالِحٌ
hadith.en: The best gift to a person is a righteous child

hadith.ar: تَهَادُواْ تَحَابُّواْ
hadith.en: Exchange gifts, for gifts increase love

shades.explanation: al-Wahb (the giving) in the Quran refers to granting without expectation. The Quran says: He gives wisdom to whom He wills (2:269).
shades.hadith_ar: يُؤۡتِي الۡحِكۡمَةَ مَن يَشَآءُ
shades.hadith_en: He gives wisdom to whom He wills

shades.explanation: al-Wahhab (the Great Giver) in the Quran is one of Allah's names. The Quran says: He is the Mighty, the Great Giver (38:9).
shades.hadith_ar: وَهُوَ الۡعَزِيزُ الۡوَهَّابُ
shades.hadith_en: And He is the Mighty, the Great Giver

shades.explanation: al-Mawhub (the gifted) in the Quran refers to what is granted. The famous hadith states: The best gift is a righteous child.
shades.hadith_ar: خَيۡرُ مَا يُوهَبُ لِلۡإِنسَانِ وَلَدٌۭ صَالِحٌ
shades.hadith_en: The best gift given to a person is a righteous child

shades.explanation: al-Ittihab (the receiving) in the Quran refers to accepting a gift. The famous hadith states: Give gifts to one another, for gifts remove rancor.
shades.hadith_ar: تَهَادُواْ تَحَابُّواْ
shades.hadith_en: Exchange gifts, for gifts increase love

meaning.en: To be low. The root denotes lowness, humility, or abasement.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الذَّالُ وَاللَّامُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الخُضُوعِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: ذَلَّ: خَضَعَ. الذِّلَّةُ: المَهَانَةُ

quran_examples.ar: وَضُرِبَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ الذِّلَّةُ وَالۡمَسۡكَنَةُ
quran_examples.en: Humiliation and poverty were struck upon them
quran_examples.context: Punishment of the Children of Israel

quran_examples.ar: وَاخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
quran_examples.en: Lower your wing to the believers

hadith.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِزَّ الۡإِسۡلَامَ وَالۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
hadith.en: O Allah, honor Islam and the Muslims

hadith.ar: مَنۡ تَوَاضَعَ لِلَّهِ رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ
hadith.en: Whoever humbles himself for Allah, Allah raises him

shades.explanation: adh-Dhull (the humiliation) in the Quran refers to lowliness and submission. The Quran says: And they were covered with humiliation and poverty (2:61).
shades.hadith_ar: وَضُرِبَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ الذِّلَّةُ وَالۡمَسۡكَنَةُ
shades.hadith_en: And they were covered with humiliation and poverty

shades.explanation: adh-Dhalil (the humble) in the Quran refers to one who is lowly. The Quran says: And be humble to the believers (15:88).
shades.hadith_ar: وَاخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
shades.hadith_en: And lower your wing to the believers

shades.explanation: adh-Dhillah (the lowliness) in the Quran refers to disgrace. The famous hadith states: Allah does not love the proud.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخۡتَالٍ فَخُورٍ
shades.hadith_en: Allah does not love every conceited boaster

shades.explanation: at-Tadhlil (the abasing) in the Quran refers to making subservient. The famous hadith states: The dunya has been made easy for us.
shades.hadith_ar: ذُلِّلَتۡ لَنَا الدُّنۡيَا
shades.hadith_en: The world has been made easy for us

meaning.en: To harm. The root denotes harm, annoyance, or injury.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡهَمۡزَةُ وَالذَّالُ وَالۡيَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الضَّرَرِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: أَذَىٰ: ضَرَّ. أَيۡذَىٰ: آلَمَ

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُؤۡذُونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ
quran_examples.en: Those who harm Allah and His Messenger
quran_examples.context: Punishment for harming Allah and His Messenger

quran_examples.ar: وَلَا تُضَآرُّوهُنَّ
quran_examples.en: And do not harm them

hadith.ar: الۡمُسۡلِمُ مَن سَلِمَ الۡمُسۡلِمُونَ مِن لِّسَانِهِۦ وَيَدِهِۦ
hadith.en: A Muslim is one from whose tongue and hand Muslims are safe

hadith.ar: كُلُّ الۡمُسۡلِمِ عَلَى الۡمُسۡلِمِ حَرَامٌ
hadith.en: Every Muslim is sacred to another Muslim

shades.explanation: al-Adha (the harm) in the Quran refers to injury or annoyance. The Quran says: Those who harm Allah and His Messenger (33:57).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُؤۡذُونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed those who harm Allah and His Messenger

shades.explanation: al-Adhi (the hurting) in the Quran refers to that which causes harm. The Quran says: And do not harm them to restrict them (65:1).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تُضَآرُّوهُنَّ
shades.hadith_en: And do not harm them

shades.explanation: al-Adha (the nuisance) in the Quran refers to that which offends. The famous hadith states: A Muslim is one from whose tongue and hand Muslims are safe.
shades.hadith_ar: الۡمُسۡلِمُ مَن سَلِمَ الۡمُسۡلِمُونَ مِن لِّسَانِهِۦ وَيَدِهِۦ
shades.hadith_en: A Muslim is one from whose tongue and hand Muslims are safe

shades.explanation: al-I'dha (the harming) in the Quran refers to causing injury. The famous hadith states: Do not harm yourself or others.
shades.hadith_ar: لَا ضَرَرَ وَلَا ضِرَارَ
shades.hadith_en: No harm and no reciprocating harm

meaning.en: To live. The root denotes life, building, or inhabiting.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡعَيۡنُ وَالۡمِيمُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الإِقَامَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: عَمَرَ: سَكَنَ. العِمَارَةُ: البِنَاءُ

quran_examples.ar: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرۡهُ نُنَكِّسۡهُ فِي الۡخَلۡقِ
quran_examples.en: Whoever We grant long life, We reverse in creation

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّمَا يَعۡمُرُ مَسَٰجِدَ اللَّهِ
quran_examples.en: The mosques of Allah are maintained by those who believe

hadith.ar: خَيۡرُ النَّاسِ مَن طَالَ عُمُرُهُۥ وَحَسُنَ عَمَلُهُۥ
hadith.en: The best of people are those whose lives are long and deeds are good

hadith.ar: إِنَّ الدُّنۡيَا حُلۡوَةٌ خَضِرَةٌ
hadith.en: The world is sweet and green

shades.explanation: al-Eumr (the life) in the Quran refers to one's lifespan. The Quran says: And We reverse the creation of the one We cause to grow old (36:68).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرۡهُ نُنَكِّسۡهُ فِي الۡخَلۡقِ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever We grant long life, We reverse in creation

shades.explanation: al-Eimarah (the building) in the Quran refers to constructing. The Quran says: The mosques of Allah are only to be maintained by those who believe (9:18).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّمَا يَعۡمُرُ مَسَٰجِدَ اللَّهِ مَنۡ ءَامَنَ بِاللَّهِ
shades.hadith_en: The mosques of Allah are only maintained by those who believe

shades.explanation: al-Eamir (the inhabitant) in the Quran refers to a resident. The famous hadith states: The best of people are those who live longest in obedience to Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: خَيۡرُ النَّاسِ مَن طَالَ عُمُرُهُۥ وَحَسُنَ عَمَلُهُۥ
shades.hadith_en: The best of people are those whose lives are long and deeds are good

shades.explanation: al-Eumran (the prosperity) in the Quran refers to flourishing. The famous hadith states: The world is sweet and green.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ الدُّنۡيَا حُلۡوَةٌ خَضِرَةٌ
shades.hadith_en: The world is sweet and green

meaning.en: To be lewd. The root denotes lewdness, obscenity, or immorality.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡفَاءُ وَالۡحَاءُ وَالشِّينُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى القُبۡحِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: فَحَشَ: قَبُحَ. الفَاحِشَةُ: الزِّنَىٰ

quran_examples.ar: وَلَا تَقۡرَبُواْ الۡفَوَٰحِشَ
quran_examples.en: Do not approach immoralities

quran_examples.ar: وَٱلۡكَٰظِمِينَ الۡغَيۡظَ
quran_examples.en: Those who restrain anger

hadith.ar: لَيۡسَ الۡمُؤۡمِنُ بِالطَّعَّانِ وَلَا اللَّعَّانِ وَلَا الفَاحِشِ
hadith.en: The believer does not taunt, curse, or speak obscenely

hadith.ar: الۡفَاحِشُ لَا يَدۡخُلُ الۡجَنَّةَ
hadith.en: The obscene person will not enter Paradise

shades.name_ar: الۡفَحۡشَاءُ - مَا قَبُحَ مِنَ القَوۡلِ وَالفِعۡلِ
shades.explanation: al-Fahsha (the lewdness) in the Quran refers to immoral acts. The Quran says: And do not approach immoralities - what is apparent and what is hidden (6:151).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تَقۡرَبُواْ الۡفَوَٰحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنۡهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ
shades.hadith_en: And do not approach immoralities, what is apparent and what is hidden

shades.explanation: al-Fahish (the obscene) in the Quran refers to one who exceeds bounds. The Quran says: Indeed Allah does not like the obscene (42:37).
shades.hadith_ar: وَٱلۡكَٰظِمِينَ الۡغَيۡظَ وَٱلۡعَافِينَ عَنِ النَّاسِ
shades.hadith_en: Those who restrain anger and pardon people

shades.explanation: al-Fuhsh (the abomination) in the Quran refers to foul speech. The famous hadith states: The believer does not taunt, curse, or speak obscenely.
shades.hadith_ar: لَيۡسَ الۡمُؤۡمِنُ بِالطَّعَّانِ وَلَا اللَّعَّانِ وَلَا الفَاحِشِ
shades.hadith_en: The believer does not taunt, curse, or speak obscenely

shades.explanation: al-Fawahish (the gross sins) in the Quran refers to major transgressions. The famous hadith states: The worst of the major sins are associating partners with Allah and killing a soul.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ أَعۡظَمَ الۡكَبَائِرِ الشِّرۡكُ بِاللَّهِ وَقَتۡلُ النَّفۡسِ
shades.hadith_en: The greatest of major sins is associating partners with Allah and killing a soul

meaning.en: To be angry. The root denotes anger, wrath, or fury.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡغَيۡنُ وَالضَّادُ وَالۡبَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الحَنَقِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: غَضِبَ: سَخِطَ. الۡمَغۡضُوبُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ: اليَهُودُ

quran_examples.ar: غَيۡرِ الۡمَغۡضُوبِ عَلَيۡهِمۡ
quran_examples.en: Not those who have incurred Your anger

quran_examples.ar: رَجَعَ مُوسَىٰٓ غَضۡبَٰنَ أَسِفًا
quran_examples.en: Moses returned angry and grieved

hadith.ar: لَيۡسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ
hadith.en: The strong person is not the one who overcomes people

hadith.ar: الۡغَضَبُ مِنَ الشَّيۡطَانِ
hadith.en: Anger is from Satan

shades.explanation: al-Ghadab (the anger) in the Quran refers to divine wrath. The Quran says: Those who have incurred Your anger (1:7).
shades.hadith_ar: غَيۡرِ الۡمَغۡضُوبِ عَلَيۡهِمۡ
shades.hadith_en: Not those who have incurred Your anger

shades.explanation: al-Ghadib (the angry) in the Quran refers to one full of wrath. The Quran says: And when Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved (7:150).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَمَّا رَجَعَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ غَضۡبَٰنَ أَسِفًا
shades.hadith_en: When Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved

shades.explanation: al-Maghdub (the object of anger) in the Quran refers to those deserving wrath. The famous hadith states: The strong person is the one who controls himself in anger.
shades.hadith_ar: لَيۡسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمۡلِكُ نَفۡسَهُ عِنۡدَ الۡغَضَبِ
shades.hadith_en: The strong person is not the one who overcomes people but the one who controls himself in anger

shades.explanation: al-Ighdab (the provocation) in the Quran refers to inciting anger. The famous hadith states: Anger comes from Satan.
shades.hadith_ar: الۡغَضَبُ مِنَ الشَّيۡطَانِ
shades.hadith_en: Anger is from Satan

meaning.en: To be ignorant. The root denotes ignorance, foolishness, or lack of knowledge.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡجِيمُ وَالۡهَاءُ وَاللَّامُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى ضِدِّ العِلۡمِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: جَهِلَ: لَمۡ يَعۡلَمۡ. الجَاهِلِيَّةُ: مَا قَبۡلَ الإِسۡلَامِ

quran_examples.ar: وَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ الۡجَٰهِلِينَ
quran_examples.en: Turn away from the ignorant

quran_examples.ar: أَفَحُكۡمَ الۡجَاهِلِيَّةِ يَبۡغُونَ
quran_examples.en: Do they seek the judgment of ignorance?

hadith.ar: طَلَبُ الۡعِلۡمِ فَرِيضَةٌ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ مُسۡلِمٍ
hadith.en: Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim

hadith.ar: مَنۡ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيۡرًا يُفَقِّهۡهُ فِي الدِّينِ
hadith.en: Whoever Allah intends good for, He gives him understanding of the religion

shades.explanation: al-Jahl (the ignorance) in the Quran refers to lack of knowledge. The Quran says: Indeed the worst of animals to Allah are the deaf and dumb who do not reason (8:22).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ شَرَّ الدَّوَآبِّ عِندَ اللَّهِ الصُّمُّ الۡبُكۡمُ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed the worst of creatures to Allah are the deaf and dumb who do not reason

shades.explanation: al-Jahil (the ignorant) in the Quran refers to one without knowledge. The Quran says: And turn away from the ignorant (7:199).
shades.hadith_ar: وَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ الۡجَٰهِلِينَ
shades.hadith_en: And turn away from the ignorant

shades.explanation: al-Jahiliyyah (the age of ignorance) in the Quran refers to pre-Islamic times. The Quran says: Do they seek the judgment of the days of ignorance? (5:50).
shades.hadith_ar: أَفَحُكۡمَ الۡجَاهِلِيَّةِ يَبۡغُونَ
shades.hadith_en: Do they seek the judgment of the days of ignorance?

shades.explanation: at-Tajahul (the feigning ignorance) in the Quran refers to pretending not to know. The famous hadith states: Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim.
shades.hadith_ar: طَلَبُ الۡعِلۡمِ فَرِيضَةٌ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ مُسۡلِمٍ
shades.hadith_en: Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim

meaning.en: To scheme. The root denotes scheming, plotting, or cunning.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡكَافُ وَالۡيَاءُ وَالدَّالُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى المَكۡرِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: كَادَ: مَكَرَ. الكَيۡدُ: الحِيلَةُ

quran_examples.ar: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكۡرًا وَمَكَرۡنَا مَكۡرًا
quran_examples.en: They plotted and We plotted

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّهُمۡ يَكِيدُونَ كَيۡدًا
quran_examples.en: They are scheming a scheme

hadith.ar: المَكۡرُ وَالۡخَدِيعَةُ فِي النَّارِ
hadith.en: Cunning and deceit are in the Fire

hadith.ar: اللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَكۡرِهِمۡ
hadith.en: Allah knows best their scheming

shades.explanation: al-Kawd (the scheming) in the Quran refers to plotting. The Quran says: And they plotted a plot, and We plotted a plot while they did not perceive (27:50).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكۡرًا وَمَكَرۡنَا مَكۡرًا
shades.hadith_en: They plotted a plot, and We plotted a plot

shades.explanation: al-Ka'id (the schemer) in the Quran refers to one who schemes. The Quran says: Indeed they are scheming a scheme, and I am scheming a scheme (86:15-16).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّهُمۡ يَكِيدُونَ كَيۡدًا وَأَكِيدُ كَيۡدًا
shades.hadith_en: Indeed they are scheming a scheme, and I am scheming a scheme

shades.explanation: al-Kayd (the cunning) in the Quran refers to craftiness. The famous hadith states: Cunning and deceit are in the Fire.
shades.hadith_ar: المَكۡرُ وَالۡخَدِيعَةُ فِي النَّارِ
shades.hadith_en: Cunning and deceit are in the Fire

shades.explanation: al-Makid (the plotted against) in the Quran refers to the target of scheming. The famous hadith states: The best of plots is from Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: خَيۡرُ المَكۡرِ مِنَ اللَّهِ
shades.hadith_en: The best of plots is from Allah

meaning.en: To be sick. The root denotes sickness, disease, or illness.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡمِيمُ وَالرَّاءُ وَالضَّادُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى السُّقۡمِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: مَرِضَ: سَقِمَ. المَرَضُ: ضِدُّ الصِّحَّةِ

quran_examples.ar: فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ
quran_examples.en: In their hearts is disease

quran_examples.ar: وَمَن كَانَ مَرِيضًا
quran_examples.en: Whoever is sick
quran_examples.context: Rulings for the sick in fasting

hadith.ar: عِيَادَةُ المَرِيضِ حَقٌّۭ عَلَى الۡمُسۡلِمِ
hadith.en: Visiting the sick is a right upon the Muslim

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا یُحِبُّ الۡمَرۡضَىٰ بِقُلُوبِهِمۡ
hadith.en: Allah does not love those with diseased hearts

shades.explanation: al-Marad (the sickness) in the Quran refers to physical or spiritual illness. The Quran says: In their hearts is disease (2:10).
shades.hadith_ar: فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ
shades.hadith_en: In their hearts is disease

shades.explanation: al-Marid (the sick) in the Quran refers to one afflicted with illness. The Quran says: And if he is sick, then a period of days (2:184).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَن كَانَ مَرِيضًا أَوۡ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever is sick or on a journey

shades.explanation: al-Marad (the disease) in the Quran refers to hypocrisy as a heart disease. The famous hadith states: The worst of the diseased hearts is the heart of a hypocrite.
shades.hadith_ar: أَشَدُّ القُلُوبِ مَرَضًا قَلۡبُ الۡمُنَافِقِ
shades.hadith_en: The worst diseased heart is the heart of a hypocrite

shades.explanation: al-Istirada (the feigning sickness) in the Quran refers to pretending illness. The famous hadith states: Visiting the sick is a duty of a Muslim.
shades.hadith_ar: عِيَادَةُ المَرِيضِ حَقٌّۭ عَلَى الۡمُسۡلِمِ
shades.hadith_en: Visiting the sick is a right of the Muslim

meaning.en: To watch. The root denotes watching, observing, or a neck.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الرَّاءُ وَالۡقَافُ وَالۡبَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى المُرَاقَبَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: رَقَبَ: حَرَسَ. الرَّقِيبُ: المُرَاقِبُ

quran_examples.ar: وَرَبُّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍۢ رَّقِيبٌ
quran_examples.en: Your Lord is a Watcher over all things

quran_examples.ar: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍۢ
quran_examples.en: Freeing a neck [slave]

hadith.ar: أَن تَعۡبُدَ اللَّهَ كَأَنَّكَ تَرَاهُ
hadith.en: To worship Allah as if you see Him

hadith.ar: الۡمُرَاقِبُ نَفۡسَهُ مُحَاسِبُهَا
hadith.en: Whoever watches his soul will hold it accountable

shades.explanation: ar-Raqabah (the watching) in the Quran refers to vigilant observation. The Quran says: And Allah is ever, over all things, a Watcher (33:52).
shades.hadith_ar: رَقِيبًا
shades.hadith_en: A watcher

shades.explanation: ar-Raqib (the Watcher) in the Quran is one of Allah's names. The Quran says: And your Lord is a Watcher over all things (34:21).
shades.hadith_ar: وَرَبُّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍۢ رَّقِيبٌ
shades.hadith_en: And your Lord is a Watcher over all things

shades.explanation: ar-Raqabah (the neck) in the Quran refers to freeing a slave. The Quran says: And for freeing a neck [slave] (90:13).
shades.hadith_ar: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍۢ
shades.hadith_en: Freeing a neck [slave]

shades.explanation: al-Muraqabah (the self-watch) in the Quran refers to self-accountability. The famous hadith states: Worship Allah as if you see Him.
shades.hadith_ar: أَن تَعۡبُدَ اللَّهَ كَأَنَّكَ تَرَاهُ
shades.hadith_en: To worship Allah as if you see Him

meaning.en: To fruit. The root denotes fruit, produce, or outcome.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الثَّاءُ وَالۡمِيمُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى مَا يَخۡرُجُ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الثَّمَرُ: حَمۡلُ الشَّجَرِ

quran_examples.ar: وَمِن ثَمَرَٰتِ النَّخِيلِ
quran_examples.en: And from the fruits of date palms

quran_examples.ar: وَلِلَّهِ عَٰقِبَةُ الۡأُمُورِ
quran_examples.en: To Allah belongs the final outcome

hadith.ar: ثَمَرَةُ الإِيمَانِ العَمَلُ الصَّالِحُ
hadith.en: The fruit of faith is righteous deeds

hadith.ar: لَا ثَمَرَ لِلزَّانِي
hadith.en: There is no produce for the adulterer

shades.explanation: ath-Thamar (the fruit) in the Quran refers to produce. The Quran says: And from the fruits of date palms and grapevines (16:67).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمِن ثَمَرَٰتِ النَّخِيلِ وَالۡأَعۡنَٰبِ
shades.hadith_en: And from the fruits of date palms and grapevines

shades.explanation: ath-Thamarah (the outcome) in the Quran refers to result. The Quran says: And to Allah belongs the final outcome (22:41).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلِلَّهِ عَٰقِبَةُ الۡأُمُورِ
shades.hadith_en: And to Allah belongs the outcome of all affairs

shades.explanation: ath-Thamarat (the fruits) in the Quran refers to rewards. The famous hadith states: The fruits of faith are good deeds.
shades.hadith_ar: ثَمَرَةُ الإِيمَانِ العَمَلُ الصَّالِحُ
shades.hadith_en: The fruit of faith is righteous deeds

shades.explanation: ath-Thimr (the profit) in the Quran refers to gain. The famous hadith states: There is no spoils of war for the fornicator.
shades.hadith_ar: لَا ثَمَرَ لِلزَّانِي
shades.hadith_en: There is no produce for the adulterer

meaning.en: To fall. The root denotes falling, occurring, or happening.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡوَاوُ وَالۡقَافُ وَالۡعَيۡنُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الحُدُوثِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: وَقَعَ: حَصَلَ. الۡوَاقِعَةُ: القِيَامَةُ

quran_examples.ar: الۡحَاقَّةُ مَا الۡحَاقَّةُ
quran_examples.en: The Inevitable Reality - what is it?

quran_examples.ar: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ
quran_examples.en: Then what they were promised came to them

hadith.ar: مَن قَرَأَ سُورَةَ الۡوَاقِعَةِ فِي كُلِّ لَيۡلَةٍۢ لَمۡ تُصِبۡهُ فَاقَةٌ
hadith.en: Whoever recites Surah al-Waqiah every night will not suffer poverty

hadith.ar: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ الۡوَاقِعَةُ لَيۡسَ لِوَقۡعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
hadith.en: When the Event occurs, there is no denying its occurrence

shades.explanation: al-Wuqu (the falling) in the Quran refers to occurring or befalling. The Quran says: The Inevitable Reality - what is the Inevitable Reality? (69:1-2).
shades.hadith_ar: الۡحَاقَّةُ مَا الۡحَاقَّةُ
shades.hadith_en: The Inevitable Reality - what is the Inevitable Reality?

shades.explanation: al-Waqi (the falling) in the Quran refers to what occurs. The Quran says: The punishment will inevitably fall upon them (26:206).
shades.hadith_ar: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ
shades.hadith_en: Then there came to them what they were promised

shades.explanation: al-Waqiah (the Event) in the Quran refers to the Day of Resurrection. The famous hadith states: Whoever recites Surah al-Waqiah every night will never suffer poverty.
shades.hadith_ar: مَن قَرَأَ سُورَةَ الۡوَاقِعَةِ فِي كُلِّ لَيۡلَةٍۢ لَمۡ تُصِبۡهُ فَاقَةٌ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever recites Surah al-Waqiah every night will not suffer poverty

shades.explanation: al-Muqia'ah (the agreement) in the Quran refers to meeting or encounter. The famous hadith states: The best of people is the one who lives longest in obedience.
shades.hadith_ar: خَيۡرُ النَّاسِ مَن طَالَ عُمُرُهُۥ وَحَسُنَ عَمَلُهُۥ
shades.hadith_en: The best of people is the one whose life is long and deeds are good

meaning.en: To be free. The root denotes freedom, divorce, or release.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الطَّاءُ وَاللَّامُ وَالۡقَافُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الحَلِّ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: طَلَّقَ: حَلَّ. الإِطۡلَاقُ: عَدَمُ التَّقۡيِيدِ

quran_examples.ar: الطَّلَاقُ مَرَّتَانِ
quran_examples.en: Divorce is twice

quran_examples.ar: هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِي الَّذِينَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
quran_examples.en: Are those who know equal to those who do not know?

hadith.ar: أَبۡغَضُ الۡحَلَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ الطَّلَاقُ
hadith.en: The most hateful of permissible things to Allah is divorce

hadith.ar: الۡمُؤۡمِنُ لَا یُؤۡذِي جَارَهُ
hadith.en: The believer does not harm his neighbor

shades.explanation: at-Talaq (the divorce) in the Quran refers to dissolution of marriage. The Quran says: Divorce is twice, then retention in honor or release with kindness (2:229).
shades.hadith_ar: الطَّلَاقُ مَرَّتَانِ
shades.hadith_en: Divorce is twice

shades.explanation: at-Talaq (the release) in the Quran refers to being set free. The Quran says: Are those who know equal to those who do not know? (39:9) - this sets the mind free.
shades.hadith_ar: قُلۡ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِي الَّذِينَ يَعۡلَمُونَ وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
shades.hadith_en: Are those who know equal to those who do not know?

shades.explanation: at-Taliq (the freed) in the Quran refers to that which is unrestricted. The famous hadith states: The most hateful of permissible things to Allah is divorce.
shades.hadith_ar: أَبۡغَضُ الۡحَلَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ الطَّلَاقُ
shades.hadith_en: The most hateful of permissible things to Allah is divorce

shades.explanation: al-Itlaq (the absoluteness) in the Quran refers to freedom from restriction. The famous hadith states: The believer is not defamed or cursed.
shades.hadith_ar: لَيۡسَ الۡمُؤۡمِنُ بِالطَّعَّانِ
shades.hadith_en: The believer is not a taunter

meaning.en: To wear. The root denotes wearing, clothing, or confusing.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: اللَّامُ وَالۡبَاءُ وَالسِّينُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى السَّتۡرِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: لَبِسَ: ارۡتَدَىٰ. لَبَّسَ: خَلَطَ

quran_examples.ar: وَلِبَاسُ التَّقۡوَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٌۭ
quran_examples.en: The clothing of righteousness is best

quran_examples.ar: وَلَا تَلۡبِسُواْ الۡحَقَّ بِالۡبَاطِلِ
quran_examples.en: Do not confuse truth with falsehood

hadith.ar: إِنَّ الۡحَلَالَ بَيِّنٌۭ وَإِنَّ الۡحَرَامَ بَيِّنٌۭ
hadith.en: The halal is clear and the haram is clear

hadith.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَظِلَّنِي فِي ظِلِّكَ
hadith.en: O Allah, shade me in Your shade

shades.explanation: al-Lubs (the wearing) in the Quran refers to clothing oneself. The Quran says: And the clothing of righteousness - that is best (7:26).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلِبَاسُ التَّقۡوَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٌۭ
shades.hadith_en: And the clothing of righteousness - that is best

shades.explanation: al-Libas (the garment) in the Quran refers to clothing. The Quran says: They are a garment for you and you are a garment for them (2:187).
shades.hadith_ar: هُنَّ لِبَاسٌۭ لَّكُمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ لِبَاسٌۭ لَّهُنَّ
shades.hadith_en: They are a garment for you and you are a garment for them

shades.explanation: al-Labs (the confusion) in the Quran refers to obscuring truth. The Quran says: And do not confuse truth with falsehood (2:42).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تَلۡبِسُواْ الۡحَقَّ بِالۡبَاطِلِ
shades.hadith_en: And do not confuse truth with falsehood

shades.explanation: al-Multabis (the ambiguous) in the Quran refers to unclear matters. The famous hadith states: The halal is clear and the haram is clear, and between them are ambiguous matters.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ الۡحَلَالَ بَيِّنٌۭ وَإِنَّ الۡحَرَامَ بَيِّنٌۭ وَبَيۡنَهُمَا مُشۡتَبِهَٰتٌۭ
shades.hadith_en: The halal is clear, the haram is clear, and between them are ambiguous matters

meaning.en: To walk. The root denotes walking or gait.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡمِيمُ وَالشِّينُ وَالۡيَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى السَّيۡرِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: مَشَىٰ: سَارَ عَلَى قَدَمَيۡهِ

quran_examples.ar: يَمۡشُونَ عَلَى الۡأَرۡضِ هَوۡنًا
quran_examples.en: They walk on the earth gently

quran_examples.ar: وَلَا تَمۡشِ فِي الۡأَرۡضِ مَرَحًا
quran_examples.en: Do not walk exultantly

hadith.ar: إِذَا أَتَيۡتُمُ الصَّلَاةَ فَعَلَيۡكُم بِالسَّكِينَةِ
hadith.en: When you come to prayer, come with calmness

hadith.ar: مَنۡ يَمۡشِ فِي حَاجَةِ أَخِيهِ كَانَ خَيۡرًا لَّهُۥ
hadith.en: Whoever walks in the need of his brother, it is better for him

shades.explanation: al-Mashy (the walking) in the Quran refers to moving on foot. The Quran says: And walk not upon the earth exultantly (25:63).
shades.hadith_ar: وَعِبَادُ الرَّحۡمَٰنِ الَّذِينَ يَمۡشُونَ عَلَى الۡأَرۡضِ هَوۡنًا
shades.hadith_en: The servants of the Most Merciful walk on the earth gently

shades.explanation: al-Mashi (the walker) in the Quran refers to one who walks. The Quran says: And do not walk upon the earth exultantly (17:37).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تَمۡشِ فِي الۡأَرۡضِ مَرَحًا
shades.hadith_en: And do not walk upon the earth exultantly

shades.explanation: al-Mashyah (the walking pace) in the Quran refers to gait. The famous hadith states: When you walk to the mosque, walk with calmness.
shades.hadith_ar: إِذَا أَتَيۡتُمُ الصَّلَاةَ فَعَلَيۡكُم بِالسَّكِينَةِ
shades.hadith_en: When you come to prayer, come with calmness

shades.explanation: al-Mamsha (the promenade) in the Quran refers to a walking place. The famous hadith states: The best of your walks is to the mosque.
shades.hadith_ar: خَيۡرُ مَمۡشَاكُمۡ إِلَى المَسَاجِدِ
shades.hadith_en: The best of your walks is to the mosques

meaning.en: To marry. The root denotes marriage, wedlock, or matrimony.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: النُّونُ وَالۡكَافُ وَالۡحَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الضَّمِّ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: نَكَحَ: تَزَوَّجَ. النِّكَاحُ: عَقۡدُ الزَّوَاجِ

quran_examples.ar: وَأَنكِحُواْ الۡأَيَامَىٰ مِنكُمۡ
quran_examples.en: Marry the unmarried among you

quran_examples.ar: فَانكِحُواْ مَا طَابَ لَكُم مِّنَ النِّسَآءِ
quran_examples.en: Marry what is good for you of women

hadith.ar: النِّكَاحُ مِن سُنَّتِي
hadith.en: Marriage is from my sunnah

hadith.ar: خَيۡرُ النِّكَاحِ أَيۡسَرُهُۥ
hadith.en: The best marriage is the easiest

shades.explanation: an-Nikah (the marriage) in the Quran refers to the marital bond. The Quran says: And marry the unmarried among you (24:32).
shades.hadith_ar: وَأَنكِحُواْ الۡأَيَامَىٰ مِنكُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: And marry the unmarried among you

shades.explanation: al-Munakah (the wedlock) in the Quran refers to matrimony. The Quran says: Then marry what is good for you of women (4:3).
shades.hadith_ar: فَانكِحُواْ مَا طَابَ لَكُم مِّنَ النِّسَآءِ
shades.hadith_en: Then marry what is good for you of women

shades.explanation: an-Nikah (the marriage contract) in the Quran refers to the legal union. The famous hadith states: Marriage is my sunnah.
shades.hadith_ar: النِّكَاحُ مِن سُنَّتِي
shades.hadith_en: Marriage is from my sunnah

shades.explanation: al-Minkah (the marriage gift) in the Quran refers to the dowry. The famous hadith states: The best marriage is the easiest one.
shades.hadith_ar: خَيۡرُ النِّكَاحِ أَيۡسَرُهُۥ
shades.hadith_en: The best marriage is the easiest

meaning.en: To waste. The root denotes waste, extravagance, or excess.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: السِّينُ وَالرَّاءُ وَالۡفَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡمُجَاوَزَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: أَسۡرَفَ: جَاوَزَ الۡحَدَّ

quran_examples.ar: وَلَا تُسۡرِفُوٓاْ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ الۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
quran_examples.en: Do not be extravagant, Allah does not like the extravagant

quran_examples.ar: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُواْ لَمۡ يُسۡرِفُواْ
quran_examples.en: Those who when they spend are not extravagant

hadith.ar: لَا تُسۡرِفُواْ الۡمَآءَ وَلَوۡ كُنتُمۡ عَلَىٰ نَهۡرٍۢ جَارٍ
hadith.en: Do not waste water even at a flowing river

hadith.ar: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ وَتَصَدَّقُواْ فِي غَيۡرِ سَرَفٍۢ
hadith.en: Eat, drink, and give charity without waste

shades.explanation: as-Saraf (the waste) in the Quran refers to extravagance. The Quran says: And do not be extravagant. Indeed He does not like the extravagant (6:141).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تُسۡرِفُوٓاْ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ الۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
shades.hadith_en: And do not be extravagant, indeed He does not like the extravagant

shades.explanation: al-Musrif (the extravagant) in the Quran refers to one who exceeds limits. The Quran says: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who spend not extravagantly (25:67).
shades.hadith_ar: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُواْ لَمۡ يُسۡرِفُواْ وَلَمۡ يَقۡتُرُواْ
shades.hadith_en: Those who when they spend are neither extravagant nor stingy

shades.explanation: al-Israf (the excess) in the Quran refers to wasteful spending. The famous hadith states: Indeed Allah loves to see the effects of His blessings on His servant.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ أَن يَرَىٰ أَثَرَ نِعۡمَتِهِۦ عَلَىٰ عَبۡدِهِۦ
shades.hadith_en: Allah loves to see the effect of His blessings on His servant

shades.explanation: as-Sarif (the waster) in the Quran refers to a spendthrift. The famous hadith states: Do not waste water even if you are at a flowing river.
shades.hadith_ar: لَا تُسۡرِفُواْ الۡمَآءَ وَلَوۡ كُنتُمۡ عَلَىٰ نَهۡرٍۢ جَارٍ
shades.hadith_en: Do not waste water even if you are at a flowing river

meaning.en: To weigh. The root denotes weighing, balance, or measurement.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡوَاوُ وَالزَّايُ وَالنُّونُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى التَّقۡدِيرِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: وَزَنَ: قَدَّرَ. المِيزَانُ: آلَةُ الوَزۡنِ

quran_examples.ar: وَزِنُواْ بِالۡقِسۡطَاسِ الۡمُسۡتَقِيمِ
quran_examples.en: Weigh with an even balance

quran_examples.ar: وَالۡوَزۡنُ يَوۡمَئِذٍ الۡحَقُّ
quran_examples.en: The weighing on that Day is the truth

hadith.ar: أَثۡقَلُ شَيۡءٍ فِي الۡمِيزَانِ حُسۡنُ الۡخُلُقِ
hadith.en: The heaviest on the scale is good character

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَنظُرُ إِلَىٰ صُوَرِكُمۡ
hadith.en: Allah does not look at your forms

shades.explanation: al-Wazn (the weighing) in the Quran refers to measurement. The Quran says: And give full measure when you measure, and weigh with an even balance (17:35).
shades.hadith_ar: وَزِنُواْ بِالۡقِسۡطَاسِ الۡمُسۡتَقِيمِ
shades.hadith_en: And weigh with an even balance

shades.explanation: al-Mizan (the scale) in the Quran refers to the balance of justice. The Quran says: And the weighing on that Day is the truth (7:8).
shades.hadith_ar: وَالۡوَزۡنُ يَوۡمَئِذٍ الۡحَقُّ
shades.hadith_en: And the weighing on that Day is the truth

shades.explanation: al-Mawzun (the weighed) in the Quran refers to what is measured. The famous hadith states: The scales on that Day will be as fine as a hair.
shades.hadith_ar: الۡمَوَازِينُ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيَامَةِ كَشَعۡرَةٍ
shades.hadith_en: The scales on the Day of Judgment are like a hair

shades.explanation: al-Wazin (the weigher) in the Quran refers to one who weighs. The famous hadith states: The heaviest thing on the scale is good character.
shades.hadith_ar: أَثۡقَلُ شَيۡءٍ فِي الۡمِيزَانِ حُسۡنُ الۡخُلُقِ
shades.hadith_en: The heaviest thing on the scale is good character

meaning.en: To be orphaned. The root denotes orphanhood or being alone.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡيَاءُ وَالتَّاءُ وَالۡمِيمُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الفَقۡدِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: يَتِمَ الصَّبِيُّ: فَقَدَ أَبَاهُ

quran_examples.ar: أَلَمۡ يَجِدۡكَ يَتِيمًا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
quran_examples.en: Did He not find you an orphan and give refuge?

quran_examples.ar: فَأَمَّا الۡيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقۡهَرۡ
quran_examples.en: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him]

hadith.ar: أَنَا وَكَافِلُ الۡيَتِيمِ فِي الۡجَنَّةِ كَهَاتَيۡنِ
hadith.en: I and the caretaker of the orphan will be like these two in Paradise

hadith.ar: خَيۡرُ بَيۡتٍۢ فِي الۡمُسۡلِمِينَ بَيۡتٌۭ فِيهِ يَتِيمٌۭ يُحۡسَنُ إِلَيۡهِ
hadith.en: The best house is one where an orphan is treated well

shades.explanation: al-Yatm (the orphanhood) in the Quran refers to losing a father. The Quran says: And He found you an orphan and gave [you] refuge (93:6).
shades.hadith_ar: أَلَمۡ يَجِدۡكَ يَتِيمًا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
shades.hadith_en: Did He not find you an orphan and give you refuge?

shades.explanation: al-Yatim (the orphan) in the Quran refers to a child without a father. The Quran says: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him] (93:9).
shades.hadith_ar: فَأَمَّا الۡيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقۡهَرۡ
shades.hadith_en: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him]

shades.explanation: al-Yatama (the orphans) in the Quran refers to those who have lost parents. The famous hadith states: I and the caretaker of the orphan will be like this in Paradise.
shades.hadith_ar: أَنَا وَكَافِلُ الۡيَتِيمِ فِي الۡجَنَّةِ كَهَاتَيۡنِ
shades.hadith_en: I and the caretaker of the orphan will be like these two in Paradise

shades.explanation: al-Yatimah (the orphan girl) in the Quran refers to a female orphan. The famous hadith states: The best house among the Muslims is a house in which an orphan is treated well.
shades.hadith_ar: خَيۡرُ بَيۡتٍۢ فِي الۡمُسۡلِمِينَ بَيۡتٌۭ فِيهِ يَتِيمٌۭ يُحۡسَنُ إِلَيۡهِ
shades.hadith_en: The best house among Muslims is one in which an orphan is treated well

meaning.en: To be familiar. The root denotes familiarity, unity, or the number thousand.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡهَمۡزَةُ وَاللَّامُ وَالۡفَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الجَمۡعِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: أَلِفَ: أَنِسَ. أَلۡفٌ: عَشۡرُ مِئَةٍ

quran_examples.ar: إِن يَكُن مِّنكُمۡ أَلۡفٌۭ يَغۡلِبُوٓاْ أَلۡفَيۡنِ
quran_examples.en: If there are a thousand of you, they will overcome two thousand

quran_examples.ar: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفۡسٍۢ وَٰحِدَةٍۢ
quran_examples.en: He created you from one soul

hadith.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفۡ بَيۡنَ قُلُوبِنَا
hadith.en: O Allah, unite our hearts

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الۡمُؤۡلِفِينَ بَيۡنَ الۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
hadith.en: Allah loves those who reconcile between Muslims

shades.explanation: al-Ulfah (the familiarity) in the Quran refers to affection and harmony. The Quran says: It is He who has created you from one soul and made from it its mate that he might dwell in comfort with her (7:189).
shades.hadith_ar: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفۡسٍۢ وَٰحِدَةٍۢ وَجَعَلَ مِنۡهَا زَوۡجَهَا لِيَسۡكُنَ إِلَيۡهَا
shades.hadith_en: He created you from one soul and made its mate to dwell in comfort

shades.explanation: al-Alf (the thousand) in the Quran refers to the number 1,000. The Quran says: And if there are a thousand of you who are patient, they will overcome two thousand (8:66).
shades.hadith_ar: إِن يَكُن مِّنكُمۡ أَلۡفٌۭ يَغۡلِبُوٓاْ أَلۡفَيۡنِ
shades.hadith_en: If there are a thousand of you, they will overcome two thousand

shades.explanation: at-Ta'lif (the uniting) in the Quran refers to bringing hearts together. The famous hadith states: O Allah, unite their hearts.
shades.hadith_ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفۡ بَيۡنَ قُلُوبِهِمۡ
shades.hadith_en: O Allah, unite their hearts

shades.explanation: al-Mu'allaf (the reconciled) in the Quran refers to those whose hearts are won over. The famous hadith states: Their hearts are united by the faith.
shades.hadith_ar: تَأَلَّفَتۡ قُلُوبُهُمۡ عَلَى الإِيمَانِ
shades.hadith_en: Their hearts united upon faith

meaning.en: To be clear. The root denotes clarity, Arabic language, or eloquence.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡعَيۡنُ وَالرَّاءُ وَالۡبَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الفَصَاحَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: العَرَبُ: أَهۡلُ اللِّسَانِ الفَصِيحِ

quran_examples.ar: قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيۡرَ ذِي عِوَجٍۢ
quran_examples.en: An Arabic Quran, without deviance

quran_examples.ar: وَلَوۡ جَعَلۡنَٰهُ قُرۡءَانًا أَعۡجَمِيًّا
quran_examples.en: If We had made it a non-Arabic Quran

hadith.ar: إِنَّ الۡقُرۡآنَ نَزَلَ بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِيٍّ مُّبِينٍ
hadith.en: The Quran was revealed in a clear Arabic tongue

hadith.ar: أَنَا أَفۡصَحُ العَرَبِ
hadith.en: I am the most eloquent of Arabs

shades.explanation: al-Earab (the Arabic) in the Quran refers to the Arabic language. The Quran says: An Arabic Quran, without any deviance (39:28).
shades.hadith_ar: قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيۡرَ ذِي عِوَجٍۢ
shades.hadith_en: An Arabic Quran, without any deviance

shades.explanation: al-Earabi (the Arab) in the Quran refers to an Arab person. The Quran says: And if We had made it a non-Arabic Quran they would have said (41:44).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَوۡ جَعَلۡنَٰهُ قُرۡءَانًا أَعۡجَمِيًّا
shades.hadith_en: If We had made it a non-Arabic Quran

shades.explanation: al-Eirab (the clarity) in the Quran refers to clear expression. The famous hadith states: Indeed the Quran was revealed in clear Arabic speech.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ الۡقُرۡآنَ نَزَلَ بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِيٍّ مُّبِينٍ
shades.hadith_en: The Quran was revealed in a clear Arabic tongue

shades.explanation: al-Mu'arrab (the Arabicized) in the Quran refers to loan words. The famous hadith states: The Arabs are the best of nations.
shades.hadith_ar: العَرَبُ خَيۡرُ الأُمَمِ
shades.hadith_en: The Arabs are the best of nations

meaning.en: To rejoice. The root denotes joy, gladness, or exultation.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡفَاءُ وَالرَّاءُ وَالۡحَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى السُّرُورِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: فَرِحَ: سُرَّ. الفَرَحُ: ضِدُّ الحُزۡنِ

quran_examples.ar: فَبِذَٰلِكَ فَلۡيَفۡرَحُواْ
quran_examples.en: In that let them rejoice

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الۡفَرِحِينَ
quran_examples.en: Allah does not love the exultant

hadith.ar: أَفۡضَلُ الۡفَرَحِ فَرَحُ الإِيمَانِ
hadith.en: The best joy is the joy of faith

hadith.ar: فَرِحَ الۡمُؤۡمِنُ بِرَحۡمَةِ اللَّهِ
hadith.en: The believer rejoices in the mercy of Allah

shades.explanation: al-Farah (the joy) in the Quran refers to happiness. The Quran says: Say: In the bounty of Allah and in His mercy - in that let them rejoice (10:58).
shades.hadith_ar: فَبِذَٰلِكَ فَلۡيَفۡرَحُواْ
shades.hadith_en: In that let them rejoice

shades.explanation: al-Farih (the rejoicing) in the Quran refers to one who is joyful. The Quran says: Indeed Allah does not love the exultant (28:76).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الۡفَرِحِينَ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed Allah does not love the exultant

shades.name_en: al-Farih - The Rejoicing in This World
shades.explanation: al-Farih (the rejoicing) in the Quran refers to arrogant joy. The famous hadith states: The best joy is the joy of faith.
shades.hadith_ar: أَفۡضَلُ الۡفَرَحِ فَرَحُ الإِيمَانِ
shades.hadith_en: The best joy is the joy of faith

shades.explanation: al-Iftirah (the exultation) in the Quran refers to intense joy. The famous hadith states: The believer's joy is in obedience to Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: فَرَحُ الۡمُؤۡمِنِ بِطَاعَةِ اللَّهِ
shades.hadith_en: The believer's joy is in obedience to Allah

meaning.en: To go astray. The root denotes error, falsehood, or misguidance.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡغَيۡنُ وَالۡوَاوُ وَالۡيَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الضَّلَالِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: غَوِيَ: ضَلَّ. الغَيُّ: ضِدُّ الرُّشۡدِ

quran_examples.ar: وَلَقَدۡ ضَلَّ قَبۡلَهُمۡ أَكۡثَرُ الۡأَوَّلِينَ
quran_examples.en: Most of the earlier people went astray

quran_examples.ar: وَاتَّبَعُواْ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ
quran_examples.en: They follow their own desires

hadith.ar: الشِّرۡكُ أَعۡظَمُ الغَيِّ
hadith.en: Shirk is the greatest error

hadith.ar: إِنَّ الۡمُؤۡمِنَ لَا يَغۡوَىٰ
hadith.en: The believer does not go astray

shades.explanation: al-Ghaway (the error) in the Quran refers to going astray. The Quran says: And do not follow the way of the corrupters.
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تَتَّبِعُواْ سَبِيلَ الۡمُفۡسِدِينَ
shades.hadith_en: Do not follow the way of the corrupters

shades.explanation: al-Ghawy (the falsehood) in the Quran refers to error. The Quran says: And indeed the astray follow their own desires.
shades.hadith_ar: وَاتَّبَعُواْ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: They follow their own desires

shades.explanation: al-Ghawi (the astray) in the Quran refers to the misguided. The famous hadith states: Shirk is the greatest error.
shades.hadith_ar: الشِّرۡكُ أَعۡظَمُ الغَيِّ
shades.hadith_en: Shirk is the greatest error

shades.explanation: al-Ghayah (the utmost) in the Quran refers to the extreme limit. The famous hadith states: The best of women are the Qurayshi women.
shades.hadith_ar: خَيۡرُ نِسَآءٍ رَكِبۡنَ الۡحُدُوجَ نِسَآءُ قُرَيۡشٍ
shades.hadith_en: The best of women who ride camels are the women of Quraysh

meaning.en: To be four. The root denotes the number four, a quarter, or spring.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الرَّاءُ وَالۡبَاءُ وَالۡعَيۡنُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى العَدَدِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: رَبَعَ: أَقَامَ. أَرۡبَعَةٌ: العَدَدُ

quran_examples.ar: فَانكِحُواْ مَثۡنَىٰ وَثُلَاثَ وَرُبَاعَ
quran_examples.en: Marry two, three, or four

quran_examples.ar: وَلَهُنَّ الرُّبُعُ مِمَّا تَرَكۡتُمۡ
quran_examples.en: They have a quarter of what you leave
