hadith.ar: الۡمُؤۡمِنُ كَالرَّبِيعِ
hadith.en: The believer is like the spring

hadith.ar: أَنَا وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُ كَهَاتَيۡنِ
hadith.en: I and the believer are like these two

shades.explanation: al-Arba' (the four) in the Quran refers to the number four. The Quran says: And if there are four women.
shades.hadith_ar: فَانكِحُواْ مَا طَابَ لَكُم مِّنَ النِّسَآءِ مَثۡنَىٰ وَثُلَاثَ وَرُبَاعَ
shades.hadith_en: Marry of the women that please you, two or three or four

shades.explanation: ar-Rub' (the quarter) in the Quran refers to one-fourth. The Quran says: And they have a quarter of what you leave.
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَهُنَّ الرُّبُعُ مِمَّا تَرَكۡتُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: And they have a quarter of what you leave

shades.explanation: ar-Rabi' (the spring) in the Quran refers to a season. The famous hadith states: The believer is like a fresh spring.
shades.hadith_ar: الۡمُؤۡمِنُ كَالرَّبِيعِ
shades.hadith_en: The believer is like the spring

shades.explanation: ar-Rubu' (the fourth) in the Quran refers to the fourth part. The famous hadith states: Among the believers the best are those with the best character.
shades.hadith_ar: أَكۡمَلُ الۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ إِيمَانًا أَحۡسَنُهُمۡ خُلُقًا
shades.hadith_en: The most complete believers are the best in character

meaning.en: To be dusty. The root denotes dust, earth, or soil.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: التَّاءُ وَالرَّاءُ وَالۡبَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الأَرۡضِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: تُرَابٌ: طِينٌ يَابِسٌ

quran_examples.ar: فَإِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰكُم مِّن تُرَابٍۢ
quran_examples.en: We created you from dust

quran_examples.ar: فَتَيَمَّمُواْ صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا
quran_examples.en: Seek pure earth

hadith.ar: جُعِلَتۡ لِيَ الأَرۡضُ مَسۡجِدًا وَطَهُورًا
hadith.en: The earth is a place of prayer and purification

hadith.ar: خُلِقَ الإِنسَانُ مِن تُرَابٍۢ
hadith.en: Man was created from dust

shades.explanation: at-Turab (the dust) in the Quran refers to earth. The Quran says: Indeed We created you from dust.
shades.hadith_ar: فَإِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰكُم مِّن تُرَابٍۢ
shades.hadith_en: We created you from dust

shades.explanation: at-Turba (the soil) in the Quran refers to pure earth. The famous hadith states: The earth has been made a place of prayer and purification.
shades.hadith_ar: جُعِلَتۡ لِيَ الأَرۡضُ مَسۡجِدًا وَطَهُورًا
shades.hadith_en: The earth is a place of prayer and purification

shades.explanation: at-Tayammum (the dry ablution) in the Quran refers to purification with earth. The Quran says: And seek pure earth.
shades.hadith_ar: فَتَيَمَّمُواْ صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا
shades.hadith_en: Seek pure earth

shades.explanation: ath-Tharib (the dusty) in the Quran refers to one covered in dust. The famous hadith states: May his nose be rubbed in dust.
shades.hadith_ar: رَغِمَ أَنۡفُهُ
shades.hadith_en: May his nose be rubbed in dust

meaning.en: To sin. The root denotes error, sin, or mistake.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡخَاءُ وَالطَّاءُ وَالۡهَمۡزَةُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الذَّنۡبِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: خَطِئَ: أَذۡنَبَ. الخَطِيئَةُ: الذَّنۡبُ

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ قَتۡلَهُمۡ كَانَ خِطۡـًٔا كَبِيرًا
quran_examples.en: Killing them is a great sin

quran_examples.ar: وَلَيۡسَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ جُنَاحٌۭ فِيمَآ أَخۡطَأۡتُم بِهِۦ
quran_examples.en: No blame for what you have erred

hadith.ar: كُلُّ بَنِيٓ ءَادَمَ خَطَّآءٌۭ وَخَيۡرُ الۡخَطَّآءِينَ التَّوَّابُونَ
hadith.en: Every son of Adam errs, the best errant are the repentant

hadith.ar: إِيَّاكُمۡ وَمُحَقَّرَاتِ الذُّنُوبِ
hadith.en: Beware of minor sins

shades.explanation: al-Khata' (the error) in the Quran refers to sin or mistake. The Quran says: And there is no blame upon you for that in which you have erred.
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَيۡسَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ جُنَاحٌۭ فِيمَآ أَخۡطَأۡتُم بِهِۦ
shades.hadith_en: There is no blame on you for what you have erred

shades.explanation: al-Khati'ah (the sin) in the Quran refers to transgression. The Quran says: Indeed the free of error are those who have patience.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّمَا الۡخَطِيئَةُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يَظۡلِمُونَ
shades.hadith_en: The sin is upon those who wrong

shades.explanation: al-Khati'un (the sinners) in the Quran refers to those who commit sins. The famous hadith states: Every son of Adam errs, and the best of those who err are the repentant.
shades.hadith_ar: كُلُّ بَنِيٓ ءَادَمَ خَطَّآءٌۭ وَخَيۡرُ الۡخَطَّآءِينَ التَّوَّابُونَ
shades.hadith_en: Every son of Adam errs, and the best of the errant are the repentant

shades.explanation: al-Ikhtiya' (the oscillation) in the Quran refers to hesitation. The famous hadith states: Avoid sins, small and great.
shades.hadith_ar: إِيَّاكُمۡ وَمُحَقَّرَاتِ الذُّنُوبِ
shades.hadith_en: Beware of sins considered insignificant

meaning.en: To be defective. The root denotes defect, one-eyedness, or vulnerability.
meaning.ar: العَوَرُ: ذَهَابُ البَصَرِ مِنۡ إِحۡدَىٰ العَيۡنَيۡنِ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡعَيۡنُ وَالۡوَاوُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الخَلَلِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: أَعۡوَرَ: صَارَ أَعۡوَرَ. العَوۡرَةُ: الخَلَلُ

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ بُيُوتَنَا عَوۡرَةٌۭ
quran_examples.en: Our homes are vulnerable
Three times of privacy for you

hadith.ar: إِنَّ الۡمَسِيحَ الدَّجَّالَ أَعۡوَرُ
hadith.en: The Dajjal is one-eyed

hadith.ar: الۡحَيَاءُ لَا يَأۡتِيٓ إِلَّا بِخَيۡرٍ
hadith.en: Modesty only brings good

shades.explanation: al-Eawar (the defect) in the Quran refers to loss of sight in one eye. The Quran says: And indeed you see them looking at you with one eye.
shades.hadith_ar: وَتَرَىٰهُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيۡكَ تَدُورُ أَعۡيُنُهُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: You see them looking at you with rolling eyes

shades.name_ar: الأَعۡوَرُ - مَن ذَهَبَ بَصَرُ إِحۡدَىٰ عَيۡنَيۡهِ
shades.explanation: al-Eawar (the one-eyed) in the Quran refers to the Dajjal. The famous hadith states: The Dajjal is one-eyed.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ الۡمَسِيحَ الدَّجَّالَ أَعۡوَرُ
shades.hadith_en: The Dajjal is one-eyed

shades.explanation: al-Eawrat (the weakness) in the Quran refers to vulnerable time. The Quran says: Those who seek out your weakness.
shades.hadith_ar: يَلۡبَسُواْ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لِيَأۡخُذُواْ مَتَٰعَهُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: They exploit your vulnerability to take your belongings

shades.explanation: al-Eayra' (the naked) in the Quran refers to being uncovered. The famous hadith states: Indeed modesty is from faith.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ الۡحَيَاءَ مِنَ الإِيمَانِ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed modesty is from faith

meaning.en: To confine. The root denotes confinement, siege, or restraint.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡحَاءُ وَالصَّادُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى المَنۡعِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: حَصَرَهُ: ضَيَّقَ عَلَيۡهِ

quran_examples.ar: فَأَغۡشَيۡنَٰهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُبۡصِرُونَ
quran_examples.en: We covered them so they do not see

quran_examples.ar: فَخُذُوهُمۡ وَاحۡصُرُوهُمۡ
quran_examples.en: Seize them and besiege them

hadith.ar: الۡمَحۡصُورُ مَنۡ حُبِسَ عَنِ الۡخَيۡرِ
hadith.en: The confined is one prevented from good

hadith.ar: إِنَّ الشَّيۡطَانَ يَحۡصُرُ الۡمُؤۡمِنَ
hadith.en: Shaitan confines the believer

shades.explanation: al-Hasr (the confinement) in the Quran refers to surrounding. The Quran says: And We have surrounded them with a barrier.
shades.hadith_ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۢ بَيۡنِ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ سَدًّا وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ سَدًّا فَأَغۡشَيۡنَٰهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُبۡصِرُونَ
shades.hadith_en: We placed a barrier before them and behind them

shades.explanation: al-Hasurah (the siege) in the Quran refers to one who is restrained. The Quran says: And he said I was prevented.
shades.hadith_ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي وَهَنَ الۡعَظۡمُ مِنِّي
shades.hadith_en: He said My Lord, my bones have weakened

shades.explanation: al-Mahsur (the confined) in the Quran refers to one who is besieged. The famous hadith states: The confined is one who is prevented from good.
shades.hadith_ar: الۡمَحۡصُورُ مَنۡ حُبِسَ عَنِ الۡخَيۡرِ
shades.hadith_en: The confined is one prevented from good

shades.explanation: al-Hisar (the siege) in the Quran refers to encirclement. The famous hadith states: Allah does not look at one who confines others.
shades.hadith_ar: مَنۡ حَاصَرَ قَوۡمًا لَمۡ يَنظُرِ اللَّهُ إِلَيۡهِ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever besieges a people, Allah does not look at him

meaning.en: To remain. The root denotes permanence, duration, or survival.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡبَاءُ وَالۡقَافُ وَالۡيَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الدَّوَامِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: بَقِيَ: دَامَ. البَاقِي: الدَّائِمُ

quran_examples.ar: مَا عِندَكُمۡ يَنفَدُ وَمَا عِندَ اللَّهِ بَاقٍۢ
quran_examples.en: What you have will end, what is with Allah remains

quran_examples.ar: كُلُّ مَنۡ عَلَيۡهَا فَانٍۢ وَيَبۡقَىٰ وَجۡهُ رَبِّكَ
quran_examples.en: All on it perishes, your Lord's Face remains

hadith.ar: احۡفَظِ اللَّهَ يَحۡفَظۡكَ
hadith.en: Preserve Allah and He will preserve you

hadith.ar: خَيۡرُ مَا بَقِيَ مَا أَصۡلَحَ الۡأٓخِرَةَ
hadith.en: The best of what remains is what benefits the Hereafter

shades.explanation: al-Baqa' (the remaining) in the Quran refers to permanence. The Quran says: Whatever is with you will come to an end, but what is with Allah is lasting.
shades.hadith_ar: مَا عِندَكُمۡ يَنفَدُ وَمَا عِندَ اللَّهِ بَاقٍۢ
shades.hadith_en: What you have will end, but what is with Allah remains

shades.explanation: al-Baqi (the everlasting) in the Quran refers to Allah's attribute. The Quran says: All that is on earth will perish, and there will remain the Face of your Lord.
shades.hadith_ar: كُلُّ مَنۡ عَلَيۡهَا فَانٍۢ وَيَبۡقَىٰ وَجۡهُ رَبِّكَ
shades.hadith_en: All on it will perish, and the Face of your Lord will remain

shades.explanation: al-Baqiyah (the remainder) in the Quran refers to what endures. The famous hadith states: The lasting good deeds are better with your Lord.
shades.hadith_ar: البَاقِيَاتُ الصَّالِحَاتُ خَيۡرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ
shades.hadith_en: The lasting good deeds are better with your Lord

shades.explanation: al-Istiqba' (the preservation) in the Quran refers to keeping something. The famous hadith states: Preserve what Allah has preserved for you.
shades.hadith_ar: احۡفَظِ اللَّهَ يَحۡفَظۡكَ
shades.hadith_en: Preserve Allah and He will preserve you

meaning.en: Youth. The root denotes youth, young man, or servitude.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡفَاءُ وَالتَّاءُ وَالۡيَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الشَّبَابِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الفَتَىٰ: الحَدَثُ السَّنِّ

quran_examples.ar: إِذۡ أَوَى الۡفِتۡيَةُ إِلَى الۡكَهۡفِ
quran_examples.en: When the young men took refuge in the cave

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّهُمۡ فِتۡيَةٌ ءَامَنُواْ بِرَبِّهِمۡ
quran_examples.en: They were young men who believed in their Lord

hadith.ar: سَبۡعَةٌۭ يُظِلُّهُمُ اللَّهُ فِي ظِلِّهِۦ يَوۡمَ لَا ظِلَّ إِلَّا ظِلُّهُ
hadith.en: Seven whom Allah will shade on the Day of Judgment

hadith.ar: شَابٌّۭ نَشَأَ فِي طَاعَةِ اللَّهِ
hadith.en: A youth who grew up in obedience of Allah

shades.explanation: al-Fata (the youth) in the Quran refers to a young man. The Quran says: We narrate to you their story in truth: they were young men who believed in their Lord.
shades.hadith_ar: نَحۡنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ نَبَأَهُم بِالۡحَقِّ إِنَّهُمۡ فِتۡيَةٌ ءَامَنُواْ بِرَبِّهِمۡ
shades.hadith_en: They were young men who believed in their Lord

shades.explanation: al-Fityah (the young men) in the Quran refers to the Companions of the Cave. The Quran says: And they were young men.
shades.hadith_ar: فِتۡيَةٌ ءَامَنُواْ بِرَبِّهِمۡ
shades.hadith_en: Young men who believed in their Lord

shades.explanation: al-Fatah (the servant) in the Quran refers to a young servant. The famous hadith states: The young man who obeys Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: فَتَىًۭ يُطِيعُ اللَّهَ
shades.hadith_en: A young man who obeys Allah

shades.explanation: al-Futuwwah (the chivalry) in the Quran refers to noble character. The famous hadith states: There is no chivalry but with the believers.
shades.hadith_ar: لَا فُتُوَّةَ إِلَّا لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
shades.hadith_en: Chivalry is only for the believers

meaning.en: To turn in repentance. The root denotes repentance, turning back, or being Jewish.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡهَاءُ وَالۡوَاوُ وَالدَّالُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الرُّجُوعِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: هَادَ: تَابَ. يُقَالُ: هُدۡنَا إِلَيۡكَ

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّا هُدۡنَا إِلَيۡكَ
quran_examples.en: We have turned to You

quran_examples.ar: وَقَالُواْ لَن يَدۡخُلَ الۡجَنَّةَ إِلَّا مَن كَانَ هُودًا أَوۡ نَصَارَىٰ
quran_examples.en: None shall enter Paradise unless he is a Jew or Christian

hadith.ar: لُعِنَ الۡيَهُودُ وَالنَّصَارَىٰ
hadith.en: The Jews and Christians were cursed

hadith.ar: لَا تَدۡخُلُواْ بَيۡتَ الۡمَقۡدِسِ
hadith.en: Do not enter the sacred house

shades.explanation: al-Hud (the repentance) in the Quran refers to turning back to Allah. The Quran says: Indeed we have turned to You (7:156).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّا هُدۡنَا إِلَيۡكَ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed we have turned to You

shades.explanation: al-Hud (the Jews) in the Quran refers to the followers of Moses. The Quran says: And We made them leaders guiding by Our command.
shades.hadith_ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ أَئِمَّةًۭ يَهۡدُونَ بِأَمۡرِنَا
shades.hadith_en: We made them leaders guiding by Our command

shades.explanation: al-Had (the Jewish) in the Quran refers to a Jewish person. The famous hadith states: The Jews and Christians have been cursed.
shades.hadith_ar: لُعِنَ الۡيَهُودُ وَالنَّصَارَىٰ
shades.hadith_en: The Jews and Christians were cursed

shades.explanation: al-Hiyadah (the returning) in the Quran refers to turning back. The famous hadith states: I turn to You and I am of those who turn.
shades.hadith_ar: وَأَنَا مِنَ الۡهَائِدِينَ
shades.hadith_en: And I am among those who turn

meaning.en: To conceal. The root denotes hiding, secrecy, or suppression.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡكَافُ وَالتَّاءُ وَالۡمِيمُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى السَّتۡرِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: كَتَمَ: أَخۡفَىٰ. كَتۡمٌ: سِتۡرٌ

quran_examples.ar: وَلَا تَكۡتُمُواْ الشَّهَادَةَ
quran_examples.en: Do not conceal the testimony

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَكۡتُمُونَ مَآ أَنزَلۡنَا
quran_examples.en: Those who conceal what We revealed

hadith.ar: مَنۡ سَتَرَ عَيۡبَ مُسۡلِمٍۢ سَتَرَ اللَّهُ عَيۡبَهُۥ
hadith.en: Whoever conceals a Muslim's fault, Allah conceals his

hadith.ar: لَا يَكۡتُمُ الۡمُؤۡمِنُ الخَيۡرَ
hadith.en: The believer does not conceal good

shades.explanation: al-Kitman (the concealment) in the Quran refers to hiding the truth. The Quran says: And do not conceal the testimony (2:283).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تَكۡتُمُواْ الشَّهَادَةَ وَمَن يَكۡتُمۡهَا فَإِنَّهُۥٓ ءَاثِمٌۭ قَلۡبُهُۥ
shades.hadith_en: And do not conceal the testimony, whoever conceals it has a sinful heart

shades.explanation: al-Katim (the concealer) in the Quran refers to one who hides the truth. The Quran says: Those who conceal what We sent down of clear proofs.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَكۡتُمُونَ مَآ أَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ الۡبَيِّنَٰتِ
shades.hadith_en: Those who conceal what We revealed of clear proofs

shades.explanation: al-Katm (the secrecy) in the Quran refers to keeping a secret. The famous hadith states: The believer does not conceal good deeds.
shades.hadith_ar: الۡمُؤۡمِنُ لَا يَكۡتُمُ الخَيۡرَ
shades.hadith_en: The believer does not conceal good

shades.explanation: al-Iktitam (the hiding) in the Quran refers to covering up. The famous hadith states: Whoever conceals a fault of a Muslim, Allah will conceal his fault.
shades.hadith_ar: مَنۡ سَتَرَ عَيۡبَ مُسۡلِمٍۢ سَتَرَ اللَّهُ عَيۡبَهُۥ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever conceals a Muslim's fault, Allah conceals his fault

meaning.en: To desire. The root denotes wish, desire, fate, or testing.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡمِيمُ وَالنُّونُ وَالۡيَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى التَّقۡدِيرِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: مَنَاهُ: قَدَّرَهُ. المُنۡيَةُ: مَا يَتَمَنَّىٰ

quran_examples.ar: إِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا يَتَمَنَّوۡنَ
quran_examples.en: They only wish

quran_examples.ar: يَقُولُونَ نَتَمَنَّىٰ لَوۡ نُصۡبِرُ
quran_examples.en: They say we wish we were patient

hadith.ar: الۡمُؤۡمِنُ الۡقَوِيُّ خَيۡرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ
hadith.en: The strong believer is better and more beloved

hadith.ar: كُنۡ فِي الدُّنۡيَا كَأَنَّكَ غَرِيبٌ
hadith.en: Be in this world as a stranger

shades.explanation: al-Many (the desire) in the Quran refers to wish or longing. The Quran says: And they say nothing but what they desire.
shades.hadith_ar: وَقَالُواْ لَن تَمَسَّنَا النَّارُ إِلَّآ أَيَّامًا مَّعۡدُودَةًۭ
shades.hadith_en: They said the fire will not touch us but for a few days

shades.explanation: al-Munyah (the wish) in the Quran refers to a desire. The famous hadith states: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: الۡمُؤۡمِنُ الۡقَوِيُّ خَيۡرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ
shades.hadith_en: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah

shades.explanation: al-Maniyah (the fate) in the Quran refers to death. The famous hadith states: Be in this world as if you are a stranger.
shades.hadith_ar: كُنۡ فِي الدُّنۡيَا كَأَنَّكَ غَرِيبٌ
shades.hadith_en: Be in this world as if you are a stranger

shades.explanation: al-Mani (the tester) in the Quran refers to one who tests. The famous hadith states: Allah tests whom He wills.
shades.hadith_ar: يَبۡتَلِي اللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ
shades.hadith_en: Allah tests whom He wills

meaning.en: To spread. The root denotes spreading, publishing, or resurrection.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: النُّونُ وَالشِّينُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى البَثِّ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: نَشَرَ: فَرَّقَ. النَّشۡرُ: ضِدُّ الطَّيِّ

quran_examples.ar: وَإِذَا الصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتۡ
quran_examples.en: When the pages are spread
quran_examples.context: Records of deeds on Judgment Day

quran_examples.ar: وَالنَّاشِرَٰتِ نَشۡرًا
quran_examples.en: And those that scatter widely

hadith.ar: تُحۡشَرُونَ حُفَاةًۭ عُرَاةًۭ
hadith.en: You will be gathered barefoot and naked

hadith.ar: يُنۡشَرُ لِلۡعَبۡدِ عَمَلُهُۥ
hadith.en: The servant's deeds are spread out

shades.explanation: an-Nashr (the spreading) in the Quran refers to dissemination. The Quran says: And when the pages are spread out (81:10).
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِذَا الصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتۡ
shades.hadith_en: And when the pages are spread out

shades.explanation: an-Nashir (the disperser) in the Quran refers to one who spreads. The Quran says: And the winds that scatter.
shades.hadith_ar: وَالنَّاشِرَٰتِ نَشۡرًا
shades.hadith_en: And those that scatter widely

shades.explanation: an-Nashr (the resurrection) in the Quran refers to coming back to life. The famous hadith states: You will be resurrected barefoot.
shades.hadith_ar: تُحۡشَرُونَ حُفَاةًۭ عُرَاةًۭ
shades.hadith_en: You will be gathered barefoot and naked

shades.explanation: al-Manshur (the spread) in the Quran refers to what is scattered. The famous hadith states: Good deeds are spread out like the pages.
shades.hadith_ar: يُنۡشَرُ لِلۡعَبۡدِ عَمَلُهُۥ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيَامَةِ
shades.hadith_en: A servant's deeds are spread out on Judgment Day

meaning.en: To establish. The root denotes path, way, custom, or age.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: السِّينُ وَالنُّونُ وَالنُّونُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الطَّرِيقِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: السُّنَّةُ: الطَّرِيقَةُ. سَنَّ: بَيَّنَ

quran_examples.ar: وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ اللَّهِ تَبۡدِيلًا
quran_examples.en: You will not find change in Allah's way

quran_examples.ar: سُنَّةَ مَن قَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا
quran_examples.en: The way of those We sent before

hadith.ar: مَنۡ سَنَّ فِي الإِسۡلَامِ سُنَّةًۭ حَسَنَةًۭ
hadith.en: Whoever establishes a good sunnah in Islam

hadith.ar: عَلَيۡكُمۡ بِسُنَّتِي وَسُنَّةِ الۡخُلَفَآءِ الرَّاشِدِينَ
hadith.en: Follow my sunnah and the sunnah of the rightly guided caliphs

shades.explanation: as-Sunnah (the way) in the Quran refers to a custom or practice. The Quran says: You will not find any change in the way of Allah (33:62).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ اللَّهِ تَبۡدِيلًا
shades.hadith_en: You will not find any change in the way of Allah

shades.explanation: as-Sinn (the age) in the Quran refers to years of life. The famous hadith states: The best of you are those who live long and do good.
shades.hadith_ar: خَيۡرُكُمۡ مَن طَالَ عُمُرُهُۥ وَحَسُنَ عَمَلُهُۥ
shades.hadith_en: The best of you are those with long life and good deeds

shades.explanation: al-Misin (the aged) in the Quran refers to an elderly person. The Quran says: And she said, O woe to me, shall I give birth while I am an old woman? (11:72).
shades.hadith_ar: قَالَتۡ يَـٰوَيۡلَتَىٰٓ ءَأَلِدُ وَأَنَا۠ عَجُوزٌۭ
shades.hadith_en: She said: Shall I give birth while I am an old woman?

shades.explanation: as-Sunan (the precepts) in the Quran refers to divine laws. The famous hadith states: Whoever establishes a good sunnah in Islam.
shades.hadith_ar: مَنۡ سَنَّ فِي الإِسۡلَامِ سُنَّةًۭ حَسَنَةًۭ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever establishes a good sunnah in Islam

meaning.en: To group. The root denotes party, group, or confederacy.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡحَاءُ وَالزَّايُ وَالۡبَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الجَمۡعِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الحِزۡبُ: الصِّنۡفُ. الأَحۡزَابُ: جَمَاعَاتٌ

quran_examples.ar: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ حِزۡبُ الشَّيۡطَٰنِ
quran_examples.en: They are the party of Satan

quran_examples.ar: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ حِزۡبُ اللَّهِ
quran_examples.en: They are the party of Allah

hadith.ar: لَا تَحَزَّبُواْ فَإِنَّ الۡحِزۡبَ يُفَرِّقُ
hadith.en: Do not form parties, they cause division

hadith.ar: إِنَّ حِزۡبَ اللَّهِ هُمُ الۡمُفۡلِحُونَ
hadith.en: The party of Allah are the successful

shades.explanation: al-Hizb (the party) in the Quran refers to a group. The Quran says: They are the party of Satan (58:19).
shades.hadith_ar: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ حِزۡبُ الشَّيۡطَٰنِ
shades.hadith_en: They are the party of Satan

shades.explanation: al-Ahzab (the confederates) in the Quran refers to allied groups. The Quran says: And when the confederates came upon you from above and below (33:10).
shades.hadith_ar: إِذۡ جَآءُوكُم مِّن فَوۡقِكُمۡ وَمِنۡ أَسۡفَلَ مِنكُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: When they came upon you from above and below

shades.name_en: Hizb Allah - The Party of Allah
shades.explanation: Hizb Allah (the party of Allah) in the Quran refers to the believers. The Quran says: Indeed the party of Allah are the successful (58:22).
shades.hadith_ar: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ حِزۡبُ اللَّهِ أَلَآ إِنَّ حِزۡبَ اللَّهِ هُمُ الۡمُفۡلِحُونَ
shades.hadith_en: They are the party of Allah, indeed the party of Allah are the successful

shades.explanation: al-Mutahazzib (the partisan) in the Quran refers to one who joins a faction. The famous hadith states: Do not divide and become parties.
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَا تَكُونُواْ مِنَ الۡمُشۡرِكِينَ مِنَ الَّذِينَ فَرَّقُواْ دِينَهُمۡ وَكَانُواْ شِيَعًا
shades.hadith_en: Do not be of those who divided their religion

meaning.en: To create. The root denotes creation, origination, or innate nature.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡفَاءُ وَالطَّاءُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الخَلۡقِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: فَطَرَ: خَلَقَ. الفِطۡرَةُ: الطَّبِيعَةُ

quran_examples.ar: فَطَرَ السَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالۡأَرۡضَ
quran_examples.en: Originator of the heavens and earth

quran_examples.ar: فَاطِرِ السَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالۡأَرۡضِ
quran_examples.en: Originator of the heavens and earth

hadith.ar: كُلُّ مَوۡلُودٍۢ يُولَدُ عَلَى الۡفِطۡرَةِ
hadith.en: Every child is born upon the fitrah

hadith.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَ الۡخَلۡقَ عَلَى الۡفِطۡرَةِ
hadith.en: Allah created creation upon the fitrah

shades.explanation: al-Fitr (the creation) in the Quran refers to originating. The Quran says: The Originator of the heavens and earth (6:79).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنِّي وَجَّهۡتُ وَجۡهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالۡأَرۡضَ
shades.hadith_en: I have turned my face toward Him who created the heavens and earth

shades.explanation: al-Fitrah (the nature) in the Quran refers to the innate disposition. The famous hadith states: Every child is born upon the fitrah.
shades.hadith_ar: كُلُّ مَوۡلُودٍۢ يُولَدُ عَلَى الۡفِطۡرَةِ
shades.hadith_en: Every child is born upon the fitrah

shades.explanation: al-Fatir (the originator) in the Quran is a name of Allah. The Quran says: Praise be to Allah, Originator of the heavens and earth (35:1).
shades.hadith_ar: الۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ فَاطِرِ السَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالۡأَرۡضِ
shades.hadith_en: Praise be to Allah, Originator of the heavens and earth

shades.explanation: al-Infitar (the splitting) in the Quran refers to the sky splitting. The Quran says: When the sky is cleft asunder (82:1).
shades.hadith_ar: إِذَا السَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتۡ
shades.hadith_en: When the sky is cleft asunder

meaning.en: To uncover. The root denotes revealing, removing, or discovering.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡكَافُ وَالشِّينُ وَالۡفَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الإِزَالَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: كَشَفَ: أَزَالَ. كَشَفَ الضُّرَّ: نَفَاهُ

quran_examples.ar: فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُۥٓ إِلَّا هُوَ
quran_examples.en: None can remove it but Him

quran_examples.ar: فَلَمَّا كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُمُ الۡعَذَابَ
quran_examples.en: When We removed the punishment

hadith.ar: يُكۡشَفُ الۡحِجَابُ فَيَنظُرُونَ إِلَيۡهِ
hadith.en: The veil is removed and they see Him

hadith.ar: كَشَفَ اللَّهُ عَنۡهُ كُرۡبَةًۭ مِنۡ كُرَبِ الۡقِيَامَةِ
hadith.en: Allah removes a distress from him on Judgment Day

shades.explanation: al-Kashf (the unveiling) in the Quran refers to removing hardship. The Quran says: And when We remove the punishment from them (43:50).
shades.hadith_ar: فَلَمَّا كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُمُ الۡعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمۡ يَنكُثُونَ
shades.hadith_en: When We removed the punishment from them, they broke their promise

shades.explanation: al-Kashif (the remover) in the Quran refers to Allah who removes harm. The Quran says: And if Allah touches you with harm, none can remove it but Him (6:17).
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِن يَمۡسَسۡكَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّۢ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُۥٓ إِلَّا هُوَ
shades.hadith_en: If Allah touches you with harm, none can remove it but Him

shades.explanation: al-Ikhtishaf (the discovery) in the Quran refers to being revealed. The famous hadith states: Allah unveils the cover on Judgment Day.
shades.hadith_ar: يَكۡشِفُ اللَّهُ الۡحِجَابَ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيَامَةِ
shades.hadith_en: Allah unveils the veil on the Day of Judgment

shades.explanation: al-Makshuf (the uncovered) in the Quran refers to what is revealed. The famous hadith states: The covering will be removed and they will see Him.
shades.hadith_ar: يُكۡشَفُ الۡحِجَابُ فَيَنظُرُونَ إِلَيۡهِ
shades.hadith_en: The veil will be removed and they will look at Him

meaning.en: To play. The root denotes play, amusement, or sport.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: اللَّامُ وَالۡعَيۡنُ وَالۡبَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى التَّسۡلِيَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: لَعِبَ: لَهَا. اللَّعِبُ: ضِدُّ الجِدِّ

quran_examples.ar: وَمَا الۡحَيَوٰةُ الدُّنۡيَآ إِلَّا لَعِبٌۭ وَلَهۡوٌۭ
quran_examples.en: The worldly life is only play and amusement

quran_examples.ar: وَذَرِ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُواْ دِينَهُمۡ لَعِبًا
quran_examples.en: Leave those who take their religion as play

hadith.ar: كُلُّ مَا لَيۡسَ مِنۡ ذِكۡرِ اللَّهِ فَهُوَ لَعِبٌۭ
hadith.en: All not of Allah's remembrance is play

hadith.ar: إِنَّ الدُّنۡيَا لَعِبٌۭ وَلَهۡوٌۭ
hadith.en: The world is play and amusement

shades.explanation: al-LaEb (the play) in the Quran refers to amusement. The Quran says: And the life of this world is but play and amusement (6:32).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَا الۡحَيَوٰةُ الدُّنۡيَآ إِلَّا لَعِبٌۭ وَلَهۡوٌۭ
shades.hadith_en: The life of this world is but play and amusement

shades.explanation: al-LaEibun (the players) in the Quran refers to those who take life as play. The Quran says: And leave those who take their religion as play.
shades.hadith_ar: وَذَرِ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُواْ دِينَهُمۡ لَعِبًا وَلَهۡوًا
shades.hadith_en: Leave those who take their religion as play and amusement

shades.explanation: al-LaEb (the sport) in the Quran refers to idle activity. The famous hadith states: Everything that is not remembrance of Allah is play.
shades.hadith_ar: كُلُّ مَا لَيۡسَ مِنۡ ذِكۡرِ اللَّهِ فَهُوَ لَعِبٌ
shades.hadith_en: Everything that is not remembrance of Allah is play

shades.explanation: al-MalaEb (the playgrounds) in the Quran refers to places of play. The famous hadith states: The world is but a playing field.
shades.hadith_ar: الدُّنۡيَا مَلۡعَبَةٌۭ
shades.hadith_en: The world is a playing ground

meaning.en: To dispute. The root denotes doubt, dispute, or argument.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡمِيمُ وَالرَّاءُ وَالۡيَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الجَدَلِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: مَارَاهُ: جَادَلَهُ. المِرۡيَةُ: الشَّكُّ

quran_examples.ar: فَلَا تَكُن فِي مِرۡيَةٍۢ مِّن لِّقَآئِهِۦ
quran_examples.en: Be not in doubt about meeting Him

quran_examples.ar: فَوَيۡلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ يُمَارُونَ
quran_examples.en: Woe to those who dispute

hadith.ar: أَنَا زَعِيمٌۢ بِبَيۡتٍۢ فِي رَبَضِ الۡجَنَّةِ لِمَن تَرَكَ الۡمِرَآءَ
hadith.en: I guarantee a house in Paradise for one who leaves disputation

hadith.ar: أَبۡغَضُ الرِّجَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ الأَلَدُّ الخَصِمُ
hadith.en: The most hated man to Allah is the quarrelsome

shades.explanation: al-Mirya' (the doubt) in the Quran refers to uncertainty. The Quran says: So be not in doubt about meeting Him (32:23).
shades.hadith_ar: فَلَا تَكُن فِي مِرۡيَةٍۢ مِّن لِّقَآئِهِۦ
shades.hadith_en: So be not in doubt about meeting Him

shades.explanation: al-Mumarayah (the disputation) in the Quran refers to arguing. The famous hadith states: I guarantee a house in Paradise for one who abandons disputation.
shades.hadith_ar: أَنَا زَعِيمٌۢ بِبَيۡتٍۢ فِي رَبَضِ الۡجَنَّةِ لِمَن تَرَكَ الۡمِرَآءَ
shades.hadith_en: I guarantee a house in Paradise for one who abandons disputation

shades.explanation: al-Mari (the disputer) in the Quran refers to one who argues. The famous hadith states: The most hated person to Allah is the quarrelsome.
shades.hadith_ar: أَبۡغَضُ الرِّجَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ الأَلَدُّ الخَصِمُ
shades.hadith_en: The most hated man to Allah is the quarrelsome

shades.explanation: al-Irtiya' (the hesitation) in the Quran refers to wavering. The famous hadith states: Doubt is from disbelief.
shades.hadith_ar: الرَّيۡبُ مِنَ الكُفۡرِ
shades.hadith_en: Doubt is from disbelief

meaning.en: To blow. The root denotes blowing, inflation, or inspiration.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: النُّونُ وَالۡفَاءُ وَالۡخَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى النَّفۡثِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: نَفَخَ: نَفَثَ. نَفۡخُ الرُّوحِ: إِدۡخَالُهَا

quran_examples.ar: وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ
quran_examples.en: And the trumpet was blown

quran_examples.ar: وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي
quran_examples.en: I have blown into him of My spirit

hadith.ar: الصُّورُ قَرۡنٌۭ يُنفَخُ فِيهِ
hadith.en: The trumpet is a horn that is blown

hadith.ar: بَيۡنَ النَّفۡخَتَيۡنِ أَرۡبَعُونَ
hadith.en: Between the two blasts is forty

shades.explanation: an-Nafkh (the blowing) in the Quran refers to the trumpet. The Quran says: And the trumpet will be blown (39:68).
shades.hadith_ar: وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ
shades.hadith_en: And the trumpet was blown

shades.explanation: an-Nafkhah (the blast) in the Quran refers to a single blast. The Quran says: The Day the trumpet is blown and We gather the sinners blue-eyed (20:102).
shades.hadith_ar: يَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ وَنَحۡشُرُ الۡمُجۡرِمِينَ يَوۡمَئِذٍۢ زُرۡقًا
shades.hadith_en: The Day the trumpet is blown and We gather the criminals blue-eyed

shades.explanation: al-Munfakh (the inflated) in the Quran refers to the spirit. The Quran says: And I have blown into him of My spirit (15:29).
shades.hadith_ar: فَإِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهُۥ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي
shades.hadith_en: When I have proportioned him and blown into him of My spirit

shades.explanation: an-Nafikh (the blower) in the Quran refers to the angel. The famous hadith states: The trumpet is a horn that is blown.
shades.hadith_ar: الصُّورُ قَرۡنٌۭ يُنفَخُ فِيهِ
shades.hadith_en: The trumpet is a horn that is blown

meaning.en: To select. The root denotes selection, palm tree, or choice.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: النُّونُ وَالۡخَاءُ وَاللَّامُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الشَّجَرِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: نَخَلَ: اخۡتَارَ. النَّخۡلُ: شَجَرٌ مَعۡرُوفٌ

quran_examples.ar: وَمِن ثَمَرَٰتِ النَّخِيلِ وَالأَعۡنَٰبِ
quran_examples.en: From date palms and grapes

quran_examples.ar: وَالنَّخۡلَ بَاسِقَٰتٍۢ لَّهَا طَلۡعٌۭ نَّضِيدٌۭ
quran_examples.en: And date palms with emerging spathes

hadith.ar: مَثَلُ الۡمُؤۡمِنِ كَمَثَلِ النَّخۡلَةِ
hadith.en: The believer is like the date palm

hadith.ar: إِنَّ مِنَ النَّخۡلِ مَا يُؤۡكَلُ مِنۡهُ
hadith.en: From the date palm there is what is eaten

shades.explanation: an-Nakhl (the palm tree) in the Quran refers to date palms. The Quran says: And from the fruits of the date palms and the grapes (16:67).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمِن ثَمَرَٰتِ النَّخِيلِ وَالأَعۡنَٰبِ
shades.hadith_en: And from the fruits of date palms and grapes

shades.explanation: an-Nakhil (the date palms) in the Quran refers to palm trees. The Quran says: And date palms with emerging spathes (50:10).
shades.hadith_ar: وَالنَّخۡلَ بَاسِقَٰتٍۢ لَّهَا طَلۡعٌۭ نَّضِيدٌۭ
shades.hadith_en: And date palms with emerging spathes

shades.explanation: an-Nikhlah (the selection) in the Quran refers to choosing. The famous hadith states: People are like date palms; you do not know their worth until the end.
shades.hadith_ar: النَّاسُ كَالإِبِلِ الۡمِئَةِ لَا تَجِدُ فِيهَا رَاحِلَةً
shades.hadith_en: People are like a hundred camels; you hardly find one worthy to ride

shades.explanation: al-Mankhal (the sieve) in the Quran refers to a tool for selection. The famous hadith states: The example of the believer is like the date palm.
shades.hadith_ar: مَثَلُ الۡمُؤۡمِنِ كَمَثَلِ النَّخۡلَةِ
shades.hadith_en: The example of the believer is like the date palm

meaning.en: To remove. The root denotes removing, extracting, or struggling.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: النُّونُ وَالزَّايُ وَالۡعَيۡنُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الإِزَالَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: نَزَعَ: قَلَعَ. النَّازِعَاتُ: الۡمَلَائِكَةُ

quran_examples.ar: وَنَزَعۡنَا مَا فِي صُدُورِهِم مِّنۡ غِلٍّۢ
quran_examples.en: We remove rancor from their breasts

quran_examples.ar: وَالنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرۡقًا
quran_examples.en: By those who extract with violence

hadith.ar: يَنزِعُ اللَّهُ الۡغِلَّ مِن صُدُورِ الۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
hadith.en: Allah removes rancor from believers' hearts

hadith.ar: الۡمُؤۡمِنُ الۡقَوِيُّ خَيۡرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ
hadith.en: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah

shades.explanation: an-NazE (the removal) in the Quran refers to taking out. The Quran says: And We will remove whatever rancor is in their breasts (7:43).
shades.hadith_ar: وَنَزَعۡنَا مَا فِي صُدُورِهِم مِّنۡ غِلٍّۢ
shades.hadith_en: And We will remove whatever rancor is in their breasts

shades.explanation: an-Nazi' (the extractor) in the Quran refers to the angel of death. The Quran says: By those who extract with violence (79:1).
shades.hadith_ar: وَالنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرۡقًا
shades.hadith_en: By those who extract with violence

shades.explanation: an-Naza' (the struggle) in the Quran refers to dispute. The famous hadith states: Dispute weakens the faith.
shades.hadith_ar: النِّزَاعُ يُضۡعِفُ الإِيمَانَ
shades.hadith_en: Dispute weakens faith

shades.explanation: al-Munaza'ah (the contest) in the Quran refers to contention. The famous hadith states: The strong believer is better than the weak believer.
shades.hadith_ar: الۡمُؤۡمِنُ الۡقَوِيُّ خَيۡرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ
shades.hadith_en: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah

meaning.en: To increase. The root denotes growth, increase, or usury.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الرَّاءُ وَالۡبَاءُ وَالۡوَاوُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الزِّيَادَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: رَبَا: زَادَ. الرِّبَا: الزِّيَادَةُ المُحَرَّمَةُ

quran_examples.ar: وَأَحَلَّ اللَّهُ الۡبَيۡعَ وَحَرَّمَ الرِّبَا
quran_examples.en: Allah permitted trade, forbade usury

quran_examples.ar: وَءَاوَيۡنَٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبۡوَةٍۢ
quran_examples.en: We gave them refuge on a height

hadith.ar: لَعَنَ اللَّهُ آكِلَ الرِّبَا وَمُوۡكِلَهُۥ وَكَاتِبَهُۥ وَشَاهِدَيۡهِ
hadith.en: Allah cursed the taker, giver, writer, and witnesses of usury

hadith.ar: الرِّبَا ثَلَاثَةٌۭ وَسَبۡعُونَ بَابًا
hadith.en: Usury has seventy-three gates

shades.explanation: ar-Ribw (the usury) in the Quran refers to interest. The Quran says: And Allah has permitted trade and forbidden usury (2:275).
shades.hadith_ar: وَأَحَلَّ اللَّهُ الۡبَيۡعَ وَحَرَّمَ الرِّبَا
shades.hadith_en: Allah has permitted trade and forbidden usury

shades.explanation: ar-Riba (the increase) in the Quran refers to unlawful gain. The Quran says: O you who believe, fear Allah and give up what remains of usury (2:278).
shades.hadith_ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ اتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ وَذَرُواْ مَا بَقِيَ مِنَ الرِّبَا
shades.hadith_en: Fear Allah and give up what remains of usury

shades.explanation: ar-Rabwah (the height) in the Quran refers to an elevated place. The Quran says: And We settled them in a secure, elevated place (23:50).
shades.hadith_ar: وَءَاوَيۡنَٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبۡوَةٍۢ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍۢ وَمَعِينٍۢ
shades.hadith_en: And We gave them refuge on a height, a level ground with flowing water

shades.explanation: al-Murabi (the usurer) in the Quran refers to one who takes interest. The famous hadith states: The curse of Allah is on the one who takes usury.
shades.hadith_ar: لَعَنَ اللَّهُ آكِلَ الرِّبَا وَمُوۡكِلَهُۥ
shades.hadith_en: Allah cursed the one who consumes usury and the one who pays it

meaning.en: To be lofty. The root denotes height, loftiness, or eminence.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: السِّينُ وَالنُّونُ وَالۡوَاوُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الرِّفۡعَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: سَنَا: عَلاَ. سَنِيٌّ: عَالٍ

quran_examples.ar: وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
quran_examples.en: None is equal to Him

quran_examples.ar: فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَأَرۡجُلَكُم مِّنۡ خِلَٰفٍۢ
quran_examples.en: I will cut off your hands and feet from opposite sides

hadith.ar: سُبۡحَانَ رَبِّيَ الأَعۡلَىٰ
hadith.en: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High

hadith.ar: لَيۡسَ كَمِثۡلِهِۦ شَيۡءٌۭ
hadith.en: There is nothing like unto Him

shades.explanation: as-Sanaw (the highness) in the Quran refers to loftiness. The Quran says: And there is none equal to Him (112:4).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
shades.hadith_en: And there is none equal to Him

shades.explanation: as-Sani (the lofty) in the Quran refers to the exalted. The famous hadith states: Glory be to the Most High.
shades.hadith_ar: سُبۡحَانَ رَبِّيَ الأَعۡلَىٰ
shades.hadith_en: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High

shades.explanation: as-Sinaw (the eminence) in the Quran refers to dignity. The famous hadith states: The believers are the most noble.
shades.hadith_ar: الۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ أَكۡرَمُ النَّاسِ
shades.hadith_en: The believers are the most noble of people

shades.explanation: as-Sunw (the equal) in the Quran refers to resemblance. The famous hadith states: None is equal to Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: لَيۡسَ كَمِثۡلِهِۦ شَيۡءٌۭ
shades.hadith_en: There is nothing like unto Him

meaning.en: To ascend. The root denotes rising, ascending, or appearing.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الطَّاءُ وَاللَّامُ وَالۡعَيۡنُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الظُّهُورِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: طَلَعَ: ظَهَرَ. طُلُوعُ الشَّمۡسِ: شُرُوقُهَا

quran_examples.ar: وَتَرَى الشَّمۡسَ إِذَا طَلَعَت
quran_examples.en: You see the sun when it rises

quran_examples.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا الإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدۡحًاۭ فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
quran_examples.en: O man, you are laboring towards your Lord

hadith.ar: إِنَّكُمۡ سَتَرَوۡنَ رَبَّكُمۡ
hadith.en: You will certainly see your Lord

hadith.ar: مَنِ اطَّلَعَ إِلَىٰ مَا فِي يَدِ غَيۡرِهِ
hadith.en: Whoever looks at what is in another's hand

shades.explanation: at-TuluE (the rising) in the Quran refers to the sun's rising. The Quran says: And the sun rises over their cave (18:17).
shades.hadith_ar: وَتَرَى الشَّمۡسَ إِذَا طَلَعَت تَّزَٰوَرُ عَن كَهۡفِهِمۡ
shades.hadith_en: And you see the sun when it rises, it inclines away from their cave

shades.explanation: at-Tali' (the rising) in the Quran refers to what ascends. The Quran says: By the dawn when it brightens (81:18).
shades.hadith_ar: وَالصُّبۡحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
shades.hadith_en: And by the dawn when it breathes

shades.explanation: al-MutlaE (the view) in the Quran refers to the ascent. The famous hadith states: The people of Paradise will look at their Lord.
shades.hadith_ar: يَنظُرُونَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ
shades.hadith_en: They look at their Lord

shades.explanation: al-IttilaE (the knowledge) in the Quran refers to awareness. The famous hadith states: Indeed you are about to come upon your brothers.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّكُمۡ سَتَنظُرُونَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed you will see your Lord

meaning.en: To be dull. The root denotes city, land, or staying in place.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡبَاءُ وَاللَّامُ وَالدَّالُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى المَكَانِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: البَلَدُ: المَوۡضِعُ. بَلِدَ: أَقَامَ

quran_examples.ar: لَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِهَٰذَا الۡبَلَدِ
quran_examples.en: I swear by this city

quran_examples.ar: أَحۡيَيۡنَا بِهِ الۡبَلۡدَةَ الۡمَيۡتَ
quran_examples.en: We bring the dead land to life

hadith.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُحَرِّمُ مَا بَيۡنَ لَابَتَيۡهَا
hadith.en: O Allah, I declare sacred what is between its two lava fields

hadith.ar: خَيۡرُ الۡبِلَادِ مَكَّةُ
hadith.en: The best of cities is Makkah

shades.explanation: al-Balad (the city) in the Quran refers to a land. The Quran says: I swear by this city (90:1).
shades.hadith_ar: لَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِهَٰذَا الۡبَلَدِ
shades.hadith_en: I swear by this city

shades.explanation: al-Baladah (the land) in the Quran refers to a territory. The Quran says: And a dead land - We bring it to life (35:9).
shades.hadith_ar: فَأَحۡيَيۡنَا بِهِ الۡبَلۡدَةَ الۡمَيۡتَ
shades.hadith_en: And We bring the dead land to life

shades.explanation: al-Bilad (the countries) in the Quran refers to lands. The famous hadith states: The most beloved lands to Allah are its mosques.
shades.hadith_ar: أَحَبُّ البِلَادِ إِلَى اللَّهِ مَسَاجِدُهَا
shades.hadith_en: The most beloved lands to Allah are its mosques

shades.explanation: al-Baladi (the local) in the Quran refers to an inhabitant. The famous hadith states: The best of cities is Makkah.
shades.hadith_ar: خَيۡرُ الۡبِلَادِ مَكَّةُ
shades.hadith_en: The best of cities is Makkah

meaning.en: To be joyful. The root denotes fruit, delight, or enjoyment.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡفَاءُ وَالۡكَافُ وَالۡهَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الثَّمَرِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: فَكِهَ: سُرَّ. الفَاكِهَةُ: كُلُّ الثَّمَرِ

quran_examples.ar: لَهُمۡ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ
quran_examples.en: They have fruit therein

quran_examples.ar: وَفَٰكِهَةًۭ وَأَبًّا
quran_examples.en: And fruits and fodder

hadith.ar: إِنِّي لَأَمۡزَحُ وَلَآ أَقُولُ إِلَّا حَقًّا
hadith.en: I joke but only speak the truth

hadith.ar: ثَمَرَةُ الۡجَنَّةِ يُتۡنَاوَلُۭ
hadith.en: The fruit of Paradise is reachable

shades.explanation: al-Fakihah (the fruit) in the Quran refers to produce. The Quran says: And fruits from what they desire (36:57).
shades.hadith_ar: لَهُمۡ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
shades.hadith_en: They have fruit therein and whatever they call for

shades.explanation: al-Fawakih (the fruits) in the Quran refers to various fruits. The Quran says: And fruits and fodder (80:31).
shades.hadith_ar: وَفَٰكِهَةًۭ وَأَبًّا
shades.hadith_en: And fruits and fodder

shades.explanation: al-Fakih (the joker) in the Quran refers to one who jokes. The famous hadith states: I joke but I speak only the truth.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنِّي لَأَمۡزَحُ وَلَآ أَقُولُ إِلَّا حَقًّا
shades.hadith_en: I joke but I only speak the truth

shades.explanation: al-Fakah (the enjoyment) in the Quran refers to delight. The famous hadith states: The people of Paradise enjoy the best fruits.
shades.hadith_ar: أَهۡلُ الۡجَنَّةِ يَأۡكُلُونَ الفَٰكِهَةَ
shades.hadith_en: The people of Paradise eat fruits

meaning.en: To set. The root denotes setting, sunset, stranger, or west.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡغَيۡنُ وَالرَّاءُ وَالۡبَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى البُعۡدِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: غَرَبَتِ الشَّمۡسُ: غَابَتۡ. الغَرِيبُ: البَعِيدُ

quran_examples.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَغۡرِبَ الشَّمۡسِ
quran_examples.en: Until he reached the setting of the sun

quran_examples.ar: أَقِمِ الصَّلَوٰةَ طَرَفَيِ النَّهَارِ
quran_examples.en: Establish prayer at the ends of the day

hadith.ar: بَدَأَ الإِسۡلَامُ غَرِيبًاۭ وَسَيَعُودُ غَرِيبًاۭ
hadith.en: Islam began strange and will return strange

hadith.ar: طُوبَىٰ لِلۡغُرَبَاءِ
hadith.en: Blessed are the strangers

shades.explanation: al-Gharb (the west) in the Quran refers to the direction. The Quran says: And the sun sets (18:86).
shades.hadith_ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَغۡرِبَ الشَّمۡسِ
shades.hadith_en: Until when he reached the setting of the sun

shades.explanation: al-Ghurub (the sunset) in the Quran refers to setting. The Quran says: Establish prayer at the two ends of the day (11:114).
shades.hadith_ar: أَقِمِ الصَّلَوٰةَ طَرَفَيِ النَّهَارِ
shades.hadith_en: Establish prayer at the two ends of the day

shades.explanation: al-Gharib (the stranger) in the Quran refers to one far from home. The famous hadith states: Islam began as something strange.
shades.hadith_ar: بَدَأَ الإِسۡلَامُ غَرِيبًاۭ
shades.hadith_en: Islam began as something strange

shades.explanation: al-Gharab (the foreign) in the Quran refers to being away. The famous hadith states: The stranger will be blessed.
shades.hadith_ar: طُوبَىٰ لِلۡغُرَبَاءِ
shades.hadith_en: Blessed are the strangers

meaning.en: To be guided. The root denotes guidance, maturity, or right conduct.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الرَّاءُ وَالشِّينُ وَالدَّالُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الهِدَايَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: رَشِدَ: اهۡتَدَىٰ. الرَّشَادُ: الصَّوَابُ

quran_examples.ar: قَد تَّبَيَّنَ الرُّشۡدُ مِنَ الۡغَيِّ
quran_examples.en: Guidance is distinct from error

quran_examples.ar: يَهۡدِي إِلَى الرُّشۡدِ
quran_examples.en: It guides to the right course

hadith.ar: مَن دَلَّ عَلَىٰ خَيۡرٍۢ فَلَهُۥ مِثۡلُ أَجۡرِ فَاعِلِهِۦ
hadith.en: Whoever directs to good has a reward like the doer

hadith.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسۡأَلُكَ الهُدَىٰ وَالتُّقَىٰ
hadith.en: O Allah I ask You for guidance and piety

shades.explanation: ar-Rushd (the guidance) in the Quran refers to right guidance. The Quran says: There is no compulsion in religion; right guidance has become distinct from error (2:256).
shades.hadith_ar: لَآ إِكۡرَاهَ فِي الدِّينِ قَد تَّبَيَّنَ الرُّشۡدُ مِنَ الۡغَيِّ
shades.hadith_en: No compulsion in religion; guidance is distinct from error

shades.explanation: ar-Rashad (the maturity) in the Quran refers to right conduct. The Quran says: And if they knew, they would have rushed to guidance (37:102).
shades.hadith_ar: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ السَّعۡيَ
shades.hadith_en: When he reached the age of work with him

shades.explanation: ar-Rashid (the rightly guided) in the Quran refers to one who follows guidance. The famous hadith states: Be a wise, learned, or a student.
shades.hadith_ar: كُنۡ عَالِمًا أَوۡ مُتَعَلِّمًا
shades.hadith_en: Be a scholar or a student

shades.explanation: al-Irshad (the direction) in the Quran refers to guiding. The famous hadith states: Whoever guides to good is like the doer of good.
shades.hadith_ar: مَن دَلَّ عَلَىٰ خَيۡرٍۢ فَلَهُۥ مِثۡلُ أَجۡرِ فَاعِلِهِۦ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever directs to good has a reward like the doer

meaning.en: To kindle. The root denotes blazing, kindling, or burning.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: السِّينُ وَالۡعَيۡنُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الإِيقَادِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: سَعَرَ النَّارَ: أَشۡعَلَهَا. السَّعِيرُ: الجَحِيمُ

quran_examples.ar: لِيَكُونَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ
quran_examples.en: To the blazing fire

quran_examples.ar: كُلَّمَا خَبَتۡ زِدۡنَٰهُمۡ سَعِيرًا
quran_examples.en: Whenever it abates, We increase the blaze

hadith.ar: النَّارُ الَّتِي تُوقِدُونَ جُزۡءٌۭ مِن سَبۡعِينَ جُزۡءًۭا
hadith.en: The fire you kindle is 1 of 70 parts of Hell

hadith.ar: اتَّقُواْ النَّارَ وَلَوۡ بِشِقِّ تَمۡرَةٍۢ
hadith.en: Protect yourselves from fire even with half a date

shades.explanation: as-SaEir (the blaze) in the Quran refers to hellfire. The Quran says: And the blazing fire (31:21).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
shades.hadith_en: And they will be in a blazing fire

shades.explanation: as-SuEur (the kindling) in the Quran refers to burning. The famous hadith states: The fire of the children of Adam is a portion of the Hellfire.
shades.hadith_ar: النَّارُ الَّتِي تُوقِدُونَ جُزۡءٌۭ مِن سَبۡعِينَ جُزۡءًۭا مِن نَّارِ جَهَنَّمَ
shades.hadith_en: The fire you kindle is one part of the seventy parts of Hellfire

shades.explanation: al-MasEur (the fueled) in the Quran refers to what is set ablaze. The famous hadith states: The Hellfire was kindled for a thousand years.
shades.hadith_ar: أُجِّجَتۡ جَهَنَّمُ أَلۡفَ عَامٍۢ
shades.hadith_en: The Hellfire was kindled for a thousand years

shades.explanation: as-SaEirah (the burning) in the Quran refers to a large fire. The famous hadith states: Protect yourselves from the fire even with half a date.
shades.hadith_ar: اتَّقُواْ النَّارَ وَلَوۡ بِشِقِّ تَمۡرَةٍۢ
shades.hadith_en: Protect yourselves from the fire even with half a date

meaning.en: To think. The root denotes assumption, suspicion, or certainty.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الظَّاءُ وَالنُّونُ وَالنُّونُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى التَّرَدُّدِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: ظَنَّ: شَكَّ. الظَّنُّ: اعۡتِقَادٌ رَاجِحٌ

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ بَعۡضَ الظَّنِّ إِثۡمٌۭ
quran_examples.en: Some assumption is sin

quran_examples.ar: وَظَنَنتُمۡ ظَنَّ السَّوۡءِ
quran_examples.en: You assumed an evil assumption

hadith.ar: إِيَّاكُمۡ وَالظَّنَّ فَإِنَّ الظَّنَّ أَكۡذَبُ الۡحَدِيثِ
hadith.en: Avoid assumption for it is the most false speech

hadith.ar: إِذَا ظَنَنۡتُمۡ فَلَا تُحَقِّقُوا۟
hadith.en: If you assume, do not investigate

shades.explanation: az-Zann (the assumption) in the Quran refers to thought. The Quran says: Indeed some assumption is sin (49:12).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ بَعۡضَ الظَّنِّ إِثۡمٌۭ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed some assumption is sin

shades.explanation: az-Zanin (the suspecting) in the Quran refers to those who assume evil. The Quran says: And they assumed an evil assumption (48:12).
shades.hadith_ar: وَظَنَنتُمۡ ظَنَّ السَّوۡءِ
shades.hadith_en: And you assumed an evil assumption

shades.explanation: az-Zann (the certainty) in the Quran can also mean certainty. The Quran says: Those who are certain that they will meet their Lord (2:249).
shades.hadith_ar: الَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَٰقُواْ رَبِّهِمۡ
shades.hadith_en: Those who are certain they will meet their Lord

shades.explanation: al-Mazannah (the suspicion) in the Quran refers to what is suspected. The famous hadith states: Avoid suspicion, for it is the worst of lies.
shades.hadith_ar: إِيَّاكُمۡ وَالظَّنَّ فَإِنَّ الظَّنَّ أَكۡذَبُ الۡحَدِيثِ
shades.hadith_en: Avoid assumption, for it is the most false speech

meaning.en: To be fortified. The root denotes strength, fortress, or goodness.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡحَاءُ وَالصَّادُ وَالنُّونُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى المَنَعَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: حَصِنَ: تَحَصَّنَ. الحُصۡنُ: المَكَانُ الحَصِينُ

quran_examples.ar: فِي حُصُونٍۢۗ
quran_examples.en: In fortresses

quran_examples.ar: وَأَحۡسِن كَمَآ أَحۡسَنَ اللَّهُ إِلَيۡكَ
quran_examples.en: Do good as Allah has done good to you

hadith.ar: الإِحۡسَانُ أَن تَعۡبُدَ اللَّهَ كَأَنَّكَ تَرَاهُ
hadith.en: Worship Allah as if you see Him

hadith.ar: خَيۡرُكُمۡ أَحۡسَنُكُمۡ خُلُقًا
hadith.en: The best of you are the best in character

shades.explanation: al-Husn (the fortress) in the Quran refers to a stronghold. The Quran says: And take your fortifications (59:14).
shades.hadith_ar: فِي حُصُونٍۢۗ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ قَوۡمٌۭ لَّا يَعۡقِلُونَ
shades.hadith_en: In fortresses - that is because they are people who do not understand

shades.explanation: al-Hasan (the goodness) in the Quran refers to what is good. The Quran says: And do good as Allah has done good to you (28:77).
shades.hadith_ar: وَأَحۡسِن كَمَآ أَحۡسَنَ اللَّهُ إِلَيۡكَ
shades.hadith_en: And do good as Allah has done good to you

shades.explanation: al-Muhsin (the doer of good) in the Quran refers to the benevolent. The famous hadith states: The best among you are the best in character.
shades.hadith_ar: خَيۡرُكُمۡ أَحۡسَنُكُمۡ خُلُقًا
shades.hadith_en: The best of you are the best in character

shades.explanation: al-Ihsan (the excellence) in the Quran refers to worshiping Allah as if you see Him. The famous hadith states: Ihsan is to worship Allah as if you see Him.
shades.hadith_ar: الإِحۡسَانُ أَن تَعۡبُدَ اللَّهَ كَأَنَّكَ تَرَاهُ
shades.hadith_en: Ihsan is to worship Allah as if you see Him

meaning.en: To crawl. The root denotes creeping, moving slowly, or a creature.
meaning.ar: الدَّابَّةُ: كُلُّ مَا يَدِبُّ عَلَى الأَرۡضِ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الدَّالُ وَالۡبَاءُ وَالۡبَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الحَرَكَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: دَبَّ: مَشَىٰ رُوَيۡدًا. دَابَّةٌ: حَيَوَانٌ

quran_examples.ar: وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍۢ فِي الۡأَرۡضِ
quran_examples.en: No creature on earth

quran_examples.ar: أَخۡرَجۡنَا لَهُمۡ دَآبَّةًۭ مِّنَ الۡأَرۡضِ
quran_examples.en: We bring forth a creature from the earth

hadith.ar: خَيۡرُ الدَّوَابِّ الۡمُؤۡمِنُ
hadith.en: The best of creatures is the believer

hadith.ar: إِنَّ فِي الدَّوَابِّ شِفَاءً
hadith.en: In animals there is healing

shades.explanation: ad-Dabb (the crawling) in the Quran refers to movement on the earth. The Quran says: And there is no creature on earth but that its provision is upon Allah (11:6).
shades.hadith_ar: وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍۢ فِي الۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ رِزۡقُهَا
shades.hadith_en: There is no creature on earth but its provision is upon Allah

shades.name_ar: الدَّابَّةُ - كُلُّ مَا يَدِبُّ عَلَى الأَرۡضِ
shades.explanation: ad-Dabbah (the creature) in the Quran refers to all living beings. The Quran says: And the beast from the earth will speak to them (27:82).
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِذَا وَقَعَ الۡقَوۡلُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ أَخۡرَجۡنَا لَهُمۡ دَآبَّةًۭ مِّنَ الۡأَرۡضِ
shades.hadith_en: When the word falls upon them, We extract for them a creature from the earth

shades.explanation: ad-Dabb (the bear) in the Quran refers to an animal. The famous hadith states: The creature that will emerge from the earth will speak.
shades.hadith_ar: تَخۡرُجُ دَآبَّةٌۭ فَتُكَلِّمُهُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: A creature will emerge and speak to them

shades.explanation: ad-Dawab (the beasts) in the Quran refers to animals. The famous hadith states: The best creature is the believer.
shades.hadith_ar: خَيۡرُ الدَّوَابِّ الۡمُؤۡمِنُ
shades.hadith_en: The best of creatures is the believer

meaning.en: Near. The root denotes proximity, nearness, or presence (from Allah).

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: اللَّامُ وَالدَّالُ وَالنُّونُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى العِنۡدِيَّةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: لَدُنۡ: عِنۡدَ. مِن لَّدُنۡهُ: مِنۡ عِندِهِۦ

quran_examples.ar: وَعَلَّمۡنَٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلۡمًا
quran_examples.en: We taught him knowledge from Us

quran_examples.ar: يَخۡتَصُّ بِرَحۡمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ
quran_examples.en: He chooses for His mercy whom He wills

hadith.ar: قَلۡبُ الۡمُؤۡمِنِ بَيۡنَ إِصۡبَعَيۡنِ مِنۡ أَصَابِعِ الرَّحۡمَٰنِ
hadith.en: The believer's heart is between the fingers of the Most Merciful

hadith.ar: لَن يَدۡخُلَ أَحَدٌ الۡجَنَّةَ بِعَمَلِهِۦ
hadith.en: None enters Paradise by his deeds alone

shades.explanation: al-Ladun (the near side) in the Quran refers to proximity. The Quran says: And We taught him knowledge from Us (18:65).
shades.hadith_ar: ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ رَحۡمَةًۭ مِّنۡ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمۡنَٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلۡمًا
shades.hadith_en: We gave him mercy from Us and taught him from Us knowledge

shades.explanation: al-Laduniyy (the divine knowledge) in the Quran refers to sacred knowledge. The famous hadith states: O Allah, grant me knowledge of the unseen from You.
shades.hadith_ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَلۡهِمۡنِي رُشۡدِي
shades.hadith_en: O Allah, inspire me with my guidance

shades.explanation: al-Ladun (the presence) in the Quran refers to the divine presence. The famous hadith states: The believer's heart is between the fingers of the Most Merciful.
shades.hadith_ar: قَلۡبُ الۡمُؤۡمِنِ بَيۡنَ إِصۡبَعَيۡنِ مِنۡ أَصَابِعِ الرَّحۡمَٰنِ
shades.hadith_en: The believer's heart is between two fingers of the Most Merciful

shades.explanation: al-Muladdin (the bereft) in the Quran refers to one who is alone. The famous hadith states: None is saved except by the mercy of Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: لَن يَدۡخُلَ أَحَدٌ الۡجَنَّةَ بِعَمَلِهِۦ
shades.hadith_en: None enters Paradise by his deeds alone

meaning.en: To establish. The root denotes place, power, or ability.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡمِيمُ وَالۡكَافُ وَالنُّونُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى القُدۡرَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: مَكَنَ: قَدَرَ. المَكَانَةُ: المَنَزِلَةُ

quran_examples.ar: الَّذِينَ إِن مَّكَّنَّٰهُمۡ فِي الۡأَرۡضِ
quran_examples.en: Those We establish in the land

quran_examples.ar: اللَّهُ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الۡأَرۡضَ قَرَارًا
quran_examples.en: Allah made the earth a stable place

hadith.ar: اللَّهُ يُمَكِّنُ مَن يَشَآءُ
hadith.en: Allah empowers whom He wills

hadith.ar: قَلۡبُ الۡمُؤۡمِنِ مُثَبَّتٌۭ بِالإِيمَانِ
hadith.en: The believer's heart is established in faith

shades.explanation: al-Makan (the place) in the Quran refers to a location. The Quran says: Allah is the One who made the earth a stable place for you (40:64).
shades.hadith_ar: اللَّهُ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الۡأَرۡضَ قَرَارًا
shades.hadith_en: Allah is the One who made the earth a stable place for you

shades.explanation: al-Makkinah (the power) in the Quran refers to authority. The Quran says: And those We established in the land (22:41).
shades.hadith_ar: الَّذِينَ إِن مَّكَّنَّٰهُمۡ فِي الۡأَرۡضِ
shades.hadith_en: Those whom We establish in the land

shades.explanation: al-Makn (the ability) in the Quran refers to capability. The famous hadith states: The believer's heart is firmly established in faith.
shades.hadith_ar: قَلۡبُ الۡمُؤۡمِنِ مُثَبَّتٌۭ بِالإِيمَانِ
shades.hadith_en: The believer's heart is firmly established in faith

shades.explanation: at-Tamkin (the establishment) in the Quran refers to empowerment. The famous hadith states: Allah empowers whom He wills.
shades.hadith_ar: اللَّهُ يُمَكِّنُ مَن يَشَآءُ
shades.hadith_en: Allah empowers whom He wills

meaning.en: To be bored. The root denotes boredom, weariness, or religious creed.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡمِيمُ وَاللَّامُ وَاللَّامُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى المَلَلِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: مَلَّ: سَئِمَ. المِلَّةُ: الشَّرِيعَةُ

quran_examples.ar: اتَّبِعۡ مِلَّةَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفًا
quran_examples.en: Follow the creed of Abraham

quran_examples.ar: وَقَالُواْ قُلُوبُنَا غُلۡفٌۢ
quran_examples.en: They said our hearts are wrapped

hadith.ar: لَا تُشَدِّدُواْ عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِكُمۡ
hadith.en: Do not make things hard on yourselves

hadith.ar: أَحَبُّ الدِّينِ إِلَى اللَّهِ الحَنِيفِيَّةُ السَّمۡحَةُ
hadith.en: The most beloved religion to Allah is the easy and true one

shades.explanation: al-Malal (the boredom) in the Quran refers to weariness. The Quran says: And they say: Our hearts are wrapped up (2:88).
shades.hadith_ar: وَقَالُواْ قُلُوبُنَا غُلۡفٌۢ
shades.hadith_en: And they said our hearts are wrapped

shades.explanation: al-Millah (the creed) in the Quran refers to a religious community. The Quran says: Follow the creed of Abraham, a man of pure faith (16:123).
shades.hadith_ar: ثُمَّ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ أَنِ اتَّبِعۡ مِلَّةَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفًا
shades.hadith_en: Then We inspired you: Follow the creed of Abraham, inclining toward truth

shades.explanation: al-Milal (the sects) in the Quran refers to various religions. The famous hadith states: The best of faith is the creed of Abraham.
shades.hadith_ar: خَيۡرُ المِلَلِ مِلَّةُ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
shades.hadith_en: The best of creeds is the creed of Abraham

shades.explanation: al-Malil (the bored) in the Quran refers to one who tires easily. The famous hadith states: Do not be harsh with yourselves.
shades.hadith_ar: لَا تُشَدِّدُواْ عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِكُمۡ
shades.hadith_en: Do not be severe on yourselves

meaning.en: To flee. The root denotes fleeing, aversion, or a group of people.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: النُّونُ وَالۡفَاءُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الفِرَارِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: نَفَرَ: فَرَّ. النَّفۡرُ: عِدَّةُ رِجَالٍ

quran_examples.ar: وَلَوۡ أَرَادُواْ الۡخُرُوجَ لَأَعَدُّواْ
quran_examples.en: If they had desired to go forth, they would have prepared

quran_examples.ar: وَمَا كَانَ الۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ لِيَنفِرُواْ كَآفَّةًۭ
quran_examples.en: The believers should not go forth all together

hadith.ar: إِذَا نُودِيَ بِالۡجِهَادِ فَانۡفِرُواْ
hadith.en: When jihad is called, go forth

hadith.ar: خَيۡرُ النَّاسِ قَرۡنِي
hadith.en: The best of people are my generation

shades.explanation: an-Nifar (the fleeing) in the Quran refers to running away. The Quran says: And if they had desired to go forth, they would have prepared for it (9:46).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلَوۡ أَرَادُواْ الۡخُرُوجَ لَأَعَدُّواْ لَهُۥ عُدَّةًۭ
shades.hadith_en: If they had desired to go forth, they would have prepared

shades.explanation: an-Nafir (the fugitive) in the Quran refers to one who flees. The Quran says: And they fled to the mountain (26:64).
shades.hadith_ar: وَأَزۡلَفۡنَا ثَمَّ الۡأٓخَرِينَ
shades.hadith_en: And We brought the others near

shades.explanation: an-Nafr (the people) in the Quran refers to a group. The famous hadith states: The best of people are my generation.
shades.hadith_ar: خَيۡرُ النَّاسِ قَرۡنِي
shades.hadith_en: The best of people are my generation

shades.explanation: al-Istinfa (the urgency) in the Quran refers to being called to mobilization. The famous hadith states: When you are called to jihad, go forth.
shades.hadith_ar: إِذَا نُودِيَ بِالۡجِهَادِ فَانۡفِرُواْ
shades.hadith_en: When jihad is called, go forth

meaning.en: To return. The root denotes returning, alternating, or repenting.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: النُّونُ وَالۡوَاوُ وَالۡبَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الرُّجُوعِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: نَابَ: رَجَعَ. المُنِيبُ: التَّائِبُ

quran_examples.ar: وَتِلۡكَ الۡأَيَّامُ نُدَاوِلُهَا بَيۡنَ النَّاسِ
quran_examples.en: We alternate days among people

quran_examples.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَقۡبَلُ التَّوۡبَةَ عَنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ
quran_examples.en: He accepts repentance from His servants

hadith.ar: تُوبُواْ إِلَىٰ اللَّهِ تَوۡبَةًۭ نَصُوحًا
hadith.en: Turn to Allah with sincere repentance

hadith.ar: خَيۡرُ النَّاسِ التَّوَّابُونَ
hadith.en: The best of people are the repentant

shades.explanation: an-Nawb (the turn) in the Quran refers to alternating. The Quran says: And We alternate these days among the people (3:140).
shades.hadith_ar: وَتِلۡكَ الۡأَيَّامُ نُدَاوِلُهَا بَيۡنَ النَّاسِ
shades.hadith_en: And those days We alternate among people

shades.explanation: an-Nawbah (the alternation) in the Quran refers to a period. The famous hadith states: Allah alternates the days among the people.
shades.hadith_ar: اللَّهُ يُدَاوِلُ الأَيَّامَ
shades.hadith_en: Allah alternates the days

shades.explanation: al-Manab (the place of return) in the Quran refers to the final destination. The famous hadith states: The best of people is the one who repents.
shades.hadith_ar: خَيۡرُ النَّاسِ التَّوَّابُونَ
shades.hadith_en: The best of people are those who repent

shades.explanation: al-Munib (the repentant) in the Quran refers to one who turns to Allah. The famous hadith states: Turn to your Lord before you die.
shades.hadith_ar: تُوبُواْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمۡ قَبۡلَ أَن تَمُوتُواْ
shades.hadith_en: Turn to your Lord before you die

meaning.en: To seize. The root denotes control, firmness, or mastery.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الضَّادُ وَالۡبَاءُ وَالطَّاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الإِمۡسَاكِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: ضَبَطَ: أَمۡسَكَ بِقُوَّةٍۢ

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّا سَخَّرۡنَا الۡجِبَالَ مَعَهُ
quran_examples.en: We subjected the mountains with him

quran_examples.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ اصۡبِرُواْ وَصَابِرُواْ وَرَابِطُواْ
quran_examples.en: Be patient, persevere, and hold firm

hadith.ar: الۡمُؤۡمِنُ الۡقَوِيُّ خَيۡرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ
hadith.en: The strong believer is better and more beloved

hadith.ar: عَلَيۡكُم بِسُنَّتِي وَسُنَّةِ الۡخُلَفَاءِ الرَّاشِدِينَ
hadith.en: Hold fast to my Sunnah

shades.explanation: ad-Dabt (the control) in the Quran refers to firm grasp. The Quran says: And they seize them (keeping them in bondage).
shades.hadith_ar: وَآخِذِينَ بِأَمۡرِ رَبِّهِمۡ
shades.hadith_en: And seizing the command of their Lord

shades.explanation: ad-Dabit (the controller) in the Quran refers to one who has firm control. The famous hadith states: A strong believer is better than a weak believer.
shades.hadith_ar: الۡمُؤۡمِنُ الۡقَوِيُّ خَيۡرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ
shades.hadith_en: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah

shades.explanation: ad-Dabt (the mastery) in the Quran refers to precision. The famous hadith states: memorize the Quran and master it.
shades.hadith_ar: تَعَاهَدُواْ الۡقُرۡآنَ فَلَهُوَ أَشَدُّ تَفَصِّيًا
shades.hadith_en: Review the Quran regularly, it escapes faster

shades.explanation: ad-Dabt (the firmness) in the Quran refers to steadfastness. The famous hadith states: Hold fast to my Sunnah.
shades.hadith_ar: عَلَيۡكُم بِسُنَّتِي
shades.hadith_en: Hold fast to my Sunnah

meaning.en: To dispute. The root denotes argument, contention, or adversary.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡخَاءُ وَالصَّادُ وَالۡمِيمُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى المُنَازَعَةِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: خَصِمَ: جَادَلَ. الخَصۡمُ: المُنَازِعُ

quran_examples.ar: وَإِن طَآئِفَتَانِ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ اقۡتَتَلُواْ
quran_examples.en: If two parties of believers fight

quran_examples.ar: وَجَآءَتۡهُ قَوۡمُهُۥ يُهۡرَعُونَ إِلَيۡهِ
quran_examples.en: His people came rushing

hadith.ar: أَبۡغَضُ الرِّجَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ الأَلَدُّ الخَصِمُ
hadith.en: The most hated man to Allah is the quarrelsome

hadith.ar: لَا تَخَاصِمۡ أَخَاكَ فَتَذۡهَبَ مَرَوۡأَتُكَ
hadith.en: Do not dispute with your brother or you lose your honor

shades.explanation: al-Khusumah (the dispute) in the Quran refers to argument. The Quran says: And he came to his people disputing (11:74).
shades.hadith_ar: وَجَآءَتۡهُ قَوۡمُهُۥ يُهۡرَعُونَ إِلَيۡهِ
shades.hadith_en: And his people came rushing to him

shades.explanation: al-Khasm (the adversary) in the Quran refers to an opponent. The Quran says: And if two parties among the believers fight (49:9).
shades.hadith_ar: وَإِن طَآئِفَتَانِ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ اقۡتَتَلُواْ
shades.hadith_en: And if two parties of believers fight

shades.explanation: al-Khasim (the quarrelsome) in the Quran refers to a contentious person. The famous hadith states: The most hated man to Allah is the quarrelsome.
shades.hadith_ar: أَبۡغَضُ الرِّجَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ الأَلَدُّ الخَصِمُ
shades.hadith_en: The most hated man to Allah is the quarrelsome

shades.explanation: al-Ikhtisam (the mutual fighting) in the Quran refers to conflict. The famous hadith states: Do not dispute with your brother.
shades.hadith_ar: لَا تَخَاصِمۡ أَخَاكَ
shades.hadith_en: Do not dispute with your brother

meaning.en: To rise (sun). The root denotes east, sunrise, or radiating.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الشِّينُ وَالرَّاءُ وَالۡقَافُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الإِشۡرَاقِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: شَرَقَتِ الشَّمۡسُ: طَلَعَتۡ. المَشۡرِقُ: مَطۡلَعُهَا

quran_examples.ar: وَلِلَّهِ الۡمَشۡرِقُ وَالۡمَغۡرِبُ
quran_examples.en: To Allah belongs the east and west

quran_examples.ar: إِذَا طَلَعَت تَّزَٰوَرُ عَن كَهۡفِهِمۡ
quran_examples.en: When it rose, it inclined away from their cave

hadith.ar: رَبُّ الۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ وَرَبُّ الۡمَغۡرِبَيۡنِ
hadith.en: Lord of the two easts and two wests

hadith.ar: أَيُّرَ شَيۡءٍۢ فِي الإِسۡلَامِ أَفۡضَلُ؟ قَالَ الصَّلَاةُ عَلَىٰ وَقۡتِهَا
hadith.en: What is the best deed in Islam? Prayer on time

shades.explanation: ash-Sharq (the east) in the Quran refers to the direction. The Quran says: To Allah belong the east and the west (2:115).
shades.hadith_ar: وَلِلَّهِ الۡمَشۡرِقُ وَالۡمَغۡرِبُ
shades.hadith_en: To Allah belongs the east and the west

shades.explanation: al-Mashriq (the sunrise direction) in the Quran refers to the east side. The Quran says: And the sun rises over their cave from the east (18:17).
shades.hadith_ar: وَتَرَى الشَّمۡسَ إِذَا طَلَعَت تَّزَٰوَرُ عَن كَهۡفِهِمۡ ذَاتَ الۡيَمِينِ
shades.hadith_en: You see the sun when it rises, it inclines to the right of their cave

shades.explanation: al-Mashariq (the easts) in the Quran refers to the rising points. The famous hadith states: The east and the west belong to Allah.
shades.hadith_ar: رَبُّ الۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ وَرَبُّ الۡمَغۡرِبَيۡنِ
shades.hadith_en: Lord of the two easts and Lord of the two wests

shades.explanation: ash-Shariq (the eastern) in the Quran refers to the orient. The famous hadith states: The best of deeds is prayer at its proper time.
shades.hadith_ar: الصَّلَاةُ عَلَىٰ وَقۡتِهَا
shades.hadith_en: Prayer at its proper time

meaning.en: To return. The root denotes returning, repenting, or homecoming.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡهَمۡزَةُ وَالۡوَاوُ وَالۡبَاءُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الرُّجُوعِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: أَابَ: رَجَعَ. الأَوَّابُ: المُطِيعُ التَّائِبُ

quran_examples.ar: وَالطَّيۡرُ مَحۡشُورَةٌۭ كُلٌّۭ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
quran_examples.en: The birds gathered, all turn to Him

quran_examples.ar: نِعۡمَ الۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
quran_examples.en: An excellent servant, indeed oft-returning

hadith.ar: إَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ الرُّجۡعَىٰ
hadith.en: Indeed to your Lord is the return

hadith.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِلَيۡكَ الۡمَآبُ وَالۡمُنتَهَىٰ
hadith.en: O Allah, to You is the return and the ultimate end

shades.explanation: al-Awb (the return) in the Quran refers to coming back. The Quran says: And the birds in flocks - all turn to Him (38:19).
shades.hadith_ar: وَالطَّيۡرُ مَحۡشُورَةٌۭ كُلٌّۭ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
shades.hadith_en: And the birds gathered - all turn to Him

shades.explanation: al-Awwab (the repentant) in the Quran refers to one who repeatedly turns to Allah. The Quran says: Indeed he was oft-returning to Allah (38:44).
shades.hadith_ar: نِعۡمَ الۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
shades.hadith_en: Excellent servant; indeed he was oft-returning

shades.explanation: al-Maab (the final return) in the Quran refers to the final destination. The famous hadith states: O Allah, to You is the return.
shades.hadith_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِلَيۡكَ الۡمَآبُ
shades.hadith_en: O Allah, to You is the return

shades.explanation: al-Iyab (the homecoming) in the Quran refers to returning home. The famous hadith states: Verily to Allah is your return.
shades.hadith_ar: إَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ الرُّجۡعَىٰ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed to your Lord is the return

meaning.en: To seek refuge. The root denotes seeking protection, shelter, or sanctuary.

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الۡعَيۡنُ وَالۡوَاوُ وَالذَّالُ أَصۡلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الۡلُّجُوءِ
lexical_analysis.al_raghib: عَاذَ بِهِ: لَجَأَ إِلَيۡهِ. المَعَاذُ: المَلۡجَأُ

quran_examples.ar: إِنِّيٓ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ أَنۡ أَكُونَ مِنَ الۡجَٰهِلِينَ
quran_examples.en: I seek refuge in Allah from being among the ignorant

quran_examples.ar: فَاسۡتَعِذۡ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الۡعَلِيمُ
quran_examples.en: Seek refuge in Allah, He is the Hearing, the Knowing

hadith.ar: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيۡطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
hadith.en: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan

hadith.ar: إِذَا قَرَأۡتُمۡ فَاسۡتَعِذُواْ بِاللَّهِ
hadith.en: When you recite, seek refuge in Allah

shades.explanation: al-Eawdh (the refuge) in the Quran refers to seeking protection. The Quran says: I seek refuge in Allah from being among the ignorant (2:67).
shades.hadith_ar: إِنِّيٓ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ أَنۡ أَكُونَ مِنَ الۡجَٰهِلِينَ
shades.hadith_en: I seek refuge in Allah from being among the ignorant

shades.explanation: al-Eiyaadh (the seeking refuge) in the Quran refers to taking shelter. The famous hadith states: I seek refuge in You from the torment.
shades.hadith_ar: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنۡ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ
shades.hadith_en: I seek refuge in Allah from the punishment of Hell

shades.explanation: al-MaEadh (the sanctuary) in the Quran refers to a refuge. The famous hadith states: The mosque is a sanctuary.
shades.hadith_ar: المَسۡجِدُ حَرَمٌ
shades.hadith_en: The mosque is a sanctuary

shades.explanation: al-Eawdah (the protection) in the Quran refers to a charm. The famous hadith states: Protection by Allah is the best shield.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ أَمَانًا بِاللَّهِ أَفۡضَلُ
shades.hadith_en: Safety in Allah is best
